news.body: The Panthers D/ST allowed 276 passing yards, 157 rushing yards, and 33 points in a 35-33 win over the Panthers.
news.head: Panthers D/ST allows 33 points in Week 11 win
news.impact: The Panthers' defense tallied two sacks, one interception, and three fumble recoveries in the win Sunday. They will have a tough matchup with Tampa Bay in Week 12.

news.body: The Panthers D/ST allowed 187 passing yards, 49 rushing yards, and 17 points in a 20-17 win over the Saints.
news.head: Panthers D/ST allows 17 points in Week 10 win
news.impact: The Panthers' defense tallied three sacks, one interception, and one fumble recovery in the win. The defense did a great job limiting the Saints' rushing attack to 2.1 yards per carry. The Panthers will take on the Ravens in Week 11.

news.body: The Carolina Panthers' defense allowed 26 points and 312 total yards while recording one sack and one interception in the team's 26-21 loss to the Denver Broncos in Week 9.
news.head: Panthers D/ST records interception in Week 9
news.impact: Carolina intercepted Bo Nix and held Denver to 82 rushing yards. That's the good. The bad? The Panthers allowed 13 unanswered points in the fourth quarter, including touchdowns from Jonah Coleman and Pat Bryant. Carolina also recorded just one sack. The Panthers D/ST will look to rebound against the Saints in Week 10.

news.body: The Panthers D/ST allowed 27 points on 354 yards of offense, forcing three turnovers in Thursday's 27-19 loss to the Packers.
news.head: Panthers D/ST comes up with three takeaways in Thursday's loss
news.impact: The Panthers were not able to generate much of a pass rush, finishing Thursday's contest with zero sacks. However, the defense took the ball away twice, and the kickoff coverage unit recovered a fumble on the opening play. The Panthers also held the Packers to just 66 yards rushing on 26 attempts, but Green Bay has struggled to get the run going all season. The Panthers return home to play the Broncos in Week 9.

news.body: The Bears D/ST recorded one sack while also forcing one turnover (one interception) in a 39-35 win over the Lions in Week 12.
news.head: Bears D/ST quiet in Week 12
news.impact: The defense struggled to slow down a high-octane Lions offense, allowing 549 offensive yards in the win. The unit will look to return to its disruptive form against the Jacksonville Jaguars in Week 13.

news.body: The Bears D/ST forced two turnovers (one interception, one fumble recovery) while also registering six sacks in a 21-13 win over the Saints in Week 11.
news.head: Bears D/ST disruptive in Week 11
news.impact: The defense wreaked havoc against an underwhelming New Orleans offensive line, allowing less than 190 passing yards in the win. The unit will look for another disruptive performance against an explosive Detroit Lions offense in Week 12.

news.body: The Bears D/ST allowed 24 points while notching four sacks and forcing two turnovers in a 27-24 win over the Buccaneers in Week 9.
news.head: Bears D/ST scores TD in Week 9 win
news.impact: Chicago got a 67-yard pick-six from Jalon Johnson in the third quarter in a sloppy game with seven turnovers between the two teams. The Bears will be on bye in Week 10 before taking on the Saints in Week 11.

news.body: The Bears' D/ST logged three sacks and one interception while allowing 17 points in Monday night's win over the Seattle Seahawks.
news.head: Bears D/ST allows 17 points in win Monday
news.impact: Chicago's defense actually looked effective on Monday night. They were able to hold the Seahawks to just 17 points over the course of the game, which made it much easier for their own offense to put the game out of reach. This unit will have another primetime matchup against the Buccaneers in Week 9.

news.body: The Bengals D/ST allowed 22 points while picking up three sacks in a 22-20 loss to the Commanders in Week 11's Monday night game.
news.head: Bengals D/ST allows 22 points in Week 11 loss
news.impact: Cincinnati held the Commanders to just one touchdown in the game, but they allowed Jayden Daniels to complete two long passes to set up a game-winning field goal with less than a minute left in regulation. They will look to bounce back in Week 12 vs. the Saints.

news.body: The Bengals' D/ST logged three sacks and allowed just 18 points in Sunday's win over the Pittsburgh Steelers.
news.head: Bengals D/ST plays well in win Sunday
news.impact: Cincinnati's defense played great on Sunday night. They held the Steelers to just 18 points over the course of the game, though they weren't able to to log any turnovers in the process. This unit can be started in favorable matchups moving forward.

news.body: The Bengals D/ST allowed 162 passing yards, 157 rushing yards, and 17 points in a 34-17 win over the Falcons.
news.head: Bengals D/ST allows 17 points in Week 10 win
news.impact: The Bengals' defense tallied one interception, but did not record a sack. The Bengals' defense was able to keep the Falcons' passing attack in check and will look to pick up their seventh win of the season in Week 10 against the Steelers.

news.body: The Bengals D/ST allowed 36 points while picking up two sacks and forcing two turnovers in a 43-36 overtime win over the Titans in Week 8.
news.head: Bengals D/ST allows 36 points in Week 8
news.impact: Cincinnati's defense did not play well against the middling Tennessee offense. They did manage to recover two fumbles but overall it was a disappointing outing for the Bengals on defense. They will look to bounce back against the Falcons in Week 9.

news.body: The Browns D/ST allowed 24 points on 290 yards of total offense, recording one sack and one interception in Sunday's 27-24 win over the Texans.
news.head: Browns defense comes up with one sack, one pick in Week 10 win
news.impact: It appeared early on Sunday that the Browns' defense was going to be no match for the Texans' offense, as the latter put 17 points on the board within the game's first 20 minutes. The Browns deserve plenty of credit for making adjustments, allowing just seven more points the rest of the way and giving the offense a chance to come back in the game. The Browns' defense has been up-and-down this season. The unit will get a week off before taking on rookie QB Fernando Mendoza and the Raiders in Week 12.

news.body: The Cleveland Browns D/ST forced two fumbles against the Saints on Sunday, as well as racking up five sacks in the Browns' 23-22 loss.
news.head: Cleveland Browns force two fumbles in loss
news.impact: The Browns' defense made several great plays against the Saints, but to no avail in the end, as the Browns fell to 5-4. They are still a decent unit and can be streamed in the right matchup. That might not be the case next week, however, as they face the surging Texans.

news.body: The Browns defense allowed 27 points on 361 total yards with one sack and one interception on Sunday against the Steelers.
news.head: Browns D/ST struggles against run Sunday
news.impact: Jaylen Warren and Rico Dowdle combined to run for 199 yards on Sunday. Cleveland will face Tyler Shough and the Saints next week.

news.body: The Browns D/ST allowed 24 points while notching one sack and forcing two turnovers in a 27-24 win over the Titans in Week 7.
news.head: Browns D/ST forces two turnovers in Week 7
news.impact: Cleveland's defense struggled to slow Tony Pollard, who ran for three touchdowns, but they did enough to give the team their fifth win. They recovered a Carnell Tate fumble while Denzel Ward picked off Cam Ward in the contest. Cleveland will now prepare to face the Steelers on the road in Week 8.

news.body: The Cowboys D/ST recorded five sacks while also forcing one turnover (one interception) in a 39-38 loss to the Eagles in Week 12.
news.head: Cowboys D/ST racks up five sacks in Week 12
news.impact: The defense was unable to make stops down the stretch, blowing a 31-10 lead culminating in a Jake Elliott field goal to complete the Philadelphia comeback. The unit can remain off rosters in all formats ahead of a Week 13 contest against the Seattle Seahawks.

news.body: The Cowboys defense allowed 30 points on 346 total yards with five sacks and one fumble recovery on Sunday against the Titans.
news.head: Cowboys D/ST records five sacks Sunday
news.impact: Dallas had some success getting to Cam Ward on the day. They still remain well off the fantasy radar as a defense.

news.body: The Cowboys D/ST registered five sacks while failing to force any turnovers in a 46-40 loss to the 49ers in Week 10.
news.head: Cowboys D/ST dismal in Week 10
news.impact: The defense had no answers for an efficient 49ers offense, allowing three rushing and passing touchdowns along with a franchise-record 584 offensive yards in the loss. The unit remains difficult to roster in any format despite a more favorable Week 11 contest against the Tennessee Titans up next.

news.body: The Cowboys D/ST allowed 23 points while notching two sacks and forcing two turnovers in a 27-23 win over the Colts in Week 9.
news.head: Cowboys D/ST allows 23 points in Week 9
news.impact: Dallas struggled to keep a below-average Colts offense off the scoreboard, but they did intercept Daniel Jones once and recover a Jonathan Taylor fumble. Things won't get any easier for Dallas on defense in Week 10 vs. the 49ers.

news.body: The Broncos' defense allowed 24 points and 370 total yards while recording five sacks, one interception and one defensive touchdown in Denver's 38-24 win over the Raiders in Week 11.
news.head: Broncos D/ST scores touchdown in Week 11
news.impact: Denver allowed three touchdown passes to rookie quarterback Fernando Mendoza but also sacked him five times. And with the Broncos protecting a seven-point lead late in the fourth quarter, cornerback Ja'Quan McMillian returned an interception 35 yards for a touchdown. The sacks and defensive touchdown made up for the yardage and points allowed. Denver remains a must-start D/ST heading into Week 12 against Pittsburgh, leaving fantasy managers that dropped them during the bye down bad.

news.body: The Broncos' defense allowed 21 points and 353 total yards while recording three sacks, an interception, and a fumble recovery in Denver's 26-21 win over the Panthers in Week 9.
news.head: Broncos D/ST forces two turnovers in Week 9
news.impact: Nik Bonitto stripped Bryce Young and recovered the fumble with 1:24 remaining to secure Denver's fifth straight win. The Broncos also intercepted Young in the end zone during the third quarter. Denver allowed three passing touchdowns, but the three sacks and two takeaways helped offset the points allowed. The Broncos remain a strong fantasy defense, although they are entering their Week 10 bye.

news.body: The Broncos' defense allowed 24 points and 399 total yards while recording two sacks in Denver's 28-24 win over the Chiefs in Week 8.
news.head: Broncos D/ST allows 399 yards in Week 8
news.impact: Patrick Mahomes threw for 321 yards and three touchdowns, while Denver failed to force a turnover. So, this wasn't a productive fantasy day. That said, the Broncos held Kansas City scoreless in the fourth quarter and stopped the Chiefs at the one-yard line to end the game. Denver remains one of the better defenses in football despite the lack of fantasy production Sunday.

news.body: The Broncos' defense allowed 16 points and 353 total yards, while recording three sacks in Denver's Week 7 win over Arizona.
news.head: Broncos D/ST Holds Cardinals to 16 Points
news.impact: Denver didn't force a turnover, but the defense kept Arizona out of the end zone until the third quarter and held the Cardinals to 3.9 yards per carry. Jacoby Brissett also needed 48 attempts to reach 272 passing yards. The lack of takeaways limited the fantasy total, but Denver remains a weekly starting D/ST.

news.body: The Packers D/ST recorded one turnover (one interception) while also registering one sack in a 26-13 loss to the Rams in Week 12.
news.head: Packers D/ST disappoints in Week 12
news.impact: The defense was victimized by a physical Rams ground attack, allowing 241 rushing yards in the loss. The unit will look to get back on track against an inconsistent New Orleans Saints offense in Week 13.

news.body: The Packers D/ST registered three sacks while also forcing one turnover (one interception) in a 30-10 loss to the Vikings in Week 10.
news.head: Packers D/ST struggles in Week 10
news.impact: The defense was unable to offset a lackluster performance from the Green Bay offense, allowing three touchdowns and 336 offensive yards in the loss. The defense will look for more substantial impact in Week 12 against the Los Angeles Rams after the team's Week 11 bye.

news.body: The Packers D/ST recorded four sacks while also forcing four turnovers (three interceptions, one fumble recovery) in a 45-27 win over the Patriots in Week 9.
news.head: Packers D/ST disruptive in Week 9
news.impact: The defense took advantage of an overmatched New England offensive line, allowing less than 100 rushing yards in a winning effort. The unit will look for another disruptive performance against the Minnesota Vikings in Week 10.

news.body: The Packers D/ST held the Panthers to 19 points on 258 yards of total offense, recording six sacks and forcing two turnovers in Thursday's 27-19 win.
news.head: Packers defense racks up six sacks in Week 8 win
news.impact: The Packers have now won 4-of-5 games, giving up 20 or fewer points in all five weeks. The Green Bay defense has registered 15 sacks during that span, with six of them coming Thursday night. This is a unit still missing premier pass rusher Micah Parsons (knee), who is expected to return to practice in Week 9.

news.body: The Texans' defense gave up only three points on 167 yards of offense, registering a pair of sacks and one interception in Thursday's 26-3 rout of the Colts.
news.head: Texans D/ST dominates Colts on Thursday night
news.impact: The Texans' defense has been anything but predictable through 10 games this season, but the unit was in peak form against a struggling Colts' offense Thursday night. The Texans completely bottled up star running back Jonathan Taylor while not allowing veteran QB Daniel Jones to do much either. The Texans picked up two sacks in this one, bringing their season total to 35 - currently second in the NFL. The Ravens are up next.

news.body: The Texans D/ST allowed 27 points and 379 yards of total offense, registering four sacks and one interception in Sunday's 27-24 loss to the Browns.
news.head: Texans defense comes up with four sacks in Week 10 loss
news.impact: The Texans' defense made some impact plays Sunday, but ultimately the unit could not keep Browns QB Deshaun Watson from passing for over 300 yards and rushing for nearly 50 more. The Texans have been inconsistent on the defensive side for the most part, but an inviting matchup against the Colts awaits on Thursday.

news.body: The Texans' D/ST logged eight sacks, one interception, and one fumble recovery while allowing 22 points in Sunday's win over the Los Angeles Chargers.
news.head: Texans D/ST fantastic in win Sunday
news.impact: Houston's defense came to play on Sunday. They were able to make a number of big plays that led to a blowout win over the Chargers, though they allowed some points in garbage time. This unit should continue to be started in the favorable matchups they have over the next couple of weeks.

news.body: The Texans D/ST allowed 27 points on 420 total yards with three sacks on Sunday.
news.head: Texans D/ST struggles Sunday
news.impact: The Texans defense is not a must roster heading into their bye week.

news.body: The Jacksonville Jaguars D/ST managed a single sack and a fumble recovery in the team's 23-18 loss to the Giants on Sunday.
news.head: Jacksonville Jaguars quiet in loss to Giants
news.impact: The Jags' defense didn't get much going in the pass rush, with Giants QB JJ McCarthy only taking a single sack on the day and not throwing a pick. It wasn't the best showing by the defense, but they'll have a chance to bounce back against the Titans.

news.body: The Jacksonville Jaguars D/ST picked off Titans' QB Cam Ward once on Sunday to go along with a sack in the Jaguars' 40-23 win over the Titans.
news.head: Jacksonville Jaguars take care of business against Titans
news.impact: The Jaguars' defense took care of business in this game, though the Titans did their best to hang around for a while. They are looking like a great unit right now and could be a tough out in the playoffs to come.

news.body: The Jacksonville Jaguars D/ST had a sack, a fumble recovery and two interceptions in the Jags' 33-10 win over the Ravens on Thursday.
news.head: Jacksonville Jaguars handle Ravens in TNF win
news.impact: The Jags' defense dominated in this game, granted it didn't hurt that they were facing a third-string quarterback making his first NFL start on a short week. They held the Ravens to a measly 55 passing yards (counting sacks), and routinely messed up the Baltimore run game. They face off next against Tennessee.

news.body: The Jaguars D/ST gave up just seven points on 243 yards of offense, registering four sacks, one fumble recovery, and two interceptions in Sunday's 42-7 rout of the Colts.
news.head: Jaguars defense dominates in Week 8 blowout
news.impact: The Jaguars' defense scored off one of its interceptions in this one, as safety Rayuan Lane ran one back 92 yards to give the Jaguars a four-score lead going into halftime. This was a bounce-back performance for the Jaguars' defense, as the unit entered its Week 7 bye after a poor showing against the Texans. Jacksonville has now given up 17 or fewer points in five of seven games this season, and will take on a Ravens team facing a QB quandary on Thursday night. The Jaguars will be a popular play in Week 9.

news.body: The Chiefs D/ST allowed 155 passing yards, 75 rushing yards, and seven points in a 34-7 win over the Cardinals.
news.head: Chiefs D/ST allows seven points in Week 11 win
news.impact: The Chiefs' defense tallied three sacks but failed to force a turnover in the win. The defense will face a much tougher test when they take on Buffalo in Week 12.

news.body: The Chiefs D/ST forced two turnovers (one interception, one fumble recovery) while also recording three sacks in a 35-13 Week 10 win over the Falcons.
news.head: Chiefs D/ST forces two turnovers in Week 10
news.impact: The defense was able to make stops when it mattered, holding superstar running back Bijan Robinson to under 75 rushing yards in the win. The unit will look to take advantage of an underwhelming Arizona Cardinals offense led by quarterback Carson Beck in Week 11.

news.body: The Chiefs D/ST allowed 165 passing yards, 106 rushing yards, and 12 points in a 35-12 win over the Jets.
news.head: Chiefs D/ST allows 12 points in Week 9
news.impact: The Chiefs' defense tallied 5 sacks and one fumble recovery in the win over the Jets. They will take on a struggling Falcons' offense in Week 10.

news.body: The Chiefs' defense allowed 28 points and 294 total yards. while recording one sack in Kansas City's Week 8 loss to the Broncos.
news.head: Chiefs D/ST fails to force turnover in Week 8
news.impact: Kansas City held Denver to 294 yards, but the defense failed to force a turnover and allowed 15 points in the fourth quarter. Jonah Coleman scored the game-winning touchdown with two minutes remaining. One sack and zero takeaways resulted in a poor fantasy day for the Chiefs D/ST.

news.body: The Chargers D/ST allowed 27 points while notching one sack in a 27-24 loss to the Jets in Week 11.
news.head: Chargers D/ST allows 27 points in Week 11
news.impact: Los Angeles was unable to slow down the Jets' offense in the close loss. Their lone sack came from Troy Dye. The Chargers will now face off against the Patriots in Week 12. They will not be a recommended streaming option, despite the Patriots having to start Tommy DeVito at quarterback following Drake Maye's multi-week ankle injury.

news.body: The Chargers' D/ST logged two sacks, one interception, and one fumble recovery while allowing 20 points in Monday night's win over the Baltimore Ravens.
news.head: Chargers D/ST logs two turnovers in win Monday
news.impact: Los Angeles' defense played pretty well on Monday night. They allowed just 20 points over the course of the night and were able to log a few big plays, including a key forced fumble that helped secure the win for them late in the game. This unit will have favorable matchups against the Jets and Patriots coming up over the next couple of weeks.

news.body: The Chargers' D/ST logged one sack and one interception while allowing 44 points in Sunday's loss to the Houston Texans.
news.head: Chargers D/ST dismal in loss Sunday
news.impact: Los Angeles' defense struggled heavily on Sunday. They allowed the Texans to score a whopping 44 points over the course of the game, and they weren't able to log more than a couple big plays to help out their own offense. This is one of the worst units in the NFL and shouldn't be started moving forward, even in a favorable matchup against the Ravens next week.

news.body: The Chargers' D/ST logged one interception and one sack while allowing 24 points in Sunday's loss to the Los Angeles Rams.
news.head: Chargers D/ST allows 24 points in loss Sunday
news.impact: The Chargers' defense didn't look very strong on Sunday. They allowed 24 points over the course of the game, and they weren't able to log many big plays to help out their own offense. This unit should not be started even in the best of matchups moving forward.

news.body: The Rams D/ST forced three turnovers (one fumble recovery, two interceptions) while also registering one sack in the Rams' 26-13 win over the Packers in Week 12.
news.head: Rams D/ST forces three turnovers in Week 12
news.impact: The defense held the Green Bay offense in check, allowing just 244 offensive yards in the win. The unit faces a much stiffer test entering a Week 13 matchup against the Kansas City Chiefs.

news.body: The Rams defense allowed six points on 123 total yards with two interceptions and five sacks on Sunday against the Cardinals.
news.head: Rams D/ST totals five sacks Sunday
news.impact: The Rams defense made it tough on Carson Beck in his first career start. They'll face the Packers in two weeks out of their bye.

news.body: The Los Angeles Rams D/ST held the Commanders to 13 points on Sunday and recovered a fumble. They also sacked Jayden Daniels four times.
news.head: Los Angeles Rams defense holds Commanders to 13 points in win
news.impact: After a stint on IR, Myles Garrett re-joined the Rams in the victory. With Garrett's return, the Rams will be a high-end D/ST option for Week 10's game against the Cardinals.

news.body: The Rams' D/ST logged two interceptions and two sacks while allowing just nine points in Sunday's 24-9 win over the Los Angeles Rams.
news.head: Rams D/ST plays well in win Sunday
news.impact: The Rams' defense had a good showing on Sunday. They were able to hold the Chargers to just nine points over the course of the game, while logging several big plays to help out their own offense. This unit has an easy schedule coming up with matchups against the Commanders and Cardinals over the next couple of weeks.

news.body: The Raiders' defense surrendered 351 total yards, while recording one sack and one interception in Las Vegas' 38-24 loss to Denver in Week 11.
news.head: Raiders D/ST allows 31 offensive points in Week 11
news.impact: The Broncos scored 38 points, seven of which came via a Ja'Quan McMillian pick-six and the ensuing extra point. Las Vegas intercepted Bo Nix but allowed Jonah Coleman to rush for 111 yards and three touchdowns. One sack and one takeaway weren't enough to offset the points allowed. The Raiders D/ST remains difficult to trust in fantasy heading into Week 12 against Cleveland.

news.body: The Raiders D/ST allowed 21 points on 382 total yards with three sacks and two fumble recoveries on Sunday.
news.head: Raiders D/ST recovers two fumbles Sunday
news.impact: The Raiders allowed just seven points in the first half before getting burned badly by Jaxon Smith-Njigba in the third quarter. They will have Bo Nix and the Broncos next week.

news.body: The Raiders defense allowed 31 points on 414 total yards with one interception and one sack.
news.head: Raiders D/ST struggles Sunday
news.impact: The Raiders defense remains off the fantasy radar, though they could be facing an injured Drew Lock or potentially Jalen Milroe in his first career start next week.

news.body: The Raiders D/ST allowed 290 passing yards, 166 rushing yards, and 33 points in a win over the Jets.
news.head: Raiders D/ST allows 33 points in Week 8 win
news.impact: The Raiders' defense tallied two sacks and one interception in the win. Neither defense really did anything of note in this game, with both teams scoring over 30 points. The Raiders did score on special teams, with Dylan Laube returning a 95-yard kickoff for a touchdown in the second quarter. The Raiders will take on the 49ers in Week 9.

news.body: The Vikings' defense gave up 28 points on 343 yards of total offense, recording one sack and no takeaways in Sunday's 35-10 loss to the 49ers.
news.head: Vikings D/ST no match for 49ers on Sunday night
news.impact: The Vikings' defense entered Sunday night's game as the most dominant unit in the league this season. The 49ers did not care, becoming the first team this season to score more than two touchdowns in a game against Minnesota. The 49ers' offense found the end zone four times, and added another on the defensive side. The Vikings will look to rebound quickly in what appears to be a more inviting matchup with the Falcons in Week 12.

news.body: The Vikings D/ST registered eight sacks while also forcing four turnovers (one interception, three fumble recoveries) in a 30-10 win over the Packers in Week 10.
news.head: Vikings D/ST wreaks havoc in Week 10
news.impact: The defense turned in another impactful performance Sunday, allowing just 220 offensive yards while consistently disrupting the Green Bay offense in the win. The unit will look to offer another dynamic performance for fantasy managers against a prolific San Francisco 49ers offense in Week 11.

news.body: The Vikings' defense gave up 23 points on 339 yards of total offense, registering four sacks and forcing one turnover in Monday's 23-6 loss to the Bills.
news.head: Vikings D/ST picks up four sacks in Week 9 loss
news.impact: The Vikings' defense got pretty much no help from the offense in this one, but the unit hung tough regardless. The Vikings head into Week 10 tied for the league lead in sacks (29) and ranked second in yards allowed per game (280.0). Minnesota also ranks first in points allowed per game at 14.5.

news.body: The Vikings D/ST recorded four sacks while also forcing one turnover in a 19-15 loss to the Lions in Week 8.
news.head: Vikings D/ST does its part in Week 8
news.impact: The defense was unable to contain a physical Detroit ground attack, allowing 230 rushing yards and 5.9 yards per carry in the loss. The unit faces another stiff test against a physical Buffalo Bills offense in Week 9.

news.body: The Patriots D/ST allowed 35 points while notching two sacks and forcing two turnovers in a 35-10 loss to the Lions in Munich in Week 10.
news.head: Patriots D/ST struggles in Week 10
news.impact: The Patriots struggled on defense for a second straight week as they coughed up 45 points to the Packers in Week 9. Their bye in Week 11 comes at a perfect time, with a plus matchup vs. the Chargers awaiting in Week 12.

news.body: The Patriots' D/ST logged three sacks while allowing 45 points in Sunday's loss to the Green Bay Packers.
news.head: Patriots D/ST allows 45 points in loss Sunday
news.impact: New England's defense had a terrible showing on Sunday. They allowed Green Bay to score 45 points over the course of the afternoon, despite the Packers losing their starting running back early on. This unit should not be started in a tough matchup against the Lions next week.

news.body: The New England Patriots D/ST racked up five sacks and a pick in the Patriots' 24-19 win over the Dolphins on Sunday.
news.head: New England Patriots D/ST rack up five sacks in win
news.impact: The Patriots' defense struggled a bit in the first half before tightening up on the Dolphins in the second half, holding them to just six points while the offense got back on their feet. They will face a tougher matchup next week against Green Bay.

news.body: The Patriots' defense gave up 30 points and more than 400 yards of total offense in Thursday's 30-24 loss to the Bears.
news.head: Patriots D/ST records three sacks, gives up 30 points in Week 7 loss
news.impact: The Patriots did come up with three sacks on Bears QB Caleb Williams, but that was about the extent of the positives in Thursday's loss. The Patriots defense was coming off a couple of solid showings against the Raiders and Jets, but the Bears' high-powered offense in Chicago proved to be too much to handle for most of the night. Still, the Dolphins await in Week 8, which will make the Patriots unit a popular choice for fantasy managers.

news.body: The New York Giants D/ST racked up three sacks and two interceptions in the team's 23-18 win over the Jaguars on Sunday.
news.head: New York Giants D/ST rattle Jags in win
news.impact: Abdul Carter and the Giants were pressuring Lawrence all afternoon, giving the powerful Jags offense little space to work. They will get a great matchup against the Colts next week.

news.body: The Giants D/ST allowed 24 points while notching one sack and forcing two turnovers in a 24-21 loss to the Commanders in Week 10.
news.head: Giants D/ST allows 24 points in TNF loss
news.impact: New York's defense struggled to contain the Commanders' passing attack as they allowed two long touchdown catches in the game. They did manage to intercept Jayden Daniels twice in the contest while getting a sack from Shelby Harris. The Giants will have a tough test in Week 11 against an excellent Jacksonville offense.

news.body: The Giants' D/ST logged seven sacks and one fumble recovery while allowing just 11 points in Sunday's win over the Philadelphia Eagles.
news.head: Giants D/ST stellar in win Sunday
news.impact: New York's defense stepped up to the plate on Sunday. They held Philadelphia's offense to just 11 points over the course of the afternoon, and they were also able to log a number of big plays to help out their own offense. This unit should not be started outside of great matchups moving forward, however.

news.body: The Giants D/ST allowed 21 points on 237 total yards with one sack on Sunday against the Texans.
news.head: Giants D/ST holds their own Sunday
news.impact: The Giants were unable to force any turnovers. They remain off the fantasy radar.

news.body: The Jets D/ST allowed 24 points while picking up six sacks in a 27-24 win over the Chargers in Week 11.
news.head: Jets D/ST allows 24 points in Week 11 win
news.impact: New York's defense was unable to force any turnovers but they notched an impressive six sacks vs. Justin Herbert. The Jets were led by David Bailey, who contributed a pair of sacks. The Jets will be a solid fantasy streaming option in Week 12 vs. a struggling Kyle McCord and the Dolphins.

news.body: The Jets D/ST allowed 196 passing yards, 201 rushing yards, and 31 points in a 31-12 loss to the Bills.
news.head: Jets D/ST allows 31 points in Week 10 loss
news.impact: The Jets' defense tallied one sack, one interception, and one fumble recovery in the loss. The defense did a solid job of keeping the running game in check, until a late James Cook 74-yard touchdown run in the fourth quarter. The Jets' will look to bounce back against the Chargers in Week 11.

news.body: Jets D/ST allowed 228 passing yards, 163 rushing yards, and 35 points in a 35-12 loss to the Chiefs.
news.head: Jets D/ST allows 35 points in Week 9 loss
news.impact: The Jets' defense tallied two sacks and two fumble recoveries in the loss. The Jets' defense will have another tough matchup in Week 10 against Josh Allen and the Bills.

news.body: The Jets D/ST allowed 247 passing yards, 95 rushing yards, and 38 points in a loss to the Raiders.
news.head: Jets D/ST allows 38 points in Week 8 loss
news.impact: The Jets' defense tallied one sack, but failed to force any turnovers in the loss. The Jets' defense will face a tough test in Week 9 against Patrick Mahomes and the Chiefs.

news.body: The Eagles D/ST registered three sacks while also forcing one turnover (one interception and returning a blocked punt for a touchdown in the Eagles' 39-38 win over the Cowboys in Week 12.
news.head: Eagles D/ST registers three sacks in Week 12
news.impact: The defense stood tall while trailing 31-10 in the second half, making key stops in the comeback win. The defense will look to take advantage of an underperforming Arizona Cardinals offense in Week 13.

news.body: The Philadelphia Eagles D/ST allowed 16 points and had five sacks in Sunday's win over the Steelers.
news.head: Philadelphia Eagles record five sacks in win
news.impact: The defense only allowed one touchdown all game against a struggling Steelers offense. However, they face a high powered Cowboys offense in Week 12, so they are not fantasy vialble for that matchup.

news.body: The Eagles' D/ST logged six sacks and one fumble recovery while allowing 19 points in Sunday's loss to the New York Giants.
news.head: Eagles D/ST solid in loss Sunday
news.impact: Philadelphia's defense played pretty well on Sunday. They were able to log six sacks and a turnover over the course of the afternoon, though that wasn't enough to lead the team to a win. This unit shouldn't be targeted in a matchup against the Steelers next week.

news.body: The Eagles D/ST allowed 27 points while picking up two sacks and forcing one turnover in a 27-10 loss to the Commanders in Week 8.
news.head: Eagles D/ST allows 27 points in Week 8 loss
news.impact: Philadelphia got out to a 10-0 lead in the contest but their defense couldn't keep the Commanders off the scoreboard. They will look to bounce back against the Giants in Week 9.

news.body: The Pittsburgh Steelers D/ST allowed 19 points and recorded three sacks in Sunday's loss to the Eagles.
news.head: Pittsburgh Steelers D/ST allows 19 points in loss
news.impact: The Steelers faced the Eagles on a seven-game skid, but weren't to take much advantage of a struggling offense. The Steelers face the improving Broncos on Sunday.

news.body: The Steelers' D/ST logged one sack and allowed 38 points in Sunday's loss to the Cincinnati Bengals.
news.head: Steelers D/ST dismal in loss Sunday
news.impact: Pittsburgh's defense was terrible on Sunday night. They allowed 38 points over the course of the game, and they weren't able to log many big plays to help out their own offense. This unit should bounce back in a favorable matchup against the Eagles next week, however.

news.body: The Steelers defense allowed six points on 319 total yards with eight sacks and two fumble recoveries on Sunday against the Browns.
news.head: Steelers D/ST racks up eight sacks Sunday
news.impact: The Steelers pass rush made it tough on Deshaun Watson all afternoon with eight sacks. The lone struggle for Pittsburgh on the day came via containing Harold Fannin. The Steelers head into their bye next week.

news.body: The Pittsburgh Steelers D/ST had a pick and two sacks in the team's 16-10 win over the Saints on Sunday.
news.head: Pittsburgh Steelers D/ST limits Saints in win
news.impact: The Steelers kept the Saints offense out of the endzone and forced several more punts in the team's win to put them up at 5-2. It might not have been the prettiest game, but the defense certainly won't care. They will face the Browns at home next Sunday.

news.body: The Seahawks defense allowed 13 points on 163 total yards with six sacks on Sunday.
news.head: Seahawks D/ST dominates in second half Sunday
news.impact: Fernando Mendoza had some success early in his first career start, but the Seahawks locked in against him by the second half. They will be facing the 49ers in Week 12 out of their bye.

news.body: The Seahawks defense allowed three points on 198 total yards with three sacks.
news.head: Seahawks D/ST dominates Sunday
news.impact: The Seahawks were able to completely shut down the entire Cardinals offense all afternoon. They'll face Kirk Cousins and the Raiders on the road next week.

news.body: The Seahawks' D/ST logged just one sack and one fumble recovery while allowing 34 points in Monday night's loss the Chicago Bears.
news.head: Seahawks D/ST struggles in loss Monday
news.impact: Seattle normally has a very stout defense, but they got outclassed by Chicago on Monday night. They ended up giving up 34 points over the course of the night, which led to yet another loss for the Seahawks. This unit will have a great opportunity to bounce back in a matchup against the Cardinals next week, however.

news.body: The Seahawks D/ST allowed three points while notching one sack and forcing one turnover in a 20-3 win over the Chiefs in Week 7.
news.head: Seahawks D/ST dominates Chiefs in Week 7
news.impact: Seattle's defense came to play in the impressive win over the previously undefeated Chiefs. The Seahawks intercepted Patrick Mahomes once in the contest. They will have another tough test ahead of them in Week 8 vs. the Bears.

news.body: The 49ers' defense held the Vikings to just 10 points and 324 yards of offense, recording one sack and one interception in Sunday's 35-10 win.
news.head: 49ers D/ST shuts down Vikings on Sunday night
news.impact: San Francisco safety Ji'Ayir Brown returned his interception for a touchdown late in the second quarter Sunday night, giving fantasy managers who played the 49ers D/ST a big night. This performance was a strong rebound for the 49ers' defense compared to Week 10's 46-40 shootout against the Cowboys. The San Francisco unit has been up-and-down this season and has a fairly tough task coming against the Seahawks.

news.body: The 49ers D/ST recorded one sack while also forcing two turnovers (one interception, one fumble recovery) in a 46-40 win over the Cowboys in Week 10.
news.head: 49ers D/ST shredded in Week 10
news.impact: The defense struggled to hold the Dallas passing attack in check, allowing five touchdowns and over 340 passing yards in the win. The unit will look to get back on track against an inconsistent Minnesota Vikings offense in Week 11.

news.body: The 49ers defense allowed 17 points on 240 total yards with three interceptions and two fumble recoveries.
news.head: 49ers D/ST forces five turnovers Sunday
news.impact: It was a dominant afternoon for the 49ers defense with five turnovers forced. They'll face Dak Prescott and the Cowboys next week.

news.body: The 49ers D/ST surrendered only 295 yards of offense on Sunday, but gave up 29 points without recording a single sack or takeaway during a 29-20 loss to the Falcons
news.head: 49ers defense surrenders three passing scores in Week 7 loss
news.impact: The 49ers' offense uncharacteristically turned the ball over four times Sunday afternoon, leaving the defense in several bad spots. The 49ers' unit did a nice job against the typically potent Falcons' rushing attack, but Atlanta QB Michael Penix looked comfortable throughout the contest, passing for 213 yards and three scores. The 49ers will regroup during the bye week before taking on the Raiders.

news.body: The Buccaneers D/ST registered one sack while failing to force any turnovers in a 31-21 loss to the Detroit Lions in Week 11.
news.head: Buccaneers D/ST struggles in Week 11
news.impact: The defense was unable to come up with stops when it mattered, allowing multiple touchdowns on the ground and through the air in the loss. The unit will look to be more disruptive in Week 12 against the Carolina Panthers.

news.body: The Buccaneers D/ST allowed 27 points while notching one sack and forcing five turnovers in a 27-24 loss to the Bears in Week 9.
news.head: Buccaneers D/ST notches four interceptions in Week 9
news.impact: Tampa Bay's defense has been on fire in the takeaway category of late as they have nine over their past two games. They were led by Zyon McCollum, who had two interceptions and two pass breakups. Tampa will be on bye in Week 10 before a Week 11 matchup vs. the Lions.

news.body: The Buccaneers defense pitched a shutout on Sunday against the Falcons, allowing 224 total yards with four interceptions.
news.head: Buccaneers D/ST records four interceptions Sunday
news.impact: It was a nightmare of a day for Michael Penix Jr. in bad weather against the Tampa Bay defense. The Bucs will face a tougher test against Caleb Williams and the Bears next week.

news.body: The Tampa Bay Buccaneers D/ST racked up five sacks, two interceptions, two fumble recoveries, and a defensive touchdown in the Bucs' dominant 43-13 win over the Panthers on Sunday.
news.head: Tampa Bay Buccaneers D/ST rattle Panthers in win
news.impact: The Bucs' defense didn't even let the Panthers make this a contest, holding them to 13 points while also scoring some points of their own. It was an impressive showing by the unit, which now gets to face the Falcons next week.

news.body: The Commanders D/ST allowed 20 points while picking up three sacks in a 22-20 win over the Bengals in Week 11's Monday night game.
news.head: Commanders D/ST holds Bengals to 20 points in Week 11
news.impact: On a rainy night at Northwest Stadium, Washington's defense was impressive in slowing down a red-hot Cincinnati offense that had scored at least 31 points in five straight games coming into Week 11. The Commanders will be a solid fantasy defense option heading into a Week 12 matchup against a struggling Arizona offense.

news.body: The Commanders D/ST allowed 21 points while notching one sack and forcing two turnovers in a 24-21 win over the Giants in Week 10's Thursday night game.
news.head: Commanders D/ST allows 21 points in TNF win
news.impact: Washington's defense struggled to contain Cam Skattebo, who ran for two touchdowns, but they otherwise did a decent job limiting the Giants. They will have a much tougher test on their hands in Week 11 when they face off against a red-hot Bengals offense.

news.body: The Washington Commanders D/ST allowed 20 points in Sunday's loss to the Rams. The unit also recorded one interception and one sack.
news.head: Washington Commanders D/ST give up 20 points in loss
news.impact: The Commanders defense has been volatile and unreliable in the 2026 campaign. However, they look to be a viable streamer for Week 10's rematch with the Giants on Thursday Night Football.

news.body: The Commanders D/ST allowed 10 points while picking up five sacks and forcing two turnovers in a 27-10 win over the Eagles in Week 8.
news.head: Washington D/ST allows 10 points in Week 8 win
news.impact: Washington's defense made life miserable for Eagles QB Tanner McKee. The Commanders held the Eagles to just 268 yards of total offense on Sunday night. They will look to stay hot against the Rams in Week 9.

news.body: Andre Szmyt made 2-of-3 FG attempts and all three of his PATs in Sunday's 27-24 win over the Texans.
news.head: Andre Szmyt puts nine points on the board in Week 10 win
news.impact: Szmyt continues his solid season for the Browns. The second-year kicker is now 21-of-24 on field-goal tries this season with a long of 56 yards. He's also 15-of-16 on PATs.

news.body: Andre Szmyt hit all three field goal attempts and his only PAT in the Browns' 23-22 loss to the Saints.
news.head: Andre Szmyt goes for 10 kicking points in loss
news.impact: Szmyt did his part to keep the Browns in this game, going perfect 4-for-4 on kicking attempts of any kind on Sunday. He will look to stay strong next week against the surging Texans.

news.body: Andre Szmyt went 2-for-2 on field goals on Sunday.
news.head: Andre Szmyt makes two field goals Sunday
news.impact: Szmyt connected on attempts from 32 and 49 yards out. Those were the lone points scored by Cleveland on the day.

news.body: Andre Szmyt made two of his three field goals and added three extra points in a 27-24 win over the Titans in Week 7.
news.head: Andre Szmyt makes game-winning FG in Week 7
news.impact: Szmyt made a 32-yard field goal as time expired to give the Browns the win. The second-year kicker has made 14 of his 16 field-goal attempts this season. He will kick vs. the Steelers in Week 8.

news.body: Brandon Aubrey converted all five of his extra point attempts as well as one of his two field goal attempts to finish with eight points in the Cowboys' 39-38 loss to the Eagles in Week 12.
news.head: Brandon Aubrey misses field goal in Week 12
news.impact: Aubrey continues a productive stretch behind a high-powered Dallas offense, recording eight or more points in each of his last six contests. The kicker remains one of the more impactful options entering a tough Week 13 contest against the Seattle Seahawks.

news.body: Brandon Aubrey made his lone field goal on Sunday.
news.head: Brandon Aubrey makes lone field goal Sunday
news.impact: Aubrey was busy with six extra point attempts. His lone field goal came from 49 yards out.

news.body: Brandon Aubrey converted both of his field goal attempts as well as 2-of-3 extra point attempts to finish with eight points in the Cowboys' 46-40 loss to the 49ers in Week 10.
news.head: Brandon Aubrey misses extra point in Week 10
news.impact: Aubrey continues a scorching stretch of late, finishing with eight or more points in each of his last four games. The kicker remains one of the more impactful options ahead of a favorable Week 11 contest against the Tennessee Titans.

news.body: Brandon Aubrey made two of his three field-goal attempts and added three extra points in a 27-23 win over the Colts in Week 9.
news.head: Brandon Aubrey makes two FGs in Week 9
news.impact: Aubrey drilled field goals from 45 and 28 yards out in the close win over Indy. The veteran kicker has now made 17 of his 22 field-goal attempts and 23 extra points this year. He will take on the 49ers in Week 10.

news.body: Cairo Santos converted his only field goal attempt as well as all four of his extra point attempts to finish with six points in the Bears' 39-35 win over the Lions in Week 12.
news.head: Cairo Santos perfect in Week 12
news.impact: Santos has benefited from kicking behind a high-powered Chicago offense of late, registering six or more points in each of his last six contests. The kicker will look for more success in a Week 13 contest against the Jacksonville Jaguars.

news.body: Cairo Santos converted one of his two extra point attempts as well as both of his field goal attempts to finish with seven points in the Bears' 21-13 win over the Saints in Week 11.
news.head: Cairo Santos misses extra point in Week 11
news.impact: Santos continues a productive stretch of late, recording seven or more points in each of his last five contests. The kicker will look for another impactful outing in Week 12 against the Detroit Lions.

news.body: Cairo Santos made both of his field goals and added three extra points in a 27-24 win over the Buccaneers in Week 9.
news.head: Cairo Santos makes two FGs in Week 9
news.impact: Santos hit field goals from 25 and 38 yards out, with the second kick serving as the game-winner as time expired. Santos has made 15 of his 19 field-goal attempts this season. He will be on bye in Week 10 before taking on the Saints in Week 11.

news.body: Cairo Santos went 4-for-4 on his extra-point attempts and made both of his field-goal attempts in Monday night's 34-17 win over the Seattle Seahawks.
news.head: Cairo Santos scores ten points in win Monday
news.impact: Santos was perfect on Monday night, making all six of his kicks in a comfortable win over the Seahawks. He has been producing very well lately and should be started in most leagues at this point.

news.body: Cam Little hit all four of his field goal attempts in the Jaguars' 23-18 loss to the Giants on Sunday.
news.head: Cam Little goes for 12 kicking points in loss
news.impact: Little was the beneficiary of the Jaguars' offense being unable to seal the deal when they got close to the end zone on Sunday, forcing four field goal attempts. He now has three straight games with 12 or more kicking points.

news.body: Cam Little hit all four of his PATs and all four of his field goal attempts in the Jaguars' 40-23 win over the Titans on Sunday.
news.head: Cam Little puts up 16 kicking points in Week 10
news.impact: Little was perfect in this game, hitting all eight of his PATs and field goal kicks. He now has 31 kicking points in his last two games and looks like a premier kicker in fantasy.

news.body: Cam Little hit all four of his field goal attempts and all three PATs in the Jaguars' 33-10 win over the Ravens.
news.head: Cam Little racks up 15 kicking points in win
news.impact: Little now has totals of 10, 7, 7, 6, and 15 kicking points in his last five games. He's been a great play for fantasy and one of the better kickers so far in 2026.

news.body: Cam Little did not attempt a field goal but made all six of his PATs in Sunday's 42-7 blowout of the Colts.
news.head: Cam Little hits a half-dozen PATs in Week 8 win
news.impact: Little gave fantasy managers six points, all on PATs, in Sunday's blowout. One of the league's best kickers, Little remains 10-of-12 on FG attempts with a long of 60 yards. He's also 22 of 23 on PATs.

news.body: Cameron Dicker made his lone field-goal attempt and added three extra points in a 27-24 loss to the Jets in Week 11.
news.head: Cameron Dicker makes one FG in Week 11
news.impact: Dicker hit a 52-yard field goal on his only attempt. The veteran kicker has made 19 of his 21 field-goal attempts and added 15 extra points this year. He will face the Patriots in Week 12.

news.body: Cameron Dicker went 3-for-3 on his field-goal attempts and 2-for-2 on his extra-point attempts in Monday night's 23-20 win over the Baltimore Ravens.
news.head: Cameron Dicker scores 11 points in win Monday
news.impact: Dicker played well on Monday night. He made all five of his kicks over the course of the game, and his accuracy was very much needed in this narrow win over the Ravens. He will be a decent fantasy option moving forward if Los Angeles' offense can continue to move the ball competently.

news.body: Cameron Dicker went 3-for-3 on his field-goal attempts and made his lone extra-point attempt in Sunday's 44-22 loss to the Houston Texans.
news.head: Cameron Dicker perfect in loss Sunday
news.impact: Dicker was one of the lone bright spots for the Chargers on Sunday. He totaled ten points over the course of the game and made all four of his kicks, including one from 52 yards out. His fantasy value will continue to be limited with how bad Los Angeles' offense has been playing this season.

news.body: Cameron Dicker went 3-for-3 on his field-goal attempts in Sunday's 24-9 loss to the Los Angeles Rams.
news.head: Cameron Dicker scores nine points in loss Sunday
news.impact: The Chargers suffered another tough loss at the hands of the Rams on Sunday, but Dicker did his job in that matchup. He made all three of his attempted kicks and was responsible for all nine of the team's points over the course of the afternoon. He may not see as many opportunities on a game-to-game basis as fantasy managers would like, however, with how bad Los Angeles' offense looks.

news.body: Chad Ryland connected on his lone extra point attempt in a 34-7 loss to the Chiefs.
news.head: Chad Ryland perfect on lone kick in Week 11
news.impact: Ryland connected on his lone extra point attempt after a second quarter touchdown by Simi Fehoko. The Cardinals' offense continues to struggle, which limits Ryland's opportunities.

news.body: Chad Ryland was 2-for-2 on field goal attempts on Sunday.
news.head: Chad Ryland makes two field goals Sunday
news.impact: Ryland connected on two field goals from 49 yards out in the opening quarter. That would be all the scoring on the day for Arizona.

news.body: Chad Ryland made his lone field goal attempt against the Seahawks.
news.head: Chad Ryland knocks in field goal Sunday
news.impact: Ryland knocked in a 28-yard field goal on the opening drive of the game. That was his lone scoring chance all afternoon.

news.body: Chad Ryland converted both of his field goal attempts while also converting three of his four extra point attempts to finish with nine points in the Cardinals' 33-30 win over the Cowboys in Week 8.
news.head: Chad Ryland misses extra point in Week 8
news.impact: Ryland has caught fire of late, recording nine or more points in each of his last three contests. The kicker will look to stay hot behind an Arizona offense with newly named starting quarterback Gardner Minshew behind center in a tough Week 9 contest against the Seattle Seahawks.

news.body: Chase McLaughlin converted all three of his extra point attempts to finish with three points in the Buccaneers' 31-21 loss to the Lions in Week 11.
news.head: Chase McLaughlin perfect in Week 11
news.impact: McLaughlin fell back to earth, finishing with less than six points for the first time in six contests. The kicker will look to return to his impactful form in a Week 12 divisional contest against the Carolina Panthers.

news.body: Chase McLaughlin made all three of his field-goal attempts and added an extra point in a 27-24 loss to the Bears in Week 9.
news.head: Chase McLaughlin makes three FGs in Week 9
news.impact: McLaughlin hit field goals from 27, 21, and 35 yards out in the close loss on Sunday night. The veteran kicker has now made all 22 of his field-goal attempts and added 18 extra points on the season. He will be on bye in Week 10 before taking on the Lions.

news.body: Chase McLaughlin connected on 3-of-3 field goal attempts and his lone extra point attempt on Sunday.
news.head: Chase McLaughlin connects on three field goals Sunday
news.impact: Despite brutal weather, it didn't stop McLaughlin from hitting field goals from 46, 34 and 42 yards out in the first half. He remains one of the top kickers in fantasy football this season.

news.body: Chase McLaughlin made both of his field goal attempts and all five of his PATs in the Bucs' resounding 43-13 win over the Panthers on Sunday.
news.head: Chase McLaughlin racks up 11 kicking points in win
news.impact: McLaughlin has been on fire this year, with nine or more kicking points in five of the Bucs seven contests. It's been a great start for the veteran kicker, who has not missed a single field goal or PAT this year.

news.body: Chris Boswell made all three field goal attempts and added an extra point in Sunday’s loss to the Eagles.
news.head: Chris Boswell is perfect on four kicks
news.impact: Boswell has missed five field goals this year, most recently missing one in Week 10. He will be a solid streaming option for Week 12, where he figures to get some opportunities against a stingy Broncos defense that may prevent the offense from reaching the endzone.

news.body: Chris Boswell made his lone field-goal attempt and his lone extra-point attempt in Sunday's 38-18 loss to the Cincinnati Bengals.
news.head: Chris Boswell perfect in loss Sunday
news.impact: Boswell did his job on Sunday, making both of his kicks to rack up a total of four points. He wasn't able to put up a good fantasy performance, however, just because the Steelers' offense wasn't able to get him into scoring range on many occasions.

news.body: Chris Boswell made 2-of-3 field goal attempts and 3-of-3 extra point attempts on Sunday.
news.head: Chris Boswell connects on 5-of-6 kicks Sunday
news.impact: Boswell made field goals from 20 and 37 yards out. His miss came from 57 yards out. He remains one of the more consistent kickers for fantasy managers.

news.body: Chris Boswell connected on all three of his field goal attempts and made his only PAT in the Steelers' 16-10 win over the Saints.
news.head: Chris Boswell leads Steelers to win on Sunday
news.impact: Boswell benefited from the Steelers' offense failing to move the ball effectively down into the end zone, resulting in the team primarily putting up field goals. He should be a consistent and top-end option with the Steelers' offense humming, touchdowns or not.

news.body: Dominic Zvada hit both of his PATs and three of four field goal attempts in the Giants' 23-18 win over the Jaguars on Sunday.
news.head: Dominic Zvada goes for 11 kicking points in win over Jags
news.impact: Zvada had a miss in this game, but thankfully for him it was not a deciding factor for this game, though it could have been had things fallen differently. He's now missed four field goal attempts in his last four games, so the Giants could start entertaining new names for the job.

news.body: Dominic Zvada missed his lone field-goal attempt but added three extra points in a 24-21 loss to the Commanders in Week 10.
news.head: Dominic Zvada makes three XPs in Week 10 loss
news.impact: Zvada missed on a 33-yard attempt in the first quarter. The rookie kicker has made 17 of his 23 field-goal attempts while converting all 16 of his extra points this season. He will take on the Jaguars in Week 11.

news.body: Dominic Zvada went 4-for-4 on his field-goal attempts and made his lone extra-point attempt in Sunday's 19-11 win over the Philadelphia Eagles.
news.head: Dominic Zvada scores 13 points in win Sunday
news.impact: Zvada had a great game on Sunday. He was able to make all five of his kicks in a win over the Eagles and finished with 13 total points. Fantasy managers should be ecstatic with his production in this matchup.

news.body: Dominic Zvada missed both of his field goal attempts on Sunday.
news.head: Dominic Zvada misses two field goals Sunday
news.impact: Zvada had misses from 56 and 44 yards out. He remains off the fantasy radar for now.

news.body: Drew Stevens made all five of his field-goal attempts and added an extra point in a 22-20 win over the Bengals in Week 11.
news.head: Drew Stevens hits game-winning FG in Week 11
news.impact: Stevens was busy on a rainy night at Northwest Stadium, hitting field goals from 36, 40, 25, 41, and 26 yards out. His final field goal was the game-winner as time expired. Stevens has now made 22 of his 25 field-goal attempts and added 16 extra points this year. He will take on the Cardinals in Week 12.

news.body: Drew Stevens made a 46-yard field goal and added three extra points in a 24-21 win over the Giants in Week 10's Thursday night game.
news.head: Drew Stevens makes one FG in Week 10 win
news.impact: Stevens was perfect on the night, giving him 17 made field goals on 20 attempts this season. The rookie kicker will now prepare to take on the Bengals in Week 11.

news.body: Drew Stevens went 3/3 on his kicks on Sunday, hitting both field goal tries and one extra point in the loss.
news.head: Drew Stevens hits two field goals in loss
news.impact: Stevens had a solid, if not spectacular outing on Sunday. He will look to carry his momentum into Thursday night's matchup against the Giants.

news.body: Drew Stevens made four of his five field-goal attempts and added an extra point in a 27-10 win over the Eagles in Week 8.
news.head: Drew Stevens hits four field goals in Week 8
news.impact: Stevens was busy on Sunday night, hitting field goals from 56, 39, 25, and 42 yards out. The rookie kicker has now hit 14 of his 17 field goals on the season. He will take on the Rams in Week 9.

news.body: Evan McPherson made both of his field-goal attempts and added two extra points in a 22-20 loss to the Commanders in Week 11.
news.head: Evan McPherson makes two FGs in Week 11 loss
news.impact: McPherson hit what looked like it was going to be a game-winning 56-yard field goal with 50 seconds left in regulation but Washington was able to rally back to hit a game-winning field goal of their own. McPherson has now made 15 of his 16 field-goal attempts and added 35 extra points this season. He will kick against the Saints in Week 12.

news.body: Evan McPherson went 5-for-5 on his extra-point attempts and 1-for-2 on his field-goal attempts in Sunday's 38-18 win over the Pittsburgh Steelers.
news.head: Evan McPherson scores seven points in win Sunday
news.impact: McPherson scored seven points on Sunday night. He wasn't perfect, however, as he left three points on the field by missing one of his two field-goal attempts over the course of the game. He should continue to be a good fantasy option for the time being.

news.body: Evan McPherson connected on both of his field goal attempts and 4-of-4 extra point attempts in a 34-17 win over the Falcons.
news.head: Evan McPherson perfect in Week 9 win
news.impact: McPherson made field goals from 43 and 57 yards out to help pace the Bengals to their sixth win of the season. McPherson continues to have an excellent season and will look to continue that against the Steelers in Week 10.

news.body: Evan McPherson made all five of his extra points in a 43-36 overtime win over the Titans in Week 8.
news.head: Evan McPherson makes five XPs in Week 8
news.impact: McPherson did not attempt any field goals in the high-scoring win. The veteran kicker has now converted all 10 of his field-goal attempts and added 24 extra points on the season. He will take on the Falcons in Week 9.

news.body: Harrison Butker connected on 2-of-2 field goal attempts and 4-of-4 extra point attempts in a 34-7 win over Arizona.
news.head: Harrison Butker perfect in Week 11 win
news.impact: Butker connected on field goals from 40 and 44 yards out to help pace the Chiefs to a win. Butker needed a strong performance in what has been a trying season for the veteran. The Chiefs and Butker will take on the Bills in Week 12.

news.body: Harrison Butker converted all five of his extra point attempts in a 35-13 Week 10 win over the Falcons.
news.head: Harrison Butker perfect in Week 10
news.impact: Butker took advantage of his opportunity to remain the No. 1 kicker for head coach Andy Reid, converting all of his attempts for just the second time in his last six contests. The kicker will look for another reliable performance in a Week 11 contest against the Arizona Cardinals.

news.body: Harrison Butker will remain the Chiefs kicker in Week 10 against the Falcons.
news.head: Harrison Butker to remain Chiefs kicker in Week 10
news.impact: Butker continues to struggle on the season with another missed field goal.

news.body: Harrison Butker missed his lone field goal attempt and made all five extra point attempts in a 35-12 win over the Jets.
news.head: Harrison Butker misses lone field goal attempt
news.impact: Butker missed a 51-yard filed goal wide right, marking his fourth straight game with a missed field goal. Fantasy managers should expect the Chiefs to at least consider activating Justin Tucker to see if he can bring some consistency to the field goal unit in Week 10.

news.body: Jake Bates converted both of his field goal attempts as well as three of his four extra point attempts to finish with nine points in the Lions' 39-35 loss to the Bears in Week 12.
news.head: Jake Bates misses extra point in Week 12
news.impact: Bates has been dynamic behind a high-powered offense to this point, recording seven or more points in 10 of 11 contests. The kicker will look to offer another prolific performance in a favorable Week 13 contest against the Atlanta Falcons.

news.body: Jake Bates converted one of his two field goal attempts as well as all four of his extra point attempts to finish with seven points in the Lions' 31-21 win over the Buccaneers in Week 11.
news.head: Jake Bates misses field goal in Week 11
news.impact: Bates has been impactful behind a prolific Detroit offense to this point, finishing with seven or more points in nine of 10 contests. The kicker will look for another productive performance against the Chicago Bears in Week 12.

news.body: Jake Bates made all five of his extra-point attempts in a 35-10 win over the Patriots in Munich in Week 10.
news.head: Jake Bates hits five extra points in Week 10
news.impact: Bates was not asked to attempt any field goals in a game where the Detroit offense dominated. He will now take on the Buccaneers in Week 11.

news.body: Jake Bates converted all four of his field goal attempts as well as his lone extra point attempt to finish with 13 points in the Lions' 19-9 win over the Dolphins in Week 9.
news.head: Jake Bates racks up 13 points in Week 9
news.impact: Bates continues to take advantage of playing behind a prolific Detroit offense, registering seven or more points in each of his eight contests. The kicker remains locked in as an impactful option in kicker formats entering a Week 10 contest against the New England Patriots.

news.body: Jason Myers went 0-for-1 on field goal attempts and 3-for-3 on extra point attempts.
news.head: Jason Myers misses field goal Sunday
news.impact: Myers missed a field goal from 44 yards out. He is still 16-of-18 on the season.

news.body: Jason Myers made his lone field goal attempt and two extra points against the Cardinals.
news.head: Jason Myers connects on field goal Sunday
news.impact: Myers was able to bounce back following his struggles last week.

news.body: Jason Myers went 1-for-2 on his field-goal attempt and missed his lone extra-point attempt in Monday night's 34-17 loss to the Chicago Bears.
news.head: Jason Myers misses two kicks in loss Monday
news.impact: Myers missed two kicks on Monday night. One of them wasn't his fault, as it was blocked by Chicago, but there were still four points left out on the field by the veteran kicker. He isn't expected to be among the top kickers in fantasy over the back half of the season.

news.body: Jason Myers made both of his field-goal attempts and added two extra points in a 20-3 win over the Chiefs in Week 7.
news.head: Jason Myers makes two FGs in Week 7
news.impact: Myers hit field goals from 25 and 35 yards out in the win over the previously undefeated Chiefs. The veteran kicker has now hit 14 of his 15 attempts on the year. He will take on the Bears in Week 8.

news.body: Jason Sanders made both of his field-goal attempts and added three extra points in a 27-24 win over the Chargers in Week 11.
news.head: Jason Sanders hits two FGs in Week 11
news.impact: Sanders was perfect in the close win, adding field goals from 50 and 24 yards out. The veteran kicker has hit 27 of his 30 field-goal attempts and 16 extra points this year. He will now get ready to take on the Dolphins in Week 12.

news.body: Jason Sanders connected on all four of his field goal attempts in a 31-12 loss to the Bills.
news.head: Jason Sanders makes four field goals in Week 10
news.impact: Sanders connected from 22, 27, 41, and 48 to account for all 12 of the Jets' points Sunday. Sanders and the Jets will take on the Chargers in Week 11.

news.body: Jason Sanders connected on 4-of-5 field goal attempts in a 35-12 loss to the Chiefs.
news.head: Jason Sanders makes four field goals in Week 9
news.impact: Sanders made field goals from 23, 48, 49, and 54 yards out to account for all of the Jets' scoring Sunday. His lone miss came on a 53-yard attempt late in the second quarter. Sanders and the Jets will look to bounce back against Buffalo in Week 10.

news.body: Jason Sanders connected on 4-of-4 field goal attempts and 3-of-3 extra point attempts in a 38-33 loss to the Raiders.
news.head: Jason Sanders perfect in Week 8
news.impact: Sanders connected on field goals from 21, 31, 36, and 39 yards out. This was a much needed bounce back performance after the 30-year-old had a costly miss last week. Sanders and the Jets will take on the Chiefs in Week 9.

news.body: Ka'imi Fairbairn made his only field-goal attempts and all three PATs in Thursday's 26-3 win over the Colts.
news.head: Ka'imi Fairbairn puts six points on the board in Week 11 win
news.impact: Fairbairn remains one of the league's steadiest kickers. The 10-year veteran has missed just one of his 21 FG attempts this season, and that came all the way back in Week 2. He's also a perfect 27-of-27 on his PATs.

news.body: Ka'imi Fairbairn made his only field-goal attempt and all three PATs in Sunday's 27-24 loss to the Browns.
news.head: Ka'imi Fairbairn contributes six points in Week 10 loss
news.impact: Fairbairn continues another solid season. The veteran kicker has missed just one of his 20 FG attempts this season, and he's perfect on 24 PATs. Fairbairn is one of the most reliable kickers in the league.

news.body: Ka'imi Fairbairn went 5-for-5 on his field-goal attempts and 3-for-3 on his extra-point attempts in Sunday's win over the Los Angeles Chargers.
news.head: Ka'imi Fairbairn scores 14 points in win Sunday
news.impact: Fairbairn had a fantastic game on Sunday. He scored 14 points and made all eight of his kicks in this win over the Texans, including one from 56 yards out. He will continue to be a good fantasy option at the position moving forward.

news.body: Ka'imi Fairbairn connected on 2-of-2 field goal attempts on Sunday.
news.head: Ka'imi Fairbairn makes both field goals Sunday
news.impact: Fairbairn made field goals from 58 and 57 yards out. He remains a reliable kicker for fantasy managers.

news.body: Spencer Shrader made 1-of-3 field-goal attempts and no PATs in Thursday's 26-3 loss to the Texans.
news.head: Spencer Shrader makes just 1-of-3 kicks Thursday night
news.impact: Very little went right for the Colts on Thursday night, including in the kicking game. In Shrader's defense, he missed from 56 yards and had a 62-yard FG try blocked. The third-year kicker has actually been quite good overall this season, making 24-of-28 field-goal attempts and 19-of-20 PATs through 11 games.

news.body: Spencer Shrader hit all three of his PATs and his only field goal attempt in the Colts' 24-22 win over the Dolphins on Sunday.
news.head: Spencer Shrader goes for six kicking points in win
news.impact: Shrader was perfect in this game, and now has 17 kicking points in his last two games after going quiet for a three-game stretch. He is likely going to be a bit up and down given the Colts offense, or lack thereof.

news.body: Spencer Shrader made all three of his field goals and added two extra points in a 27-23 loss to the Cowboys in Week 9.
news.head: Spencer Shrader hits three FGs in Week 9
news.impact: Shrader was perfect in the close loss. He hit field goals from 47, 59, and 50 yards out for the Colts. The veteran kicker now has 22 field goals in 24 tries, including eight from at least 50 yards away. He will take on the Dolphins in Week 10.

news.body: Spencer Shrader did not attempt a field goal and made his only PAT in Sunday's 42-7 loss to the Jaguars.
news.head: Spencer Shrader puts just one point on the board in Week 8
news.impact: Simply put, the Colts were terrible on Sunday afternoon in Jacksonville. That led to Shrader not getting much of a chance to help fantasy managers. The third-year kicker is still tied atop the NFL with 19 field goals made through eight games.

news.body: Tyler Bass made 4-of-5 field goal attempts and 2-of-2 extra point attempts on Sunday.
news.head: Tyler Bass makes four field goals Sunday
news.impact: Bass connected on field goals from 43, 54, 40 and 28 yards out. His lone miss came from 54 yards out.

news.body: Tyler Bass connected on his lone field goal attempt and 4-of-4 extra points in a 31-12 win over the Jets.
news.head: Tyler Bass perfect in Week 10 win
news.impact: Bass remains perfect with field goals, connecting on 20 straight so far this season. He will look to continue his excellent 2026 season against Miami in Week 11.

news.body: Tyler Bass made all three of his field-goal attempts and both PATs in Monday's 23-6 win over the Vikings.
news.head: Tyler Bass puts 11 points on the board in Week 9
news.impact: Bass made good on all of his opportunities in Monday's win, remaining an impressive 19-of-19 on FG attempts this season. The veteran kicker is an excellent fantasy option given the Bills' offensive prowess.

news.body: Tyler Bass connected on 3-of-3 field goal attempts and 3-of-3 extra point attempts in a 36-10 win over the Ravens.
news.head: Tyler Bass perfect in Week 8 win
news.impact: Bass connected on field goals from 22, 51, and 56 yards out in the first half to help pace the Bills to the win. Bass has not missed a field goal attempt this season and will look to continue that against the Vikings in Week 9.

news.body: Wil Lutz converted his lone field-goal attempt and all five extra-point attempts in the Broncos' 38-24 win over the Raiders in Week 11.
news.head: Wil Lutz makes all six kicks in Week 11
news.impact: Lutz connected from 38 yards out in the first quarter. Denver scored touchdowns on five of its six scoring possessions, limiting Lutz to one field-goal attempt despite scoring a season-high 38 points. He'll get the Steelers on the road in Week 12.

news.body: Wil Lutz converted field goals from 26 and 48 yards in the Broncos' 26-21 win over the Panthers in Week 9.
news.head: Wil Lutz makes two field goals in Week 9
news.impact: Lutz has now made seven field goals over Denver's last three games. The Broncos scored 26 points Sunday, giving Lutz another productive afternoon. Denver enters its Week 10 bye before hosting the Raiders in Week 11.

news.body: Wil Lutz made both of his field-goal attempts and both extra-point attempts in the Broncos' 28-24 win over the Chiefs in Week 8.
news.head: Wil Lutz makes two field goals in Week 8
news.impact: Lutz connected from 39 and 45 yards. He has now made five field goals over the last two games as Denver's offense has scored 58 points. The scoring opportunities are there for Lutz.

news.body: Wil Lutz made all three of his field-goal attempts and all three extra-point attempts in the Broncos' 30-16 win over the Cardinals in Week 7.
news.head: Wil Lutz Perfect in Week 7 Win
news.impact: Lutz connected from 48, 43 and 31 yards, giving him 12 points on the afternoon. Denver's offense moved the ball much better than it had through the first six weeks, creating six scoring opportunities for Lutz. He is a viable weekly fantasy kicker.

news.body: Will Reichard made 1-of-3 field-goal attempts and his only PAT in Sunday's 35-10 loss to the 49ers.
news.head: Will Reichard puts four points on the board in Week 11
news.impact: Reichard's two missed field-goal tries obviously do not look good at first glance, but they came from 55 and 71 yards. The third-year kicker connected from 48 yards in the second quarter, and he is now a solid 24-of-28 on field goals for the season. He's also been perfect on 14 PATs.

news.body: Will Reichard converted all three of his field goal attempts as well as each of his three extra point attempts to finish with 12 points in the Vikings' 30-10 win over the Packers in Week 10.
news.head: Will Reichard racks up 12 points in Week 10
news.impact: Reichard continues a dynamic stretch to this point, recording six or more points in eight of his nine contests. The kicker will look to offer fantasy managers another impactful performance in a difficult Week 11 contest against the San Francisco 49ers.

news.body: Will Reichard made both of his field-goal attempts in Monday's 23-6 loss to the Bills.
news.head: Will Reichard makes a pair of field goals in Week 9 loss
news.impact: The Vikings' offense was almost completely stifled Monday night, leaving Reichard as the only Minnesota player to put up any points. The third-year kicker is 1-of-5 in the NFL with as many as 20 field goals made so far this season, and he's missed just two in the process.

news.body: Will Reichard converted his only extra point attempt while also missing his lone field goal attempt in the Vikings' 19-15 loss to the Lions in Week 8.
news.head: Will Reichard misses field goal in Week 8
news.impact: Reichard struggled to make an impact Sunday, registering less than nine points for the first time in his last six contests. The kicker will look to get back on track against the Buffalo Bills in Week 9.

news.body: Anthony Richardson Sr. will start for the Colts in Week 12. The report came seconds before news broke that the team released Daniel Jones. Either way, the team has a new starter.
news.head: Anthony Richardson Sr. to start for Colts in Week 12
news.impact: Richardson came in to the game last night in relief of Jones, who was having yet another abysmal performance. Richardson didn’t fair much better, going 0 for 2 during his short relief stint. Still, he’s a capable runner with a cannon for an arm, so he provides some intrigue in that regard. However, he’s a QB3 at best given the state of the Colts roster.

news.body: Anthony Richardson Sr. (groin) will be active for Sunday night's game against the Kansas City Chiefs.
news.head: Anthony Richardson Sr. (groin) active for Week 2
news.impact: Richardson is going to be active for the Colts on Sunday night, so his groin injury is likely considered nothing more than a minor issue at this point. He will continue to serve as the QB2 for this team behind Daniel Jones.

news.body: Anthony Richardson Sr. is expected to be available for Sunday’s game against the Chiefs.
news.head: Anthony Richardson Sr. (groin) expected to be available Week 2
news.impact: Richardson returned to practice on Thursday. He should remain the backup to Daniel Jones.

news.body: Anthony Richardson Sr. (groin) returned to practice as a full participant on Thursday.
news.head: Anthony Richardson Sr. (groin) returns to practice Thursday
news.impact: Richardson returned to the practice field on Thursday after missing Wednesday's practice due to a groin injury. He was a full participant and it looks like he should be fully healthy heading into the weekend, though he will continue to be just the QB2 on this offense behind Daniel Jones for the foreseeable future.

news.body: Baker Mayfield was a full participant in practice on Thursday.
news.head: Baker Mayfield (foot/thumb) logs full practice Thursday
news.impact: Mayfield is dealing with multiple injuries. He remains on track to be good to go for Monday's game against the Panthers.

news.body: Baker Mayfield completed 20-of-33 pass attempts for 187 yards and two touchdowns while also rushing six times for 36 yards in the Buccaneers' 31-21 Week 11 loss to the Lions.
news.head: Baker Mayfield tosses two touchdowns in Week 11 loss to Lions
news.impact: Mayfield delivered a gritty performance while playing through multiple injuries Sunday, recording multiple passing touchdowns for the first time this season. The quarterback will look to take advantage of a generous Carolina Panthers defense in Week 12.

news.body: Baker Mayfield (foot) will return to start at quarterback for the Tampa Bay Buccaneers Sunday according to Ian Rapoport.
news.head: Baker Mayfield (foot) will play Sunday
news.impact: Mayfield will take the field while fighting through lingering plantar fasciitis, as the veteran signal-caller looks to keep Tampa Bay’s NFC South hopes alive while playing though the injury for head coach Todd Bowles, facing a resurgent Detroit Lions defense on the road Sunday.

news.body: Baker Mayfield is good to go Sunday against the Lions barring a setback.
news.head: Baker Mayfield (foot) to play Sunday barring setback
news.impact: Pelissero notes that Mayfield is expected to wear a special orthotic and new cleats to help with the injury he is managing. He will be a mid-to-low-end QB2.

news.body: Bo Nix completed 19 of 35 passes for 225 yards, one touchdown and one interception while rushing six times for five yards in the Broncos' 38-24 win over the Raiders in Week 11.
news.head: Bo Nix throws one touchdown in Week 11
