news.impact: The Broncos scored a season-high 38 points, but three of their five touchdowns came on the ground via Jonah Coleman -- while another came on defense. Nix, meanwhile, threw just one touchdown after throwing two in each of his previous two games. The Broncos quarterback will look to rebound against the Steelers in Week 12.

news.body: Bo Nix completed 25 of 37 passes for 237 yards, two touchdowns, and one interception in the Broncos' 26-21 win over the Panthers in Week 9.
news.head: Bo Nix throws two touchdowns again in Week 9
news.impact: Nix threw touchdowns to Courtland Sutton and Pat Bryant, including a 26-yard score to the latter in the fourth quarter. The Broncos quarterback has now thrown six touchdowns over his last three games. That said, Nix has been less productive on the ground since his 74-yard rushing performance in Week 7. Denver gets a Week 10 bye before facing the Raiders in Week 11.

news.body: Bo Nix completed 20 of 32 passes for 222 yards and two touchdowns, while rushing three times for four yards in the Broncos' 28-24 win over the Chiefs in Week 8.
news.head: Bo Nix throws two touchdowns in Week 8
news.impact: Nix threw touchdowns to Jaylen Waddle and Nate Adkins without turning the ball over. The Broncos quarterback didn't offer much on the ground, but he has now thrown four touchdowns and zero interceptions over his last two games. Nix gets the Panthers in Week 9.

news.body: Bo Nix completed 15 of 29 passes for 222 yards and one touchdown, while rushing seven times for 73 yards and another touchdown in the Broncos' 30-16 win over the Cardinals in Week 7.
news.head: Bo Nix Scores Twice in Week 7 Win
news.impact: Nix did most of his damage with his legs, including a 62-yard touchdown run in the second quarter. He later connected with RJ Harvey for a 52-yard score and finished without a turnover. Nix's 51.7% completion rate wasn't impressive, but 295 total yards and two touchdowns were enough for a strong fantasy performance. He enters the low-end QB1 conversation heading into Week 8.

news.body: Brock Purdy has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Seahawks.
news.head: Brock Purdy (ankle) ruled out for Week 12
news.impact: Purdy was unable to practice all week after suffering an ankle injury last Sunday. It will be Mac Jones behind center for the 49ers.

news.body: Brock Purdy remained sidelined from practice on Thursday.
news.head: Brock Purdy (ankle) misses practice again Thursday
news.impact: Purdy missed his second straight practice this week. He will need to be monitored in practice on Friday, but he is currently trending in the wrong direction.

news.body: Brock Purdy is not practicing on Wednesday due to an ankle injury.
news.head: Brock Purdy (ankle) not practicing Wednesday
news.impact: Purdy injured his ankle in the second quarter last Sunday. 49ers head coach Kyle Shanahan said it’s not a high ankle and he is day to day.

news.body: Brock Purdy completed 21-of-26 passes for 255 yards with three touchdowns and no interceptions in Sunday's 35-10 drubbing of the Vikings.
news.head: Brock Purdy delivers another stellar effort in Sunday's win
news.impact: Purdy threw three touchdown passes for the second straight game Sunday night, as he continues his MVP-caliber play this season. Through 10 games, Purdy has completed 71.0% of his passes (2nd NFL) while averaging more than 260 yards with 23 TDs (3rd) and only five interceptions. Purdy is orchestrating one of the most potent offenses in the league and is one of the top QBs on the board.

news.body: Bryce Young was a full participant in practice on Thursday.
news.head: Bryce Young (foot) logs full practice Thursday
news.impact: Young was also on the injury report last week. He should still be good to go for Monday's game against the Buccaneers.

news.body: Bryce Young completed 22-of-30 pass attempts for 254 yards, two touchdowns, and one interception. He rushed for negative two yards on two carries.
news.head: Bryce Young tosses a pair of touchdowns in Week 11 win
news.impact: Young turned in a solid performance after failing to throw a touchdown pass a week ago. Young connected on touchdown passes to Tetairoa McMillan and Mitchell Evans to help pace the Panthers to their fifth victory of the season. They will take on Tampa Bay in Week 12.

news.body: Bryce Young was a full participant in practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Bryce Young (foot) logs full practice Wednesday
news.impact: Young is back on the injury report, but he was able to practice in full. He should be good to go for Sunday's game against the Ravens.

news.body: Bryce Young completed 17-of-30 passes for 200 yards in a 20-17 win over the Saints. He added one rushing yard on one attempt.
news.head: Bryce Young manages Week 10 win
news.impact: Young failed to throw a passing touchdown for the first time this season, but did enough to lead the Panthers' to their fourth win of the season. Young and the Panthers will take on the Ravens in Week 11.

news.body: Caleb Williams completed 30-of-44 pass attempts for 345 yards and two touchdowns while also rushing three times for 15 yards in the Bears' 39-35 Week 12 win over the Lions.
news.head: Caleb Williams comes up clutch in Week 12 win over Lions
news.impact: Williams has been impactful behind center of late, passing for two touchdowns in four of his last five games. The quarterback offers fantasy managers a dynamic QB1 option ahead of a Week 13 matchup against the Jacksonville Jaguars.

news.body: Caleb WIlliams told reporters that he was “fine” after undergoing X-rays following the Week 12 win over the Lions.
news.head: Caleb Williams 'fine' after undergoing X-rays following Week 12 game
news.impact: Williams told reporters he took a weird fall and wanted to double check. He will get a mini bye heading into Week 13.

news.body: Caleb Williams completed 15-of-23 pass attempts for 181 yards, two touchdowns, and one interception while also rushing four times for 11 yards in the Bears' 21-13 Week 11 win over the Saints.
news.head: Caleb Williams throws two touchdowns in Week 11 win over Saints
news.impact: Williams has been steady behind center of late, throwing for two touchdowns in three of his last four games. The athletic signal-caller will look to offer more dynamic results in a Week 12 Thanksgiving Day matchup against the Detroit Lions.

news.body: Caleb Williams completed 22 of his 37 passes for 279 yards, two touchdowns, and four interceptions while adding five rushes for 16 yards in a 27-24 win over the Buccaneers in Week 9.
news.head: Caleb Williams throws two TDs, four INTs in Week 9
news.impact: Williams came into the game with just one interception on the season, but he struggled on Sunday night, throwing four picks in the close win over Tampa Bay. His touchdowns went to Luther Burden III and Rome Odunze in the contest. Williams has thrown for 1,546 yards, eight touchdowns, and five interceptions in six games for the Bears this year. A solid fantasy QB1 for the rest of the season, Williams will be on bye in Week 10 before a Week 11 matchup vs. the Saints.

news.body: Cam Ward completed 21-of-30 passes for 248 yards and two touchdowns in the Titans 51-30 loss against the Cowboys.
news.head: Cam Ward totals three touchdowns Sunday
news.impact: Ward added another score on the ground at the goal line. On one of his touchdown passes, he connected with Carnell Tate who appeared to be down but he got up and ran into the end zone. He'll take on the Jaguars next.

news.body: Cam Ward completed 28 of 39 passes for 231 yards, two touchdowns and a pick in the Titans' 40-23 loss to the Jaguars on Sunday. He also ran three times for 39 yards.
news.head: Cam Ward tosses two touchdowns in loss
news.impact: Ward had a decent game, all things considered. He now has four touchdown passes in the last two weeks, as many as he had in the previous seven games. His rushing production is also a welcome sight, going for 80 total rushing yards in that same two-game span. He had 71 total rushing yards in his first seven games. He certainly seems to have turned a corner these last two games; here's to hoping they can build some momentum and that this lasts.

news.body: Cam Ward completed 26 of his 40 passes for 304 yards and two touchdowns while adding 41 rushing yards on seven rushes in a 43-36 overtime loss to the Bengals in Week 8.
news.head: Cam Ward throws two TDs in Week 8 loss
news.impact: Ward fumbled twice, losing one, but he surprisingly kept his team in it against a tough Bengals offense. The second-year quarterback completed his touchdown passes to Chimere Dike and Wan'Dale Robinson in the contest. Ward has now thrown for 1,483 yards, six touchdowns, and five interceptions through eight games. He will be on a bye in Week 9.

news.body: Cam Ward completed 20 of his 31 passes for 181 yards and one interception while adding two rushes for five yards in a 27-24 loss to the Browns in Week 7.
news.head: Cam Ward throws one INT in Week 7 loss
news.impact: Ward struggled yet again, failing to throw a touchdown pass for the third time this season. The second-year signal-caller is still looking for his first multi-touchdown game as it has been a disappointing sophomore campaign for the 2025 No. 1 overall pick. Ward will not be a recommended fantasy option heading into Week 8's matchup vs. the Bengals.

news.body: C.J. Stroud completed 21-of-27 passes for 194 yards with three touchdowns and one interception in Thursday's 26-3 blowout of the Colts.
news.head: C.J. Stroud fires three more touchdowns strikes in Week 11 win
news.impact: Stroud added 27 yards on six carries to round out another impressive effort Thursday night. The fourth-year QB is completely dialed in right now, as he's thrown multiple touchdowns in five straight games, with at least three TD passes in four of them. During this run, Stroud has posted a 63.6% completion rate while averaging right around 250 yards per game with a 16-4 TD/INT ratio. He is a certain QB1 in standard formats

news.body: C.J. Stroud completed 20-of-38 passes for 211 yards with three touchdowns and one interception in Sunday's 27-24 loss to the Browns.
news.head: C.J. Stroud tosses three more touchdowns in Week 10
news.impact: A week after firing five touchdown passes, Stroud followed up with three more Sunday afternoon. The Texans QB has now thrown for multiple scores in four straight weeks, recording 1a 13-3 TD/INT ratio in the process. Stroud is definitely playing at a QB1 level for fantasy purposes. The Colts present another inviting matchup in Week 11.

news.body: C.J. Stroud completed 21-of-35 passing attempts for 384 yards, five touchdowns, and one interception in Sunday's 44-22 win over the Los Angeles Chargers.
news.head: C.J. Stroud tosses five touchdowns in win Sunday
news.impact: Stroud played a superb game on Sunday. He finished with over 400 total yards on the day and threw five touchdowns, while limiting himself to just one turnover in the process. He has been playing fantastic for most of the season and should continue to be a good week-to-week starter for the foreseeable future.

news.body: C.J. Stroud completed 17-of-28 passes for 153 yards and two touchdowns in the Texans 27-21 loss against the Giants.
news.head: C.J. Stroud tosses two touchdowns Sunday
news.impact: Stroud did not throw for many yards, but he also didn't commit any turnovers. The Texans are heading into their bye next week.

news.body: Dak Prescott completed 19-of-28 pass attempts for 291 yards, two touchdowns, and one interception while also rushing twice for 19 yards and one touchdown in the Cowboys' 39-38 Week 12 loss to the Eagles.
news.head: Dak Prescott accounts for three touchdowns in Week 12 loss to Eagles
news.impact: Prescott has led a high-powered Dallas passing attack of late, passing for over 290 yards and two or more touchdowns in each of his last four games. The quarterback faces a stiff test against an aggressive Seattle Seahawks defense in Week 13.

news.body: Dak Prescott (hand) is off of the injury report Wednesday for the Dallas Cowboys according to Todd Archer.
news.head: Dak Prescott (hand) off injury report for Week 12
news.impact: Prescott is good to go after a short walkthrough practice week, as the signal-caller leads a high-octane passing attack against the Eagles Thanksgiving Day.

news.body: Dak Prescott was listed as a full participant on Monday's estimated injury report.
news.head: Dak Prescott (hand) logs full practice on estimated report Monday
news.impact: Prescott was listed with a hand injury. He should still be good to go for Thursday’s game against the Eagles on Thanksgiving.

news.body: Dak Prescott completed 28-of-33 passes for 325 yards and four touchdowns in the Cowboys 51-30 win over the Titans.
news.head: Dak Prescott totals five touchdowns Sunday
news.impact: Prescott added a fifth touchdown on the day on the ground. He tossed touchdowns to CeeDee Lamb, George Pickens, Javonte Williams and Brevyn Spann-Ford through the air. He'll face the Eagles next on Thanksgiving.

news.body: Deshaun Watson completed 25 of 40 passes for 312 yards, adding 49 yards and a touchdown on eight carries in Sunday's 27-24 win over the Texans.
news.head: Deshaun Watson accounts for 360 yards, one touchdown in Week 10
news.impact: Watson threw one pick in Sunday's win, but that was one of the few blemishes for the dual-threat QB, as he led the Browns back from 17 down at one point to grab their sixth victory of the season. After missing Week 9, this was a solid comeback. Watson is now over 2,100 yards passing and 266 yards rushing with nine total touchdowns through nine games. He's certainly a factor in deeper and two-QB fantasy formats right now.

news.body: Deshaun Watson (concussion) is set to start on Sunday against the Texans.
news.head: Deshaun Watson (concussion) will start in Week 10
news.impact: Watson missed Week 9 due to a concussion. He's past the issue now and will return to the starting role at the helm of the Browns' offense. Shedeur Sanders will return to a backup role.

news.body: Jeremy Fowler reports that the Browns plan to start Deshaun Watson in Week 10 against the Texans.
news.head: Deshaun Watson (concussion) expected to start in Week 10
news.impact: Watson was expected to return behind center once he cleared concussion protocol. Shedeur Sanders got the start this week against the Saints.

news.body: Browns QB Deshaun Watson (concussion) is officially inactive for a Week 9 matchup with the Saints.
news.head: Deshaun Watson (concussion) officially inactive for Week 9
news.impact: Watson did not clear the concussion protocol in time to be active for Sunday's contest. Sheduer Sanders will draw the start, with Dillion Gabriel serving as the backup.

news.body: Drake Maye (ankle) will miss at least six weeks for the New England Patriots according to Ian Rapoport.
news.head: Drake Maye (ankle) to miss at least six weeks
news.impact: Maye will miss extended time after being injured in the first quarter of a Week 10 loss to the Detroit Lions, with quarterback potentially only returning if New England remains in the playoff hunt. Tommy DeVito remains QB1 unless the Patriots look to add to their quarterback room moving forward.

news.body: The Patriots are concerned that QB Drake Maye fractured his ankle.
news.head: Drake Maye (ankle) out indefinitely
news.impact: Schefter notes that Maye remained in Germany to undergo additional testing to determine whether he needs surgery. He is feared to be out for the season.

news.body: The Patriots have ruled out QB Drake Maye for the remainder of the game with an ankle injury.
news.head: Drake Maye (ankle) ruled out
news.impact: Maye was injured early on a sack by Aidan Hutchinson. He will finish the game with completions on 3-of-4 pass attempts for 48 yards and one rush for 11 yards. Tommy DeVito will quarterback the Patriots for the remainder of the game.

news.body: Drake Maye (knee) is headed to the locker room for the New England Patriots according to Mike Reiss.
news.head: Drake Maye (knee) heads to locker room Sunday
news.impact: Maye limped off the field after being sacked by Detroit defensive end Aidan Hutchinson in the first quarter, completing 3-of-4 pass attempts for 48 yards and rushing once for 11 yards prior to exiting. Tommy DeVito has taken over behind center for head coach Mike Vrabel against the Lions Sunday.

news.body: Fernando Mendoza completed 18 of 37 passes for 267 yards, three touchdowns and one interception while rushing four times for 22 yards in the Raiders' 38-24 loss to the Broncos in Week 11.
news.head: Fernando Mendoza throws three touchdowns in Week 11
news.impact: Mendoza threw the first three touchdown passes of his career, connecting with Ashton Jeanty, Ian Thomas and Jack Bech. The rookie helped the Raiders erase a 17-point deficit but was sacked five times and threw a pick-six late in the fourth quarter. All things considered, Mendoza put together a productive fantasy performance against a difficult matchup in his second career start. He enters the QB2 conversation in Superflex leagues heading into Week 12 against Cleveland.

news.body: Fernando Mendoza completed 17-of-29 passes for 143 yards in the Raiders 21-13 loss against the Seahawks.
news.head: Fernando Mendoza runs for touchdown Sunday
news.impact: Mendoza had some success early in his first career start, including a rushing touchdown on his first possession. He lost Brock Bowers to an injury early which didn't help. Mendoza did not turn the ball over, but he was sacked six times. He draws another tough matchup next week against the Broncos.

news.body: Raiders QB Fernando Mendoza will make his first career start in Week 10 against the Seahawks.
news.head: Fernando Mendoza to start in Week 10 against Seattle
news.impact: With Kirk Cousins traded to the Vikings, Mendoza is set to take over the rest of the season for the Raiders. The rookie will face a pair of tough tests in his first two starts against the Seahawks and Broncos.

news.body: Fernando Mendoza is expected to play roughly the first half in Thursday's preseason game against the Texans.
news.head: Fernando Mendoza to play roughly first half Thursday
news.impact: Mendoza will get extended run on the field in his second preseason game. Aidan O'Connell will take the field in the second half.

news.body: Jacoby Brissett completed 24-of-37 pass attempts for 276 yards, one touchdown, and one interception in a 35-33 loss to the Panthers. He added seven rushing yards on two attempts.
news.head: Jacoby Brissett tosses game ending INT in Week 11 loss
news.impact: Brissett was solid in his second start for Baltimore, but tossed up a bad pass late in the fourth quarter to seal the win for the Panthers. The veteran connected with Rashod Bateman on a 52-yard touchdown reception early in the first quarter. The Ravens and Brissett will look to bounce back in a Week 12 matchup with Houston.

news.body: Jacoby Brissett completed 33-of-49 passing attempts for 340 yards and one interception in Monday night's 23-20 loss to the Los Angeles Chargers.
news.head: Jacoby Brissett scoreless in Ravens debut Moday
news.impact: Brissett threw the ball nearly 50 times in his first game with the Ravens. He was able to rack up 340 yards in the process, but he didn't score any touchdowns, which left him with an underwhelming fantasy score individually. He was able to successfully support Zay Flowers and Mark Andrews, but the team will almost certainly want him to throw significantly less passes on a game-to-game basis moving forward, so those guys may not have the consistent workload that this week suggested they might.

news.body: The Arizona Cardinals are finalizing a trade to send QB Jacoby Brissett to the Baltimore Ravens.
news.head: Jacoby Brissett traded to Ravens
news.impact: The deal is expected to be finalized this weekend. The Ravens get their new starting quarterback after losing Lamar Jackson and Tyler Huntley to injuries.

news.body: Jacoby Brissett has officially been benched by the Cardinals.
news.head: Jacoby Brissett officially benched by Cardinals
news.impact: Gardner Minshew II was named the starter after leading Arizona to a comeback win on Sunday against the Cowboys. Minshew will start in Week 9 in Seattle.

news.body: Jalen Hurts (blood clot) is out for the remainder of the 2026 NFL Season due to blood clots found in his lungs. Hurts was on blood thinners already to treat the clot that was originally found, but will need additional treatment to bring him back to full health. He is expected to make a full recovery.
news.head: Jalen Hurts (blood clot) out for the season as additional clots are found
news.impact: A report by Rapoport noted Hurts played in London with no sleep, as sleep was a risk for the QB. This is obviously extremely serious news for Hurts, his family, and the team, so don’t lose sight of that, but it’s relieving to hear he should make a full recovery. As for football, it’s a big blow for an already struggling Eagles team, who will now proceed with Tanner McKee at QB. Don’t be surprised if Cole Payton also sees some run towards the end of the year if things really fly south for the Eagles.

news.body: Jalen Hurts (blood clot) has been placed on IR due to a blood clot.
news.head: Jalen Hurts (blood clot) placed on IR
news.impact: At first the Eagles were not going to place him on IR, but after further consultations, they have decided to make that move. Tanner McKee will start in his place for at least the next four games, with Carolina on tap tomorrow. All the pass catchers will likely see a downtick in production, but should still be usable if McKee is halfway decent.

news.body: Jalen Hurts has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Panthers due to a superficial blood clot.
news.head: Jalen Hurts ruled out Sunday due to superficial blood clot
news.impact: Per the Eagles, Hurts underwent an ultrasound that revealed a superficial blood clot. "On Wednesday night, a follow-up ultrasound revealed movement in the small blood clot." It will likely be Tanner McKee starting for the Eagles.

news.body: Jalen Hurts was a full participant in practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Jalen Hurts (calf) logs full practice Wednesday
news.impact: Hurts fantasy value will largely be dependant on the health of DeVonta Smith and Saquon Barkley. He is a risky start for fantasy managers as of now given his recent struggles.

news.body: Jared Goff completed 25-of-36 pass attempts for 313 yards, one touchdown, and one interception while also rushing three times for 10 yards in the Lions' 39-35 Week 12 loss to the Bears.
news.head: Jared Goff surpasses 300 yards in Week 12 loss to Bears
news.impact: Goff fell slightly back to earth Thursday, tossing less than two touchdowns for the first time in his last three contests. The signal-caller remains one of the more stable quarterback options while guiding a high-octane Detroit offense for fantasy managers, with a Week 13 matchup against the Atlanta Falcons up next.

news.body: Jared Goff completed 20-of-28 pass attempts for 279 yards and two touchdowns while also rushing five times for 12 yards in the Lions' 31-21 Week 11 win over the Buccaneers.
news.head: Jared Goff tosses two touchdowns in Week 11 win over Buccaneers
news.impact: Goff continues a productive stretch behind center, throwing for two or more touchdowns in four of his last six games. The veteran signal caller will for another impactful performance against a tough Chicago Bears defense in Week 12.

news.body: Jared Goff completed 20 of his 31 passes for 303 yards, three touchdowns, and two interceptions while adding a three-yard run in a 35-10 win over the Patriots in Munich, Germany in Week 10.
news.head: Jared Goff throws three TDs in Week 10 win
news.impact: Goff and the Lions made short work of the Patriots, who lost Drake Maye to an ankle injury during the first quarter. Two of Goff's touchdowns went to Amon-Ra St. Brown while the third went to Isaac TeSlaa. Goff has now thrown for 18 touchdowns and four interceptions in nine games this year. He will now head back to the US to take on the Buccaneers in Week 11.

news.body: Jared Goff is off the injury report for Sunday's game against the Patriots.
news.head: Jared Goff (chest) off injury report Sunday
news.impact: Goff was limited in practice earlier this week. He will be good to go on Sunday.

news.body: Jayden Daniels completed 23 of his 35 passes for 289 yards and added six rushes for 55 yards in a 22-20 win over the Bengals in Week 11's Monday night game.
news.head: Jayden Daniels throws for 289 yards in MNF win
news.impact: Daniels and the Washington offense got off to a slow start on a rainy night at Northwest Stadium as they didn't score their first points until the second quarter. That being said, with the Commanders trailing 20-19, Daniels completed two long passes to Antonio Williams with less than a minute left in the game to set up a game-winning 26-yard field goal. Daniels has thrown for 10 touchdowns and two interceptions while adding 335 rushing yards and two scores on the ground in eight games this year. He will be a solid QB1 in fantasy in Week 12 vs. the Cardinals.

news.body: Jayden Daniels completed 23 of his 33 passes for 249 yards, three touchdowns, and two interceptions while adding 28 rushing yards on 11 carries in a 24-21 win over the Giants in Week 10's Thursday night game.
news.head: Jayden Daniels throws three TDs in TNF win
news.impact: Daniels wasn't his sharpest, throwing his first two interceptions of the season, but he got the job done. He threw two long touchdowns in the game, including a game-winning 32-yard TD toss to Stefon Diggs with 57 seconds left in regulation. Daniels now has 1,499 passing yards, 10 touchdowns, and two interceptions through seven games this year. He will be a solid QB1 in fantasy in Week 11 vs. the Bengals.

news.body: Jayden Daniels completed 24/35 passes for 274 yards and a touchdown while rushing four times for 16 yards.
news.head: Jayden Daniels nears 300 total yards in loss
news.impact: Despite his second-highest passing total of the season, Daniels once again struggled in the clutch and was unable to score in the waning seconds of the one-score game. Daniels and the Commanders will look to bounce back on Thursday Night Football for an inter-division game against the Giants, where he will be a mid-QB1 option.

news.body: Jayden Daniels completed 16 of his 29 passes for 217 yards and one touchdown while adding 23 yards on two rushes in a 27-10 win over the Eagles in Week 8.
news.head: Jayden Daniels throws one TD in Week 8 win
news.impact: Daniels didn't post huge numbers in the Sunday night win but it didn't matter against a sputtering Philadelphia team. His lone touchdown pass went to Stefon Diggs on an eight-yard completion in the second quarter. Daniels has thrown for 976 yards, six touchdowns, and zero interceptions in five contests this season. He will be a solid QB1 in fantasy in Week 9 vs. the Rams.

news.body: J.J. McCarthy completed 18-of-38 passes for 173 yards and a touchdown and also ran seven times for 33 yards in the Giants' 23-18 win over the Jaguars.
news.head: J.J. McCarthy has modest game against Jaguars
news.impact: McCarthy didn't have a big game by any means, but he did enough to keep the Giants ahead and in control for the majority of the game, and greatly helped by the defense putting them in good spots. It would have been nice to see him complete more than 50% of his passes, but he isn't complaining after the win.

news.body: J.J. McCarthy completed 23 of his 36 passes for 293 yards, one touchdown, and one interception while adding 34 rushing yards on six carries in a 24-21 loss to the Commanders in Week 10's Thursday night game.
news.head: J.J. McCarthy throws one TD in Week 10 loss
news.impact: McCarthy dealt with a hip pointer throughout the week, but it didn't seem to be an issue for him in the loss on Thursday night. The veteran signal-caller found Isaiah Likely for a 66-yard touchdown catch in the fourth quarter to give the Giants a temporary lead. McCarthy has thrown for 915 yards, two touchdowns, and two interceptions in five games for the Giants this year. He will be a solid QB2 in a tough matchup against the Jaguars in Week 11.

news.body: J.J. McCarthy (hip) is off of the injury report for Thursday night's game against the Washington Commanders.
news.head: J.J. McCarthy (hip) off injury report for Thursday
news.impact: McCarthy suffered a hip injury in Week 9, but he is now off of the team's injury report ahead of Thursday night's game and is going to be a full go against the Commanders. Fantasy managers should continue to expect mixed results from the young quarterback, though he might struggle more this week if he's still managing the lingering effects of his injury.

news.body: J.J. McCarthy was practicing on Tuesday.
news.head: J.J. McCarthy (hip) practices Tuesday
news.impact: McCarthy remains on track to be good to go for Thursday’s game against the Commanders.

news.body: Joe Burrow completed 28 of his 40 passes for 300 yards and two touchdowns in a 22-20 loss to the Commanders in Week 11.
news.head: Joe Burrow throws two TDs in Week 11 loss
news.impact: Burrow and the Cincy offense got off to a slow start on a rainy night at Northwest Stadium as they didn't score their first points until the second quarter. His first touchdown pass went to Tee Higgins in the second quarter, while his second was a four-yard completion to Colbie Young in the third. The game on Monday night was the first time Burrow didn't throw for at least three touchdowns since Week 4 vs. Jacksonville. He will be a top-three fantasy QB in Week 12 against the Saints.

news.body: Joe Burrow is practicing on Friday.
news.head: Joe Burrow (illness) practicing Friday
news.impact: Burrow had missed his press conference on Thursday due to an illness. He appears to still be trending towards being good to go for Monday's game against the Commanders.

news.body: Joe Burrow completed 35-of-44 passing attempts for 409 yards and four touchdowns in Sunday night's 38-18 win over the Pittsburgh Steelers.
news.head: Joe Burrow dominant in win Sunday
news.impact: Burrow had another unreal performance on Sunday night. He took on a tough Pittsburgh defense, but he was able to come away with over 400 yards and four touchdowns en route to a win, while also committing zero turnovers in the process. He has been playing some of the best football in the league recently and will certainly be an MVP finalist if he can continue on a similar pace over the back half of the season.

news.body: Joe Burrow completed 24-of-29 pass attempts for 271 yards and three touchdowns in a 34-17 win over the Falcons. Burrow also rushed for seven yards and a touchdown on three attempts.
news.head: Joe Burrow tosses three touchdowns in Week 9 win
news.impact: Burrow found Ja'Marr Chase once and Tee Higgins twice for his three passing touchdowns in another stellar performance. Burrow has at least three passing touchdowns in each of his last four games. The Bengals will look to continue their strong play against the Steelers in Week 10.

news.body: Joe Milton III completed 21-of-31 pass attempts for 331 yards, three touchdowns, and one interception while also rushing three times for 15 yards and one touchdown in the Eagles' 39-38 Week 12 win over the Cowboys.
news.head: Joe Milton III records four touchdowns in Week 12 win over Cowboys
news.impact: Milton III was dynamic in leading a comeback victory Thursday, averaging 15.8 yards per completion in the win. The quarterback will look for more explosive plays against the Arizona Cardinals in Week 13.

news.body: Joe Milton III completed 11/22 passes for 141 yards with no interceptions or touchdowns in Sunday’s win over the Steelers. He also added five rushes for nine yards.
news.head: Joe Milton III secures first win as Eagles starter
news.impact: Milton did just enough to end the Eagles’ seven game losing streak. Milton has a much more favorable defensive matchup against the Cowboys on Thursday, but he isn’t fantasy-relevant in one quarterback leagues.

news.body: Eagles coach Nick Sirianni announced Joe Milton will start in Week 11 against the Steelers.
news.head: Joe Milton III to remain Eagles starter in Week 11
news.impact: Milton started in the Eagles’ loss to the Giants before their bye. He'll continue to add more mobility as a rusher to go along with an inconsistent arm.

news.body: Joe Milton III completed 18-of-34 passing attempts for 169 yards and rushed the ball nine times for 64 yards in Sunday's 19-11 loss to the New York Giants.
news.head: Joe Milton III underwhelms as passer Sunday
news.impact: The Eagles took a chance on starting Milton on Sunday, but it didn't go very well. He failed to score a touchdown over the course of the game and led Philadelphia to just 11 points as a team, but he did lead the team with 64 rushing yards, which helped pad his fantasy total on the day. It will be hard to trust starting anyone on Philadelphia's offense for as long as Milton remains their starter.

news.body: Jordan Love completed 17-of-29 pass attempts for 198 yards, one touchdown, and two interceptions while also rushing once for seven yards in the Packers' 26-13 Week 12 loss to the Rams.
news.head: Jordan Love disappoints in Week 12 loss to Rams
news.impact: Love has struggled behind center of late, passing for less than 250 yards while throwing one or more interceptions in each of his last two games. The quarterback will look to get back on track against the New Orleans Saints in Week 13.

news.body: Jordan Love completed 17-of-27 pass attempts for 220 yards, one touchdown, and one interception in the Packers' 30-10 Week 10 loss to the Vikings.
news.head: Jordan Love disappoints in Week 10 loss to Vikings
news.impact: Love struggled to make plays against a disruptive Minnesota defense, finishing with under 270 passing yards for the first time in his last six games. The signal-caller will look to get back on track in Week 12 against the Los Angeles Rams after the team's Week 11 bye.

news.body: Jordan Love completed 23-of-29 pass attempts for 372 yards and three touchdowns while also rushing once for 13 yards and one touchdown in the Packers' 25-27 Week 9 win over the Patriots.
news.head: Jordan Love accounts for four touchdowns in Week 9 win over Patriots
news.impact: Love continues an impactful stretch behind center, recording two or more touchdowns in each of nine games. The quarterback has offered fantasy managers a dynamic quarterback option behind an inconsistent Green Bay offensive line to this point, with a difficult Week 10 contest against the Minnesota Vikings up next.

news.body: Jordan Love completed 30 of 41 passes for 288 yards with three touchdowns and one interception in Thursday's 27-19 win over the Panthers.
news.head: Jordan Love fires three TD passes in Thursday night win
news.impact: Aside from an early fourth-quarter pick deep into n Carolina territory, Love was pretty locked in on Thursday. The Panthers did not generate much of a pass rush, failing to sack Love even once, and that kept the Green Bay QB comfortable in the pocket most of the night. Love has thrown an interception in three straight games now, but he has countered that with six touchdown passes and an additional score on the ground. He's also averaged just under 280 passing yards per game in that span.

news.body: Josh Allen completed 27-of-45 passes for 304 yards with one touchdown and two interceptions in the Bills 26-9 win over the Dolphins.
news.head: Josh Allen throws for 304 yards Sunday
news.impact: Allen did not attempt a single rush all game. It was not his best performance overall as a result, though he still threw for over 300 yards. He'll take on the Chiefs next on Thursday.

news.body: Josh Allen completed 11-of-21 passes for 196 yards, one touchdown, and one interception in a 31-12 win over the Jets. He added five rushing yards and two touchdowns on five attempts.
news.head: Josh Allen rushes for two touchdowns in Week 10 win
news.impact: Allen tallied his lowest passing yards total of the season, but was able to turn in a solid day with three total touchdowns. Allen has thrown an interception in three straight games and will look to break that streak against Miami in Week 11.

news.body: Josh Allen completed 21 of 31 passes for 234 yards with one touchdown and one interception, adding 15 yards on six carries in Monday's 23-6 win over the Vikings.
news.head: Josh Allen turns in decent performance Monday night
news.impact: This performance was certainly below the norm for Allen, but considering it came against arguably the league's top defense, it was serviceable. Allen eclipsed 2,000 yards passing for the season in this one, and he's now up to a dozen touchdown passes along with a whopping nine rushing scores. Allen remains one of the top fantasy assets in the league regardless of position. He should be set for a larger output against the Jets in Week 10.

news.body: Josh Allen completed 21-of-34 passes for 289 yards, two touchdowns, and one interception in a 36-10 win over the Ravens. He rushed for 30 yards and a touchdown on seven attempts.
news.head: Josh Allen accounts for three touchdowns in Week 8 win
news.impact: Allen opened the scoring with a one-yard rush in first quarter and found DJ Moore and Dalton Kincaid on passing touchdowns to ice the game in the fourth quarter. Allen has at least two touchdowns in every game so far this season. He will look to continue to build on his strong start to the season against the Vikings in Week 9.

news.body: Justin Herbert has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Patriots.
news.head: Justin Herbert (concussion) ruled out for Week 12
news.impact: Herbert was unable to clear concussion protocol. DJ Uiagalelei is expected to start in his place for the Chargers.

news.body: Justin Herbert did not practice on Thursday.
news.head: Justin Herbert (concussion) misses practice Thursday
news.impact: Herbert is trending towards missing Week 12 as he remains in concussion protocol.

news.body: Justin Herbert did not practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Justin Herbert (concussion) misses practice Wednesday
news.impact: Herbert was placed in concussion protocol to open the week. His status is up in the air heading into Week 12.

news.body: Justin Herbert completed 15 of his 21 passes for 131 yards and two touchdowns while adding eight rushes for 32 yards and a touchdown in a 27-24 loss to the Jets in Week 11.
news.head: Justin Herbert throws two TDs, suffers concussion late in Week 11 loss
news.impact: Herbert tossed a pair of touchdowns to Ladd McConkey while adding a 10-yard rushing touchdown in the close loss. He suffered a concussion late in the game and entered the league's concussion protocol after the contest ended. He is unlikely to play in Week 12 vs. the Patriots, putting DJ Uiagalelei in line to make the start. Uiagalelei has completed two of his seven pass attempts this season for 24 yards and a touchdown. Stay tuned to the Chargers' practice reports this week.

news.body: Kirk Cousins completed 26-of-38 passes for 235 yards with no touchdowns and one interception in Sunday's 35-10 loss to the 49ers.
news.head: Kirk Cousins flounders against 49ers on Sunday night
news.impact: Cousins had a nice return to the Vikings in Week 10. He followed up with a tough game in Week 11. The veteran QB was fairly efficient with his passing, but he failed to find the end zone, unless the pick-six he threw late in the second quarter counts. Joking aside, Cousins will have better games, and a matchup with one of his former teams - the Falcons - awaits in Week 12. Cousins is right on the fringe of QB1 status in standard formats.

news.body: Kirk Cousins completed 21-of-31 pass attempts for 207 yards, two touchdowns, and one interception while also rushing three times for 11 yards in the Vikings' 30-10 Week 10 win over the Packers.
news.head: Kirk Cousins tosses two touchdowns in Week 10 win over Packers
news.impact: Cousins continues a steady stretch behind center, tossing two or more touchdowns in eight of his 10 games. The veteran signal-caller looks to offer head coach Kevin O'Connell more reliable quarterback play after being traded from Las Vegas, with a tough Week 11 matchup against the San Francisco 49ers up next.

news.body: Vikings head coach Kevin O'Connell has announced that QB Kirk Cousins will start Sunday at Green Bay.
news.head: Kirk Cousins officially starting Sunday for Vikings
news.impact: This was the expectation and it is now official. Cousins will make his return to Minnesota where he should help boost the entire offense for the Vikings.

news.body: Kirk Cousins and the Raiders are finalizing a deal to trade the QB to the Vikings. Reports say Minnesota is sending Las Vegas a third-round pick in the deal.
news.head: Kirk Cousins traded to Vikings
news.impact: Cousins spent six years in Minnesota, where he threw for 23,265 yards and 171 touchdowns in 88 games with a passer rating of 101.2. He will reunite with an offense he knows, which increases the fantasy value for Minnesota pass catchers, particularly Justin Jefferson. Cousins remains fantasy relevant as a high-end QB2 with some low-end QB1 potential.

news.body: Kyler Murray has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the 49ers.
news.head: Kyler Murray (hamstring) ruled out Sunday
news.impact: Murray remains week-to-week.

news.body: Kyler Murray (hamstring) missed Minnesota's practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Kyler Murray (hamstring) misses practice Wednesday
news.impact: Murray is still managing a nagging hamstring issue and wasn't able to practice on Wednesday as a result. He looks likely to miss another game in Week 11, although that won't have much of an impact on the team with Kirk Cousins now starting at quarterback.

news.body: Kyler Murray has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Packers.
news.head: Kyler Murray (hamstring) ruled out Sunday
news.impact: Murray remains week-to-week. He will be the backup when he is healthy.

news.body: Vikings coach Kevin O'Connell said Kyler Murray remains week to week.
news.head: Kyler Murray (hamstring) remains week-to-week
news.impact: Murray will figure to backup Kirk Cousins when he is healthy.

news.body: Lamar Jackson (thumb) will miss 6-10 weeks after undergoing thumb surgery.
news.head: Lamar Jackson (thumb) undergoes surgery, out 6-10 weeks
news.impact: Jackson seems likely to miss the rest of the season while rehabbing from thumb surgery this week. However, that is not definite, as head coach Jesse Minter stated that the "timelines are challenging to predict." The Ravens traded for veteran QB Jacoby Brissett last week, and he's expected to helm the Ravens' offense starting Monday night against the Chargers.

news.body: The Ravens placed Lamar Jackson on injured reserve.
news.head: Lamar Jackson (thumb) officially placed on IR
news.impact: Jackson is expected to require surgery on his thumb injury. His status to return this season remains up in the air.

news.body: Lamar Jackson (thumb) will require surgery on his injured thumb and will head to injured reserve.
news.head: Lamar Jackson (thumb)will need surgery for thumb, heading to IR
news.impact: It’s a brutal loss for the Ravens and fantasy managers depending on Lamar’s return. The Ravens offense struggled to get anything going with Lamar out, and it wasn’t helped when backup Tyler Huntley also went down with injury. Jackson will now miss at least the next four games, and quite possibly more.

news.body: Lamar Jackson (thumb) has been ruled out for the remainder of Sunday’s contest between the Baltimore Ravens and Buffalo Bills according to Mike Garafolo.
news.head: Lamar Jackson (thumb) ruled out Sunday
news.impact: Jackson suffered the thumb injury while following through on his lone pass attempt, finishing 0-for-1 through the air. Tyler Huntley takes over behind center against the Bills.

news.body: Matthew Stafford completed 16-of-23 pass attempts for 140 yards and one interception in the Rams' 26-13 Week 12 win over the Packers.
news.head: Matthew Stafford held in check in Week 12 win over Packers
news.impact: Stafford relied on a dominant Rams rushing attack Wednesday night, passing for under 200 yards for the third time in his last five games. The quarterback will hope to get the Los Angeles passing attack back on track with the potential return of wideout Davante Adams for a Week 13 matchup against the Kansas City Chiefs.

news.body: Matthew Stafford completed 18-of-26 passes for 249 yards with three touchdowns and one interception in the Rams 34-6 win over the Cardinals.
news.head: Matthew Stafford tosses three touchdowns Sunday
news.impact: Despite being without Puka Nacua (to go along with Davante Adams still being sidelined), Stafford still managed to make it work in a blowout win for the Rams. He tossed touchdowns to Xavier Smith, Davis Allen and Tyler Higbee. The Rams will look to get healthier heading into their bye next week.

news.body: Matthew Stafford completed 26 of 43 passes for 228 yards in Sunday's win against the Commanders. He also threw one touchdown and one interception while adding one rush for one yard.
news.head: Matthew Stafford tosses one touchdown, one interception in win
news.impact: Stafford hyper-targeted standout wide receiver, Puka Nacua, who accounted for 150 of Stafford's 228 passing yards. Stafford and the Rams play the Cardinals in Week 10, but his value may take a hit of Nacua (knee) misses time.

news.body: Matthew Stafford (elbow) is good to go for Sunday's game against the Washington Commanders.
news.head: Matthew Stafford (elbow) good to go for Sunday
news.impact: As expected, Stafford's elbow injury is nothing serious at this point and won't prevent him from playing on Sunday. He should be good to go, although he is harder to trust starting on a week-to-week basis now with several key pass catchers sidelined due to injury for the Rams.

news.body: Patrick Mahomes II completed 27-of-39 passes for 324 yards and three touchdowns in a 34-7 win over the Cardinals.
news.head: Patrick Mahomes II tosses three touchdowns in Week 11 win
news.impact: Mahomes has now eclipses 300+ yards passing in three of his last four games and has not thrown an interception in four straight games. Mahomes connected with Xaiver Worthy and Travis Kelce twice to account for his three passing touchdowns. The Chiefs will have a short week as they take on the Bills on Thursday.

news.body: Patrick Mahomes II completed 22-of-35 pass attempts for 348 yards and five touchdowns while also rushing twice for 15 yards in the Chiefs' 35-13 Week 10 win over the Falcons.
news.head: Patrick Mahomes II tosses five touchdowns in Week 10 win over Falcons
news.impact: Mahomes II was dynamic behind center, averaging 15.8 yards per completion in the win. The quarterback will look to reward fantasy managers with another explosive performance against the Arizona Cardinals in Week 11.

news.body: Patrick Mahomes II (knee/elbow) is off of the injury report for Sunday's game against the Atlanta Falcons.
news.head: Patrick Mahomes II (knee/elbow) off injury report for Sunday
news.impact: Mahomes was dealing with a couple of different issues at practice throughout the week, but neither of them are serious and he is off of the injury report heading into Week 10. He will start and may be a worthy streaming option this week, although Kansas City's offense will struggle more if Kenneth Walker III (groin) is ruled out.

news.body: Patrick Mahomes II was a full participant in practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Patrick Mahomes II (elbow) logs full practice Wednesday
news.impact: Mahomes remains on track to be a full-go for Sunday's game against the Falcons.

news.body: Sam Darnold (quad) is off of the injury report for Week 12 for the Seattle Seahawks according to Gregg Bell.
news.head: Sam Darnold (quad) off injury report for Week 12
news.impact: Darnold is back behind center after being able to practice throughout the week, as the veteran signal-caller takes on a tough San Francisco 49ers defense Sunday.

news.body: Sam Darnold was a full participant in practice on Thursday.
news.head: Sam Darnold (quad) logs full practice Thursday
news.impact: Darnold continues to trend towards returning for Sunday's game against the 49ers with back-to-back full practices.

news.body: Sam Darnold was a full participant in practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Sam Darnold (quad) logs full practice Wednesday
news.impact: Darnold remains on track to return behind center for Sunday's game against the 49ers.

news.body: Sam Darnold will practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Sam Darnold (quad/rib) will practice Wednesday
news.impact: Darnold continues to trend towards returning for Sunday's game against the 49ers.

news.body: Trevor Lawrence completed 25-of-47 passes for 301 yards, a touchdown, and two picks in the Jaguars' 23-18 loss to the Giants on Sunday.
news.head: Trevor Lawrence throws for 300 yards in loss to Giants
news.impact: Lawrence could have had a much better day, and the game's outcome would have been different had an end-zone throw to Parker Washington been ruled a catch rather than an incompletion. The controversial play saw Washington bobble a pass before appearing to secure it and getting feet in bounds for a touchdown, but it was ruled incomplete. Still, Lawrence had his faults and seemed to succumb to the Giants' pass rush. He will look to have a better outing when he faces the Titans next Sunday.

news.body: Trevor Lawrence completed 25-of-35 passes for 352 yards, three touchdowns, and a pick in the Jaguars' 40-23 win over the Titans on Sunday. He also ran four times for 27 yards.
news.head: Trevor Lawrence goes off for three touchdowns in win
news.impact: Lawrence had a fantastic game against the Titans' woeful defense. He's been in MVP form for some time now, and the Jaguars are rolling. He has had at least three touchdowns in three of his last four games, and he will get to face the Giants next weekend.

news.body: Trevor Lawrence completed 16 of 26 passes for 242 yards and a touchdown in the Jaguars' 33-10 win over the Ravens. He also ran once for -1 yard.
news.head: Trevor Lawrence throws for 242 yards in rainy TNF
news.impact: Lawrence didn't have to do much to get his team the win in this game, much like Sunday when he faced the Colts. His one touchdown came on a breakaway play by Parker Washington, who was quiet aside from that play. Lawrence gets another easy matchup next week against the Titans. They will be well rested, however, as Tennessee is on a bye, but the Jaguars have a mini-bye themselves thanks to the Thursday game.

news.body: Trevor Lawrence completed 10 of 14 passes for 210 yards and three touchdowns in Sunday's 42-7 win over the Colts.
news.head: Trevor Lawrence torches Colts with only 10 completions
news.impact: It simply does not get much more efficient than Lawrence's performance Sunday afternoon. The Jags' ringleader averaged 21 yards on his 10 completions, connecting with seven different receivers. Lawrence added 10 yards on three carries and did not throw an interception. He did lose a fumble, but that was his only real blemish. Lawrence has completed 65.7% of his throws this season, averaging over 240 yards with an impressive 17-4 TD/INT ratio through seven games.

news.body: Tyler Shough completed 25-of-42 pass attempts for 222 yards, one touchdown, and one interception while also rushing three times for 34 yards in the Saints' 21-13 Week 11 loss to the Bears.
news.head: Tyler Shough fights consistency issues behind center in Week 11 loss
news.impact: Shough has made up for inconsistent results behind center of late, throwing for one or more touchdowns in each of his last five games. The athletic signal-caller will look for more impactful success against the Cincinnati Bengals in Week 12.

news.body: Tyler Shough completed 25-of-35 pass attempts for 187 yards, one touchdown, and one interception. He added 25 rushing yards and one fumble on six carries.
news.head: Tyler Shough accounts for two turnovers in Week 10 loss
news.impact: Shough led the team in rushing in Sunday's loss, but had a costly fumble that led to a Panthers' touchdown. Shough will look to bounce back in Week 11, but will be taking on a tough Bears' defense on the road.

news.body: Tyler Shough completed 21-of-35 passes for 265 yards and a touchdown in the Saints' 23-22 win over the Browns on Sunday. He also ran 10 times for 51 yards.
news.head: Tyler Shough goes for 265 yards in win over Browns
news.impact: Shough had two fumbles in this game as well, but both were recovered by the offense. He didn't throw a pick, but he took five sacks. So it was a bit so-so in real life, but for fantasy, he did just fine and was boosted by his 51 rushing yards. He could be an interesting QB option next week against the Panthers.

news.body: Tyler Shough completed 30 of 38 passes for 278 yards, a touchdown, and a pick in the Saints' 16-10 loss to the Steelers on Sunday. He was the Saints' leading rusher with seven yards on three carries.
news.head: Tyler Shough throws for 278 yards in loss
news.impact: Shough didn't have a terrible game, all things considered. He was accurate, put up decent yardage, but was just held out of the end zone. Obviously, that's a big part of fantasy football, but it's also important to remember that because the Saints had no running game, it made things a little tougher for Shough in the passing game.

news.body: Aaron Jones Sr. rushed for 30 yards and a touchdown on eight carries, adding 13 yards on one reception in Sunday's 35-10 loss to the 49ers.
news.head: Aaron Jones Sr. finds the end zone again in Week 11
news.impact: Despite going for just a combined 77 yards on 19 carries, Jones has crossed the goal line each of the past two weeks. The veteran is sharing the backfield load with Jordan Mason, which lowers his fantasy ceiling compared to earlier this season. However, Jones is producing enough with his limited touches to remain fantasy relevant.

news.body: Aaron Jones Sr. rushed 11 times for 47 yards and one touchdown while also hauling in his only target for eight yards in the Vikings' 30-10 Week 10 win over the Packers.
news.head: Aaron Jones Sr. reaches end zone in Week 10 win over Packers
news.impact: Jones Sr. has cooled off out of the backfield of late, recording under 100 offensive yards in each of his last four contests. The running back remains difficult to trust while sharing backfield work with Jordan Mason for the Vikings ahead of a Week 11 matchup against the San Francisco 49ers.

news.body: Aaron Jones Sr. gained 16 yards on five carries and caught his only target for five yards in Monday's 23-6 loss to the Bills.
news.head: Aaron Jones Sr. gets just six touches on Monday night
news.impact: Jones' paltry production in this one wasn't the result of backfield mate Jordan Mason seeing a surge in touches, as the latter finished with just seven of his own. The Vikings' offense is all out of sorts at the moment, and their RB tandem is suffering as a result. Jones looked like he might have found the Fountain of Youth earlier this season, but over the last three weeks, the veteran has given fantasy managers next to nothing.

news.body: Aaron Jones Sr. rushed five times for 22 yards while also catching both of his targets for 18 yards in the Vikings' 19-15 Week 8 loss to the Lions.
news.head: Aaron Jones Sr. held in check in Week 8 loss
news.impact: Jones Sr. has struggled to make an impact out of the backfield of late, rushing for less than 30 yards in each of his last two contests. The running back faces another stiff test against the Buffalo Bills in Week 9.

news.body: Alvin Kamara rushed once for one yard while also catching one of his two targets for one yard and one touchdown in the Saints' 21-13 loss to the Bears in Week 11.
news.head: Alvin Kamara held in check in Week 11 loss
news.impact: Kamara has made up for an otherwise forgettable stretch out of the New Orleans backfield, recording one or more touchdowns in each of his last two contests. The running back remains difficult to trust as part of an underperforming New Orleans running back group ahead of a Week 12 contest against the Cincinnati Bengals.

news.body: Alvin Kamara rushed for four yards and a touchdown on two carries in a 20-17 loss to the Panthers. He caught 3-of-4 targets for 10 yards and a touchdown.
news.head: Alvin Kamara finds the end zone in Week 10
news.impact: It was a low volume day for Kamara, but he made the most of it with two touchdowns. His role was considered up in the air with Travis Etienne returning and Audric Estime playing well, but the veteran was able to produce when it mattered Sunday. Kamara and the Saints will take on the Bears in Week 11 .

news.body: Alvin Kamara is off the injury report for Sunday's game against the Panthers.
news.head: Alvin Kamara (rest/back) off injury report Sunday
news.impact: Kamara will be good to go in his passing down role in the Saints backfield.

news.body: Alvin Kamara (rest/back) returned to practice in a full capacity on Thursday.
news.head: Alvin Kamara (rest/back) returns to practice Thursday
news.impact: Kamara was held out of the team's first practice of the week on Wednesday, but he made his return to practice on Thursday and was a full participant. He should be a full go in Week 10 but will see less work than usual if Travis Etienne Jr. (hamstring) is back in the lineup this week.

news.body: Ashton Jeanty rushed 11 times for 79 yards while catching five of eight targets for 90 yards and one touchdown in the Raiders' 38-24 loss to the Broncos in Week 11.
news.head: Ashton Jeanty totals 169 yards and a touchdown in Week 11
news.impact: Jeanty had a season-long 46-yard run and caught a 68-yard touchdown from Fernando Mendoza. More importantly, the latter was Jeanty's fourth receiving touchdown of the season. Mike Washington Jr. had nine carries compared to 11 for Jeanty, but Jeanty's involvement in the passing game helped compensate for the limited rushing volume. The second-year running back remains an RB1 heading into Week 12 against Cleveland. This was what we needed to see from Jeanty.

news.body: Ashton Jeanty ran for 18 yards on nine carries in the Raiders 21-13 loss against the Seahawks. He also caught 4-of-4 targets for 46 yards receiving.
news.head: Ashton Jeanty totals 64 yards from scrimmage Sunday
news.impact: Jeanty was once again shut down on the ground. The majority of his yardage on the day came on a catch and run for 38 yards. He remains a borderline RB2 play for fantasy managers right now.

news.body: Ashton Jeanty ran for 25 yards on six carries in the Raiders 38-17 loss against the 49ers. He also caught 5-of-7 targets for -5 yards receiving.
news.head: Ashton Jeanty totals 11 touches Sunday
news.impact: Jeanty led Las Vegas in rushing on the day with 25 yards. Mike Washington Jr. also saw six carries. Based on his role the past two games, Jeanty is solely a risky RB2 for fantasy managers.

news.body: Ashton Jeanty rushed for nine yards on two carries in a 38-33 win over the Jets. He caught 3-of-4 targets for 64 yards.
news.head: Ashton Jeanty sees just two carries in Week 8 win
news.impact: Jeanty saw the bulk of the rushing attempts go to Mike Washington Jr. in the win Sunday. After the game, it was made clear that this was the plan and was communicated to Jeanty prior to the game. Fantasy managers will want to monitor reports from the Raiders heading into Week 9.

news.body: Austin Ekeler carried the ball seven times for 41 yards and caught two of three targets for three yards in a 22-20 win over the Bengals in Week 11's Monday night game.
news.head: Austin Ekeler runs for 41 yards in Week 11
news.impact: Ekeler played behind Jacory Croskey-Merritt but he still did damage on the ground, averaging 5.9 yards per carry in the win. Ekeler remains a solid piece of Washington's running-back rotation. He will be a low-end flex option in Week 12 vs. the Cardinals.

news.body: Austin Ekeler carried the ball nine times for 26 yards and caught all four of his targets for 26 yards in a 24-21 win over the Giants in Week 10's Thursday night game.
news.head: Austin Ekeler sees 13 touches in Week 10
news.impact: Ekeler saw his largest touch total of the season while Rachaad White had 12 touches. The veteran running back has yet to find the end zone through six games this year, but he is worth a look as a low-end flex in deeper leagues moving forward. The Commanders face the Bengals in Week 11.

news.body: Austin Ekeler rushed eight times for 16 yards and added two receptions for 18 yards in Sunday’s loss to the Rams.
news.head: Austin Ekeler struggles in loss
news.impact: Ekeler and fellow running back Rachad White split running back duties for the Commanders, but White outproduced Ekeler by 35 yards despite Ekeler having one more touch. Ekeler is nothing more than a desperation deep-league play on Thursday night against the Giants.

news.body: Austin Ekeler carried the ball eight times for 36 yards and ran in a two-point conversion in a 27-10 win over the Eagles in Week 8.
news.head: Austin Ekeler runs for 36 yards in Week 8
news.impact: Ekeler averaged 4.5 yards per carry but was surprisingly not targeted in the passing game in the win. The veteran running back could see a larger role in Week 9 vs. the Rams as Jeremy McNichols (foot) left Sunday's game with a foot injury and did not return.

news.body: Bam Knight rushes for 35 yards on seven attempts in a 34-7 loss to the Chiefs. He caught his lone target for 10 yards.
news.head: Bam Knight tallies eight touches in Week 11 loss
news.impact: Knight tied Tyler Alleiger for the same number of carries, but outgained him on the ground. His seven rushing attempts are the most in a game for Knight since he saw 15 carries against the Rams in Week 6. Knight and the Cardinals will take on the Commanders in Week 12.

news.body: Bam Knight ran for 19 yards on five carries in the Cardinals 34-6 loss against the Rams.
news.head: Bam Knight runs for 19 yards Sunday
news.impact: Making his return from the concussion protocol, Knight and Tyler Allgeier both saw five carries in the blowout loss. They will be tougher to trust in lineups splitting the work on what is currently a not very good offense.

news.body: Bam Knight will play in Week 10 against the Rams after clearing concussion protocol.
news.head: Bam Knight clears concussion protocol, will play Sunday
news.impact: Knight was able to log a full practice on Thursday. He'll likely return to a committee with Tyler Allgeier in the Cardinals backfield with Carson Beck making his debut.

news.body: Bam Knight was a full participant in practice on Thursday.
news.head: Bam Knight (concussion) logs full practice Thursday
news.impact: Knight is on track to return for Sunday's game against the Rams. He'll likely form a committee again with Tyler Allgeier in the Cardinals backfield.

news.body: Bhayshul Tuten (ankle) has been ruled out for the Jaguars’ game against the Titans on Sunday.
news.head: Bhayshul Tuten (ankle) ruled out against Titans
news.impact: With Tuten out, the Jags will lean on Chris Rodriguez against the Titans. Rodriguez should be a decent RB2 option based on volume. Tuten will try to find his way back on the field next week.

news.body: Bhayshul Tuten was not seen practicing on Friday.
news.head: Bhayshul Tuten (foot/ankle) not seen practicing Friday
news.impact: Tuten continues to trend towards likely being sidelined for Sunday's game against the Titans. Chris Rodriguez would take over the lead role in the backfield.

news.body: Bhayshul Tuten did not practice on Thursday.
news.head: Bhayshul Tuten (foot/ankle) misses practice Thursday
news.impact: Tuten is trending towards being sidelined for Sunday's game against the Titans unless he can return to practice on Friday.

news.body: Bhayshul Tuten was not seen practicing on Wednesday.
news.head: Bhayshul Tuten (ankle) not seen at practice Wednesday
news.impact: Tuten got banged up twice in last week's game against the Giants. He will need to be monitored in practice the rest of the week.

news.body: Bijan Robinson carried the ball 16 times for 71 yards and one touchdown while also catching four of his five targets for six yards in the Falcons' 35-13 Week 10 loss to the Chiefs.
news.head: Bijan Robinson reaches end zone in Week 10 loss to Chiefs
news.impact: Robinson was one of the few bright spots in the Atlanta offense Sunday, finishing with over 70 offensive yards in nine of 10 games. The running back remains locked in as a reliable RB1 option in all formats entering the team's Week 11 bye.

news.body: Bijan Robinson rushed for 100 yards and a touchdown on 19 carries in a 34-17 loss to the Flacons. He caught 6-of-7 targets for 47 yards.
news.head: Bijan Robinson eclipses 100 rushing yards in Week 9 loss
news.impact: Robinson dominated the backfield touches for the Falcons and was able to account for 147 total yards in the loss. Robinson will look to continue his strong season in Week 10 against Kansas City.

news.body: Bijan Robinson ran for 76 yards on 19 carries in the Falcons 16-0 loss against the Buccaneers.
news.head: Bijan Robinson runs for 76 yards Sunday
news.impact: Robinson did not catch his lone target. It was a week to forget for the entire Falcons offense. Bijan remains an RB1 heading into next week against the Bengals.

news.body: Bijan Robinson rushed for 63 yards on 20 carries and caught all five of his targets for 59 yards in Sunday's 29-20 win over the 49ers.
news.head: Bijan Robinson gains 122 yards of total offense in Week 7 win
news.impact: Robinson finished with just over 60 yards on the ground for the second straight week, but he nearly doubled his offensive output with his efforts in the passing game. Robinson hasn't visited the end zone since Week 4, and fantasy managers hope that will change in a Week 8 matchup with the Buccaneers. Robinson remains one of the top overall fantasy assets despite this short dry spell.

news.body: Blake Corum carried the ball 32 times for 184 yards and one touchdown while also hauling in two of his three targets for 21 yards in the Rams' 26-13 Week 12 win over the Packers.
news.head: Blake Corum dominates on ground in Week 12 win over Packers
news.impact: Corum has taken advantage of increased touches out of the Los Angeles backfield of late, finishing with over 50 offensive yards and rushing for one touchdown in each of his last five games. The running back has offered fantasy managers an impactful backfield option while wrestling touches away from Kyren Williams, with a Week 13 matchup against the Kansas City Chiefs up next.

news.body: Blake Corum ran for 100 yards and a touchdown on 17 carries in the Rams 34-6 win over the Cardinals. He also caught 3-of-4 targets for 19 yards receiving.
news.head: Blake Corum runs for 100 yards Sunday
news.impact: Kyren Williams got the start for the Rams per usual, but Corum wound up being the hot hand on the day in the Rams backfield. He also added three receptions on the day. He remains a steady RB2 for fantasy managers, especially with the Rams wide receiver room banged up.

news.body: Blake Corum rushed 11 times for 58 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's win over the Commanders.
news.head: Blake Corum hits paydirt in win
news.impact: Despite having four carries fewer than fellow running back Kyren Williams, Corum outproduced Williams by 13 yards on the ground. Corum started the season as a high-end handcuff, but now is a high floor RB3/Flex play weekly. Corum will look to continue this momentum in Week 10's matchup against the Cardinals.

news.body: Blake Corum rushed the ball 11 times for 73 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 24-9 win over the Los Angeles Chargers.
news.head: Blake Corum leads team in rushing Sunday
news.impact: Corum played well on Sunday. He led the team with 73 yards over the course of the game, and he was able to do that while maintaining an efficient clip of 6.6 yards per carry. His touchdown was the cherry on top, and fantasy managers should expect him to continue to see considerable work moving forward, even while sharing the backfield with Kyren Williams.

news.body: Braelon Allen carried the ball 16 times for 75 yards and caught a nine-yard pass in a 27-24 win over the Chargers in Week 11.
news.head: Braelon Allen runs for 75 yards in Week 11
news.impact: Allen and Breece Hall combined for 151 rushing yards in the close win over Los Angeles. Allen continues to see a solid workload despite sharing time with Hall, giving both running backs standalone fantasy value. He will be a flex option in Week 12 vs. the Dolphins.

news.body: Braelon Allen rushed for 40 yards on eight carries in a 31-12 loss to the Bills. He caught his lone target for six yards.
news.head: Braelon Allen sees nine touches in Week 10 loss
news.impact: Allen took a backseat to Breece Hall for the second straight week since Hall's return to the lineup. Allen remains a handcuff at best heading into a Week 11 matchup with the Chargers.

news.body: Braelon Allen rushed for 33 yards on eight carries in the Jets' 35-12 loss to the Chiefs. He caught both of his targets for 21 yards.
news.head: Braelon Allen sees 10 touches in Week 9
news.impact: Allen saw the return of Breece Hall to the lineup for the first time since Week 3. Allen has three 100 yard performances with Hall sidelined with a quad injury, but immediately saw his usage take a dip with Hall's return. Allen will likely remain the backup to Hall heading into a Week 10 matchup with Buffalo.

news.body: Braelon Allen rushed for 147 yards and a touchdown on 21 carries in a 38-33 loss to the Raiders. He caught both of his targets for six yards.
news.head: Braelon Allen excellent in Week 8 loss
news.impact: Allen set a new career high in rushing yards and has been excellent as the starting running back with Breece Hall (quad) out for the fifth straight game. Allen has tallied over 100 rushing yards in three of those five games and will likely remain a key part of the Jets' offense in Week 9 against the Chiefs.

news.body: Breece Hall carried the ball 20 times for 86 yards and caught all three of his targets for 14 yards and a touchdown in a 27-24 win over the Chargers in Week 11.
news.head: Breece Hall finds the end zone in Week 11
news.impact: Hall found the end zone for the first time since Week 1 vs. the Titans on a seven-yard reception in the second quarter. The veteran running back has 560 all-purpose yards and two TDs in six games this season. He will be a strong fantasy play in Week 12 against the Dolphins.

news.body: Breece Hall rushed for 41 yards on 11 carries in a 31-12 loss to the Bills. He caught all four of his targets for 67 yards.
news.head: Breece Hall sees 15 touches in Week 10 loss
news.impact: Hall continued to lead the Jets' backfield in his second game since returning from injury. Fantasy managers should expect Hall to continue to lead the backfield in Week 11 against the Chargers.

news.body: Breece Hall rushed for 61 yards on 15 carries in a 35-12 loss to the Jets. He caught 3-of-4 targets for 26 yards.
news.head: Breece Hall leads Jets' backfield in Week 9
news.impact: Hall made his return from a quad injury that has kept him out of action since Week 3. Braelon Allen returned to the backup role, seeing eight rushing attempts to Hall's 15. Hall and the Jets will take on the Bills in Week 10.

news.body: Breece Hall (quad) is off of the injury report for Sunday's game against the Kansas City Chiefs.
news.head: Breece Hall (quad) off injury report for Sunday
news.impact: Hall is now off of the injury report entirely heading into the weekend, meaning that he is fully good to go and will make his return to the lineup on Sunday. He still has explosive week-to-week potential, but he may be more inconsistent moving forward now that Braelon Allen has earned more touches for himself while serving as the team's temporary RB1.

news.body: Brian Robinson Jr. (hamstring) has been placed on Injured Reserve.
news.head: Brian Robinson Jr. (hamstring) placed on Injured Reserve
news.impact: Robinson has missed the last several games with a hamstring injury, and apparently hasn’t made enough progress for the team to keep him off of IR. He will miss at least the next four games. The Falcons will need to elevate someone to back up Bijan Robinson.

news.body: Brian Robinson Jr. remained limited in practice on Thursday.
news.head: Brian Robinson Jr. (hamstring) limited in practice Thursday
news.impact: Robinson was also limited on Wednesday. He is trending towards having a chance to return this week for the Falcons.

news.body: Brian Robinson Jr. (hamstring) was listed as limited on Wednesday's estimated injury report.
news.head: Brian Robinson Jr. (hamstring) listed as limited Wednesday
news.impact: Robinson has missed the last two weeks due to a hamstring injury, but this is a positive development for the Falcons' No. 2 RB. Robinson has been solid behind dual-threat star Bijan Robinson this season. Brian Robinson has averaged 4.0 yards per carry for more than 200 yards and four touchdowns in six games.

news.body: Falcons RB Brian Robinson Jr. (hamstring) is officially inactive for a Week 8 matchup with Tampa Bay.
news.head: Brian Robinson Jr. (hamstring) officially inactive for Week 8
news.impact: Robinson was unable to practice in any capacity this week and will not suit up for the Falcons. Khalil Herbert will serve as the backup against Tampa Bay.

news.body: Bucky Irving carried the ball 18 times for 68 yards and one touchdown while also hauling in three of his four targets for 32 yards in the Buccaneers' 31-21 Week 11 loss to the Lions.
news.head: Bucky Irving reaches end zone in Week 11 loss to Lions
news.impact: Irving has been impactful out of the Tampa Bay backfield of late, rushing for at least one touchdown and over 60 yards in five of his last six games. The running back remains the lone trustworthy option in an underperforming Buccaneers offense for fantasy managers ahead of a Week 12 matchup against the Carolina Panthers.

news.body: Bucky Irving carried the ball 20 times for 97 yards and two touchdowns while catching four of his five targets for 28 yards in a 27-24 loss to the Bears in Week 9.
news.head: Bucky Irving scores two TDs in Week 9 loss
news.impact: Irving scored on rushes of two and six yards in the close loss, giving him five touchdowns over his past three games. The veteran running back has been one of the few bright spots on a disappointing Tampa Bay offense this season, posting 825 rushing yards and eight all-purpose touchdowns in nine contests. He will be on bye in Week 10 before taking on the Lions in Week 11.

news.body: Bucky Irving ran for 170 yards and a touchdown on 27 carries in the Buccaneers 16-0 win over the Falcons.
news.head: Bucky Irving explodes for 170 yards Sunday
news.impact: It was the Irving and Kenneth Gainwell show all afternoon as Baker Mayfield did not complete a single pass. Irving saw career-highs in both carries and yardage. He also had a second touchdown taken away on a fumble at the goal line. He'll be a borderline RB1 play next week against the Bears.

news.body: Bucky Irving did not practice on Thursday.
news.head: Bucky Irving (rest) misses practice Thursday
news.impact: It was a rest day for Irving. He should be back at practice on Friday.

news.body: Cam Skattebo ran 14 times for 34 yards and caught three of seven targets for 14 yards in the Giants' 23-18 win over the Jaguars on Sunday. He also lost a fumble.
news.head: Cam Skattebo contained in win over Jaguars
news.impact: This was not Skattebo's best performance, going for just 2.4 YPC and losing a fumble. If there is any solace, the Jags defensive front is one of the better units in the NFL, though that does little to comfort fantasy managers who started him.

news.body: Cam Skattebo (hamstring) logged another full practice session on Thursday.
news.head: Cam Skattebo (hamstring) logs another full practice Thursday
news.impact: To no surprise, Skattebo was again a full participant on Thursday, which means that his hamstring injury is almost a non-issue at this point. He should play and continue to be a good fantasy option in Week 11.

news.body: Cam Skattebo (hamstring) practiced in a full capacity on Wednesday.
news.head: Cam Skattebo (hamstring) practices in full Wednesday
news.impact: Skattebo was able to practice in a full capacity on Wednesday. He previously missed time with a hamstring issue, but he played through it and looked great last week, so it's unlikely to be an issue for him moving forward. He will continue to be a good fantasy option for the foreseeable future.

news.body: Cam Skattebo carried the ball 18 times for 78 yards and two touchdowns while catching three of his four targets for 44 yards on Thursday night in a 24-21 loss to the Commanders in Week 10.
news.head: Cam Skattebo scores two TDs in Week 10
news.impact: Skattebo missed the previous game with a hamstring injury but he was a difference-maker for the Giants in Week 10. The second-year runner found on the end zone twice, on runs of one and 13 yards. Skattebo has run for 496 yards and four touchdowns while catching 14 passes for 120 yards in eight games this year. He will be an RB2 in fantasy in Week 11 vs. the Jaguars.

news.body: Chase Brown carried the ball six times for six yards and caught five of his eight targets for 30 yards in a 22-20 loss to the Commanders in Week 11.
news.head: Chase Brown held to six rushing yards in Week 11
news.impact: Brown and Samaje Perine both saw six carries in the Monday night loss. The Bengals continue to split work between the two, although Brown's eight targets were second on the team in the close loss. Brown has rushed for 447 yards while adding 52 catches for 276 yards and three all-purpose touchdowns through 10 games this season. He will be a low-end RB1 in fantasy heading into Week 12 vs. the Saints.

news.body: Chase Brown rushed the ball 10 times for 44 yards and caught 8-of-9 targets for 39 yards and two touchdowns in Sunday's 38-18 win over the Pittsburgh Steelers.
news.head: Chase Brown scores twice in win Sunday
news.impact: Brown finally had an explosive game on Sunday night. He racked up 83 total yards on the night and was able to get into the end zone twice through the air, which left him with a fantastic fantasy total. This should give fantasy managers confidence that he will be a good option over the back half of the season, although he still seems prone to some bad performances on a week-to-week basis.

news.body: Chase Brown rushed for 57 yards on nine carries in a 34-17 win over the Falcons. He caught all three of his targets for 18 yards.
news.head: Chase Brown sees 12 touches in Week 9 win
news.impact: Brown continues to see his impact on the Bengals' offense diminish with Joe Burrow and the passing attack being extremely effective over the last few weeks. Samaje Perine did see more carries than Brown, but the bulk of that was late in the game. Brown and the Bengals will take on the Steelers in Week 10.

news.body: Chase Brown carried the ball 12 times for 55 yards while catching eight of his nine targets for 46 yards and losing a fumble in a 43-36 overtime win over the Titans in Week 8.
news.head: Chase Brown catches eight passes in Week 8
news.impact: Brown did most of his damage in the passing game in the thrilling win over Tennessee. More importantly, he out-touched Samaje Perine 20-to-five in the contest after Perine had been cutting into his workload in recent weeks. Brown will continue to be a low-end RB1/high-end RB2 as he prepares to face the Falcons in Week 9.
