news.body: Chris Brooks rushed once for four yards while also catching four of his five targets for 22 yards in the Packers' 26-13 loss to the Rams in Week 12.
news.head: Chris Brooks sees five touches in Week 12
news.impact: Brooks has struggled to make an impact out of the backfield when active, recording less than 40 offensive yards in each of his seven contests. The running back can remain off rosters in all formats ahead of a Week 13 contest against the New Orleans Saints.

news.body: Chris Brooks rushed twice for one yard as well as catching his only target for two yards in the Packers' 30-10 loss to the Vikings in Week 10.
news.head: Chris Brooks quiet in Week 10
news.impact: Brooks was unable to make an impact in his first game action since October 4, finishing last among the Packers trio of running backs in touches in the loss. The running back can remain off rosters in all formats as the team enters its Week 11 bye.

news.body: The Packers activated RB Chris Brooks from injured reserve.
news.head: Chris Brooks (ankle) activated from IR
news.impact: Brooks will return for Sunday's game against the Vikings. He remains off the fantasy radar.

news.body: Chris Brooks (ankle) is listed questionable for Sunday's game against the Minnesota Vikings.
news.head: Chris Brooks (ankle) listed questionable for Sunday
news.impact: Brooks has been out for multiple weeks while recovering from an ankle issue, but his return to the lineup may come on Sunday, as he is officially considered questionable to play against the Vikings. If he's active, he may actually see a solid amount of opportunities with Josh Jacobs (finger) set to be sidelined for this game.

news.body: Chris Rodriguez Jr. ran for 28 yards on four carries and caught his only target for 13 yards in the Jaguars' 23-18 loss to the Giants on Sunday.
news.head: Chris Rodriguez Jr. quiet in loss to Giants
news.impact: Rodriguez made a key play on a first-quarter 4th-and-1 run, gaining 21 yards in what ultimately amounted to a field-goal drive. He was quiet after that, being phased out in what became a come-from-behind attempt by the Jags. He could get some work next week against the Titans, which should be more favorable.

news.body: Chris Rodriguez Jr. (hand) is off of the injury report ahead of Sunday's game against the New York Giants.
news.head: Chris Rodriguez Jr. (hand) off injury report for Sunday
news.impact: Rodriguez is set to play on Sunday, despite managing a hand issue at practice throughout the week. He will continue to play second fiddle in this backfield behind Bhayshul Tuten for the foreseeable future.

news.body: Chris Rodriguez Jr. (hand) was limited at Jacksonville's practice on Thursday.
news.head: Chris Rodriguez Jr. (hand) limited at practice Thursday
news.impact: Rodriguez was limited for Thursday's practice due to a hand injury that he is currently managing. It's unclear if it will affect his availability for Week 11, but if it does, fantasy managers should expect more work for LeQuint Allen Jr. (hamstring) as a result of his absence.

news.body: Chris Rodriguez Jr. (hand) was a limited participant at practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Chris Rodriguez Jr. (hand) limited participant Wednesday
news.impact: The veteran was limited in the team's first practice of the week on Wednesday. He isn't expected to miss any time with his hand issue, but fantasy managers still shouldn't be expecting him to be fantasy relevant anytime soon, especially after he saw just four carries last week.

news.body: Christian McCaffrey rushed for 49 yards and a touchdown on 12 carries, adding 13 yards on two receptions in Sunday's 35-10 rout of the Vikings.
news.head: Christian McCaffrey hits paydirt in Sunday night's win
news.impact: Did anyone really think that McCaffrey was going to pick up more than 200 yards with three touchdowns for a second straight week? Obviously, the answer is no. The star RB did produce a solid game against a typically dominant defense, though, which included his 14th overall TD of the campaign. McCaffrey also crossed the 1,000-yard mark for total offense this season on Sunday night. He remains a top-shelf fantasy asset.

news.body: Christian McCaffrey carried the ball 13 times for 62 yards and one touchdown while also hauling in all four of his targets for 161 yards and two touchdowns in the 49ers' 46-40 Week 10 win over the Cowboys.
news.head: Christian McCaffrey explodes for over 200 offensive yards in Week 10 win
news.impact: McCaffrey continues an explosive stretch out of the San Francisco backfield, posting one or more touchdowns in each of his last eight games. The running back remains a dynamic RB1 option in all formats entering a Week 11 matchup against the Minnesota Vikings.

news.body: Christian McCaffrey ran for 68 yards and a touchdown on 18 carries in the 49ers 38-17 win over the Raiders. He also caught 2-of-3 targets for 19 yards receiving and another score.
news.head: Christian McCaffrey totals two touchdowns Sunday
news.impact: McCaffrey was able to dominate in another big role for the 49ers. He remains an RB1 heading into next week against the Cowboys.

news.body: Christian McCaffrey (hamstring) is expected to see his full workload Sunday according to Mike Garafolo.
news.head: Christian McCaffrey (hamstring) expected to see full workload Sunday
news.impact: McCaffrey looks to not have any limitations entering Sunday’s Week 9 matchup against the Las Vegas Raiders, offering head coach Kyle Shanahan one of his more dynamic playmakers as part of a San Francisco offense ravaged by injuries entering Sunday.

news.body: Chuba Hubbard rushed for 120 yards and two touchdowns on 27 carries in a 35-33 win over the Ravens.
news.head: Chuba Hubbard hits pay dirt twice in Week 11
news.impact: Hubbard found the end zone on rushes from one and 18 yards out in the seesaw win over the Ravens. This marks the second straight game Hubbard has seen 27 carries and scored two touchdowns. Hubbard and the Panthers will take on Tampa Bay in Week 12.

news.body: Chuba Hubbard rushed for 92 yards and two touchdowns on 27 carries in a 20-17 win over the Saints. He caught all five of his targets for 80 yards.
news.head: Chuba Hubbard hits pay dirt twice in Week 10 win
news.impact: Hubbard found the end zone on runs of one and two yards to pace the Panthers to victory. He also led the team in receptions and receiving yards. Hubbard will look to build on his strong performance in Week 11 against Baltimore.

news.body: Chuba Hubbard rushed 16 times for 79 yards while catching four of five targets for 17 yards in the Panthers' 26-21 loss to the Broncos in Week 9.
news.head: Chuba Hubbard rushes for 79 yards in Week 9
news.impact: Hubbard averaged 4.9 yards per carry and accounted for 16 of Carolina's 20 rushing attempts. More importantly, he handled 20 touches while the Panthers' other running backs combined for just two carries. The workload is there, even if the touchdowns weren't. Hubbard remains Carolina's primary running back heading into Week 10 against New Orleans.

news.body: Chuba Hubbard rushed for 81 yards and a touchdown on 22 carries, adding 38 yards on seven receptions in Thursday's 27-19 loss to the Packers.
news.head: Chuba Hubbard gains 119 yards, scores in Thursday's loss
news.impact: Hubbard delivered a true workhorse effort Thursday night and was certainly one of the main reasons the Panthers hung around until the end of this contest. Hubbard is having a strong season through seven games, averaging 20 touches for close to 100 yards of offense. He has also found the end zone in five of those games.

news.body: Corey Kiner carried the ball 10 times for 25 yards in a 35-10 loss to the Lions in Munich in Week 10.
news.head: Corey Kiner runs for 25 yards in Week 10
news.impact: Kiner led the Patriots in carries despite Rhamondre Stevenson being active. Stevenson dealt with a knee injury throughout the week so it is possible the Patriots wanted to take it easy on their starter. Kiner will be on bye in Week 11 before taking on the Chargers in Week 12.

news.body: Corey Kiner rushed the ball eight times for 55 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 45-27 loss to the Green Bay Packers.
news.head: Corey Kiner leads team in rushing Sunday
news.impact: Kiner saw increased work on Sunday and had the most rushing attempts out of anyone on the team. He did well with his opportunities, finishing with 55 yards and a touchdown while rushing at an efficient clip of 6.9 yards per carry. He could be establishing himself as the team's top rusher right now, but the situation in their backfield is likely to remain murky for the foreseeable future.

news.body: Corey Kiner ran seven times for 38 yards in the Patriots' 24-19 win over the Dolphins on Sunday.
news.head: Corey Kiner runs for 38 yards in win
news.impact: Kiner played second fiddle to Rhamondre Stevenson on Sunday and was efficient on his touches. The problem was that he didn't get many touches, resulting in a low fantasy point total. He's not really startable right now, and would only be so if Stevenson were to also miss time.

news.body: Corey Kiner has been traded to the New England Patriots for a seventh-round pick. In a corresponding move, the Pats released Hassan Haskins.
news.head: Corey Kiner traded to the New England Patriots
news.impact: The trade for Kiner is interesting. While the cost to acquire is minimal, you would think given the Patriots depth at running back at this point in the season, they'd be trading for Kiner based on special teams usage. But, he was barely used in that department by Arizona last year and all throughout college. He's not a receiving specialist; in fact, you could say he was the opposite. So the move is puzzling, but we will have to see how they plan on deploying the former Bearcat.

news.body: D'Andre Swift carried the ball nine times for 65 yards and one touchdown while also hauling in seven of his eight targets for a team-high 97 yards in the Bears' 39-35 Week 12 win over the Lions.
news.head: D'Andre Swift dynamic in Week 12 win over Lions
news.impact: Swift continues an impactful stretch out of the backfield, recording one or more touchdowns in six of his last seven games. The running back remains an impactful RB1 option for head coach Ben Johnson ahead of a Week 13 matchup against the Jacksonville Jaguars.

news.body: D'Andre Swift carried the ball 13 times for 51 yards while also catching both of his targets for eight yards and one touchdown in the Bears' 21-13 Week 11 win over the Saints.
news.head: D'Andre Swift reaches end zone in Week 11 win over Saints
news.impact: Swift has had a nose for the end zone of late, recording at least one touchdown in five of his last six games. The running back remains a mostly steady backfield option for head coach Ben Johnson entering a Week 12 matchup against the Detroit Lions.

news.body: D'Andre Swift carried the ball 12 times for 31 yards and failed to catch his lone target in a 27-24 win over the Buccaneers in Week 9.
news.head: D'Andre Swift runs for 31 yards in Week 9 win
news.impact: Swift was quiet in the win just one week after scoring three touchdowns. The veteran running back has 576 rushing yards and 10 touchdowns in nine games this season. A strong RB1 in fantasy this season, Swift will be on bye in Week 10 before a Week 11 matchup vs. the Saints.

news.body: D'Andre Swift rushed the ball 27 times for 69 yards and three touchdowns while adding two catches for ten yards through the air in Monday night's 24-17 win over the Seattle Seahawks.
news.head: D'Andre Swift scores three touchdowns in win Monday
news.impact: Swift pulled off the hat trick on Monday night, getting into the end zone three different times in a big win over Seattle. Outside of that he wasn't very efficient and didn't get a lot of work as a receiver, so while his fantasy total was very good, it didn't quite reach dominant levels. He should continue to be a high-end fantasy asset moving forward with how good this Chicago offense looks right now.

news.body: David Montgomery gained 107 yards on 26 carries, adding 17 yards on three receptions in Thursday's 26-3 rout of the Colts.
news.head: David Montgomery goes over 100 yards in return
news.impact: So much for easing back in after a four-game absence, as Montgomery got 29 touches in an impressive workhorse effort Thursday night. The veteran back went over 100 yards for the first time this season, and he looks plenty primed for the stretch run. Montgomery is right back in the RB2 range for standard formats.

news.body: David Montgomery (groin) is off of the injury report for Thursday night's game against the Indianapolis Colts.
news.head: David Montgomery (groin) off injury report for Thursday
news.impact: Montgomery has been out for a handful of weeks while recovering from a groin issue of some kind, but he is finally ready to make his return to the lineup and is off of the injury report ahead of Thursday night's game. Unless the team indicates that he will have limited snaps, fantasy managers should expect him to be a viable option in this great matchup against the Colts, especially with Woody Marks (concussion) set to be sidelined for Houston.

news.body: David Montgomery practiced on Tuesday.
news.head: David Montgomery (groin) practices Tuesday
news.impact: Montgomery is trending towards having a chance to return for Thursday’s game against the Colts.

news.body: David Montgomery is trending in the right direction and "moving a lot better."
news.head: David Montgomery (groin) trending in right direction
news.impact: Montgomery could be in line for a workhorse role on Thursday if he is cleared with Woody Marks (concussion) ruled out. He'll need to continue to be monitored in practice.

news.body: Derrick Henry is off the injury report for Sunday's game against the Texans.
news.head: Derrick Henry (concussion) off injury report for Week 12
news.impact: Henry should be in line for his usual workload in the Ravens backfield.

news.body: Derrick Henry was a full participant in practice on Thursday.
news.head: Derrick Henry (concussion) practices fully Thursday
news.impact: Henry is on track to be good to go for Sunday's game against the Texans. He will need to be monitored again on Friday.

news.body: Derrick Henry was limited in practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Derrick Henry (concussion) limited in practice Wednesday
news.impact: Henry is in concussion protocol. He will need to be monitored in practice the rest of the week.

news.body: Derrick Henry is being evaluated for a concussion by the Baltimore Ravens according to Mike Garafolo.
news.head: Derrick Henry being evaluated for concussion
news.impact: Henry exited late in the fourth quarter after landing hard in the end zone, rushing 13 times for 94 yards and one touchdown prior to exiting. Justice Hill will take over in the backfield for head coach Jesse Minter against the Panthers.

news.body: Devin Singletary ran once for five yards and caught his only target for five yards in the Giants' 23-18 win over the Jags on Sunday.
news.head: Devin Singletary quiet in win over Jags
news.impact: Singletary was a distant second to Cam Skattebo in running back attempts and targets in this game, and irrelevant for fantasy. It will likely stay that way unless Skattebo is punished for his fumbling issues.

news.body: Devin Singletary carried the ball once for three yards in a 24-21 loss to the Commanders in Week 10's Thursday night game.
news.head: Devin Singletary sees just one carry in TNF loss
news.impact: Singletary was quiet with Cam Skattebo returning from a one-game absence and dominating the backfield touches for New York. Singletary can head back to the waiver wire in fantasy leagues ahead of a Week 11 matchup against the Jaguars.

news.body: Devin Singletary rushed the ball 21 times for 31 yards and caught two passes for eight yards in Sunday's 19-11 win over the Philadelphia Eagles.
news.head: Devin Singletary inefficient in win Sunday
news.impact: Singletary was essentially the last man standing in New York's backfield on Sunday, but he wasn't able to take advantage of the increased opportunities, finishing with just 31 rushing yards at a terrible clip of 1.5 yards per carry. Fantasy managers shouldn't trust starting him moving forward, even if Cam Skattebo (hamstring) misses another game.

news.body: Devin Singletary ran for 41 yards and a touchdown on five carries in the Giants 27-21 win over the Texans.
news.head: Devin Singletary scores winning touchdown Sunday
news.impact: Singletary won the game on a 30-yard in overtime. The Giants are on bye next week, but it is worth noting that Cam Skattebo and Tyrone Tracy both got banged up in this game.

news.body: DJ Giddens (knee) was absent from Indianapolis' practice on Thursday.
news.head: DJ Giddens (knee) absent from practice Thursday
news.impact: Giddens is a new addition to Indianapolis' injury report. He has been added because of a knee injury that he's dealing with, and it looks like he could miss Sunday's game because of it. He is currently nothing more than a depth RB for the Colts, however, so fantasy managers shouldn't read too much into his injury status for Sunday night's game.

news.body: DJ Giddens left practice early on Wednesday with an apparent hamstring injury.
news.head: DJ Giddens (hamstring) exits early Wednesday
news.impact: Giddens was working his way back from a previous hamstring injury, so it appears he may have aggravated his previous injury.

news.body: DJ Giddens did not practice on Saturday.
news.head: DJ Giddens (hamstring) not practicing Saturday
news.impact: Giddens is competing for a depth role in the Colts backfield. It is not ideal timing for him up be missing several days of training camp.

news.body: DJ Giddens did not practice on Tuesday due to a hamstring injury.
news.head: DJ Giddens (hamstring) misses practice Tuesday
news.impact: Giddens is competing for a depth role in the Colts backfield.

news.body: Dylan Sampson gained just six yards on four carries, but caught 4-of-6 targets for 31 yards in Sunday's 27-24 win over the Texans.
news.head: Dylan Sampson finishes with four receptions in Week 10 win
news.impact: Sampson continues to do very little on the ground, but he remains a steady pass catcher out of the backfield for the Browns. The second-year back has caught at least three passes in all four of his games so far this season, averaging 38 yards per contest with a long gain of 22 yards. Samspon is a solid spell to starter Quinshon Judkins and has deeper PPR value as an RB or Flex.

news.body: Dylan Sampson ran eight times for 21 yards and caught three of six targets for 27 yards in the Browns' 23-22 loss to the Saints.
news.head: Dylan Sampson snags three passes in loss
news.impact: Sampson operated as the Browns' primary receiving back once again, something that he will do on the regular. His six targets tied for second on the team with KC Concepcion, which is great from a volume standpoint. He's a low-end flex at RB in PPR formats given his current role.

news.body: Dylan Sampson ran for seven yards on one carry in the Browns 27-6 loss against the Steelers. He also caught 6-of-8 targets for 62 yards receiving.
news.head: Dylan Sampson catches six passes Sunday
news.impact: Sampson has now caught 9-of-11 targets across two games since returning from injury. He remains on the flex radar in PPR leagues for fantasy managers.

news.body: Dylan Sampson (knee) is set to play in Sunday's game against the Pittsburgh Steelers.
news.head: Dylan Sampson (knee) set to play Sunday
news.impact: Sampson is set to play on Sunday, despite being listed on Cleveland's injury report earlier in the week with a knee issue. He isn't expected to see enough work to be fantasy relevant in this matchup, however.

news.body: Emmett Johnson will start again for the Chiefs in Week 12.
news.head: Emmett Johnson to get another start Thursday
news.impact: With Kenneth Walker (groin) ruled out for Thanksgiving Day, Johnson will start against the Bills. The rookie RB has been outstanding in back-to-back starts for the Chiefs, totaling more than 300 yards of offense with three touchdowns.

news.body: Emmett Johnson rushed for 105 yards and a touchdown on 23 carries in a 34-7 win over the Cardinals.
news.head: Emmett Johnson finds the end zone in Week 11 win
news.impact: Johnson led the Chiefs' backfield with Kenneth Walker inactive again due to injury. The Chiefs have clearly trusted Johnson in his two starts, providing the rookie with 20+ carries in each outing. If Walker returns in Week 12, Johnson remains an extremely strong handcuff for fantasy managers.

news.body: Emmett Johnson carried the ball 22 times for 101 yards while also hauling in six of his seven targets for 70 yards and two touchdowns in the Chiefs' 35-13 Week 10 win over the Falcons.
news.head: Emmett Johnson dominates in Week 10 win over Falcons
news.impact: Johnson took advantage of the absence of RB1 Kenneth Walker III, recording over 140 offensive yards and one or more touchdowns in two of his last three contests. The rookie running back continues to flash game-changing explosiveness out of the backfield for head coach Andy Reid entering a Week 11 matchup against the Arizona Cardinals.

news.body: Emmett Johnson will lead Kansas City’s rushing attack Sunday against the Falcons.
news.head: Emmett Johnson to lead Chiefs backfield Sunday
news.impact: Kenneth Walker is being held out due to a groin injury. Johnson has shown flashes this season backing up Walker and now gets his chance to step into the lead role.

news.body: Isiah Pacheco (back/knee) is out for at least the next 12 weeks after undergoing surgery to remove a body that was pressing a nerve on his neck. The plan is to have him back in early December.
news.head: Isiah Pacheco (back/knee) out for 12 weeks after undergoing back surgery
news.impact: It’s a tough blow to Pacheco, who was already struggling with a knee injury. He’s droppable in all formats, as his handcuff status for 2026 is pretty much out the window.

news.body: Isiah Pacheco (back/MCL) has been placed on injured reserve by the Detroit Lions Tuesday according to Ari Meirov.
news.head: Isiah Pacheco (back/MCL) placed in injured reserve
news.impact: Pacheco will be sidelined for at least the first four games of the upcoming regular season, with his first opportunity to return coming ahead of a Week 5 contest against the Arizona Cardinals. Jacob Saylors will slide into the No. 2 running back role behind superstar Jahmyr Gibbs in the Lions backfield after an impressive preseason for the time being, with the Lions likely to add more depth to a shorthanded running backs room prior to the regular season.

news.body: Lions coach Dan Campbell said Isiah Pacheco is dealing with a back injury in addition to his MCL sprain.
news.head: Isiah Pacheco dealing with back injury in addition to MCL sprain
news.impact: Pacheco remains without a clear timetable to return. The Lions recently worked out Kareem Hunt.

news.body: Lions coach Dan Campbell said Isiah Pacheco is dealing with a sprained MCL but should be good to go in time for Week 1.
news.head: Isiah Pacheco dealing with sprained MCL, should be good to go Week 1
news.impact: “We feel pretty good about him being ready to go, especially when the season gets here," Campbell said. Pacheco is slated to open the season backing up Jahmyr Gibbs.

news.body: Jacory Croskey-Merritt carried the ball 13 times for 54 yards and a touchdown while catching two of his three targets for 23 yards in a 22-20 win over the Bengals in Week 11's Monday night game.
news.head: Jacory Croskey-Merritt finds the end zone in Week 11
news.impact: Croskey-Merritt made his return to action after a multi-week absence due to a groin injury. He went right back to leading the Commanders' backfield, scoring on a one-yard touchdown run in the second quarter. The veteran will be a solid fantasy RB2 in Week 12 against the Cardinals in a plus matchup.

news.body: The Commanders officially activated RB Jacory Croskey-Merritt from injured reserve.
news.head: Jacory Croskey-Merritt (groin) activated from IR
news.impact: Croskey-Merritt will return for Monday's game against the Bengals. He should return to his lead role in the backfield for Washington after missing the past four games.

news.body: Jacory Croskey-Merritt is listed as questionable for Monday's game against the Bengals.
news.head: Jacory Croskey-Merritt (groin) listed questionable Monday
news.impact: Croskey-Merritt was a full participant in practice all week. He is trending in the right direction to be activated from IR.

news.body: Commanders RB Jacory Croskey-Merritt is trending in the right direction to play Monday against the Bengals.
news.head: Jacory Croskey-Merritt (groin) trending in right direction for Monday
news.impact: Commanders coach Dan Quinn said Croskey-Merritt had a "great week" of practice. He'll have a chance to be activated from injured reserve.

news.body: Jadarian Price ran for 36 yards and a touchdown on nine carries in the Seahawks 21-13 win over the Raiders. He also caught his lone target for eight yards receiving.
news.head: Jadarian Price finds the end zone Sunday
news.impact: Price was able to score a touchdown for the first time in his career. He continues to look like the 1B in the backfield for Seattle with Zach Charbonnet as the 1A. Price remains a steady flex option.

news.body: Jadarian Price ran for 24 yards on nine carries in the Seahawks 17-3 win over the Cardinals. He also caught 4-of-4 targets for 54 yards receiving.
news.head: Jadarian Price totals 78 yards from scrimmage Sunday
news.impact: Price led Seattle in receiving on the day, including an impressive 17-yard catch and run. Zach Charbonnet led the Seahawks on the ground on the day. Price should maintain flex value moving forward.

news.body: Jadarian Price rushed the ball ten times for 29 yards and caught two passes for eight yards in Monday night's 34-17 loss to the Chicago Bears.
news.head: Jadarian Price inefficient in loss Monday
news.impact: Price made his return to the lineup on Monday night after missing several games while on injured reserve. He didn't look great in his first game back, however, rushing at an inefficient clip of 2.9 yards per carry and not being much better in the passing game. He will not be fantasy relevant for the foreseeable future, especially with Zach Charbonnet also now back in the lineup for the Seahawks.

news.body: The Seahawks are expected to activate RB Jadarian Price from injured reserve for Monday's game against the Bears.
news.head: Jadarian Price (chest) to be activated from IR Monday
news.impact: Price will return after a month-long absence. The Seahawks will have a fully healthy backfield for the first time this season between him and Zach Charbonnet.

news.body: Jahmyr Gibbs carried the ball 21 times for 205 yards and three touchdowns while also hauling in each of his five targets for 47 yards in the Lions' 39-35 Week 12 loss to the Bears.
news.head: Jahmyr Gibbs explodes out of backfield in Week 12 loss to Bears
news.impact: Gibbs continues an explosive stretch out of the Detroit backfield, recording over 115 offensive yards and two or more touchdowns in each of his last three games. The running back remains an elite RB1 option in all formats entering a Week 13 matchup against the Atlanta Falcons.

news.body: Jahmyr Gibbs carried the ball 23 times for 98 yards and two touchdowns while also hauling in four of his five targets for 20 yards in the Lions' 31-21 Week 11 win over the Buccaneers.
news.head: Jahmyr Gibbs rushes for two touchdowns in Week 11 win over Buccaneers
news.impact: Gibbs continues a dynamic stretch out of the Detroit backfield, recording one or more touchdowns in nine of 10 games. The running back remains an explosive RB1 option in all formats entering a Week 12 matchup against the Chicago Bears.

news.body: Jahmyr Gibbs carried the ball 22 times for 153 yards and two touchdowns while catching seven of his eight targets for 99 yards in a 35-10 win over the Patriots in Munich in Week 10.
news.head: Jahmyr Gibbs scores twice in Munich game
news.impact: Gibbs fell one yard shy of posting a 100-yard game in both rushing and receiving. He continued his dominant season in Germany, bringing his touchdown total up to 13 in nine games. He will be a locked-in top-three fantasy option heading into Week 11 vs. Tampa Bay.

news.body: Jahmyr Gibbs carried the ball 20 times for 74 yards and one touchdown while failing to catch his lone target in the Lions' 19-9 Week 9 win over the Dolphins.
news.head: Jahmyr Gibbs reaches end zone in Week 9 win over Dolphins
news.impact: Gibbs has been dynamic out of the backfield of late, rushing for one or more touchdowns in five of his last six games. The running back remains an explosive RB1 option in all formats ahead of a Week 10 matchup against the New England Patriots.

news.body: James Cook III ran for 89 yards and a touchdown on 11 carries in the Bills 26-9 win over the Dolphins. He also caught 2-of-2 targets for three yards receiving.
news.head: James Cook III finds the end zone Sunday
news.impact: Cook put together another steady day of production as he has done every week this season. He remains a steady RB1 for fantasy managers.

news.body: James Cook III rushed for 157 yards and a touchdown on 18 carries in a 31-12 win over the Jets. He did not record a reception on his lone target.
news.head: James Cook III hits pay dirt in Week 10 win
news.impact: Cook found the end zone on a 74-yard rush late the in the fourth quarter to salvage what would have been a disappointing fantasy day. Cook has found the end zone in every game this season since Week 2 against Detroit. Cook will look to continue his strong season against Miami in Week 11.

news.body: James Cook II rushed for 107 yards and a touchdown on 31 carries in Monday's 23-6 win over the Vikings.
news.head: James Cook II goes over 100 yards, finds end zone in Week 9
news.impact: This was a true workhorse effort from Cook. The last time he got 30-plus carries was Week 13 of last season. Cook is one of only three backs in the league currently averaging over 100 rushing yards per game, and Jahmyr Gibbs is the only player carrying the ball more times per game than Cook.

news.body: James Cook III rushed for 80 yards and a touchdown on 21 carries in a 36-10 win over the Ravens. He caught 2-of-3 targets for 21 yards.
news.head: James Cook III finds the end zone in Week 8
news.impact: Cook found the end zone on a five-yard carry in the third quarter. Cook has a rushing touchdown in six straight games. Cook and the Bills have a tough matchup in Week 9 against a strong Vikings' defense.

news.body: Javonte Williams carried the ball 29 times for 101 yards and two touchdowns while also hauling in all three of his targets for 22 yards and one touchdown in the Cowboys' 39-38 Week 12 loss to the Eagles.
news.head: Javonte Williams records three touchdowns in Week 12 loss to Eagles
news.impact: Williams has been impactful out of the backfield of late, finishing with over 90 offensive yards and one or more touchdowns in three of his last four games. The running back faces a stiff test in Week 13 against a tough Seattle Seahawks defense.

news.body: Javonte Williams ran for 67 yards and a touchdown on 18 carries in the Cowboys 51-30 win over the Titans. He also caught 3-of-3 targets for 24 yards receiving and another score.
news.head: Javonte Williams finds the end zone twice Sunday
news.impact: Williams wasn't super efficient on the ground, but it didn't matter with the volume he saw to go along with two carries. He remains an RB1 for fantasy managers in a workhorse role.

news.body: Javonte Williams carried the ball 16 times for 63 yards while also catching his lone target for four yards in the Cowboys' 46-40 loss to the 49ers in Week 10.
news.head: Javonte Williams leads backfield in Week 10 loss
news.impact: Williams has been productive out of the backfield of late, rushing for over 60 yards in three of his last four contests. The running back will look to take advantage of an underperforming Tennessee Titans defense in Week 11.

news.body: Javonte Williams carried the ball 20 times for 101 yards and a touchdown while adding four catches for 23 yards on five targets in a 27-23 win over the Colts in Week 9.
news.head: Javonte Williams finds the end zone in Week 9
news.impact: Williams notched his second 100-yard rushing game of the season in the close win over Indy. The veteran running back has been a very reliable fantasy option this season, posting 10 all-purpose touchdowns through nine games. An every-week RB1 in fantasy, Williams will take on the 49ers in Week 10.

news.body: Jaylen Warren rushed nine times for 28 yards in Sunday’s loss to the Eagles. He had two receptions for one yard.
news.head: Jaylen Warren totals 29 yards in Sunday's loss to Eagles
news.impact: For the second game in a row, Warren has seen minimal production with his touches after he had an eight game stretch where he recorded at least 75 all-purpose yards. He will try to get back on track in Week 12, but he faces a tough Denver defense. He will likely fall in the low-end RB2 range.

news.body: Jaylen Warren rushed the ball seven times for 15 yards and caught five passes for 26 yards in Sunday's 38-18 loss to the Cincinnati Bengals.
news.head: Jaylen Warren underwhelming in loss Sunday
news.impact: Warren wasn't able to get much going on Sunday. He finished with just 15 yards on the ground, but his involvement in the passing game was able to pad his fantasy total in PPR scoring formats. He should bounce back and return to being a high-end fantasy option sometime in the very near future.

news.body: Jaylen Warren ran for 143 yards and a touchdown on 17 carries in the Steelers 27-6 win over the Browns.
news.head: Jaylen Warren runs for 143 yards Sunday
news.impact: Warren did not catch either of his two targets. He tied his career-high in rushing despite Rico Dowdle seeing 15 carries himself. Warren remains a borderline RB1/RB2 heading into the Steelers bye week.

news.body: Jaylen Warren ran 18 times for 101 yards and caught three of four targets for 36 yards in the Steelers' 16-10 win over the Saints on Sunday.
news.head: Jaylen Warren goes off against Saints
news.impact: Warren was the clear lead back for the Steelers on Sunday, showing markedly better efficiency than fellow RB Rico Dowdle. A two-back system will still likely be employed to keep Warren fresh, but Warren is looking like a solid weekly RB1 candidate.

news.body: Jaylen Wright ran for 10 yards on five carries in the Dolphins 26-9 loss against the Bills.
news.head: Jaylen Wright sees five carries Sunday
news.impact: Wright remains off the fantasy radar in his current role backing up Ollie Gordon II.

news.body: Jaylen Wright (quad) is good to go for Sunday's game against the Indianapolis Colts.
news.head: Jaylen Wright (quad) good to go for Week 10
news.impact: Wright is going to be good to go for Sunday's game. He was able to practice in full all week, so his quad issue is nothing serious at this point. He isn't expected to be fantasy relevant moving forward, however.

news.body: Jaylen Wright is practicing in full for Sunday's game against the Colts.
news.head: Jaylen Wright (quad) practicing in full for Week 10
news.impact: Wright missed last week with the quad issue. He will remain off the fantasy radar.

news.body: Jaylen Wright was back at practice on Thursday.
news.head: Jaylen Wright (quad) returns to practice Thursday
news.impact: Wright remains off the fantasy radar in his current role.

news.body: Cardinals coach Mike LaFleur said he had no update on Jeremiyah Love.
news.head: Jeremiyah Love (ankle) without update on status
news.impact: Love is eligible to come off injured reserve next week. There could be an update on his status next week.

news.body: The Cardinals placed RB Jeremiyah Love on injured reserve.
news.head: Jeremiyah Love (ankle) placed on IR
news.impact: Love suffered a high-ankle sprain in Sunday's win over the Cowboys. He is expected to be sidelined for the next 4-5 weeks. Pending the status of Bam Knight, Tyler Allgeier will figure to return to the lead role in the Cardinals backfield.

news.body: Cardinals coach Mike LaFleur told reporters RB Jeremiyah Love has a new ankle injury.
news.head: Jeremiyah Love has new ankle injury
news.impact: Love will be further evaluated throughout the week.

news.body: Jeremiyah Love (ankle) is questionable to return for the Arizona Cardinals Sunday according to Adam Schefter.
news.head: Jeremiyah Love (ankle) questionable to return Sunday
news.impact: Love suffered the apparent ankle injury in the second quarter, rushing nine times for 23 yards prior to exiting. Bam Knight and Tyler Allgeier will see increased touches out of the Arizona backfield in Love’s absence.

news.body: Broncos coach Sean Payton said he suspended J.K. Dobbins one game for conduct detrimental to the team.
news.head: J.K. Dobbins suspended one game
news.impact: Dobbins played just one snap last week. Jonah Coleman will remain in his workhorse role in the Broncos backfield.

news.body: J.K. Dobbins rushed once for zero yards in the Broncos' 38-24 win over the Raiders in Week 11.
news.head: J.K. Dobbins limited to one carry in Week 11
news.impact: Dobbins had seven carries in Week 8 and just one Sunday. Meanwhile, rookie running back Jonah Coleman set career highs in carries (24), rushing yards (111) and rushing touchdowns (three) against Las Vegas. The Broncos' backfield belongs to Coleman, leaving Dobbins with little fantasy value outside of being the former's lottery ticket handcuff.

news.body: J.K. Dobbins finished with one reception for four yards as the Broncos defeated the Panthers 26-21 in Week 9.
news.head: J.K. Dobbins struggles again in Week 9
news.impact: Dobbins has lost considerable ground to Jonah Coleman over the last three games. The latter had 21 touches for 88 yards and a touchdown Sunday. Dobbins, meanwhile, hasn't scored since Week 7. The Broncos have shifted their backfield toward Coleman, leaving Dobbins difficult to trust as a fantasy starter.

news.body: J.K. Dobbins rushed seven times for 13 yards in the Broncos' 28-24 win over the Chiefs in Week 8.
news.head: J.K. Dobbins held to 13 yards in Week 8
news.impact: Dobbins wasn't targeted and averaged 1.9 yards per carry. Meanwhile, Jonah Coleman had 15 touches for 104 total yards and scored the game-winning touchdown. Dobbins had scored in three straight games entering Sunday, but Coleman has led Denver's running backs in carries in both games since returning. The former is becoming touchdown-dependent.

news.body: Jonah Coleman rushed 24 times for 111 yards and three touchdowns, while catching four of five targets for 18 yards in the Broncos' 38-24 win over the Raiders in Week 11.
news.head: Jonah Coleman rushes for three touchdowns in Week 11
news.impact: Coleman set career highs in carries, rushing yards and rushing touchdowns Sunday. The rookie has now scored five rushing touchdowns over his last three games and caught four passes in each game over that stretch. Meanwhile, J.K. Dobbins had one carry for zero yards against Las Vegas. There's no longer much ambiguity regarding Denver's backfield. Coleman is an RB1 heading into Week 12 against Pittsburgh. League winner.

news.body: Jonah Coleman rushed 17 times for 57 yards and one touchdown while catching four passes for 31 yards in the Broncos' 26-21 win over the Panthers in Week 9.
news.head: Jonah Coleman scores touchdown in Week 9
news.impact: Coleman scored from nine yards out in the fourth quarter to give Denver a 19-14 lead. More importantly, he has now led the Broncos in rushing in three straight games since returning from injured reserve. Coleman also caught four passes for the second consecutive week. So, what happened to J.K. Dobbins' role? Coleman has taken over a significant portion of the backfield, including scoring opportunities. The rookie has established himself as Denver's most productive fantasy running back.

news.body: Jonah Coleman rushed 11 times for 41 yards and one touchdown, while catching four of five targets for 63 yards in the Broncos' 28-24 win over the Chiefs in Week 8.
news.head: Jonah Coleman totals 104 yards, scores in Week 8
news.impact: Coleman led the Broncos' running backs in carries for the second straight game. More importantly, he out-touched J.K. Dobbins 15-7 and scored the game-winning touchdown with two minutes remaining. Coleman also had a 51-yard reception on the final touchdown drive. So, what does the Broncos' backfield look like after two games with Coleman back? He has 24 carries compared to 13 for Dobbins. Coleman has entered the weekly starter fantasy conversation.

news.body: Jonah Coleman rushed nine times for 54 yards, while catching both of his targets for 15 yards in the Broncos' 30-16 win over the Cardinals in Week 7.
news.head: Jonah Coleman Totals 69 Yards in Return
news.impact: Coleman returned from injured reserve and immediately led Denver's running backs with nine carries, averaging six yards per attempt. J.K. Dobbins still received the goal-line touchdown, and RJ Harvey scored through the air, but Coleman's usage in his first game back is difficult to ignore. He's worth rostering as Denver sorts out what could become a three-man backfield. Coleman is worth a start next week for Zero RB drafters.

news.body: Jonathan Taylor gained 21 yards on 11 carries and just six yards on four receptions in Thursday's 26-3 loss to the Texans.
news.head: Jonathan Taylor does very little with 15 touches Thursday night
news.impact: Taylor had pretty much his worst game of the season Thursday night, as the Colts were dominated in all facets by the Texans. The star running back is stuck in an impotent offense with a team that is now 3-8 and looking to the future. Better games should still lay ahead, but the Colts may also decide to ease off Taylor's usage down the stretch.

news.body: Jonathan Taylor ran 16 times for 83 yards and caught two of four targets for 20 yards in the Colts' 24-22 win over the Dolphins.
news.head: Jonathan Taylor goes for 103 yards in win over Miami
news.impact: Taylor led the offense in touches but it was Seth McGowan scoring the touchdown on Sunday. Taylor should still have decent volume most weeks, but his upside is going to be limited as long as the Colts QB play is this poor.

news.body: The Colts won’t trade RB Jonathan Taylor by Tuesday's deadline.
news.head: Jonathan Taylor will not be traded by Colts
news.impact: Pelissero notes that multiple teams offered a second-round pick and more for Taylor, but the Colts wanted more in a deal for him. He'll remain in Indianapolis.

news.body: Jonathan Taylor carried the ball 13 times for 46 yards while catching all five of his targets for 18 yards and losing a fumble in a 27-23 loss to the Cowboys in Week 9.
news.head: Jonathan Taylor loses fumble in Week 9 loss
news.impact: Taylor struggled in what might have been his final game in a Colts uniform with trade rumors swirling around him. The veteran running back has rushed for 656 yards and eight touchdowns through nine games this year. If the Colts don't trade him by Tuesday's trade deadline, he will face the Dolphins in Week 10.

news.body: Jonathon Brooks was a full participant in practice on Thursday.
news.head: Jonathon Brooks (groin) logs full practice Thursday
news.impact: Brooks has a chance to be activated from injured reserve this week. He is likely to remain off the fantasy radar.

news.body: Jonathon Brooks has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Ravens.
news.head: Jonathon Brooks (groin) ruled out Sunday
news.impact: Brooks will remain on IR for at least one more week.

news.body: Jonathon Brooks is listed as questionable for Sunday’s game against the Ravens.
news.head: Jonathon Brooks (groin) listed questionable Sunday
news.impact: Brooks practiced in full all three days this week. He is trending towards being activated from injured reserve.

news.body: Jonathon Brooks is practicing again on Thursday.
news.head: Jonathon Brooks (groin) practicing Thursday
news.impact: Brooks continues to trend towards being activated for Sunday's game against the Ravens.

news.body: Jordan Mason gained 38 yards on 11 carries in Sunday's 35-10 loss to the 49ers.
news.head: Jordan Mason largely bottled up Sunday night
news.impact: Mason did catch a pass Sunday, but it went for negative yardage. The 27-year-old back continues to share the backfield work with veteran Aaron Jones for the Vikings, and that has capped Mason's fantasy ceiling. He'll move forward as a TD-dependent flex option, but, notably, he's scored just once in six games this season. That came back in Week 1.

news.body: Jordan Mason carried the ball 16 times for 59 yards while failing to catch his only target in the Vikings' 30-10 Week 10 win over the Packers.
news.head: Jordan Mason leads backfield in Week 10 win over Packers
news.impact: Mason has struggled to find room out of the Minnesota backfield to this point, totaling less than 60 offensive yards in four of his five games. The running back remains part of an underperforming Minnesota backfield alongside Aaron Jones Sr. entering a Week 11 matchup against the San Francisco 49ers.

news.body: Jordan Mason rushed for 35 yards on six carries and added just seven yards on two receptions in Monday's 23-6 loss to the Bills.
news.head: Jordan Mason totals 42 yards on Monday night
news.impact: Mason missed a large chunk of the season early on. Then, he returned to gain 68 yards on 15 carries in a win over the Colts in Week 7. Any encouragement that resulted from that performance is gone now, as the Vikings just cannot get things together on offense. Mason has gained 55 yards on just 14 carries combined over the last two games. He's a bench stash for fantasy purposes right now.

news.body: Jordan Mason rushed eight times for 20 yards in the Vikings' 19-15 loss to the Lions in Week 8.
news.head: Jordan Mason bottled up in Week 8 loss
news.impact: Mason struggled to find running room in a losing effort, finishing with under 50 rushing yards for the first time in three contests. The running back remains difficult to trust in all formats ahead of a Week 9 contest against the Buffalo Bills.

news.body: Josh Jacobs (finger) is officially inactive for Week 12 for the Green Bay Packers against the Los Angeles Rams.
news.head: Josh Jacobs (finger) inactive for Week 12
news.impact: Jacobs will miss the Wednesday night contest while continuing to recover from his finger injury, with Kaleb Johnson and MarShawn Lloyd likely to see the majority of backfield touches against the Rams.

news.body: Josh Jacobs (finger) has been listed as questionable for Wednesday's game against the Rams.
news.head: Josh Jacobs (finger) questionable for Wednesday's game
news.impact: With the Packers coming off a bye week, Jacobs practiced in limited fashion Monday and was listed as questionable Tuesday. If Jacobs is ruled out, the trio of Chris Brooks, Kaleb Johnson, and MarShawn Lloyd would likely split the backfield load for the Packers once again.

news.body: Josh Jacobs was limited in practice on Monday.
news.head: Josh Jacobs (finger) limited in practice Monday
news.impact: Jacobs is not expected to be ready to return for Wednesday’s game against the Rams. He was still able to practice in limited fashion just two days before the next game for Green Bay.

news.body: Josh Jacobs (finger) is unlikely to play on Thursday, per HC Matt LeFleur.
news.head: Josh Jacobs (finger) unlikely to play Week 12 against Rams
news.impact: This isn’t altogether surprising, given Jacob’s recent surgery on his finger. He’s likely to miss at least one more game, with a return around Week 14. However, the surgery seemed fairly minor so time will tell whether he can make it back off of the mini-bye the Packers are having after the Wednesday game.

news.body: Justice Hill rushed for 69 yards and a touchdown on six carries in a 35-33 loss to the Panthers. He caught 4-of-5 targets for 27 yards.
news.head: Justice Hill finds the end zone in Week 11 loss
news.impact: Hill found the end zone on a 19 yard rush in late in the second quarter. Derrick Henry was being evaluated for a concussion late in the game, so Hill could be in line for more work in Week 12 if Henry is unable to clear the protocol in time to play against Houston.

news.body: Justice Hill rushed the ball three times for four yards and hauled in 5-of-7 targets for 34 yards in Monday night's 23-20 loss to the Los Angeles Chargers.
news.head: Justice Hill active as receiver in win Monday
news.impact: Hill was a non-factor in the rushing game on Monday night, but he was able to get involved as a pass catcher, finishing with five catches for 34 yards. Those are high-value touches, but fantasy managers still shouldn't expect him to be a reliable fantasy asset for the foreseeable future given his lack of consistent work in the rushing game.

news.body: Justice Hill ran nine times for 85 yards and a touchdown in the Ravens' 33-10 loss to the Jaguars on Thursday. He also caught three passes for seven yards.
news.head: Justice Hill breaks away for long TD in loss
news.impact: Hill managed the one explosive play by the Ravens all night, breaking away for a long touchdown late in the game. He could be an interesting flex option moving forward as the Ravens change of pace back.

news.body: Justice Hill (groin) is set to play in Thursday night's game against the Jacksonville Jaguars.
news.head: Justice Hill (groin) set to play Thursday
news.impact: Hill is managing a minor ankle issue right now, but he carries no injury designation for Thursday and should be a full go against the Jaguars. Fantasy managers can't really trust him on a week-to-week basis at this point in the season, however.

news.body: Kaelon Black gained just eight yards on six carries, adding one reception for seven yards in Sunday's 35-10 win over the Vikings.
news.head: Kaelon Black does little in Week 11 win
news.impact: Black has been an excellent spell to starting RB Christian McCaffrey this season, but the rookie was not able to get much going with his seven touches Sunday night. That's obviously disappointing when considering he had gone over 50 yards in each of the last three games, scoring twice in that stretch. Black's main fantasy value remains as a handcuff to McCaffrey.

news.body: Kaelon Black rushed 11 times for 53 yards and one touchdown while also catching both of his targets for 13 yards in the 49ers' 46-40 win over the Cowboys in Week 10.
news.head: Kaelon Black reaches end zone in Week 10 win
news.impact: Black has been impactful out of the San Francisco backfield of late, recording over 60 offensive yards in each of his last three contests. The running back remains an explosive complement to RB1 Christian McCaffrey ahead of a Week 11 matchup against the Minnesota Vikings.

news.body: Kaelon Black ran for 70 yards on 11 carries in the 49ers 38-17 win over the Raiders.
news.head: Kaelon Black runs for 70 yards Sunday
news.impact: Black led San Francisco in rushing despite seeing seven fewer carries than Christian McCaffrey. He did not see a target in the passing game. He remains a touchdown dependent flex play moving forward.

news.body: Kaelon Black rushed for 63 yards and a touchdown on 12 carries in Sunday's 29-20 loss to the Falcons.
news.head: Kaelon Black finds the end zone in Week 7 loss
news.impact: Black led the 49ers in carries Sunday afternoon and gashed the Falcons' defense for a 30-yard TD run in the second quarter. Christian McCaffrey did deal with a thigh issue in this one and ended up only outtouching Black 13-to-12. This was a nice game for Black, but he remains useful to fantasy managers only as a handcuff to McCaffrey.

news.body: Kaleb Johnson rushed eight times for 13 yards while also hauling in one of his two targets for 19 yards in the Packers' 26-13 Week 12 loss to the Rams.
news.head: Kaleb Johnson bottled up in Week 12 loss to Rams
news.impact: Johnson struggled to find running room against a stout Los Angeles front seven, finishing with under 40 rushing yards for the first time in his last three games. The running back will look to find success against the New Orleans Saints in Week 13 if Josh Jacobs (finger) remains sidelined.

news.body: Kaleb Johnson carried the ball 10 times for a team-high 42 yards in the Packers' 30-10 Week 10 loss to the Vikings.
news.head: Kaleb Johnson leads backfield in Week 10 loss to Vikings
news.impact: Johnson made the most of his opportunities out of the Green Bay backfield, averaging over 4.0 yards per carry for the second consecutive contest. The running back enters the team's Week 11 bye as their RB1 in an inconsistent Packers offense.

news.body: Kaleb Johnson carried the ball 14 times for a team-leading 68 yards and one touchdown in the Packers' 45-27 win over the Patriots in Week 9.
news.head: Kaleb Johnson reaches end zone in Week 9 win
news.impact: Johnson took advantage of increased touches after Josh Jacobs (hand) exited, rushing for over 60 yards for the first time this season. The running back could be in line for increased touches if Jacobs is to miss time entering a Week 10 contest against the Minnesota Vikings.

news.body: Kaleb Johnson is inactive for Week 7 for the Green Bay Packers against the Detroit Lions.
news.head: Kaleb Johnson inactive for Week 7
news.impact: Johnson will not suit up after just one touch in Week 6, with the returning Josh Jacobs (suspension) poised to reclaim his role as the No. 1 option in the Green Bay backfield moving forward.

news.body: Kenneth Walker III (groin) has been ruled out for Thursday's game against the Bills.
news.head: Kenneth Walker III (groin) will not play Thursday
news.impact: Walker has practiced this week, but he will not be ready to go for Thursday's game. Emmett Johnson will once again shoulder the load out of the Chiefs' backfield. Walker should have a good shot at returning in Week 13.

news.body: Kenneth Walker III (groin) will practice for the Kansas City Chiefs Tuesday according to Nate Taylor.
news.head: Kenneth Walker III (groin) practicing Tuesday
news.impact: Walker III will see limited work on the practice field, as the dynamic running back looks to return from a two-game absence against the Buffalo Bills Thanksgiving night. Emmett Johnson would be in line for an RB1 role if Walker III is unable to progress enough on a limited practice week for head coach Andy Reid against the Bills.

news.body: Kenneth Walker III did not participate in Monday's walkthrough practice.
news.head: Kenneth Walker III (groin) misses walkthrough Monday
news.impact: It is a short week for the Chiefs on Thursday against the Bills. Walker will need to continue to be monitored in practice on Tuesday after missing the past two weeks.

news.body: Kenneth Walker III (groin) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Arizona Cardinals.
news.head: Kenneth Walker III (groin) ruled out for Sunday
news.impact: The Chiefs are letting Walker sit out for a second-straight game as he continues to nurse a groin injury that he recently suffered. It's not considered a serious issue at this point, however, so he seems to have a chance to play in Week 12's matchup against the Bills next Thursday night. Emmett Johnson was dominant as the Chiefs' RB1 last week and will be a must-start fantasy option in a favorable matchup against the Cardinals this week.

news.body: Kenny Gainwell rushed four times for 16 yards while also catching four of his five targets for 43 yards in the Buccaneers' 31-21 Week 11 loss to the Lions.
news.head: Kenny Gainwell sees eight touches in Week 11 loss
news.impact: Gainwell has offered steady output out of the Tampa Bay backfield of late, recording over 55 offensive yards in each of his last four games. The running back offers more value in PPR formats, with a Week 12 contest against the Carolina Panthers up next.

news.body: Kenny Gainwell carried the ball five times for 16 yards and caught all three of his targets for 60 yards in a 27-24 loss to the Bears in Week 9.
news.head: Kenny Gainwell posts 60 receiving yards in Week 9
news.impact: Gainwell finished second on the team in receiving, doing most of his damage on a 44-yard reception. The veteran tailback has carved out a solid role behind Bucky Irving in Tampa, running for 305 yards while adding 15 catches for 121 yards and a touchdown in nine games. He will be on bye in Week 10.

news.body: Kenny Gainwell ran for 140 yards on 25 carries in the Buccaneers 16-0 win over the Falcons.
news.head: Kenny Gainwell sees 25 carries Sunday
news.impact: Gainwell and Bucky Irving combined for 310 rushing yards on 52 carries on a day where Baker Mayfield did not complete a single pass. He'll be an RB3/RB4 play next week against the Bears.

news.body: Kenny Gainwell (hip) is officially active for Week 8 for the Tampa Bay Buccaneers according to Brianna Dix.
news.head: Kenny Gainwell (hip) active for Week 8
news.impact: Gainwell will suit up after entering the weekend carrying a questionable designation, boosting a Tampa Bay backfield that will utilize both Gainwell and Bucky Irving against the Falcons Sunday.

news.body: Kimani Vidal carried the ball seven times for 36 yards and caught both of his targets for 18 yards in a 27-24 loss to the Jets in Week 11.
news.head: Kimani Vidal rolls up 54 all-purpose yards in Week 11
news.impact: Vidal was productive in the close loss, averaging 5.1 yards per carry behind starter Omarion Hampton. Vidal could be in line for a larger role moving forward as Keaton Mitchell missed time in Week 11 with back and knee issues. The Chargers will now prepare to face the Patriots in Week 12.

news.body: Kimani Vidal rushed the ball two times for zero yards and caught two passes for 14 yards in Monday night's 23-20 win over the Baltimore Ravens.
news.head: Kimani Vidal uninvolved in win Monday
news.impact: Vidal didn't see much work for the Chargers on Monday night. He saw just two carries over the course of the night, and the team gave Omarion Hampton 22 carries, which shows their clear mindset shift away from the committee approach that they employed in the backfield for much of the season. Fantasy managers shouldn't expect Vidal to have much relevance for the foreseeable future.

news.body: Kimani Vidal rushed the ball seven times for 30 yards and caught 1-of-3 targets for six yards in Sunday's 44-22 loss to the Houston Texans.
news.head: Kimani Vidal quiet in loss Sunday
news.impact: Vidal saw a solid amount of touches on Sunday, but he wasn't able to do much with them and ended with just 36 scoreless yards against the Texans. He isn't expected to be a relevant fantasy option for the foreseeable future.

news.body: Kimani Vidal rushed the ball eight times for 23 yards and caught two passes for seven yards in Sunday's 24-9 loss to the Los Angeles Rams.
news.head: Kimani Vidal leads team in rushing Sunday
news.impact: Vidal ended as the team's leading rusher on Sunday, but that didn't really mean much. He finished with just 23 yards on the ground, and he ran a an inefficient clip of just 2.9 yards per carry over the course of the game. Fantasy managers should not have any real expectations for him moving forward.

news.body: Kyle Monangai rushed eight times for 15 yards and two touchdowns while also catching one of his two targets for 14 yards in the Bears' 39-35 Week 12 win over the Lions.
news.head: Kyle Monangai rushes for two touchdowns in Week 12 win over Lions
news.impact: Monangai has had a nose for the end zone in limited action out of the backfield of late, rushing for two touchdowns in two of his last three contests. The running back remains a touchdown dependent option behind RB1 D'Andre Swift ahead of a Week 13 matchup against the Jacksonville Jaguars.

news.body: Kyle Monangai rushed eight times for 18 yards while also failing to catch his only target in the Bears' 21-13 Week 11 win over the Saints.
news.head: Kyle Monangai quiet in Week 11 win
news.impact: Monangai struggled to find much success on the ground, rushing for a paltry 2.3 yards per carry in the win. The running back remains a risky backfield option behind RB1 D'Andre Swift ahead of a Week 12 matchup against the Detroit Lions.

news.body: Kyle Monangai is off the injury report for Sunday's game against the Saints.
news.head: Kyle Monangai (toe) off injury report Sunday
news.impact: Monangai is officially good to go after getting in full practices all week. He'll return to being an RB2/flex play for fantasy managers.

news.body: Kyle Monangai (toe) practiced in a full capacity on Thursday.
news.head: Kyle Monangai (toe) practices in full Thursday
news.impact: As expected, Monangai was a full participant for a second-straight practice on Thursday, which means that he will almost certainly play in Week 11. His anticipated return will mean less work for D'Andre Swift and especially Roschon Johnson moving forward.

news.body: Kyren Williams rushed 12 times for 46 yards and one touchdown while also catching four of his five targets for 19 yards in the Rams' 26-13 Week 12 win over the Packers.
news.head: Kyren Williams reaches end zone in Week 12 win over Packers
news.impact: Williams maximized his role while being out-touched 34-16 by Blake Corum Wednesday night, reaching the end zone for at least once for the fifth time in his last eight games. The running back faces a stiff test in Week 13 against the Kansas City Chiefs.

news.body: Kyren Williams is off the injury report for Wednesday’s game against the Packers.
news.head: Kyren Williams (toe) off injury report Wednesday
news.impact: Williams will be good to go in his usual role. He remains an RB2 play for fantasy managers.

news.body: Kyren Williams has soreness in his toe but he is expected to play against the Packers in Week 12.
news.head: Kyren Williams (toe) expected to be good to go in Week 12
news.impact: Williams has the bye week to get fully healthy heading into Week 12.

news.body: Kyren Williams ran for 23 yards on 12 carries in the Rams 34-6 win over the Cardinals. He also caught 2-of-5 targets for nine yards receiving.
news.head: Kyren Williams quiet Sunday
news.impact: Williams started the game for the Rams per usual, but Blake Corum wound up being the hot hand on the day. He did have a receiving touchdown called back. Despite a down performance this week, Williams remains a steady RB2.

news.body: MarShawn Lloyd rushed once for 10 yards while also catching his only target for six yards in the Packers' 26-13 Week 12 loss to the Rams.
news.head: MarShawn Lloyd dismal out of backfield in Week 12 loss
news.impact: Lloyd has been dismal out of the backfield to this point, finishing with less than 40 offensive yards in each of his 10 games. The running back is best left off rosters in all formats ahead of a Week 13 contest against the New Orleans Saints.

news.body: MarShawn Lloyd rushed four times for 13 yards while also catching all three of his targets for 26 yards in the Packers' 30-10 loss to the Vikings in Week 10.
news.head: MarShawn Lloyd sees seven touches in Week 10 loss
news.impact: Lloyd has been dismal out of the Green Bay backfield to this point, rushing for less than 40 yards in each of his nine games. The running back remains one of many risky backfield options, with Green Bay's next contest in Week 12 against the Los Angeles Rams after a bye in Week 11.

news.body: MarShawn Lloyd was off the injury report on Wednesday.
news.head: MarShawn Lloyd (knee) off injury report Wednesday
news.impact: Lloyd is on track to return after missing last week. He'll figure to form a committee with Kaleb Johnson in the Packers backfield.

news.body: MarShawn Lloyd (knee) is inactive for Week 9 for the Green Bay Packers.
news.head: MarShawn Lloyd (knee) inactive for Week 9
news.impact: Lloyd will not suit up after being unable to clear through pregame tests, with Josh Jacobs to handle the majority of the backfield work anyways against the Patriots Sunday.

news.body: Mike Washington Jr. rushed nine times for 42 yards in the Raiders' 38-24 loss to the Broncos in Week 11.
news.head: Mike Washington Jr. rushes for 42 yards in Week 11
news.impact: Washington averaged 4.7 yards per carry and had just two fewer carries than Ashton Jeanty. The difference? Jeanty saw eight targets, catching five passes for 90 yards and a touchdown, while Washington wasn't targeted. The rookie warrants a roster spot as Jeanty's handcuff but isn't a reliable standalone fantasy option.

news.body: Mike Washington Jr. ran for 23 yards on eight carries in the Raiders 21-13 loss against the Seahawks. He also caught his lone target for four yards receiving.
news.head: Mike Washington Jr. shut down Sunday
news.impact: Washington saw eight carries to Ashton Jeanty's nine carries on a day where they were both once again shut down on the ground. He remains a volatile flex play.

news.body: Mike Washington Jr. ran for -3 yards on six carries in the Raiders 38-17 loss against the 49ers.
news.head: Mike Washington Jr. struggles Sunday
news.impact: One week after taking over the workhorse role in the Raiders backfield, Washington and Ashton Jeanty both saw six carries on Sunday. He draws a tough Seahawks run defense next week.

news.body: Mike Washington Jr. rushed for 83 yards on 25 carries in a 38-33 win over the Jets.
news.head: Mike Washington Jr. sees 25 rushing attempts in Week 8 win
news.impact: Washington saw 25 carries to Ashton Jeanty's two rushing attempts in the win. Head coach Klint Kubiak stated after the game that the reduced workload for Jeanty was by design. Fantasy managers should expect Washington to continue to be involved in the running game heading into Week 9 against the 49ers.

news.body: Ollie Gordon II ran for 69 yards on 11 carries in the Dolphins 26-9 loss on Sunday against the Bills. He also caught 2-of-3 targets for -2 yards receiving.
news.head: Ollie Gordon II runs for 69 yards Sunday
news.impact: Gordon did the majority of his damage on the afternoon on one 24-yard run. He did not get many opportunities. He'll remain an RB2 play next week against the Jets.

news.body: Ollie Gordon II ran 20 times for 76 yards and also caught four of five targets for 39 yards in the Dolphins' 24-22 loss to the Colts on Sunday.
news.head: Ollie Gordon II goes for 76 yards on the ground in loss
news.impact: Gordon wasn't very efficient on the ground, but had some receiving work to keep him in RB2 territory. It's gonna be tough next week against Buffalo, but he's a low-end, volume-based RB2.

news.body: Ollie Gordon II carried the ball 16 times for 55 yards while also hauling in his lone target for nine yards in the Dolphins' 19-9 Week 9 loss to the Lions.
news.head: Ollie Gordon II leads backfield in Week 9 loss to Lions
news.impact: Gordon II has capitalized on increased touches out of the Miami backfield of late, logging over 60 offensive yards in each of his last five contests. The running back remains one of the few stable options as part of an underwhelming Miami offense to this point ahead of a Week 10 matchup against the Indianapolis Colts.

news.body: Ollie Gordon II ran 19 times for 69 yards in the Dolphins' 24-19 loss to the Patriots. He also failed to catch his only target.
news.head: Ollie Gordon II runs for 69 yards in loss
news.impact: After four straight weeks with a rushing touchdown and three straight weeks of 88+ rushing yards, Gordon finally had himself a down game. That's to be expected for a player who has almost zero passing game involvement; the floor falls out when receiving is nil. He will face off against the Lions next weekend.

news.body: Omarion Hampton carried the ball 14 times for 89 yards while catching a four-yard pass in a 27-24 loss to the Jets in Week 11.
news.head: Omarion Hampton runs for 89 yards in Week 11
news.impact: After splitting work pretty evenly for much of the season, Hampton has taken over the Los Angeles backfield over the past two weeks. He has seen 36 of the 48 running back carries over the past two games as the Chargers have made it a point to get him going on offense. Hampton is shaping up as a low-end RB2 in fantasy for the rest of the season with the Patriots up next in Week 12.

news.body: Omarion Hampton rushed the ball 22 times for 105 yards and a touchdown in Monday night's 23-20 win over the Baltimore Ravens.
news.head: Omarion Hampton plays well in win Monday
news.impact: The Chargers finally gave Hampton the bulk of the work in their backfield on Monday night, and he was able to put up over 100 yards and a touchdown on good efficiency en route to the team's first win. It seems reasonable to assume that they will continue to give him the majority of touches after he found success in this game, so fantasy managers should be looking to pick him up if he was dropped earlier in the season in their league.

news.body: Omarion Hampton carried the ball 13 times for 60 yards in Sunday's 44-22 loss to the Houston Texans.
news.head: Omarion Hampton leads team in rushing Sunday
news.impact: Hampton led the backfield in carries on Sunday and was able to rush for a team-high 60 yards. His efficiency wasn't bad, but he didn't get in the end zone and didn't catch any passes, so his fantasy total remained poor. It's encouraging to see the team finally consolidating some work for him, but he is unlikely to be relevant anytime soon with how pitiful their offense continues to look.

news.body: Omarion Hampton rushed the ball nine times for 20 yards and caught two passes for seven yards in Sunday's 24-9 loss to the Los Angeles Rams.
news.head: Omarion Hampton disappoints again in loss Sunday
news.impact: Hampton hasn't been able to get anything going over the course of the season, and Sunday was no exception. He totaled just 27 yards on his 11 touches and wasn't able to get into the end zone at all, which left him with a terrible fantasy total. He should not be started in nearly any league formats for the foreseeable future.

news.body: Quinshon Judkins rushed for 38 yards and a touchdown on 10 carries, adding three receptions for 33 yards in Sunday's 27-24 win over the Texans.
news.head: Quinshon Judkins gains 71 yards, finds the end zone in Week 10
news.impact: Judkins totaled over 70 yards of offense on his 13 touches in Sunday's comeback win over the Texans. The second-year back put the Browns ahead with a five-yard TD plunge with less than a minute left to go in the game. Judkins is up to 423 yards and four touchdowns on the ground through nine games. He's also caught at least three passes four times this season.

news.body: Quinshon Judkins ran 15 times for 43 yards in the Browns' 23-22 overtime loss to the Saints on Sunday. He also caught his only target for two yards.
news.head: Quinshon Judkins struggles to get going against Saints defense
news.impact: This was a prime spot for Judkins to go off, and he didn't. The Saints had been one of the best matchups for running backs this season, and Judkins failed to deliver. He's only been above 10 PPR points twice this season and is a low-end RB3 option at best until he shows signs of life.

news.body: Quinshon Judkins ran for 25 yards on 11 carries in the Browns 27-6 loss against the Steelers. He also caught 2-of-2 targets for 24 yards receiving.
news.head: Quinshon Judkins shut down on ground Sunday
news.impact: Judkins was completely stifled on the ground all afternoon. He will look to bounce back as an RB2 play next week against the Saints.

news.body: Quinshon Judkins carried the ball 17 times for 96 yards and two touchdowns while catching his lone target for an eight-yard gain in a 27-24 win over the Titans in Week 7.
news.head: Quinshon Judkins scores twice in Week 7 win
news.impact: Judkins turned in one of his better games as a pro, finding the end zone on runs of five and six yards in the win. He looked good after missing the previous week with an ankle injury. Judkins now has three rushing touchdowns across six contests this season. He will be on the RB2 radar in Week 8 vs. the Steelers.

news.body: Rachaad White did not receive any touches in a 22-20 win over the Bengals in Week 11.
news.head: Rachaad White does not see any touches in Week 11
news.impact: White came into the game managing a heel injury but he ultimately suited up and played on 15 snaps. The return of Jacory Croskey-Merritt from injured reserve certainly cut into White's workload, as the former led the Commanders' backfield with 15 touches. White is looking like a fantasy cut candidate heading into a Week 12 matchup vs. the Cardinals.

news.body: Rachaad White (heel) is active for Week 11 for the Washington Commanders against the Cincinnati Bengals.
news.head: Rachaad White (heel) active for Week 11
news.impact: White is good to go after passing through pregame tests without any issues, offering head coach Dan Quinn a impactful pass-catching out of the backfield behind the returning Jacory Croskey-Merritt.

news.body: Rachaad White is listed as questionable for Monday's game against the Bengals.
news.head: Rachaad White (heel) listed questionable Monday
news.impact: White was added to the injury report on Friday before missing practice on Saturday. His status is uncertain heading into Monday.

news.body: Commanders RB Rachaad White was not at practice on Saturday.
news.head: Rachaad White (heel) not at practice Saturday
news.impact: White was added to the injury report on Friday, though he still got in a limited practice. He appears to be trending in the wrong direction.

news.body: Rhamondre Stevenson carried the ball six times for four yards and caught his lone target for a one-yard gain in a 35-10 loss to the Lions in Munich in Week 10.
news.head: Rhamondre Stevenson held to four rushing yards in Week 10
news.impact: Stevenson dealt with a knee injury all week and likely saw his role in the rushing attack scaled back a bit, especially with the Patriots losing 21-3 at halftime. Stevenson will have a chance to heal up during his Week 11 bye before he takes on the Chargers in Week 12.

news.body: Rhamondre Stevenson (knee) is officially active for Week 10 for the New England Patriots against the Detroit Lions according to Adam Schefter.
news.head: Rhamondre Stevenson (knee) active for Week 10
news.impact: Stevenson will take the field after clearing through pregame tests on his knee, boosting a New England backfield missing TreVeyon Henderson (illness) and should receive the majority of backfield touches against the Lions Sunday.

news.body: Rhamondre Stevenson is listed as questionable for Sunday’s game against the Lions.
news.head: Rhamondre Stevenson (knee) listed questionable Sunday
news.impact: Stevenson was expected to miss some time, but he was able to log back-to-back limited practices to end the week. He'll have a chance to play on Sunday.

news.body: Rhamondre Stevenson (knee) returned to practice as a limited participant on Thursday.
news.head: Rhamondre Stevenson (knee) returns to limited practice Thursday
news.impact: Stevenson was able to make his return to practice on Thursday and was a limited participant. Early reports indicated that he was set to miss multiple weeks with this injury, but he seems to be recovering much quicker than expected and may miss little, if any, time. This is a situation worth monitoring heading into the weekend, as he will likely see the bulk of the work in New England's backfield if he's cleared to play in time for Sunday's game.

news.body: Rico Dowdle had five rushes for 15 yards and added four catches for 19 yards in Sunday’s loss to the Eagles.
news.head: Rico Dowdle has minimal production in loss
news.impact: Dowdle has mostly disappointed this season, logging fewer than 50 all-purpose yards in all but two of his games played this season. He has failed to show the upside he had last year with the Panthers, and has only reached the end zone once all year. Dowdle will be nothing more than a desperation play in Week 12’s game against the Broncos.

news.body: Rico Dowdle rushed the ball five times for 26 yards and caught two passes for eight yards in Sunday's 38-18 loss to the Cincinnati Bengals.
news.head: Rico Dowdle quiet in loss Sunday
news.impact: Dowdle wasn't effective on Sunday, finishing with just 34 scoreless yards on seven total touches. He will continue to see involvement in this offense moving forward but shouldn't be regarded as much more than a handcuff fantasy asset behind Jaylen Warren for the foreseeable future.

news.body: Rico Dowdle ran for 56 yards and a touchdown on 15 carries in the Steelers 27-6 win over the Browns.
news.head: Rico Dowdle finds the end zone Sunday
news.impact: Dowdle saw a fairly decent role behind Jaylen Warren in Sunday's win. He'll be on the RB3 radar moving forward if his current role holds.

news.body: Rico Dowdle ran 9 times for 41 yards and caught all six of his targets for 45 yards in the Steelers' 16-10 win over the Saints.
news.head: Rico Dowdle snags six passes in win
news.impact: Dowdle really saw his numbers come up in this game after a disappointing outing against Tampa Bay. Not that his efficiency running the ball was bad then, but he simply didn't receive many opportunities. Dowdle is looking like an RB3 type of play moving forward.

news.body: RJ Harvey (knee) was placed on IR with a designation to return.
news.head: RJ Harvey (knee) placed on short-term IR
news.impact: Harvey sustained a knee injury at practice earlier this week. He will now be forced to miss at least the next four games. JK Dobbins and Jonah Coleman could see more touches as a result.

news.body: RJ Harvey has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Chiefs.
news.head: RJ Harvey (knee) ruled out Sunday
news.impact: Harvey was a late addition to the injury report on Thursday. Jonah Coleman and J.K. Dobbins should both step into bigger roles in the Broncos backfield.

news.body: RJ Harvey (knee) was added to the injury report as a limited participant on Thursday.
news.head: RJ Harvey (knee) added to injury report Thursday
news.impact: Harvey is a new addition to Denver's injury report, being listed with a knee issue of some kind that left him limited at practice. This is a situation worth monitoring heading into the weekend, as J.K. Dobbins and rookie Jonah Coleman will both see more work if Harvey is sidelined against the Chiefs.

news.body: RJ Harvey rushed three times for six yards, while catching both of his targets for 54 yards and one touchdown in the Broncos' 30-16 win over the Cardinals in Week 7
news.head: RJ Harvey Scores 52-Yard Touchdown in Week 7
news.impact: Harvey turned a short pass from Bo Nix into a 52-yard touchdown for his biggest play of the afternoon. The touchdown saved an otherwise quiet day, as Harvey received just five touches with Jonah Coleman returning to the lineup. Harvey remains involved as a receiver, but Coleman's return adds another player to an already crowded Denver backfield. The former is in flex territory.

news.body: Samaje Perine carried the ball six times for 26 yards and caught all four of his targets for 71 yards in a 22-20 loss to the Commanders in Week 11.
news.head: Samaje Perine leads Bengals in rushing in Week 11
news.impact: Perine led the Bengals in rushing while finishing second on the team in receiving in the close loss. The team continues to mix Perine in on offense behind Chase Brown, giving him low-end flex value in fantasy most weeks. He will now prepare to take on the Saints in Week 12.

news.body: Samaje Perine rushed the ball six times for 14 yards and a touchdown while adding four catches for 25 yards through the air in Sunday's 38-18 win over the Pittsburgh Steelers.
