news.head: Samaje Perine finds end zone in win Sunday
news.impact: Perine had himself a nice game on Sunday. He wasn't very productive on the ground, but he was able to make up for that by getting into the end zone once and getting involved in the receiving game. He will continue to see meaningful touches for this offense moving forward, though he won't be a good fantasy option as long as he's behind Chase Brown in the pecking order.

news.body: Samaje Perine carried the ball four times for 10 yards and caught his lone target for a nine-yard gain in a 43-36 overtime win over the Titans in Week 8.
news.head: Samaje Perine sees five touches in Week 8
news.impact: Perine was quiet in the high-scoring win while Chase Brown racked up 20 touches. The veteran tailback saw 14 carries for the Bengals two games ago but he has taken a backseat to Brown ever since. Perine will not be a strong fantasy option heading into Week 9 vs. the Falcons.

news.body: Samaje Perine rushed for 16 yards and a touchdown on four carries in a 35-13 2in over the Ravens.
news.head: Samaje Perine finds the end zone in Week 7 win
news.impact: Perine plunged into the end zone on a one-yard rush early in the fourth quarter to extend the Bengals' lead. The veteran continues to see limited work and can remain off fantasy managers' radar for now.

news.body: Saquon Barkley (stinger) is questionable to return for the Philadelphia Eagles Thursday.
news.head: Saquon Barkley (stinger) questionable to return
news.impact: Barkley argued with the coaching staff in an attempt to return to the field unsuccessfully, rushing five times for seven yards prior to exiting. Will Shipley takes over in the backfield for head coach Nick Sirianni.

news.body: Saquon Barkley (neck/illness) is off of the injury report for the Philadelphia Eagles according to Mike Garafolo.
news.head: Saquon Barkley (neck/illness) off injury report for Week 12
news.impact: Barkley is good to go after practicing throughout the week entering a Thanksgiving Day matchup against a generous Dallas Cowboys run defense as a solid RB1 option.

news.body: Saquon Barkley was a full participant in practice on Tuesday.
news.head: Saquon Barkley (neck/illness) logs full practice Tuesday
news.impact: Barkley is on track to be a full-go for Thursday’s game against the Cowboys. He'll be an RB2 play for fantasy managers.

news.body: Saquon Barkley was listed as a limited participant on Monday's estimated practice report.
news.head: Saquon Barkley (neck/illness) limited in estimated practice Monday
news.impact: Barkley was able to find the end zone in Sunday's win over the Steelers. He should be on track to be good to go despite it being a short week for the Eagles.

news.body: Seth McGowan has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Giants.
news.head: Seth McGowan (hamstring) ruled out for Week 12
news.impact: McGowan is slated to miss some time with his hamstring injury.

news.body: Colts RB Seth McGowan is expected to miss "some time" with a hamstring injury.
news.head: Seth McGowan (hamstring) to miss some time
news.impact: McGowan suffered the injury in last Thursday's loss against the Texans. It is unclear if he is an IR candidate.

news.body: Seth McGowan gained seven yards on three carries and just one yard on one catch before exiting Thursday's 26-3 loss to the Texans with a hamstring injury.
news.head: Seth McGowan gets four touches, leaves with injury Thursday night
news.impact: McGowan had been a bright spot for the struggling Colts in recent weeks, as the rookie back has looked like a capable ball carrier behind veteran Jonathan Taylor. Unfortunately, he sustained a hamstring injury after just a few touches Thursday night and did not return to the contest. McGowan has averaged an impressive 5.0 yards on his 58 total carries with two touchdowns so far this season. He's got plenty of fantasy value sharing the backfield with Taylor as long as the injury doesn't force him to miss time.

news.body: Seth McGowan ran for 77 yards and a touchdown on 12 carries in the Colts' 24-22 win over the Dolphins on Sunday.
news.head: Seth McGowan punches in score in win over Dolphins
news.impact: McGowan wasn't involved in the passing game, but when you can run for 6.4 yards a pop and find the end zone, that makes up for a lot. He is becoming more involved in the offense in recent weeks and could be finding his way into flex territory. Granted, touchdowns have greatly helped his fantasy production, without them he would be much less appealing.

news.body: Sione Vaki rushed six times for 19 yards while also catching two of his three targets for a loss of four yards in the Lions' 39-35 loss to the Bears in Week 12.
news.head: Sione Vaki sees eight touches in Week 12
news.impact: Vaki has made minimal impact out of the backfield of late, finishing with under 50 offensive yards in each of his last four contests. The running back's value remains tied to the health of explosive RB1 Jahmyr Gibbs entering a Week 13 contest against the Atlanta Falcons.

news.body: Sione Vaki rushed once for a loss of one yard while also catching his only target for seven yards in the Lions' 31-21 win over the Buccaneers in Week 11.
news.head: Sione Vaki quiet in Week 11
news.impact: Vaki has made minimal impact out of the Detroit backfield to this point, rushing for less than 30 yards in nine of 10 games. The running back's value remains tied to the health of explosive RB1 Jahmyr Gibbs, with a Week 12 contest against the Chicago Bears up next.

news.body: Sione Vaki (ankle) is active for Week 11 for the Detroit Lions against the Tampa Bay Buccaneers.
news.head: Sione Vaki (ankle) active for Week 11
news.impact: Vaki is good to go after passing through pregame testing on the ankle without any issues, providing head coach Dan Campbell with a complementary option behind RB1 Jahmyr Gibbs out of the Detroit backfield against the Buccaneers Sunday.

news.body: Sione Vaki (ankle) was listed as a limited participant at practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Sione Vaki (ankle) listed as limited Wednesday
news.impact: Vaki is a little banged up right now and was limited at Wednesday's practice due to an ankle issue. It doesn't seem to be more than a minor issue, however, so for now he's trending towards playing and seeing his usual limited workload against the Buccaneers this week.

news.body: Tony Pollard ran for 110 yards on 21 carries in the Titans 51-30 loss against the Cowboys.
news.head: Tony Pollard runs for 110 yards Sunday
news.impact: Pollard did not catch his lone target through the air. It was his third game with at least 100 yards in four games. He'll remain a steady RB2.

news.body: Tony Pollard is off the injury report for Sunday's game against the Cowboys.
news.head: Tony Pollard off injury report Sunday
news.impact: Pollard got a rest day from practice on Thursday. He will remain an RB2 play for fantasy managers.

news.body: Tony Pollard (rest) didn't take part in Tennessee's practice on Thursday.
news.head: Tony Pollard (rest) doesn't practice Thursday
news.impact: Pollard was given the day off on Thursday as a veteran rest day. He should be back at practice on Friday and is expected to be a full go for Week 11.

news.body: Tony Pollard ran 9 times for 33 yards and caught 8 of 9 targets for 66 yards and a touchdown in the Titans' 40-23 loss to the Jaguars on Sunday.
news.head: Tony Pollard explodes for 66 receiving yards in loss
news.impact: Pollard ended Sunday's game one yard shy of 100 yards on the day. His 66 receiving yards were the second-most on the team, and his eight catches led the team. Tyjae Spears had more efficiency on his four rushing attempts, but played clear second fiddle to Pollard. Keep Pollard in lineups as a volume RB3 with RB2 upside, especially if the Titans keep up their newfound energy.

news.body: Travis Etienne Jr. carried the ball 14 times for 76 yards while also failing to catch his lone target in the Saints' 21-13 Week 11 loss to the Bears.
news.head: Travis Etienne Jr. leads backfield in Week 11 loss to Bears
news.impact: Etienne Jr. has offered mixed results out of the backfield since returning from injury, rushing for over 70 yards for the first time in two contests. The running back remains one of many risky options in the New Orleans offense ahead of a Week 12 matchup against the Cincinnati Bengals.

news.body: Travis Etienne Jr. rushed for 14 yards on eight carries in a 20-17 loss to the Panthers. He caught 3-of-5 targets for 20 yards.
news.head: Travis Etienne Jr. quiet in Week 10
news.impact: Etienne returned to action for the first time since suffering a hamstring injury in Week 3. His return was expected to be a boost for the Saints' running game, but the Panthers' defense was able to keep it in check. Etienne and the Saints will take on the Bears in Week 11.

news.body: Saints RB Travis Etienne Jr. (hamstring) is officially active for a Week 10 matchup with the Panthers.
news.head: Travis Etienne Jr. (hamstring) officially active for Week 10
news.impact: Etienne was activated from injured reserve and is expected to lead the Saints' backfield. Alvin Kamara will likely see the bulk of his playing time on passing downs against the Panthers.

news.body: The Saints plan to activate RB Travis Etienne Jr. from injured reserve on Saturday.
news.head: Travis Etienne Jr. (hamstring) to be activated from IR
news.impact: Etienne is in line to make his return for Sunday's game against the Panthers. He should return to his lead role in the Saints backfield.

news.body: The Patriots placed RB TreVeyon Henderson on injured reserve.
news.head: TreVeyon Henderson (illness) placed on IR
news.impact: Henderson had already been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Lions. He will miss at least four more games. Rhamondre Stevenson and Corey Kiner will lead the Patriots backfield.

news.body: TreVeyon Henderson has been ruled out for Week 10 against the Lions.
news.head: TreVeyon Henderson (illness) ruled out for Week 10
news.impact: Henderson will remain sidelined due to an illness. He holds no clear timetable to return.

news.body: TreVeyon Henderson (illness) has been ruled out for Sunday’s contest between the New England Patriots and Green Bay Packers according to Evan Lazar.
news.head: TreVeyon Henderson (illness) ruled out for Week 9
news.impact: Henderson will not suit while continuing to battle ongoing illness issues for head coach Mike Vrabel, with Rhamondre Stevenson once again expected to receive a sizeable workload out of the New England backfield against the Packers Sunday.

news.body: TreVeyon Henderson remained absent from practice on Thursday.
news.head: TreVeyon Henderson (illness) misses practice Thursday
news.impact: Henderson is continuing to trend towards missing another game for the Patriots. He will need to be monitored in practice on Friday to end the week.

news.body: Ty Johnson ran for two yards on one carry in the Bills 26-9 win over the Dolphins. He also caught 7-of-8 targets for 55 yards receiving.
news.head: Ty Johnson catches seven passes Sunday
news.impact: Johnson was a safety blanket in the passing game out of the backfield for Josh Allen all afternoon. He still remains off the fantasy radar.

news.body: Ty Johnson caught his lone target for four yards in a 31-12 win over the Jets.
news.head: Ty Johnson hauls in one pass in Week 10 win
news.impact: Johnson did not see any work in the running game and was a non-factor in the passing game. Fantasy managers can continue to leave Johnson off their roster.

news.body: Ty Johnson rushed one time for just one yard but gained 36 yards on two receptions in Monday's 23-6 win over the Vikings.
news.head: Ty Johnson goes for 37 yards on three touches in Week 9
news.impact: It's well known that Johnson makes the vast majority of his contributions to the Bills as a receiver out of the backfield. That was the case again Monday night. He didn't do much on two of his touches, but he took one of his receptions 36 yards top give him the game's longest gain. Johnson doesn't carry much fantasy appeal outside the deepest of PPR leagues.

news.body: Ty Johnson rushed for four yards on four carries in a 36-10 win over the Ravens. He caught 3-of-3 targets for 19 yards.
news.head: Ty Johnson sees eight touches in Week 8
news.impact: Johnson continues to serve as a change-of-pace back to James Cook in the Bills' offense. His fantasy value remains limited heading into a tough matchup with the Vikings in Week 9.

news.body: Tyler Allgeier rushed for 23 yards on seven carries in a 34-7 loss to the Chiefs.
news.head: Tyler Allgeier quiet in Week 11 loss
news.impact: Allgeier did not factor into the passing attack and was outgained on the ground by Bam Knight on the same number of rushing attempts. This marked the first time that Allgeier did not register a target in a game this season. The 26-year-old will look to bounce back against the Commanders in Week 12.

news.body: Tyler Allgeier ran for 14 yards on five carries in the Cardinals 34-6 loss against the Rams.
news.head: Tyler Allgeier quiet Sunday
news.impact: The Cardinals backfield returned to a committee with Bam Knight healthy. They'll both be tougher to trust in lineups splitting snaps on what is currently a bad offense.

news.body: Tyler Allgeier ran for 46 yards on 17 carries in the Cardinals 17-3 loss against the Seahawks. He also caught 2-of-3 targets for zero yards receiving.
news.head: Tyler Allgeier sees 17 carries Sunday
news.impact: With Jeremiyah Love on IR and Bam Knight in concussion protocol, Allgeier took over the workhorse role in the Cardinals backfield. He was the only running back to see a carry for Arizona. From a volume standpoint, he'll be an RB2 play next week against the Rams if Knight remains sidelined.

news.body: Tyler Allgeier carried the ball 11 times for 147 yards and one touchdown while also hauling in all five of his targets for 44 yards and one touchdown in the Cardinals' 33-30 Week 8 win over the Cowboys.
news.head: Tyler Allgeier dynamic in Week 8 win over Cowboys
news.impact: Allgeier took advantage of an Arizona backfield attack that lost Jeremiyah Love and Bam Knight, rushing for over 50 yards for the first time in his last seven contests. The running back could be in line for a sizeable workload if both Love and Knight remain sidelined for a Week 9 contest against the Seattle Seahawks.

news.body: The New York Giants have placed running back Tyrone Tracy Jr. on injured reserve after suffering a hamstring injury in Week 7's win.
news.head: Tyrone Tracy Jr. (hamstring) placed on IR
news.impact: Tracy suffered an injury during the Giants' win over the Houston Texans, a game in which he carried the ball six times for 15 yards and a score. The third-year running back had seen an uptick in snaps after playing 3% or fewer in the opening three weeks, scoring three touchdowns in the last two weeks. Cam Skattebo and Devin Singletary will lead the way for a New York running back room that bounced back in Week 7. Tracy is eligible to return in Week 13, given New York's Week 8 bye.

news.body: Giants RB Tyrone Tracy Jr. is questionable to return against Houston due to a hamstring injury.
news.head: Tyrone Tracy Jr. (hamstring) questionable to return
news.impact: Tracy walked off the field gingerly after his last rush and now is officially questionable to return. Cam Skattebo will see an uptick in carries if Tracy cannot return, with Devin Singletary serving as the backup.

news.body: Tyrone Tracy Jr. ran for 18 yards and a touchdown in the Giants 34-27 loss against the Saints. He also caught 2-of-3 targsts for 27 yards receiving and another touchdown.
news.head: Tyrone Tracy Jr. finds the end zone twice Sunday
news.impact: It was an ugly afternoon for the entire Giants backfield. Tracy will be a risky flex play at best next week against the Texans.

news.body: Tyrone Tracy Jr. rushed three times for six yards while also catching two of his three targets for 25 yards in the Giants' 27-27 tie with the Washington Commanders in Week 5.
news.head: Tyrone Tracy Jr. sees five touches in Week 5
news.impact: Tracy Jr. has underwhelmed out of the New York backfield to this point, rushing for less than 15 yards in each of the first five contests. The running back remains best left off rosters in all formats ahead of a Week 6 contest against the New Orleans Saints.

news.body: Will Shipley rushed 10 times for 46 yards while also failing to catch his only target in the Eagles' 39-38 Week 12 win over the Cowboys.
news.head: Will Shipley leads underwhelming backfield attack in Week 12 win
news.impact: Shipley has struggled to find running room out of the backfield, rushing for under 50 yards in each of his seven games. The running back could be in line for increased snaps with Saquon Barkley (stinger) exiting early Thursday, but remains difficult to trust ahead of a Week 13 contest against the Arizona Cardinals.

news.body: Will Shipley is off the injury report for Thursday’s game against the Cowboys.
news.head: Will Shipley (foot/illness) off injury report for Thursday
news.impact: Shipley was limited in practice on Wednesday. He'll remain in his backup role behind Saquon Barkley.

news.body: Will Shipley was limited in practice on Tuesday.
news.head: Will Shipley (foot/illness) limited in practice Tuesday
news.impact: Shipley remains a pure stash when he is healthy.

news.body: Will Shipley was listed as a limited participant on Monday's estimated practice report.
news.head: Will Shipley (foot/illness) limited in estimated practice Monday
news.impact: Shipley saw four carries in his return to action on Sunday. He remains off the fantasy radar in his current role.

news.body: Woody Marks has cleared concussion protocol and will play on Sunday against the Ravens.
news.head: Woody Marks clears concussion protocol, will play Sunday
news.impact: Marks will return on Sunday. It'll likely continue to be a committee between him and David Montgomery.

news.body: Woody Marks returned to practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Woody Marks (concussion) practicing Wednesday
news.impact: Marks remains in concussion protocol. He will need to be monitored in practice the rest of the week.

news.body: Woody Marks has been ruled out for Thursday’s game against the Colts.
news.head: Woody Marks (concussion) ruled out for Week 11
news.impact: Marks left this past week's game with a concussion. He will be sidelined on a short week for the Texans.

news.body: Woody Marks exited Sunday's game early with a concussion and did not return.
news.head: Woody Marks gains 65 yards, leaves with concussion Sunday
news.impact: Marks gained 50 yards on 12 carries and caught one pass for 15 yards before leaving what ended up being a 27-24 loss to the Browns. With a quick turnaround coming for a matchup against the Colts on Thursday, Marks' chances to play in Week 11 seem very slim. Emari Demercado could see plenty of work if Marks sits.

news.body: Zach Charbonnet ran for 94 yards on 20 carries in the Seahawks 21-13 win over the Raiders.
news.head: Zach Charbonnet runs for 94 yards Sunday
news.impact: Despite it just being a few games for Charbonnet since returning from his torn ACL, he continues to impress on the ground. He remains a solid RB2 for fantasy managers.

news.body: Zach Charbonnet ran for 77 yards on 16 carries in the Seahawks 17-3 win over the Cardinals. He also caught 1-of-2 targets for nine yards receiving.
news.head: Zach Charbonnet runs for 77 yards Sunday
news.impact: Charbonnet looked much better in his second game back from injury. He has also had another impressive run called back due to a penalty. He should remain on the flex radar moving forward.

news.body: Zach Charbonnet rushed the ball six times for 23 yards and caught three passes for six yards in Monday night's 34-17 loss to the Chicago Bears.
news.head: Zach Charbonnet quiet in return game Monday
news.impact: Charbonnet made his season debut for the Seahawks on Monday night after missing an extended period of time recovering from a significant knee injury. He didn't make headlines in his first game back, however, racking up just 29 total yards on his nine touches over the course of the night. He will likely continue to get more involved as he continues to ramp back up to a full workload over the next couple of weeks.

news.body: Zach Charbonnet is off the injury report for Monday's game against the Bears.
news.head: Zach Charbonnet (knee) off injury report Monday
news.impact: Charbonnet will be ready to make his season debut. He'll be a touchdown dependent flex play in his first game back for fantasy managers.

news.body: AJ Barner caught 3-of-3 targets for 19 yards in the Seahawks 21-13 win over the Raiders.
news.head: AJ Barner hauls in three passes Sunday
news.impact: Barner remains a touchdown dependent TE2 for fantasy managers.

news.body: AJ Barner caught 2-of-4 targets for seven yards and a touchdown in the Seahawks 17-3 win over the Cardinals. He also added a rushing touchdown.
news.head: AJ Barner totals two touchdowns Sunday
news.impact: Barner got the Seahawks on the board with a "BarnYard" at the goal line. He later had a controversial touchdown catch where it appeared the ball may have hit the ground, but the refs had the call on the field stand. He remains a touchdown dependent TE2 for fantasy managers.

news.body: AJ Barner caught 2-of-5 targets for 23 yards in Monday night's 34-17 loss to the Chicago Bears.
news.head: AJ Barner catches two passes Monday
news.impact: Barner was targeted five times on Monday night, but he was only able to turn that into two catches for 23 yards. He remains off of the fantasy radar for the foreseeable future.

news.body: AJ Barner caught four of his five targets for 42 yards in a 20-3 win over the Chiefs in Week 7.
news.head: AJ Barner goes for 42 yards in Week 7
news.impact: Barner finished second on the Seahawks in targets, catches, and receiving in the impressive win against the previously undefeated Chiefs. The veteran tight end has 19 catches for 180 yards and zero touchdowns through seven games this year. He will be a TE2 in fantasy in Week 8 vs. the Bears.

news.body: Brenton Strange caught all three of his targets for 16 yards in the Jaguars' 23-18 loss to the Giants on Sunday.
news.head: Brenton Strange snags three passes in loss
news.impact: Strange was quiet yet again for the third straight week, and he didn't have a touchdown to soften the blow like last week. It's a tough stretch for those starting him, but tight end is thin right now, and you might not have a better option. He's at least attached to a good offense and should have good games from time to time.

news.body: Brenton Strange caught two of three targets for nine yards and a score in the Jaguars' 40-23 win over the Titans on Sunday.
news.head: Brenton Strange snags touchdown in win
news.impact: Strange's fantasy day was saved by the touchdown. He went through a nice four-week stretch earlier this season, but in his last two weeks, he has just 31 yards and a score. It's a rough patch for the Jags TE1, but with the offense humming as it is, his weeks will come once again.

news.body: Brenton Strange caught both of his targets for 22 yards in the Jaguars' 33-10 win over the Ravens.
news.head: Brenton Strange goes for 22 yards in win
news.impact: It was a bit of a letdown after Strange had been successful in the last few weeks as a streaming tight end play. Nate Boerkircher has started to get more involved in recent weeks, and that could be limiting Strange's upside.

news.body: Brenton Strange caught both of his targets for 55 yards in Sunday's 42-7 win over the Colts.
news.head: Brenton Strange goes for 55 receiving yards on Sunday
news.impact: Strange had the longest gain of his career Sunday, as he went 46 yards on QB Trevor Lawrence's first pass of the game. Lawrence only completed 10 passes in this contest, so Strange and the rest of the Jaguars route runners didn't deliver huge production for fantasy managers. In fact, Strange was one of three Jaguars to tie for the team lead in receptions. He also tied running back Bhayshul Tuten for the team lead in receiving yards. Strange is having a solid season, but the Jaguars run a largely balanced attack, with Lawrence spreading the ball around to a variety of targets.

news.body: Brevyn Spann-Ford caught his lone target for 15 yards in the Cowboys' 39-38 loss to the Eagles in Week 12.
news.head: Brevyn Spann-Ford sees one target in Week 12
news.impact: Spann-Ford has made minimal impact in the Dallas passing attack, finishing with under 40 receiving yards in all four contests. The tight end can remain off rosters in all formats ahead of a Week 13 contest against the Seattle Seahawks.

news.body: Brevyn Spann-Ford caught 2-of-2 targets for five yards and a touchdown in the Cowboys 51-30 win over the Titans.
news.head: Brevyn Spann-Ford catches touchdown Sunday
news.impact: Spann-Ford saw some more opportunity with Jake Ferguson sidelined. He remains off the fantasy radar.

news.body: Brevyn Spann-Ford hauled in one of his three targets for 26 yards in the Cowboys’ 46-40 loss to the 49ers in Week 10.
news.head: Brevyn Spann-Ford quiet in Week 10
news.impact: Spann-Ford has made minimal impact in the Dallas passing attack to this point, finishing with 35 receiving yards or less in all 10 games. The tight end remains difficult to trust in any format ahead of a Week 11 contest against the Tennessee Titans.

news.body: Brevyn Spann-Ford caught two of his three passes for 20 yards in a 27-23 win over the Colts in Week 9.
news.head: Brevyn Spann-Ford catches two passes in Week 9
news.impact: Spann-Ford was quiet despite Jake Ferguson leaving with a knee injury during the win. The veteran tight end now has 15 catches for 130 yards through nine games. He would presumably be in line for a larger role in Week 10 vs. the 49ers if Ferguson can't suit up.

news.body: Brock Bowers has been listed as questionable for Sunday’s game against the Browns.
news.head: Brock Bowers (ankle) listed questionable for Week 12
news.impact: Bowers did not practice on Friday after he was able to practice on Wednesday and Thursday. His status will need to be monitored closer to kickoff on Sunday.

news.body: Brock Bowers (ankle) was not seen practicing for the Las Vegas Raiders Friday according to Ryan McFadden.
news.head: Brock Bowers (ankle) not practicing Friday
news.impact: Bowers was unable to reach the practice field after limited sessions Wednesday and Thursday, putting the dynamic tight end’s availability in question. Michael Mayer would be in line for TE1 snaps if Bowers is unable to suit up against the Browns Sunday night.

news.body: Brock Bowers was limited in practice on Thursday.
news.head: Brock Bowers (ankle) limited in practice Thursday
news.impact: Bowers has posted back-to-back limited practices. He is on track to return for Sunday's game against the Browns.

news.body: Brock Bowers practiced on Wednesday.
news.head: Brock Bowers (ankle/quad) practices Wednesday
news.impact: Raiders head coach Klint Kubiak said he was optimistic that Bowers will play on Sunday night against the Browns.

news.body: Cade Otton was a full participant in practice on Thursday.
news.head: Cade Otton (thumb) logs full practice Thursday
news.impact: Otton remains a TE2 for fantasy managers.

news.body: Cade Otton caught one of his three targets for eight yards in the Buccaneers' 31-21 loss to the Lions in Week 11.
news.head: Cade Otton catches one pass in Week 11
news.impact: Otton has underwhelmed in the Tampa Bay offense of late, finishing under 30 receiving yards in each of his last six games. The tight end will look to get back on track against the Carolina Panthers in Week 12.

news.body: Cade Otton caught four of his eight targets for 25 yards in a 27-24 loss to the Bears in Week 9.
news.head: Cade Otton draws eight targets in Week 9
news.impact: Otton led the Bucs in targets, although he failed to do much with the opportunities. The veteran tight end has now caught 23 passes for 211 scoreless yards through nine games. A low-end TE2 for fantasy purposes, Otton will be on bye in Week 10 before taking on the Lions in Week 11.

news.body: Cade Otton was not targeted in the Buccaneers 16-0 win over the Falcons.
news.head: Cade Otton does not see target Sunday
news.impact: Baker Mayfield attempted only three passes on Sunday and he did not complete any of them. Otton will be a TE2 play next week against the Bears.

news.body: Chig Okonkwo caught four of his five targets for 66 yards in a 22-20 win over the Bengals in Week 11.
news.head: Chig Okonkwo goes for 66 yards in Week 11
news.impact: Okonkwo finished second on the Commanders in receiving in the win on Monday night. He did most of his damage on a 32-yard catch-and-run in the second quarter, which helped set up a one-yard touchdown run for Jacory Croskey-Merritt. Okonkwo has caught 31 passes for 329 yards through eight games for the Commanders this season. He will be a TE2 in Week 12 vs. the Cardinals.

news.body: Chig Okonkwo caught four of his eight targets for 24 yards in a 24-21 win over the Giants in Week 10's Thursday night game.
news.head: Chig Okonkwo catches four passes in TNF win
news.impact: Okonkwo finished second on the team in targets despite missing some time during the game with a back issue. He was able to return to the game after getting the injury checked out, but fellow tight end Ben Sinnott caught a touchdown pass during his absence. Okonkwo now has 27 catches for 263 yards through seven contests. He will look for his first TD of the season in Week 11 vs. the Cincinnati Bengals.

news.body: Chig Okonkwo had seven receptions for 57 yards in Sunday's loss to the Rams.
news.head: Chig Okonkwo goes 7/57 in loss
news.impact: Chig led his team in receptions and put together a respectable performance for the struggling Commanders. Okonkwo will be in the high-end TE2 range for TNF against the Giants.

news.body: Chig Okonkwo caught two of his four targets for 32 yards and lost a fumble in a 27-10 win over the Eagles in Week 8.
news.head: Chig Okonkwo catches two balls in Week 8
news.impact: Okonkwo was quiet despite the Commanders playing their first game without Terry McLaurin. The veteran tight end will look to bounce back in Week 9 vs. the Rams. He can be treated as a TE2 in fantasy for that matchup.

news.body: Colby Parkinson caught both of his targets for a loss of one yard in the Rams' 26-13 win over the Packers in Week 12.
news.head: Colby Parkinson quiet in Week 12
news.impact: Parkinson has underwhelmed in the Los Angeles offense of late, finishing with under 40 receiving yards in eight of nine contests. The tight end could be in line for increased snaps heading into a Week 13 contest against the Kansas City Chiefs after both Tyler Higbee and Davis Allen suffered injuries in the Week 12 win.

news.body: Colby Parkinson is off the injury report for Wednesday’s game against the Packers.
news.head: Colby Parkinson (ribs) off injury report Wednesday
news.impact: Parkinson remains a touchdown dependent TE2 play for fantasy managers.

news.body: Colby Parkinson caught 2-of-2 targets for 11 yards in the Rams 34-6 win over the Cardinals.
news.head: Colby Parkinson catches two passes Sunday
news.impact: Parkinson remains a touchdown dependent TE2 for fantasy managers.

news.body: Colby Parkinson (ribs) is off of the injury report for Sunday's game against the Arizona Cardinals.
news.head: Colby Parkinson (ribs) off injury report for Sunday
news.impact: Parkinson was limited at practice earlier in the week due to an injury to his ribs, but he was able to log a full practice session on Friday and is now off of the injury report heading into the weekend. He should be a full go against the Cardinals.

news.body: The initial diagnosis for Colston Loveland is a knee sprain that is expected to land him on injured reserve.
news.head: Colston Loveland suffers knee sprain, to be placed on IR
news.impact: Loveland will have a chance to return after missing four games. He is unlikely to make an immediate for fantasy managers again this season, but he'll have a chance to be back for the NFL playoffs for Chicago.

news.body: Colston Loveland (knee) will undergo an MRI on Friday.
news.head: Colston Loveland (knee) to have MRI
news.impact: Loveland left Thursday's game against the Lions early with a knee injury. The second-year TE will have further testing on Friday to determine the severity of the injury. It seems fairly certain that Loveland will miss at least some time. Rookie Sam Roush took over as the Bears' top tight end after Loveland exited.

news.body: Colston Loveland (knee) has been ruled out for the remainder of the game for the Chicago Bears.
news.head: Colston Loveland (knee) ruled out
news.impact: Loveland was carted to the locker room with the knee injury and will not continue, catching his only target for five yards prior to exiting.

news.body: Colston Loveland has been carted to the locker room by the Chicago Bears according to Adam Schefter.
news.head: Colston Loveland carted to locker room

news.body: Dallas Goedert has been ruled out for the remainder of Thursday’s game against the Cowboys.
news.head: Dallas Goedert (shoulder) ruled out for rest of game Thursday
news.impact: Goedert suffered a shoulder injury on the first drive of the game. He was later ruled out for the day in the second quarter.

news.body: Dallas Goedert (shin) is off of the injury report for Week 12 for the Philadelphia Eagles.
news.head: Dallas Goedert (shin) cleared for Week 12
news.impact: Goedert will suit up after practicing throughout the week for head coach Nick Sirianni, offering quarterback Joe Milton another stable pass-catching option against a disappointing Dallas Cowboys defense Thanksgiving Day.

news.body: Dallas Goedert was a full participant in practice on Tuesday.
news.head: Dallas Goedert (shin) logs full practice Tuesday
news.impact: Goedert will be a low-end TE1 play for fantasy managers in a favorable matchup against the Cowboys on Thursday.

news.body: Dallas Goedert was listed as a limited participant on Monday's estimated practice report.
news.head: Dallas Goedert (shin) limited in estimated practice Monday
news.impact: Goedert caught just one pass in Sunday's win over the Steelers. His upside appears to be a little more limited with Joe Milton behind center.

news.body: Dalton Kincaid (thumb/ankle) is active for Week 12 for the Buffalo Bills against the Kansas City Chiefs according to Adam Schefter.
news.head: Dalton Kincaid (thumb/ankle) active for Week 12
news.impact: Kincaid will take the field after logging limited practice activity on a short week, offering quarterback Josh Allen another impactful pass-catching option against the Chiefs Thanksgiving night.

news.body: Dalton Kincaid was limited in practice on Tuesday.
news.head: Dalton Kincaid (thumb/ankle) limited in practice Tuesday
news.impact: Kincaid told reporters he expects to return on Thursday against the Chiefs after he was sidelined last week.

news.body: Bills TE Dalton Kincaid (thumb/ankle) is officially inactive for a Week 11 matchup with Miami.
news.head: Dalton Kincaid (thumb/ankle) officially inactive for Week 11
news.impact: Kincaid was considered doubtful to play after being unable to practice all week. Dawson Knox will likely serve as the primary tight end for Josh Allen and the Bills.

news.body: Dalton Kincaid is listed as doubtful for Sunday's game against the Dolphins.
news.head: Dalton Kincaid (thumb/ankle) listed doubtful Sunday
news.impact: Kincaid was unable to practice all week. He will likely be ruled out closer to Sunday.

news.body: Dalton Schultz caught his only target for 11 yards in Thursday's 26-3 win over the Colts.
news.head: Dalton Schultz comes up with just one catch in Week 11 win
news.impact: For the second straight game, Schultz finished with one reception for 11 yards. His one catch ended up in the end zone last week, however. That was not the case Thursday night, as the veteran TE did very little for fantasy managers who rolled him out there. Schultz has a combined total of four grabs over the last three games, so he is difficult to trust for fantasy purposes right now.

news.body: Dalton Schultz caught 1-of-2 targets for an 11-yard touchdown in Sunday's 27-24 loss to the Browns.
news.head: Dalton Schultz hauls in TD in Week 10 loss
news.impact: Schultz failed to catch multiple passes for the first time this season in Sunday's loss. He did, however, make his one reception count, scoring for the first time this season. The veteran TE is averaging four grabs and just over 40 yards per game to this point on the season.

news.body: Dalton Schultz caught 2-of-4 targets for 42 yards in Sunday's 44-22 win over the Los Angeles Chargers.
news.head: Dalton Schultz catches two passes Sunday
news.impact: Schultz didn't see a lot of involvement on Sunday, finishing with just two catches in a win over the Chargers. Fantasy managers shouldn't expect him to be super reliable on a week-to-week basis moving forward, though hew will continue to have value as a streaming option.

news.body: Dalton Schultz caught 5-of-6 targets for 45 yards in the Texans 27-21 loss against the Giants.
news.head: Dalton Schultz hauls in five passes Sunday
news.impact: Schultz was the safety blanket for C.J. Stroud on the day. He remains a borderline low-end TE1/high-end TE2 for fantasy managers.

news.body: Darnell Washington caught all three of his targets for 22 yards in Sunday’s loss to the Eagles.
news.head: Darnell Washington goes 3/22 in loss
news.impact: Washington’s yardage total throughout the season has been inconsistent, although this is the fifth game with at least three receptions. Washington won’t be fantasy-relevant in Week 12’s game against the Broncos.

news.body: Darnell Washington caught 1-of-3 targets for five yards in Sunday's 38-18 loss to the Cincinnati Bengals.
news.head: Darnell Washington uninvolved in loss Sunday
news.impact: Washington didn't contribute much on Sunday. He caught just one pass for five yards over the course of the game, which left him with a poor fantasy total. He has week-to-week upside but won't be consistent moving forward.

news.body: Darnell Washington caught 3-of-5 targets for 94 yards in the Steelers 27-6 win over the Steelers.
news.head: Darnell Washington turns in big gain Sunday
news.impact: Washington found himself wide open for a catch and run of 58 yards. He has his flashes, but he still remains off the fantasy radar.

news.body: Darnell Washington caught his only target for a four-yard touchdown in the Steelers' 16-10 win over the Saints.
news.head: Darnell Washington brings in touchdown in win
news.impact: Washington now has a touchdown grab in three of the last four games. He's going to continue to be a reliable option down near the goal line, but don't expect a lot of volume most weeks. He's a touchdown-or-bust option.

news.body: Darren Waller was limited in practice on Friday.
news.head: Darren Waller (knee) limited in practice Friday
news.impact: Waller has logged back-to-back limited practices. He will remain a TE2 play for fantasy managers if he is cleared.

news.body: Darren Waller was limited in practice on Thursday.
news.head: Darren Waller (knee) limited in practice Thursday
news.impact: Waller got in a limited session. He remains on the TE2 radar when healthy.

news.body: Darren Waller caught all three of his targets for 42 yards in a 35-33 win over the Ravens.
news.head: Darren Waller hauls in three passes in Week 11
news.impact: Waller, Tommy Tremble, and Mitchell Evans all got into the action in an impressive offensive performance by the Panthers. Waller and the Panthers will take on the Buccaneers in Week 12.

news.body: Panthers TE Darren Waller (knee) is officially active for a Week 11 matchup with the Ravens.
news.head: Darren Waller (knee) officially active for Week 11
news.impact: Waller was listed as questionable after being limited in practice to close out the week. The Panthers will also have Tommy Tremble active for Bryce Young.

news.body: Dawson Knox caught 2-of-3 targets for 31 yards in the Bills 26-9 win over the Dolphins.
news.head: Dawson Knox catches two passes Sunday
news.impact: Knox was expected to play a bigger role with Dalton Kincaid sidelined, but that did end up being the case. He remains off the fantasy radar.

news.body: Dawson Knox secured 4-of-5 targets for 37 yards in Monday's 23-6 win over the Vikings.
news.head: Dawson Knox hauls in four passes Monday night
news.impact: Knox put up season highs in receptions and yards in Week 9. This has not been a very productive season for the veteran tight end, at least from a fantasy perspective. Knox is still a mainstay on the field for the Bills, but his value to the team is much higher than his fantasy upside.

news.body: Dawson Knox caught one pass for zero yards in Sunday's 33-30 win over the Las Vegas Raiders.
news.head: Dawson Knox silent in win Sunday
news.impact: The veteran didn't do much on Sunday, recording zero yards on just one catch over the course of the game. He remains off of the fantasy radar entirely for the foreseeable future.

news.body: Dawson Knox caught one of his three targets for a six-yard gain in a 37-34 overtime win over the Rams in Week 5's Monday night game.
news.head: Dawson Knox hauls in one pass in Week 5
news.impact: Knox turned in another slow day as he has yet to go over two catches or 13 receiving yards in a game thus far. Overall, the veteran tight end has seven catches for 36 yards and a touchdown through five games. He will not be a strong fantasy option in Week 6 vs. the Raiders.

news.body: Eli Raridon caught his lone target for a six-yard gain in a 35-10 loss to the Lions in Munich in Week 10.
news.head: Eli Raridon held to one catch in Week 10
news.impact: Raridon was quiet with the Patriots losing Drake Maye to an ankle injury in the first quarter. That forced Tommy DeVito into action and led to a rough day for the New England offense. Raridon has put together a solid rookie season, but he can't be trusted in fantasy with DeVito under center instead of Maye.

news.body: Eli Raridon caught 3-of-6 targets for 52 yards in Sunday's 45-27 loss to the Green Bay Packers.
news.head: Eli Raridon racks up 52 yards Sunday
news.impact: The rookie was able to contribute well on Sunday, contributing 52 yards in the team's loss to the Packers. He finished with a better game than veteran Hunter Henry, and every week it seems like Raridon continues to establish himself as an increasingly important member of this offense. He should be a worthwhile streaming option over the back half of the season.

news.body: Eli Raridon caught one of four targets for five yards in the Patriots' 24-19 win over the Dolphins on Sunday.
news.head: Eli Raridon quiet in win over Dolphins
news.impact: Not counting throwaways, Raridon was the intended target on all of Drake Maye's incompletions on Sunday. Do with that what you will, but either way, it was not the best game for the rookie. He will have better days, and on the bright side, this means he has had 4+ targets in three of his last four games.

news.body: Eli Raridon secured 3-of-4 targets for 56 yards and a touchdown in Thursday's 30-24 loss to the Bears.
news.head: Eli Raridon hits paydirt in Week 7
news.impact: Raridon emerged during a five-catch performance back in Week 5. He almost disappeared in Week 6, but the rookie third-rounder stepped back up Thursday night. Raridon scored his second career TD on a 30-yard strike from QB Drake Maye in the third quarter of this one, and he's certainly a talented young player for fantasy managers to keep tabs on.

news.body: Evan Engram caught six of eight targets for 74 yards in the Broncos' 38-24 win over the Raiders in Week 11.
news.head: Evan Engram leads Denver in receiving in Week 11
news.impact: Engram led Denver in receptions, targets and receiving yards Sunday. The tight end had two receiving yards between Weeks 7 and 8 but has since caught 10 passes for 107 yards over his last two games. So, there are signs of life here. Engram is back in the streaming conversation heading into Week 12 against Pittsburgh.

news.body: Broncos TE Evan Engram has garnered trade interest, but he's considered unlikely to be moved.
news.head: Evan Engram draws trade interest, not expected to be moved
news.impact: Engram has caught 17 passes for 169 yards and a touchdown so far this season in Denver.

news.body: Evan Engram caught four of five targets for 33 yards in the Broncos' 26-21 win over the Panthers in Week 9.
news.head: Evan Engram records 33 receiving yards in Week 9
news.impact: Engram entered Sunday with two receiving yards over his previous two games combined. So, four catches for 33 yards represent an improvement. That said, Engram still hasn't established himself as a consistent part of Denver's passing attack. He remains difficult to start in fantasy leagues outside of deeper formats.

news.body: Evan Engram failed to catch any of his three targets in the Broncos' 28-24 win over the Chiefs in Week 8.
news.head: Evan Engram held without a catch in Week 8
news.impact: Engram had two receiving yards in Week 7. He followed that performance with zero catches Sunday. Nate Adkins, meanwhile, caught a touchdown. Engram simply isn't producing enough to enter fantasy lineups.

news.body: George Kittle caught all three of his targets for 34 yards and two touchdowns in Sunday night's 35-10 win over the Vikings.
news.head: George Kittle scores twice in Week 11
news.impact: After not finding the end zone for three straight weeks, Kittle got in twice during Sunday's rout of the Vikings. Kittle is up to seven TD grabs for the campaign, with two multi-score performances. He remains a top-tier TE in the 49ers' potent offense.

news.body: George Kittle hauled in six of his nine targets for 74 yards in the 49ers' 46-40 Week 10 win over the Cowboys.
news.head: George Kittle hauls in six passes in Week 10 win
news.impact: Kittle continues a solid stretch in the San Francisco offense, recording four or more receptions in each of his last eight games. The tight end remains one of the more reliable pass-catchers for head coach Kyle Shanahan ahead of a Week 11 matchup against an aggressive Minnesota Vikings defense.

news.body: George Kittle caught 4-of-7 targets for 58 yards in the 49ers 38-17 win over the Raiders.
news.head: George Kittle totals 58 yards Sunday
news.impact: Kittle led the Niners with seven targets. Brock Purdy attempted just 25 passes on the day. Kittle will remain a TE1 for fantasy managers.

news.body: George Kittle hauled in 8-of-10 targets for 88 yards in Sunday's 29-20 loss to the Falcons.
news.head: George Kittle leads 49ers in receiving Sunday
news.impact: With both Mike Evans and Deebo Samuel out, Kittle put up new season highs in receptions, targets, and receiving yards on Sunday. The veteran TE is averaging just under five grabs for more than 60 yards per game with five touchdowns through seven weeks. Kittle remains among the top fantasy assets at TE.

news.body: Greg Dulcich caught 2-of-7 targets for 12 yards in the Dolphins 26-9 loss against the Bills.
news.head: Greg Dulcich sees seven targets Sunday
news.impact: Dulcich saw the second most targets on the team on the day. He still remains off the fantasy radar.

news.body: Greg Dulcich failed to catch either of his targets in the Dolphins' 24-22 loss to the Colts on Sunday.
news.head: Greg Dulcich shut out in loss
news.impact: Dulcich has had some promising performances this year, but far too often he's putting up duds. He is best left on waivers.

news.body: Greg Dulcich caught two of his four targets for 14 yards in the Dolphins' 19-9 Week 9 loss to the Lions.
news.head: Greg Dulcich catches two passes in Week 9 loss
news.impact: Dulcich has seen increased involvement in the Miami passing attack of late, logging four or more targets in each of his last four contests. The tight end remains one of many risky pass-catching options in the Miami offense ahead of a Week 10 matchup against the Indianapolis Colts.

news.body: Greg Dulcich caught four of six targets for 43 yards in the Dolphins' 24-19 loss to the Patriots.
news.head: Greg Dulcich snags four passes in loss to Pats
news.impact: Funny enough, he had the exact same receiving line as Caleb Douglas, who also had four receptions on six targets for 43 yards. Not only that, but just to mention it for fun, the game's total was 43 points, and the average receiving yards of Miami's top four receivers in this game was 43. Do with that information what you choose, but either way, Dulcich has been on the rise recently, with 5+ targets and 37+ receiving yards in each of the last three games. Not only that, but next week he gets the Lions, who have been one of the best matchups for tight ends so far this year.

news.body: Gunnar Helm caught 2-of-3 targets for 14 yards in the Titans 51-30 loss against the Cowboys.
news.head: Gunnar Helm hauls in two passes Sunday
news.impact: Helm remains a touchdown dependent TE2 for fantasy managers.

news.body: Gunnar Helm caught all four of his targets for 23 yards in the Titans' 40-23 loss to the Jaguars on Sunday.
news.head: Gunnar Helm snags four passes in loss
news.impact: Helm had a bit of a down game after going for more than 70 yards last week, but this performance lines up with the 3 for 24 line he put up two weeks ago. Helm is just a little too inconsistent to be worth starting.

news.body: Gunnar Helm caught five of his nine targets for 76 yards in a 43-36 overtime loss to the Bengals in Week 8.
news.head: Gunnar Helm goes for 76 yards in Week 8 OT loss
news.impact: Helm led the Titans in targets and receiving yards with Carnell Tate sidelined by a shoulder injury. The veteran tight end has drawn 13 targets over his past two games as he is starting to carve out a larger role in the Tennessee passing game. He will be on bye in Week 9.

news.body: Gunnar Helm caught three of his four targets for 24 yards in a 27-24 loss to the Browns in Week 7.
news.head: Gunnar Helm finishes with three catches in Week 7
news.impact: Helm was quiet in the close loss. It was just the second time all season that he has topped 20 receiving yards in the Tennessee offense. Helm will not be a strong fantasy play heading into Week 8 vs. the Bengals.

news.body: Harold Fannin Jr. secured 7-of-9 targets for 91 yards in Sunday's 27-24 win over the Texans.
news.head: Harold Fannin Jr. leads the Browns in receiving Sunday
news.impact: Fannin has now gained more than 90 yards in three of the last four weeks. He was coming off just a two-catch performance going into Week 10, but that included a 39-yard TD. Simply put, the second-year TE has been one of the top fantasy assets at his position in this stretch. The Browns are off in Week 11, but Fannin will be a definite TE1 after that.

news.body: Harold Fannin Jr. is off the injury report for Sunday's game against the Texans.
news.head: Harold Fannin Jr. (groin) off injury report Sunday
news.impact: Fannin will remain a TE1 for fantasy managers.

news.body: Harold Fannin Jr. (groin) was limited at practice again on Thursday.
news.head: Harold Fannin Jr. (groin) limited again Thursday
news.impact: Fannin was limited for a second-straight practice on Thursday. He's still managing a groin issue, but it doesn't seem to be a major threat to his Week 10 availability. Fantasy managers shouldn't hesitate to start him if he's active this week.

news.body: Harold Fannin Jr. was limited in practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Harold Fannin Jr. (groin) limited in practice Wednesday
news.impact: Fannin is on track to be good to go in Week 10 for the Browns. He remains a TE1 play for fantasy managers.

news.body: Hunter Henry caught two of his three targets for 22 yards in a 35-10 loss to the Lions in Munich in Week 10.
news.head: Hunter Henry goes for 22 yards in Week 10
news.impact: Henry finished third on the Patriots in receiving on a rough day for the offense, especially after Drake Maye was knocked out of the game with an ankle injury in the first quarter. Henry gets a downgrade in fantasy with Maye likely looking at a multi-week absence. The Pats are on bye in Week 11 before a Week 12 matchup vs. the Chargers.

news.body: Hunter Henry is off the injury report for Sunday's game against the Lions.
news.head: Hunter Henry (foot) off injury report Sunday
news.impact: Henry was limited in practice all week. He will remain a borderline TE1 for fantasy managers.

news.body: Hunter Henry (foot) was limited at practice again on Thursday.
news.head: Hunter Henry (foot) limited again Thursday
news.impact: Henry was again limited on Thursday. He has been dealing with this foot issue for a little while now, but he was able to play through it last week and seems likely to do so again this week. He could be worth starting in Week 10, as this matchup against the Lions is expected to be a high-scoring affair.

news.body: Hunter Henry was limited in practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Hunter Henry (foot) limited in practice Wednesday
news.impact: Henry played through the injury last week. He should be on track to be good to go in Week 10.

news.body: Isaiah Likely is off the injury report for Sunday's game against the Colts.
news.head: Isaiah Likely (groin) off injury report for Week 12
news.impact: Likely will remain a TE1 play for fantasy managers.

news.body: Isaiah Likely was limited in practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Isaiah Likely (groin) limited in practice Wednesday
news.impact: Likely played through the injury last week after he had been a late addition to the injury report. He should still be good to go on Sunday.

news.body: Isaiah Likely caught one of three targets for 35 yards in the Giants' 23-18 win over the Jaguars on Sunday.
news.head: Isaiah Likely drops touchdown in win over Jags
news.impact: If nothing else, at least Likely's one catch was a big gain. However, he dropped a sure-fire touchdown from Jameis Winston, which would have greatly helped his fantasy day. He will look to bounce back against Indianapolis next week.

news.body: Isaiah Likely is off the injury report for Sunday's game against the Jaguars.
news.head: Isaiah Likely (groin) off injury report Sunday
news.impact: Likely was unable to practice on Friday. He'll still be good to go on Sunday where he remains a TE1 play for fantasy managers.

news.body: Jake Ferguson (ankle/knee) has been ruled out for Week 12 for the Dallas Cowboys against the Philadelphia Eagles according to Todd Archer.
news.head: Jake Ferguson (ankle/knee) ruled out for Week 12
news.impact: Ferguson will miss a second consecutive contest while battling a multitude of injuries, with Brevyn Spann-Ford and James Mitchell in line for increased snaps against the Eagles Thanksgiving Day.

news.body: Jake Ferguson did not practice on Tuesday.
news.head: Jake Ferguson (ankle/knee) misses practice Tuesday
news.impact: Ferguson is trending in the wrong direction ahead of Thursday’s game against the Eagles.

news.body: Jake Ferguson (knee/ankle) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Tennessee Titans.
news.head: Jake Ferguson (knee/ankle) ruled out for Sunday
news.impact: To no surprise, Ferguson will be sidelined for a second-straight game after suffering a couple of different injuries in a recent game. It remains to be seen if he will be back in the lineup in Week 12 or not.

news.body: Jake Ferguson (knee/ankle) did not take part in Dallas' practice on Thursday.
news.head: Jake Ferguson (knee/ankle) doesn't practice Thursday
news.impact: It looks like Ferguson is gearing up to miss another game, as he was a non-participant for a second-straight practice on Thursday. Assuming he's sidelined this week, Brevyn Spann-Ford will again see more snaps as a result of his absence, though that may not lead to fantasy relevance for him.

news.body: Kenyon Sadiq caught all three of his targets for 30 yards in a 27-24 win over the Chargers in Week 11.
news.head: Kenyon Sadiq finishes with three catches in Week 11
news.impact: Sadiq tied for second on the team in receiving in a game where the Jets went run-heavy. The rookie tight end has gone over 22 receiving yards just three times this season. Sadiq will be a low-end TE2 in Week 12 vs. the Dolphins.

news.body: Kenyon Sadiq caught 1-of-2 targets for three yards in a 31-12 loss to the Bills.
news.head: Kenyon Sadiq held to one reception in Week 10
news.impact: Sadiq was out targeted by Mason Taylor as the Jets continue to deploy both tight ends. With the inconsistent target share, fantasy managers can find a better option for Week 11.

news.body: Kenyon Sadiq caught 4-of-4 targets for 49 yards in a 35-12 loss to the Chiefs.
news.head: Kenyon Sadiq logs four receptions in Week 9
news.impact: Sadiq outpaced fellow tight end Mason Taylor in all receiving categories Sunday. Both continue to split time weekly and have limited each other's fantasy value.

news.body: Kenyon Sadiq caught 1-of-2 targets for 22 yards in a 38-33 loss to the Raiders.
news.head: Kenyon Sadiq hauls in one pass in Week 8 loss
news.impact: Sadiq and Mason Taylor continue to split time in the Jets' offense, impacting their weekly fantasy value. Sadiq and the Jets will take on the Chiefs in Week 9.

news.body: Kyle Pitts Sr. caught four of his five targets for 50 yards in the Falcons' 35-13 Week 10 loss to the Chiefs.
news.head: Kyle Pitts Sr. catches four passes in Week 10 loss
news.impact: Pitts Sr. has struggled to make a consistent impact on offense to this point, finishing with less than 60 receiving yards in nine of 10 games. The tight end remains a risky pass-catching option in an inconsistent Atlanta offense for head coach Kevin Stefanski entering the team's Week 11 bye.

news.body: Kyle Pitts Sr. caught 3-of-5 targets for 23 yards in a 34-17 loss to the Bengals.
news.head: Kyle Pitts Sr. hauls in three passes in Week 9
news.impact: Pitts has seen a steady volume of targets, logging at least five in five straight games. Despite that, Pitts has not eclipsed more than 23 yards in any of his last three games. Pitts andn the Falcons will take on the Chiefs in Week 10.

news.body: Kyle Pitts Sr. caught 2-of-5 targets for six yards in the Falcons 16-0 loss against the Buccaneers.
news.head: Kyle Pitts Sr. quiet Sunday
news.impact: It was a week to forget for the entire Falcons offense. He will remain a TE2 play next week against the Bengals.

news.body: Kyle Pitts Sr. hauled in all five of his targets for 22 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 29-20 win over the 49ers.
news.head: Kyle Pitts Sr. hits paydirt again in Week 7 win
news.impact: For those who were patient with Pitts after a very slow start this season, the rewards have come over the last three weeks. The towering tight end has now scored four times during that span, catching exactly five passes each time out.

news.body: Mark Andrews caught 2-of-3 targets for 14 yards in a 35-33 loss to the Panthers.
news.head: Mark Andrews hauls in two passes in Week 11 loss
news.impact: Andrews saw his target total drop from eight in the loss Monday to just three Sunday. The veteran tight end will look to bounce back against Houston in Week 12.

news.body: Mark Andrews caught eight passes for 82 yards in Monday night's 23-20 loss to the Los Angeles Chargers.
news.head: Mark Andrews leads team in receiving Monday
news.impact: Andrews had a good game on Monday night. He led the team in receptions and receiving yards in this loss to the Chargers, although he wasn't able to get into the end zone at all to cap it off. We saw QB Jacoby Brissett hyper-target the TE position when he was in Arizona earlier in the year, so Andrews could be a worthwhile streaming option if that trend now continues in Baltimore, as it did on Monday.

news.body: Mark Andrews caught both of his targets for 19 yards in the Ravens' 33-10 loss to the Jaguars on Thursday.
news.head: Mark Andrews snags two passes in loss
news.impact: Andrews led the Ravens in receiving yards in the blowout loss, not that it meant much for fantasy. He's been tough to trust at any point this season and is safe to leave on the waiver wire. However, if you want to hold on and see what he might do with Jacoby Brissett at QB, there's merit to that.

news.body: Mark Andrews caught 3-of-4 targets for 14 yards in a 36-10 loss to the Bills.
news.head: Mark Andrews hauls in three passes in Week 8
news.impact: Andrews continues to see at least three targets a game this season. With the potential of rookie Joe Fagano starting in Week 9, Andrews may be in line for more work as a security option in the passing game against Jacksonville.

news.body: Mason Taylor caught both of his targets for 25 yards in a 27-24 win over the Chargers in Week 11.
news.head: Mason Taylor catches two balls in Week 11
news.impact: Taylor finished fourth on the Jets in receiving in the close win over the Chargers. He continues to split opportunities with Kenyon Sadiq for the Jets, posting 24 catches for 192 yards and two touchdowns in nine games this year. He will be on the TE3 radar in Week 12 vs. the Dolphins.

news.body: Mason Taylor caught all four of his targets for 20 yards in a 31-12 loss to the Bills.
news.head: Mason Taylor hauls in four passes in Week 10 loss
news.impact: Taylor saw more targets than fellow TE Kenyon Sadiq in the loss Sunday. Despite that, the target share for the young TE has been fairly inconsistent since returning in Week 5. Fantasy managers can likely find a better option heading into Week 11.

news.body: Mason Taylor caught 1-of-2 targets for 11 yards in a 35-12 loss to the Chiefs.
news.head: Mason Taylor hauls in one pass in Week 9 loss
news.impact: Taylor saw Kenyon Sadiq outpace him in targets, receiving yards, and receptions in the loss Sunday. Both Taylor and Sadiq continue to split time in the Jets' offense, capping both of their fantasy values.

news.body: Mason Taylor (back) is without an injury designation for Sunday's game against the Kansas City Chiefs.
news.head: Mason Taylor (back) without injury designation for Sunday
news.impact: Taylor was limited at practice earlier in the week due to a back injury, but he's now off of the injury report and good to go for Week 9. He isn't expected to be a consistent fantasy contributor for the foreseeable future, however.

news.body: Michael Mayer caught one of four targets for four yards before exiting the Raiders' 38-24 loss to the Broncos in Week 11 with an injury.
news.head: Michael Mayer exits Week 11 with injury
news.impact: Mayer had an opportunity to fill in for Brock Bowers, who was inactive Sunday with ankle and quadriceps injuries. The former, however, also exited the game, leaving Ian Thomas to pick up some of the slack. Thomas caught a 19-yard touchdown. Mayer's injury designation and availability for Week 12 against Cleveland will need to be monitored.

news.body: Michael Mayer caught 2-of-3 targets for 16 yards in the Raiders 21-13 loss against the Seahawks.
news.head: Michael Mayer catches two passes Sunday
news.impact: Mayer could be a streaming option moving forward if Brock Bowers (ankle) is set to miss time.

news.body: Michael Mayer caught 3-of-3 targets for 37 yards in the Raiders 38-17 loss against the 49ers.
news.head: Michael Mayer hauls in three passes Sunday
news.impact: Mayer nearly found the end zone, but he lost a fumble at the goal line. He remains a TE2 for fantasy managers.

news.body: Michael Mayer caught 5-of-6 targets for 53 yards in a 38-33 win over the Jets.
news.head: Michael Mayer hauls in five passes in Week 8
news.impact: Mayer and Brock Bowers led the Raiders' pass catchers, accounting for 16 of Kirk Cousins' 26 pass attempts. Mayer remains a solid option in deeper leagues with the Raiders' continuing to deploy both tight ends.

news.body: Mike Gesicki caught five of his six targets for 77 yards in a 22-20 loss to the Commanders in Week 11.
news.head: Mike Gesicki leads Bengals in receiving in Week 11
news.impact: Gesicki led the Bengals in receiving in the Monday night loss, doing most of his damage on a 32-yard reception in the fourth quarter to help set up a 56-yard field goal. Gesicki now has 25 catches for 338 yards and six touchdowns in 10 games this season. He will be a low-end TE2 in Week 12 vs. the Saints.

news.body: Mike Gesicki caught 1-of-2 targets for nine yards in Sunday's 38-18 win over the Pittsburgh Steelers.
news.head: Mike Gesicki quiet in win Sunday
news.impact: Cincinnati's offense was unstoppable on Sunday night, but Gesicki wasn't able to get in on that. He finished with just one catch for nine yards, so he obviously had a disappointing fantasy total as well. He has decent streaming upside on a week-to-week basis but won't be consistent moving forward.

news.body: Mike Gesicki caught both of his targets for 11 yards in a 34-17 win over the Falcons.
news.head: Mike Gesicki hauls in two passes in Week 9
news.impact: Gesicki had a streak of five straight games with a touchdown snapped Sunday. The veteran tight end had not logged a lot of receptions, but had provided fantasy managers with plenty of trips to the end zone. Gesicki and the Bengals will take on the Steelers in Week 10.

news.body: Mike Gesicki caught four of his six targets for 76 yards and a touchdown in a 43-36 overtime win over the Titans in Week 8.
news.head: Mike Gesicki catches TD in Week 8
news.impact: Gesicki had a big afternoon in the Bengals' first game since losing Erick All to a torn ACL. He has now caught a touchdown in all six of his games played this season. Gesicki will be a high-end TE2 in Week 9 vs. the Falcons.

news.body: Noah Fant caught two of his five targets for 19 yards in the Saints' 21-13 loss to the Bears in Week 11.
news.head: Noah Fant quiet in Week 11
news.impact: Fant was one of many disappointing pass-catching options Sunday, finishing under 20 receiving yards in each of his last seven contests. The tight end could be in line for increased snaps if Juwan Johnson (hamstring) misses time, with a Week 12 contest against the Cincinnati Bengals up next.

news.body: Noah Fant (back) was upgraded to a full participant at practice on Thursday.
news.head: Noah Fant (back) upgraded to full participant Thursday
news.impact: Fant was able to log a full practice session on Thursday after being limited by a back issue on Wednesday. He should be good to go for Week 10 but is not expected to be fantasy relevant for the foreseeable future.

news.body: Noah Fant caught his only target for seven yards in the Saints' 23-13 loss to the Minnesota Vikings in Week 5.
news.head: Noah Fant catches one pass in Week 5
news.impact: Fant has struggled to make a consistent impact in the New Orleans passing attack, finishing with less than 35 receiving yards in each of his four contests. The tight end remains a risky pass-catching option in all formats ahead of a Week 6 contest against the New York Giants.

news.body: Noah Fant (abdomen) was a limited participant at practice on Thursday.
news.head: Noah Fant (abdomen) limited participant Thursday
news.impact: Fant was limited for another practice on Thursday as he continues to recover from an injury to his abdomen. He seems to be trending towards playing in Week 5, but we won't know his status for sure until after practice on Friday.

news.body: Pat Freiermuth caught five passes for 39 yards in Sunday’s loss to the Eagles. He also added a rush for one yard.
news.head: Pat Freiermuth totals 40 yards in loss
news.impact: Freiermuth’s five receptions ties his season high, and he’s only gone above the 40-yard mark twice all season. Right now, Freiermuth is a touchdown-dependent TE2 against the Broncos in Week 12.

news.body: Pat Freiermuth caught 2-of-3 targets for 35 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 38-18 loss to the Cincinnati Bengals.
news.head: Pat Freiermuth finds end zone Sunday
news.impact: Freiermuth was a meaningful contributor for the Steelers on Sunday. He hauled in a touchdown on one of his two catches and racked up 35 yards in the process. He will continue to be fantasy relevant moving forward, although he's not immune from having bad games on a game-to-game basis.

news.body: Pat Freiermuth (illness) is active for Week 10 for the Pittsburgh Steelers against the Cincinnati Bengals.
news.head: Pat Freiermuth (illness) active for Week 10
news.impact: Freiermuth is good to go after entering the weekend with a questionable designation with a late-week illness, providing quarterback Aaron Rodgers with his inconsistent TE1 against the Bengals Sunday night.

news.body: Pat Freiermuth is now listed as questionable for Sunday’s game against the Bengals.
news.head: Pat Freiermuth (illness) now questionable Sunday
news.impact: Freiermuth is a late addition to the injury report due to an illness. His status will need to be monitored closer to kickoff.

news.body: Sam LaPorta hauled in four of his five targets for 44 yards and one touchdown in the Lions' 39-35 Week 12 loss to the Bears.
news.head: Sam LaPorta finds end zone in Week 12 loss to Bears
news.impact: LaPorta has offered modest results in the Detroit offense of late, recording over 40 receiving yards in each of his last two contests. The tight end has frustrated fantasy managers to this point as a risky TE1 option, with a Week 13 contest against the Atlanta Falcons up next.

news.body: Sam LaPorta is off the injury report for Thursday’s game against the Bears.
news.head: Sam LaPorta (ankle) off injury report Thursday
news.impact: LaPorta will be a TE1 play for fantasy managers.

news.body: Sam LaPorta was a full participant in practice on Tuesday.
news.head: Sam LaPorta (ankle) logs full practice Tuesday
news.impact: LaPorta should be a TE1 play heading into Thursday's game against the Bears.

news.body: Sam LaPorta (ankle) is practicing Tuesday for the Detroit Lions.
news.head: Sam LaPorta (ankle) practicing Tuesday
news.impact: LaPorta is progressing in the right direction on a short week, as the tight end looks to clear through any tests to suit up against the Chicago Bears on Thanksgiving Day. The tight end remains an impactful intermediate pass-catching option as part of a dynamic Lions offense when healthy.

news.body: T.J. Hockenson caught 6-of-7 targets for 55 yards in Sunday's 35-10 loss to the 49ers.
news.head: T.J. Hockenson hauls in six passes Sunday night
news.impact: After missing a week due to a wrist injury, Hockenson was back in action Sunday night. The veteran TE finished with his second-highest reception total of the season, gaining over 50 yards for just the third time on the campaign. This was Hockenson's first game back with veteran QB Kirk Cousins leading the Minnesota offense. Hockenson could be set for a productive stretch run.

news.body: T.J. Hockenson is off the injury report for Sunday against the 49ers.
news.head: T.J. Hockenson (wrist) off injury report Sunday
news.impact: Hockenson was able to return to practice all week. He'll be a low-end TE1 play for fantasy managers.

news.body: T.J. Hockenson remained limited in practice on Thursday.
news.head: T.J. Hockenson (wrist) limited in practice Thursday
news.impact: Hockenson logged his second straight limited practice. He is on track to be good to go for Sunday's game against the 49ers.

news.body: T.J. Hockenson (wrist) was officially a limited participant at practice on Wednesday.
news.head: T.J. Hockenson (wrist) officially limited Wednesday
news.impact: The veteran was officially a limited participant on Wednesday, as he's currently managing a wrist issue of some kind. It looks likely that he will play through it in Week 11, but we won't know for sure until later on in the week.

news.body: Tommy Tremble was limited in practice on Thursday.
news.head: Tommy Tremble (knee) limited in practice Thursday
news.impact: Tremble remains off the fantasy radar in his current role.

news.body: Tommy Tremble caught his lone target for 18 yards in a 35-33 win over the Ravens.
news.head: Tommy Tremble hauls in one pass in Week 11
news.impact: Tremble was the least targeted tight end on the offense Sunday. The team could have elected to work him back in slowly in his return from a knee injury that limited him in practice during the week. Tremble and the Panthers will take on Tampa Bay in Week 12.

news.body: Panthers TE Tommy Tremble (knee) is officially active for Week 11.
news.head: Tommy Tremble (knee) officially active for Week 11
news.impact: Tremble was limited in practice to close out the week and was deemed questionable to play against the Ravens. Darren Waller is also active for Bryce Young and the Panthers.

news.body: Tommy Tremble is listed as questionable for Sunday’s game against the Ravens.
news.head: Tommy Tremble (knee) listed questionable Sunday
news.impact: Tremble got in limited practices on Thursday and Friday. He should be trending towards being good to go for Sunday. He remains a TE2 for fantasy managers with Darren Waller also expected to play.

news.body: Travis Kelce caught 6-of-7 targets for 74 yards and two touchdowns in a 34-7 win over the Cardinals.
news.head: Travis Kelce finds the end zone twice in Week 11 win
news.impact: Kelce scored on touchdown receptions of eight and 22 yards in the first half. This ended a long receiving touchdown drought for the veteran, who had not connected with Patrick Mahomes for a touchdown reception since Week 3. Kelce and the Chiefs will take on the Bills in Week 12.

news.body: Travis Kelce (ankle) will be good to go for Sunday's game against the Arizona Cardinals.
news.head: Travis Kelce (ankle) good to go for Sunday
news.impact: As expected, Kelce's ankle injury isn't serious right now and won't prevent him from playing on Sunday. He may be a decent fantasy option in PPR formats this week, although we haven't seen a high week-to-week ceiling for him so far this season.

news.body: Travis Kelce hauled in both of his targets for 30 yards in the Chiefs' 35-13 win over the Falcons in Week 10.
news.head: Travis Kelce quiet in Week 10 win
news.impact: Kelce was hampered by a lingering ankle injury, exiting briefly on his way to finishing with less than four receptions for the first time in his last five games. The tight end will look to get back on track against the Arizona Cardinals in Week 11.

news.body: Travis Kelce (ankle) is headed to the locker room for the Kansas City Chiefs according to Mike Garafolo.
news.head: Travis Kelce (ankle) heads to locker room Sunday
news.impact: Kelce limped off the field in the first quarter after being tackled, hauling in his only target for 23 yards prior to exiting. Noah Gray will take over the TE1 role as long as Kelce remains sidelined.

news.body: Trey McBride caught 9-of-14 targets for 54 yards in a 34-7 loss to the Chiefs.
news.head: Trey McBride hauls in nine passes in Week 11
news.impact: McBride led the team in targets and receptions, which should not come as a surprise with the numerous injuries to the Cardinals' wide receiver group. McBride will remain the top pass catching option for the Cardinals in a Week 12 matchup with the Commanders.

news.body: Trey McBride caught 5-of-5 targets for 37 yards in the Cardinals 34-6 loss against the Rams.
news.head: Trey McBride catches five passes Sunday
news.impact: McBride was a safety blanket for Carson Beck in his NFL debut as a starter. He remains a steady high-end TE1 for fantasy managers.

news.body: Trey McBride caught 7-of-8 targets for 54 yards in the Cardinals 17-3 loss against the Seahawks.
news.head: Trey McBride hauls in seven passes Sunday
news.impact: McBride nearly hauled in a touchdown late in the loss, but the pass was knocked away by Nick Emmanwori late in the fourth quarter. McBride remains a locked and loaded elite high-end TE1 for fantasy managers.

news.body: Trey McBride hauled in seven of his eight targets for 72 yards and one touchdown in the Cardinals' 33-30 Week 8 win over the Cowboys.
news.head: Trey McBride finds end zone in Week 8 win over Cowboys
news.impact: McBride has had a nose for the end zone of late, recording a receiving touchdown in three of his last four contests. The tight end remains locked in as a reliable TE1 option ahead of a Week 9 matchup against a tough Seattle Seahawks defense in Week 9.

news.body: Tucker Kraft hauled in three of his five targets for 24 yards while also losing a fumble in the Packers' 26-13 Week 12 loss to the Rams.
news.head: Tucker Kraft hauls in three passes in Week 12 loss to Rams
news.impact: Kraft has struggled to make an impact on offense of late, finishing with less than 45 receiving yards in each of his last three games. The tight end continues to frustrate fantasy managers with inconsistent output in the Green Bay passing attack to this point, with a Week 13 matchup against the New Orleans Saints up next.

news.body: Tucker Kraft hauled in one of his four targets for 19 yards in the Packers' 30-10 loss to the Vikings in Week 10.
news.head: Tucker Kraft quiet in Week 10 loss
news.impact: Kraft has offered mixed results on offense of late, finishing with less than 40 receiving yards in three of the last six contests. The tight end remains another risky pass-catching option in an inconsistent Packers offense entering the team's Week 11 bye.

news.body: Tucker Kraft caught one of his three targets for one yard while also rushing twice for eight yards in the Packers' 45-27 Week 9 win over the Patriots.
news.head: Tucker Kraft quiet in Week 9 win
news.impact: Kraft fell back to earth in Sunday's win, being held to less than four receptions for the first time in seven contests. The tight end will look to get back on track against a tough Minnesota Vikings defense in Week 10.

news.body: Tucker Kraft secured all six of his targets for 53 yards and a touchdown in Thursday's 27-19 win over the Panthers.
news.head: Tucker Kraft scores again in Week 8
news.impact: Kraft scored for the second consecutive game and the third time this season in Thursday night's win. The fourth-year TE has now caught between 4-6 passes in six straight weeks, and though he hasn't gone over 65 yards in any game this season, Kraft remains a solid TE1.

news.body: Rams TE Tyler Higbee has a chest contusion that will leave him “week to week."
news.head: Tyler Higbee (chest) week-to-week
news.impact: Schefter notes that Higbee "has a chance" to play next Thursday against the Chiefs, but it seems more unlikely.

news.body: Tyler Higbee caught one of his three targets for 14 yards in the Rams' 26-13 Week 12 win over the Packers.
news.head: Tyler Higbee (chest) quiet before exiting in Week 12
news.impact: Higbee has made minimal impact on offense of late, recording under 60 receiving yards in each of his last seven games. The tight end's status will need to be monitored after exiting the win with a chest injury, with a Week 13 matchup against the Kansas City Chiefs up next.

news.body: Tyler Higbee left Wednesday's game against the Packers and did not return with a chest injury.
news.head: Tyler Higbee suffers chest injury
news.impact: Higbee will have a mini bye week to get fully healthy heading into Week 13.

news.body: Tyler Higbee caught 3-of-4 targets for 17 yards and a touchdown in the Rams 34-6 win over the Cardinals.
news.head: Tyler Higbee catches touchdown Sunday
news.impact: Higbee could have had two touchdowns, but Matthew Stafford overthrew him on one. He'll remain a touchdown dependent streamer for fantasy managers out of the bye week for the Rams.

news.body: Tyler Warren came up with just 1-of-5 targets for 22 yards in Thursday's 26-3 loss to the Texans.
news.head: Tyler Warren hauls in one pass Thursday night
