news.impact: Warren's frustrating sophomore season in the NFL continued Thursday night. He did have a nice 22-yard gain, but other than that, he was shut down. Warren has managed only 11 total receptions over the last four games and has not scored since Week 2. The Colts' passing game is a mess right now, and Warren's fantasy value has greatly suffered as a result.

news.body: Tyler Warren caught two of three targets for one yard and ran once for three yards in the Colts' 24-22 win over the Dolphins.
news.head: Tyler Warren quiet in win over the Dolphins
news.impact: Warren found some new lows in a season of low points. Earlier in the season, he was helped out by touchdowns, but he last scored in Week 2. He's had some decent yardage games, but also some low totals. QB Daniel Jones is largely to blame here, though Warren himself isn't doing as much on his touches as he did last year.

news.body: Tyler Warren caught four of his seven targets for 44 yards in a 27-23 loss to the Cowboys in Week 9.
news.head: Tyler Warren catches four balls in Week 9
news.impact: Warren finished second on the team in receiving and catches in the close loss to Dallas. The second-year tight end is putting together a quiet sophomore season, posting 38 catches for 275 yards and two touchdowns in seven games. He will settle in as a high-end TE2 in Week 10 vs. the Dolphins.

news.body: Tyler Warren managed to catch just 4-of-10 targets for only 18 yards in Sunday's 42-7 loss to the Jaguars.
news.head: Tyler Warren struggles in return from injury
news.impact: After missing each of the last two games due to a groin injury, Warren was back on the field for the Colts in Week 8. It didn't make much of a difference, however, as the second-year TE struggled in what was a terrible performance from the Colts on the whole. Warren's production should improve from here, but the Colts' offense is a difficult one to trust.

news.body: Adonai Mitchell caught two of his three targets for 30 yards in a 27-24 win over the Chargers in Week 11.
news.head: Adonai Mitchell goes for 30 yards in Week 11 win
news.impact: Mitchell tied for second on the team in receiving in a game where the Jets went very run-heavy to beat the Chargers. The veteran wideout now has 21 catches for 354 yards and one touchdown in seven games this season. He will be a boom/bust flex option in Week 12 against the Dolphins.

news.body: Adonai Mitchell caught 3-of-8 targets for 59 yards in a 31-12 loss to the Bills.
news.head: Adonai Mitchell logs three receptions in Week 10
news.impact: Mitchell was second on the team in targets, but well behind Garrett Wilson's 14 targets. With Omar Cooper Jr. (ankle) exiting early, Mitchell could be in line for a similar target share in Week 11 if Cooper is unable to suit up.

news.body: Jets WR Adonai Mitchell (knee) is officially active for a Week 10 matchup with the Bills.
news.head: Adonai Mitchell (knee) officially active for Week 10
news.impact: Mitchell was a late add to the injury report this week but is cleared to play. Mitchell, Omar Cooper Jr., and Garrett Wilson are all active for the Jets.

news.body: Adonai Mitchell is expected to play on Sunday against the Bills.
news.head: Adonai Mitchell (knee) expected to play Sunday
news.impact: Mitchell was added to the injury report on Friday, but he still got in a full practice. He is a big play dependent WR3/flex play with Garrett Wilson and Omar Cooper Jr. also expected to play.

news.body: A.J. Brown (hamstring) has been ruled out for Week 12 for the New England Patriots according to Evan Lazar.
news.head: A.J. Brown (hamstring) ruled out for Week 12
news.impact: Brown remains out for head coach Mike Vrabel, with DeMario Douglas and Mack Hollins to operate as the primary wideout options for quarterback Tommy DeVito against the Chargers Sunday.

news.body: AJ Brown is expected to miss multiple weeks due to his hamstring injury.
news.head: A.J. Brown (hamstring) to miss multiple weeks
news.impact: It is another injury for Brown that will sideline him at least two more games. It is unclear if a stint on injured reserve is being considered.

news.body: A.J. Brown (hamstring) is questionable to return for the New England Patriots Sunday.
news.head: A.J. Brown (hamstring) questionable to return Sunday
news.impact: Brown exits after catching just two of his six targets for 27 yards in a disastrous game for the New England offense as a whole. The wideout may remain sidelined with the Patriots trailing 28-3 beginning the fourth quarter.

news.body: A.J. Brown (knee/ankle) is officially active for Week 10 for the New England Patriots against the Detroit Lions according to Adam Schefter.
news.head: A.J. Brown (knee/ankle) active for Week 10
news.impact: Brown is good to go after carrying a questionable designation into the weekend, passing through pregame activities without any setbacks. The dynamic wideout will look to offer quarterback Drake Maye an impactful pass-catching option against an inconsistent Detroit secondary Sunday.

news.body: Amon-Ra St. Brown hauled in seven of his team-leading 10 targets for 146 yards in the Lions' 39-35 Week 12 loss to the Bears.
news.head: Amon-Ra St. Brown leads pass-catches in Week 12 loss to Bears
news.impact: St. Brown continues an impactful stretch of late, recording five or more receptions in seven of his last eight games. The wideout remains a reliable WR1 option in all formats ahead of a Week 13 matchup against the Atlanta Falcons.

news.body: Amon-Ra St. Brown hauled in five of his team-leading six targets for 37 yards and one touchdown in the Lions' 31-21 Week 11 win over the Buccaneers.
news.head: Amon-Ra St. Brown reaches end zone in Week 11 win over Buccaneers
news.impact: St. Brown made the most of his opportunities on offense Sunday, finishing with five or more receptions for the sixth time in his last seven games. The pass-catcher remains a steady WR1 in all formats entering a Week 12 matchup against the Chicago Bears.

news.body: Amon-Ra St. Brown caught four of his five targets for 98 yards and a touchdown in a 35-10 win over the Patriots in Munich in Week 10.
news.head: Amon-Ra St. Brown scores twice in Week 10
news.impact: St. Brown snapped a five-game scoreless streak by finding the end zone twice, on catches of 56 and 28 yards. The star wideout now has 65 catches for 755 yards and seven touchdowns through nine games. He will be a top-three fantasy wideout in Week 11 vs. Tampa Bay.

news.body: Amon-Ra St. Brown (rib) is officially active for Week 10 for the Detroit Lions against the New England Patriots.
news.head: Amon-Ra St. Brown (rib) active for Week 10
news.impact: St. Brown is good to go after entering the weekend carrying a questionable designation for head coach Dan Campbell, boosting an explosive Detroit offensive attack as a reliable WR1 option against the Patriots in Germany Sunday.

news.body: Anthony Gould caught 2-of-3 targets for 48 yards in Thursday's 26-3 loss to the Texans.
news.head: Anthony Gould finishes with 48 yards Thursday night
news.impact: The Colts completed just 12 passes Thursday night, and Gould was one of three players on the team to catch more than one. The young slot receiver led the Colts in receiving yards and had the longest play on the team with a 31-yard gain. Gould is plenty involved in the offense, but the Colts' passing attack with QB Daniel Jones is just a mess right now.

news.body: Anthony Gould was limited in practice on Tuesday.
news.head: Anthony Gould (toe) limited in practice Tuesday
news.impact: Gould will need to be monitored in practice on Wednesday on a short week.

news.body: Anthony Gould caught two of four targets for 28 yards in the Colts' 24-22 win over Miami.
news.head: Anthony Gould snags two passes in win
news.impact: Gould had the second most receiving yards on the team, but with only two catches to his name and no touchdown, it amounted to little for fantasy. He's best left on waivers with the Colts passing game currently stagnant.

news.body: Anthony Gould will start at slot receiver for the Colts going forward.
news.head: Anthony Gould to take over in the slot
news.impact: With Josh Downs traded away, Gould will move into the slot for the Colts' offense. The third-year pro has played very sparingly on offense since being drafted by the Colts in the fifth round in 2024. Gould caught his first pass of the season in Week 9 against the Cowboys, gaining 16 yards on the reception.

news.body: Antonio Williams caught nine of his 11 targets for 122 yards in a 22-20 win over the Bengals in Week 11's Monday night game.
news.head: Antonio Williams posts nine catches, 122 yards in MNF win
news.impact: The rookie exploded in the win, posting the first 100-yard receiving game of his career while also setting a career high in receptions. With less than a minute left in regulation, Williams caught two long passes from Jayden Daniels to set up the game-winning field goal. He is looking like a strong WR3 in fantasy heading into a Week 12 matchup vs. the Cardinals.

news.body: Antonio Williams caught both of his targets for 42 yards and a touchdown in a 24-21 win over the Giants in Week 10's Thursday night game.
news.head: Antonio Williams scores TD in Week 10 win
news.impact: Williams hauled in a 31-yard touchdown pass from Jayden Daniels in the third quarter. Unfortunately, he only drew two targets on a night when Daniels spread the ball around. Williams has shown explosive play-making potential in his rookie year, but he will need more targets to be fully trustworthy in fantasy leagues. Williams will be a boom/bust flex option in Week 11 vs. the Bengals.

news.body: Antonio Williams had three catches for 25 yards in Sunday’s loss to the Rams.
news.head: Antonio Williams has three catches in loss
news.impact: Williams has now put together his fifth straight game with at least three receptions. Williams has shown promising flashes of talent, and still has the chance to become the de-facto number one receiver in the Commanders' offense. He faces the Giants on Thursday Night Football where he will be in WR3/Flex range with high upside.

news.body: Antonio Williams caught five of his seven targets for 54 yards in a 27-10 win over the Eagles in Week 8.
news.head: Antonio Williams goes for 54 yards in Week 8
news.impact: Williams moved into a starting role with the Commanders playing their first game since losing Terry McLaurin to a season-ending knee injury. The rookie responded well, finishing second on the team in receiving yards while leading the way with seven targets. Williams becomes interesting in fantasy moving forward as he gears up to take on the Rams in Week 9.

news.body: Ashton Dulin caught 2-of-4 passes for 30 yards in Thursday's 26-3 loss to the Texans.
news.head: Ashton Dulin finishes with 30 yards on Thursday night
news.impact: Dulin has now gone for 30-plus yards in three straight weeks, averaging more than 28 yards on four total receptions in that span. He had a 25-yard gain in Thursday's game, and those big plays are his calling card. However, Dulin is a low-volume receiver in a struggling passing attack.

news.body: Ashton Dulin caught one of two targets for 30 yards in the Colts' 24-22 win over Miami on Sunday.
news.head: Ashton Dulin snags deep reception in win
news.impact: Dulin had a nice grab in the win, but did little else on offense. He's not worth a pickup off of waivers as of now.

news.body: Ashton Dulin caught one of his two targets for a 55-yard touchdown in a 27-23 loss to the Cowboys in Week 9.
news.head: Ashton Dulin hauls in 55-yard TD in Week 9
news.impact: Dulin brought in Daniel Jones' lone TD pass in the third quarter to cut the Cowboys' lead to 20-17 after the extra point. Dulin only has four catches on nine targets this season, although his role might grow if the Colts wind up trading Josh Downs or Keenan Allen. Dulin will take on the Dolphins in Week 10.

news.body: Ashton Dulin (hamstring) was considered a limited participant at practice on Thursday.
news.head: Ashton Dulin (hamstring) considered limited Thursday
news.impact: Dulin was only able to participate in Thursday's practice in a limited fashion, thanks to the hamstring injury he's dealing with. He may play in Week 7, but fantasy managers shouldn't expect him to do much even if active against the Vikings.

news.body: Brian Thomas Jr. caught one of three targets for an 18-yard touchdown in the Jaguars' 23-18 loss to the Giants on Sunday.
news.head: Brian Thomas Jr. snags touchdown in loss to Giants
news.impact: Thomas was the recipient of Trevor Lawrence's only touchdown pass of the afternoon, which was a nice 18-yard strike. He's been operating on extremely low volume this season, and scoring a touchdown is no reason to think about starting him now.

news.body: Brian Thomas Jr. caught three of four targets for 29 yards in the Jaguars' 40-23 win over the Titans on Sunday.
news.head: Brian Thomas Jr. snags three passes in win over Titans
news.impact: Thomas was in a four way tie for second most on the Jaguars in receptions, and was fourth on the team in yards. If you haven't already, go ahead and drop him. He is not rosterable unless there is an injury ahead of him, and even then, the Jaguars could decide to promote Travis Hunter to WR instead.

news.body: The Jaguars are not expected to trade WR Brian Thomas Jr.
news.head: Brian Thomas Jr. not expected to be traded
news.impact: Jacksonville plans to keep its roster intact after making some big trades on Monday. Fowler notes the Jaguars have told teams they plan to keep Thomas.

news.body: Brian Thomas Jr. was not targeted in the Jaguars' 33-10 win over the Ravens.
news.head: Brian Thomas Jr. held without a target in win
news.impact: Thomas caught a touchdown on Sunday, and was held without a target on Thursday. The "downfield threat," as the Jaguars coaching staff has called him, has only 117 yards all season and can be safely dropped, unless you want to hold and hope he gets traded before the deadline.

news.body: Caleb Douglas caught 2-of-10 targets for 30 yards in the Dolphins 26-9 loss against the Bills.
news.head: Caleb Douglas sees 10 targets Sunday
news.impact: Douglas was the clear feature target for Kyle McCord. It did not result in much of anything production wise. He remains a WR3/flex play heading into next week against the Jets.

news.body: Caleb Douglas (shoulder) is good to go for Sunday's game against the Buffalo Bills.
news.head: Caleb Douglas (shoulder) good to go for Sunday
news.impact: The rookie will be good to go on Sunday, as his shoulder injury isn't considered to be anything more than a minor issue at this point. He has week-to-week fantasy upside, but his weekly floor is also somewhat low with how bad Miami's offense has looked lately.

news.body: Caleb Douglas was limited in practice on Thursday.
news.head: Caleb Douglas (shoulder) limited in practice Thursday
news.impact: Douglas remained limited in practice. He will have a chance to be good to go for Sunday's game against the Bills.

news.body: Caleb Douglas (shoulder) was limited at Miami's practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Caleb Douglas (shoulder) limited at practice Wednesday
news.impact: The rookie was limited for Miami's first practice of the week on Wednesday. He's listed with a shoulder injury of some kind, but it's not though to be more than a minor issue at this point. He should play through it and continue to be a viable streaming option in most league formats this week.

news.body: Calvin Ridley caught 5-of-6 targets for 68 yards and a touchdown in the Titans 51-30 loss against the Cowboys.
news.head: Calvin Ridley finds the end zone Sunday
news.impact: Ridley had recorded only six catches for 91 yards on the season entering Sunday. Despite this performance, he remains off the fantasy radar.

news.body: Calvin Ridley (hip) is active for Week 8 for the Tennessee Titans according to Adam Schefter.
news.head: Calvin Ridley (hip) active for Week 8
news.impact: Ridley is good to go after carrying a questionable designation into the weekend for head coach Robert Saleh, offering an underwhelming Tennessee offense another explosive option Sunday.

news.body: Calvin Ridley is listed as questionable for Sunday’s game against the Bengals.
news.head: Calvin Ridley (hip) listed questionable Sunday
news.impact: Ridley remains off the fantasy radar when he is healthy.

news.body: Calvin Ridley (hip) was a limited participant at practice on Thursday.
news.head: Calvin Ridley (hip) limited participant Thursday
news.impact: The veteran was limited for another practice on Thursday, as he's still dealing with a hip issue of some kind. We should know more about his official status for Week 8 after practice on Friday.

news.body: Carnell Tate was a full participant in practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Carnell Tate (shoulder) logs full practice Wednesday
news.impact: Tate returned to the field last week for the Titans. He will remain an upside WR2 for fantasy managers.

news.body: Carnell Tate caught 2-of-5 targets for 58 yards and a touchdown in the Titans 51-30 loss against the Cowboys.
news.head: Carnell Tate scores long touchdown Sunday
news.impact: Tate recorded a 59-yard touchdown in the third quarter on a play where the Cowboys defense thought he had been down near midfield. He remains a steady WR2 for fantasy managers.

news.body: Titans WR Carnell Tate (shoulder) is officially active for a Week 11 matchup with Dallas.
news.head: Carnell Tate (shoulder) officially active for Week 11
news.impact: Tate was listed as questionable but was expected to play based on early reports. Tate is in a plus matchup against a struggling Dallas' defense, if Cam Ward can clean up some inconsistent quarterback play.

news.body: Carnell Tate (shoulder) is expected to play Sunday for the Tennessee Titans according to Ian Rapoport.
news.head: Carnell Tate (shoulder) expected to play Sunday
news.impact: Tate entered the weekend carrying a questionable designation, but barring any setbacks during pregame warmups will suit up and offer inconsistent quarterback Cam Ward an impactful pass-catching option against a dismal Dallas Cowboys secondary.

news.body: CeeDee Lamb hauled in seven of his team-high 10 targets for a team-leading 134 yards in the Cowboys' 39-38 Week 12 loss to the Eagles.
news.head: CeeDee Lamb leads pass-catchers in Week 12 loss to Eagles
news.impact: Lamb continues a productive stretch in the Dallas offense, recording 70 or more receiving yards in six of his last seven games. The explosive wideout remains a reliable WR1 option in all formats ahead of a Week 13 matchup against the Seattle Seahawks.

news.body: CeeDee Lamb caught 11-of-12 targets for 132 yards and a touchdown in the Cowboys 51-30 win over the Titans.
news.head: CeeDee Lamb hauls in 11 passes Sunday
news.impact: Lamb had one of his vintage huge performances in a shootout win for Dallas. He remains a locked and loaded WR1 for fantasy managers.

news.body: CeeDee Lamb hauled in seven of his 13 targets for 73 yards and one touchdown in the Cowboys' 46-30 Week 10 loss to the 49ers.
news.head: CeeDee Lamb finds end zone in Week 10 loss to 49ers
news.impact: Lamb has caught fire on offense of late, finishing with over 70 receiving yards and at least one touchdown in three of his last four games. The pass-catcher remains one of the more dynamic WR1 options for fantasy managers ahead of a generous Week 11 matchup against the Tennessee Titans.

news.body: CeeDee Lamb caught 10 of his 16 targets for 195 yards and a touchdown in a 27-23 win over the Colts in Week 9.
news.head: CeeDee Lamb goes for 195 yards, TD in Week 9
news.impact: Lamb lost a fumble early in the fourth quarter after making a spectacular catch for a 48-yard gain, the only blemish in an otherwise exceptional performance. The veteran wideout continues to post big numbers for the Cowboys, catching 70 balls for 904 yards and seven touchdowns through nine games. He will be a locked-in WR1 in Week 10 vs. the 49ers.

news.body: Chimere Dike caught 6-of-7 targets for 69 yards in the Titans 51-30 loss against the Cowboys.
news.head: Chimere Dike hauls in six passes Sunday
news.impact: Dike led the team in targets, receptions and receiving yards on the day. He has been able to show his flashes this season, but he hasn't been able to do in a consistent fashion.

news.body: Chimere Dike caught two of three targets for 16 yards in the Titans' 40-23 loss to the Jaguars on Sunday.
news.head: Chimere Dike goes quiet in Week 10 loss
news.impact: Dike went off for 71 yards and a touchdown last week, but was held to minimal production against the Jags' improved secondary. When Carnell Tate returns to the lineup, it will be hard for him to get another crack at fantasy production, aside from injuries to others ahead of him,

news.body: Chimere Dike caught five of his six targets for 71 yards and a touchdown in a 43-36 overtime loss to the Bengals in Week 8.
news.head: Chimere Dike goes for 71 yards, TD in Week 8
news.impact: Dike was the main beneficiary of the Carnell Tate (shoulder) absence as he set season highs in all receiving categories in the high-scoring loss. The Titans are on bye in Week 9, giving Tate some extra time to get healthy, but Dike would be an interesting fantasy flex option in Week 10 vs. the Jaguars if Tate isn't ready to play by then.

news.body: Chimere Dike caught three of four targets for 27 yards in the Titans' 41-7 loss to the Jaguars on Sunday.
news.head: Chimere Dike snags three passes in loss
news.impact: Dike didn't have much of an upside in this game, especially with QB Cam Ward out for the majority of the game. He ends his rookie season with 48 receptions for 428 receiving yards. His primary contribution came on special teams, with 1,957 yards on punt and kick returns. He's an interesting sleeper candidate for 2026, given the flashes he's shown on offense combined with the team's trust in him, evident thanks to his special teams usage.

news.body: Chris Godwin Jr. caught all three of his targets for 13 yards in the Buccaneers' 31-21 loss to the Lions in Week 11.
news.head: Chris Godwin Jr. quiet in Week 11
news.impact: Godwin Jr. continues a disappointing season in the Tampa Bay offense, finishing under 50 receiving yards in all 10 of his contests. The veteran wideout remains difficult to trust in all formats ahead of a Week 12 contest against the Carolina Panthers.

news.body: Chris Godwin Jr. caught two of his three targets for 16 yards and added a 12-yard run in a 27-24 loss to the Bears in Week 9.
news.head: Chris Godwin Jr. catches two passes in Week 9
news.impact: Godwin was quiet in the loss in what has been a disappointing year for him. He is still looking for his first touchdown of the season while failing to go over 46 receiving yards in any of his nine games. Droppable in 12-team leagues, Godwin will be on bye in Week 10 before he takes on the Lions in Week 11.

news.body: Chris Godwin Jr. did not catch his lone target in the Buccaneers 16-0 win over the Falcons.
news.head: Chris Godwin Jr. does not catch pass Sunday
news.impact: Baker Mayfield did not complete a single pass in the win on Sunday. Godwin has struggled all season regardless of the circumstances. He'll be a WR4/WR5 moving forward.

news.body: Chris Godwin Jr. caught four of five targets for 27 yards in the Buccaneers' 43-13 win over the Panthers on Sunday.
news.head: Chris Godwin Jr. catches four passes in win
news.impact: While the final stat line is a bit disappointing considering Emeka Egbuka did not play, it's important to remember Baker Mayfield threw only 11 passes for 64 yards. Godwin had a 45% target share and a 42% receiving yards share with those numbers. So again, nothing much to write home about in the final box score, but his actual market share was great. He could be interesting next week against the Falcons

news.body: Chris Olave hauled in nine of his team-leading 15 targets for 102 yards in the Saints' 21-13 Week 11 loss to the Bears.
news.head: Chris Olave leads pass-catchers in Week 11 loss to Bears
news.impact: Olave has made the most of increased volume in the New Orleans offense of late, recording six or more receptions in three of his last four games. The wideout remains the lone reliable option in an inconsistent New Orleans offense to this point, with a Week 12 matchup against the Cincinnati Bengals up next.

news.body: Chris Olave caught 3-of-4 targets for 30 yards in a 20-17 loss to the Panthers.
news.head: Chris Olave quiet in Week 10 loss
news.impact: Olave's four targets are his lowest of the season. The 26-year-old saw Jordyn Tyson dominate the target share against the Panthers. Olave will look to bounce back against the Bears in Week 11.

news.body: Chris Olave caught 7 of 12 targets for 98 yards in the Saints' 23-22 overtime win over the Browns on Sunday.
news.head: Chris Olave sees 12 targets in win over Browns
news.impact: Olave was hard at work in this one, more than doubling up the next closest Saint in targets, which was rookie Jordyn Tyson. He also nearly doubled up the next closest Saint in yardage and had three more receptions than any other. It was his best yardage total in a month, and he will look to keep things up against the Panthers next week.

news.body: Chris Olave caught six of ten targets for 56 yards in the Saints' 16-10 loss to the Steelers on Sunday.
news.head: Chris Olave snags 6 passes in loss
news.impact: Olave was second on the team in receiving yards by one, but led in targets by three over RB Alvin Kamara. It wasn't the game we would have hoped for Olave, but it certainly wasn't something that ruined your week. He's been quiet over the last three weeks, aside from a touchdown last Sunday. He will look to have better results against Cleveland after the Saints' bye.

news.body: Christian Watson (concussion) hauled in all four of his targets for 65 yards and one touchdown in the Packers' 26-13 Week 12 loss to the Rams.
news.head: Christian Watson (concussion) lone bright spot before exiting in Week 12
news.impact: Watson continues a reliable stretch in the Green Bay offense, finishing with 50 or more receiving yards in six of his last seven games. The wideout remains one of the few dynamic pass-catching options as part of an inconsistent Green Bay offense that will look to take advantage of an extended break to clear through concussion protocols ahead of a Week 13 matchup against the New Orleans Saints.

news.body: Christian Watson (concussion) has been ruled out for the remainder of the Packers’ Week 12 game against the Rams after taking a nasty hit by Kam Kinchens.
news.head: Christian Watson (concussion) ruled out for remainder of Week 12
news.impact: Watson had four receptions for 65 yards and a touchdown before being ruled out. Matthew Golden and Tucker Kraft will lead the Packers receiving options with Watson out.

news.body: Christian Watson caught three of his five targets for 37 yards in the Packers' 30-10 Week 10 loss to the Vikings.
news.head: Christian Watson bottled up in Week 10 loss
news.impact: Watson was held in check by a stout Minnesota defense, being held to less than 50 receiving yards for the first time in six games. The wideout will look to return to his impactful form for fantasy managers after the team's Week 11 bye.

news.body: Christian Watson hauled in seven of his eight targets for 171 yards and one touchdown in the Packers' 45-27 Week 9 win over the Patriots.
news.head: Christian Watson finds end zone in Week 9 win over Patriots
news.impact: Watson has been impactful in the Green Bay offense of late, recording over 115 receiving yards in three of his last five games. The wideout remains one of the few dynamic offensive options in the Green Bay offense to this point, with a Week 10 matchup against the Minnesota Vikings up next.

news.body: CJ Daniels has been ruled inactive against the Niners on Thursday.
news.head: CJ Daniels inactive against Niners on Thursday
news.impact: The rookie will join Ty Simpson and Max Klare on the sidelines as the Rams open up the season. He will look to find his way onto the field soon.

news.body: The Rams signed WR CJ Daniels to his rookie contract.
news.head: CJ Daniels signs rookie deal with Rams
news.impact: Daniels was a sixth-round pick for the Rams this year. He caught 50 passes for 557 yards and seven touchdowns at Miami last season.

news.body: The Los Angeles Rams have selected WR C.J. Daniels with the No. 197 overall pick in the 2026 NFL Draft.
news.head: C.J. Daniels selected No. 197 by Los Angeles Rams
news.impact: Many thought the Los Angeles Rams would use their first-round pick on a wide receiver. Instead, they waited until the sixth round to give Matthew Stafford some options on the depth chart behind Puka Nacua and Davante Adams. C.J. Daniels finished second on the team with seven receiving touchdowns last year at Miami. He will compete with Jordan Whittington and Xavier Smith for snaps behind the two superstar wide receivers.

news.body: Cooper Kupp hauled in his lone target for a 34-yard touchdown in the Seahawks 21-13 win over the Raiders.
news.head: Cooper Kupp hauls in touchdown Sunday
news.impact: Kupp got open in the end zone with Drew Lock stopping just in front of the line scrimmage and finding him for a sliding catch. Kupp remains off the fantasy radar.

news.body: Cooper Kupp caught 3-of-4 targets for 32 yards in the Seahawks 17-3 win over the Cardinals.
news.head: Cooper Kupp totals 32 yards Sunday
news.impact: Kupp had a couple of big receptions from Drew Lock in the middle of the field. He will remain off the fantasy radar.

news.body: Cooper Kupp caught one pass for seven yards and a touchdown in Monday night's 34-17 loss to the Chicago Bears.
news.head: Cooper Kupp finds end zone Monday
news.impact: Kupp was able to catch a touchdown on Monday night, but that was his only reception, so he still had a terrible fantasy total over the course of the game. He remains entirely off of the fantasy radar moving forward.

news.body: Cooper Kupp caught both of his targets for 20 yards in a 20-3 win over the Chiefs in Week 7.
news.head: Cooper Kupp goes for 20 yards in Week 7
news.impact: Kupp was quiet just one week after drawing 10 targets vs. the Broncos. The veteran wideout continues to operate as Seattle's No. 2 receiver, although the majority of the work goes to Jaxon Smith-Njigba. Kupp will be a low-end flex option in Week 8 vs. the Bears.

news.body: Courtland Sutton failed to catch either of his two targets in the Broncos' 38-24 win over the Raiders in Week 11.
news.head: Courtland Sutton held without a catch in Week 11
news.impact: Sutton led Denver with nine targets in Week 9, albeit in a game Jaylen Waddle exited with a concussion. With the latter back in the lineup Sunday, Sutton saw just two targets. The Broncos scored a season-high 38 points, and Sutton didn't factor into the scoring. He's difficult to justify rostering in standard-sized fantasy leagues.

news.body: Courtland Sutton caught five of nine targets for 45 yards and one touchdown in the Broncos' 26-21 win over the Panthers in Week 9.
news.head: Courtland Sutton catches touchdown in Week 9
news.impact: Sutton scored from three yards out in the first quarter for his first touchdown since Week 1. He also led Denver with nine targets, nearly doubling his four targets from Week 8. That's the good. The bad? Sutton still hasn't surpassed 60 receiving yards in a game this season. The touchdown helps, but one productive fantasy performance doesn't erase eight weeks of limited production.

news.body: Courtland Sutton caught all four of his targets for 53 yards in the Broncos' 28-24 win over the Chiefs in Week 8.
news.head: Courtland Sutton records 53 receiving yards in Week 8
news.impact: Sutton's 53 yards were his most since Week 2. That's the good. The bad? He saw only four targets and has now gone seven straight games without a touchdown. One improved performance doesn't change what Sutton has been through eight weeks. He remains difficult to start outside of deeper leagues.

news.body: Courtland Sutton caught three of five targets for 45 yards in the Broncos' 30-16 win over the Cardinals in Week 7.
news.head: Courtland Sutton Held to 45 Yards in Week 7
news.impact: Sutton averaged 15 yards per reception but wasn't involved in either of Bo Nix's explosive touchdowns. He also finished behind Jaylen Waddle in targets for the second straight week. Sutton isn't a viable fantasy starter. Denver's expanding group of playmakers make his weekly production volatile.

news.body: Cyrus Allen caught 2-of-4 targets for 41 yards in a 34-7 win over Arizona.
news.head: Cyrus Allen hauls in two passes in Week 11
news.impact: Allen continues to be used sparingly in the Chiefs' offense, with his four targets tying a season high. Fantasy managers can leave him out of their lineups heading into a Week 12 matchup with the Bills.

news.body: Cyrus Allen caught two of his four targets for 44 yards and one touchdown in the Chiefs' 35-13 win over the Falcons in Week 10.
news.head: Cyrus Allen reaches end zone in Week 10 win
news.impact: Allen has underwhelmed in the Kansas City offense to this point, recording over 40 receiving yards for the first time in nine contests Sunday. The wideout remains difficult to trust in all formats ahead of a Week 11 contest against the Arizona Cardinals.

news.body: Cyrus Allen caught one of his two targets for an 18-yard gain in a 20-3 loss to the Seahawks in Week 7.
news.head: Cyrus Allen brings in 18-yard pass in Week 7
news.impact: Despite an increased role due to injuries, Allen has just three catches for 45 yards over his past two games. The rookie wideout does not need to be rostered in most fantasy leagues heading into Week 8 against the Broncos.

news.body: Cyrus Allen was a full participant in practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Cyrus Allen (knee) logs full practice Wednesday
news.impact: Allen is likely to be good to go on Sunday. He remains off the fantasy radar in his current role.

news.body: Darius Cooper caught one of his two targets for 14 yards in the Eagles' 39-38 win over the Cowboys in Week 12.
news.head: Darius Cooper catches pass in Week 12
news.impact: Cooper has made minimal impact in the Philadelphia offense of late, recording less than 30 receiving yards in five of his last six contests. The wideout remains one of many inconsistent pass-catching options in the Philadelphia offense ahead of a Week 13 contest against the Arizona Cardinals.

news.body: Darius Cooper caught 4/5 targets for 59 yards in Sunday’s win over the Steelers.
news.head: Darius Cooper catches goes 4/59 in win
news.impact: Cooper led the wide receiving group in yardage, despite DeVonta Smith’s return to the lineup. Cooper faces the Cowboys on Thanksgiving and will likely be a low-end flex play.

news.body: Darius Cooper caught 2-of-8 targets for 25 yards in Sunday's 19-11 loss to the New York Giants.
news.head: Darius Cooper struggles in loss Sunday
news.impact: Cooper saw eight targets on Sunday, but he was only able to haul in two of them in this loss to the Giants. He was only able to turn those opportunities into 25 scoreless yards, so any fantasy managers who took a chance on starting him got burned.

news.body: Darius Cooper caught two of his six targets for 19 yards in a 27-10 loss to the Commanders in Week 8.
news.head: Darius Cooper catches two passes in Week 8
news.impact: Cooper tied for second on the team with his six targets but he wasn't able to do much with the chances on Sunday night. The veteran now has 11 catches for 175 yards and four touchdowns in eight games this year. He will be a low-end flex in Week 9 vs. the Giants.

news.body: Darnell Mooney caught two of his five targets for eight yards in a 24-21 loss to the Commanders in Week 10's Thursday night game.
news.head: Darnell Mooney held to eight yards in Week 10
news.impact: Mooney led the Giants in receiving in Week 9 but he couldn't keep it going in the Thursday night loss. The veteran wideout has just 14 catches for 175 yards in nine games for New York this year. He will not be a recommended fantasy option in Week 11 vs. the Jaguars.

news.body: Darnell Mooney caught 3-of-4 targets for 54 yards in Sunday's 19-11 win over the Philadelphia Eagles.
news.head: Darnell Mooney leads team in receiving Sunday
news.impact: The veteran was productive on Sunday. He finished as the team's leading receiver in this win over the Eagles, but he accomplished that with just 54 yards, so his fantasy total still wasn't the best. He still shouldn't be started in most leagues for the foreseeable future.

news.body: Darnell Mooney did not catch either of his two targets in the Giants 34-27 loss against the Saints.
news.head: Darnell Mooney does not catch pass Sunday
news.impact: Mooney had one carry for 20 yards. He remains off the fantasy radar.

news.body: Darnell Mooney (neck) was upgraded to a full participant at practice on Thursday.
news.head: Darnell Mooney (neck) upgraded to full participant Thursday
news.impact: The veteran was able to practice in a full capacity on Thursday, despite being limited by a neck issue on Wednesday. He should play in Week 6 but will continue to be irrelevant from a fantasy perspective moving forward.

news.body: Davante Adams (hamstring) could return in Week 13 for the Los Angeles Rams according to Michael J. Duarte.
news.head: Davante Adams (hamstring) could return Week 13
news.impact: Adams continues to recover from hamstring surgery, but has progressed enough to potentially return sooner than later for a shorthanded Rams passing attack. The veteran wideout would slide into a WR1 role for head coach Sean McVay with Puka Nacua potentially out for the remainder of the season upon his return.

news.body: Rams head coach Sean McVay told reporters that WR Davante Adams ruptured his hamstring and now will be sidelined 6-10 weeks.
news.head: Davante Adams to miss 6-10 weeks with ruptured hamstring
news.impact: It is another brutal injury for the Rams and for fantasy managers. They'll likely continue to involve the tight ends even more in the passing game.

news.body: Davante Adams caught 3-of-4 targets for 39 yards before leaving Sunday's 18-16 loss to the Arizona Cardinals early with a leg injury of some kind.
news.head: Davante Adams suffers leg injury in loss Sunday
news.impact: Adams wasn't having a good game late on Sunday, and things got worse when he suffered a lower-body injury of some kind late in the game. Los Angeles wasn't able to pick up the win, and fantasy managers should keep very close tabs on all updates about his health throughout the week.

news.body: Davante Adams caught five of his seven targets for 51 yards and two touchdowns in a 37-34 overtime loss to the Bills in Week 5.
news.head: Davante Adams brings in two TD passes in Week 5
news.impact: Adams found the end zone twice in the high-scoring loss on Monday night. He kicked off the scoring for LA with a four-yard grab in the second quarter and later came back to add a five-yard catch for a score. Adams now has 27 catches for 441 yards and four touchdowns through five games for the Rams. He will be a solid WR2 in Week 6 vs. the Cardinals.

news.body: Deebo Samuel Sr. caught 3-of-4 passes for 20 yards and rushed for 27 yards on two attempts in Sunday's 35-10 win over the Vikings.
news.head: Deebo Samuel Sr. totals 47 yards on five touches Sunday night
news.impact: Predictably, Samuel did not repeat his huge performance from Week 10 that saw him hit paydirt twice. First off, Mike Evans returned to his WR1 role for the 49ers, which cut into Samuel's snap share a bit. Secondly, the Vikings' defense just doesn't allow many big plays. Samuel is still a major role player for the 49ers' potent attack, though. He maintains his big-play, WR3 potential going forward.

news.body: Deebo Samuel Sr. hauled in all three of his targets for 31 yards and one touchdown while also rushing three times for a team-high 78 yards and one touchdown in the 49ers' 46-40 Week 10 win over the Cowboys.
news.head: Deebo Samuel Sr. scores two touchdowns in Week 10 win over Cowboys
news.impact: Samuel Sr. has had a nose for the end zone of late, scoring at least one touchdown in three of his last four contests. The veteran wideout will look to remain one of the more impactful offensive options for the 49ers ahead of a Week 11 matchup against a strong Minnesota Vikings defense.

news.body: Deebo Samuel Sr. is off the injury report for Sunday's game against the Cowboys.
news.head: Deebo Samuel Sr. (hamstring) off injury report Sunday
news.impact: Samuel is officially good to go. He will be an upside WR2 for fantasy managers.

news.body: Deebo Samuel Sr. was limited in practice on Thursday.
news.head: Deebo Samuel Sr. (hamstring) limited in practice Thursday
news.impact: Samuel will have a chance to return on Sunday against the Cowboys. He will need to be monitored in practice on Friday to end the week.

news.body: Colts head coach Shane Steichen said Deion Burks will see an expanded role.
news.head: Deion Burks to see expanded role
news.impact: Burks has played a very limited role to begin the season. With the trades of Josh Downs and Keenan Allen, Burks is slated for an expanded role to finish the season alongside Laquon Treadwell.

news.body: Deion Burks caught both of his targets for 41 yards in the Colts' 26-20 loss to the Titans on Sunday. He also ran once for seven yards.
news.head: Deion Burks goes for 41 yards in loss to Titans
news.impact: The rookie had only caught one of four targets on the season leading into Sunday, but he put up a nice splash play for 36 yards. He could work his way into a larger workload if the Colts find his ability as a deep threat is superior to that of Laquon Treadwell.

news.body: The Indianapolis Colts have selected WR Deion Burks with the No. 254 overall pick in the 2026 NFL Draft.
news.head: Deion Burks selected No. 254 by Indianapolis Colts
news.impact: Burks had a great combine, finishing in the top percentiles of every drill specific to receivers. He runs fluid routes and has good hands and speed. He caught a career-best 57 passes in his final season in Oklahoma last season. He joins a Colts' wide receiving room that is wide open for competition entering 2026, so it's possible he could get some looks right out of the gate.

news.body: DeMario Douglas caught one of his three targets for four yards in a 35-10 loss to the Lions in Munich in Week 10.
news.head: DeMario Douglas held to one catch in Week 10
news.impact: Douglas had been trending up coming into the game as he had four touchdowns in his previous five contests. The entire New England pass-catching corps is likely to take a hit with Drake Maye (ankle) looking at a multi-week absence. Douglas will look to bounce back in Week 12 vs. the Chargers after his bye next week.

news.body: DeMario Douglas caught 5-of-9 targets for 102 yards in Sunday's 45-27 loss to the Green Bay Packers.
news.head: DeMario Douglas leads team in receiving Sunday
news.impact: Douglas was a bright spot for the Patriots on Sunday. He led the team with 102 yards on five catches, which left him with a good fantasy total despite him not getting into the end zone at all. He will continue to be a viable fantasy option for as long as A.J. Brown (knee) remains out of the lineup moving forward.

news.body: DeMario Douglas caught all three of his targets for 76 yards and a score in the Patriots' 24-19 win over Miami on Sunday.
news.head: DeMario Douglas leads Patriots WRs in win
news.impact: Douglas led the Patriots in receiving yards and tied for third on the team in targets with two other players: Hunter Henry and Rhamondre Stevenson. Douglas made his targets count, though, with a 48 yard score being the highlight of his night. Should AJ Brown continue to miss time, Douglas seems to be a safe bet for targets and production.

news.body: DeMario Douglas brought in 3-of-4 targets for 23 yards in Thursday's 30-24 loss to the Bears.
news.head: DeMario Douglas catches three passes in Week 7
news.impact: Douglas delivered back-to-back big games in Week and Week 6, but he fell back down to Earth against the Bears. Drake Maye heavily relied on his running backs and tight ends Thursday night, not leaving much for Douglas behind fellow wideout A.J. Brown. Douglas may have already had his best games of the season and will likely be tough to rely on for fantasy purposes going forward this season.

news.body: Denzel Boston has been listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Raiders.
news.head: Denzel Boston (toe) listed questionable for Week 12
news.impact: Boston was unable to practice all week. He is likely on the wrong side of questionable heading into Sunday.

news.body: Denzel Boston (toe) missed another practice Friday and is unlikely to play Sunday against the Raiders.
news.head: Denzel Boston (toe) unlikely to play in Week 12
news.impact: Boston has not practiced all week due to a toe injury. The rookie is not expected to play Sunday night, which will leave KC Concepcion and Jerry Jeudy to lead the Browns' receiver corps.

news.body: Denzel Boston did not practice on Thursday.
news.head: Denzel Boston (toe) misses practice Thursday
news.impact: Boston has now missed back-to-back practices. He will need to be monitored in practice again on Friday.

news.body: Denzel Boston (toe) did not take part in Tuesday's practice session.
news.head: Denzel Boston (toe) not practicing Tuesday
news.impact: The Browns are coming off a bye week and have until Sunday night to get ready for the Raiders. That will hopefully leave enough time for Boston to be ready, but this is not an encouraging start to the practice week for the rookie wideout. If Boston cannot go, Jerry Jeudy would likely see his snaps go up.

news.body: Devaughn Vele hauled in all seven of his targets for 76 yards in the Saints' 21-13 Week 11 loss to the Bears.
news.head: Devaughn Vele hauls in seven passes in Week 11 loss to Bears
news.impact: Vele has offered mixed results in the New Orleans offense of late, posting over 50 receiving yards for the second time in his last four contests. The wideout remains another risky pass-catching option entering a Week 12 contest against the Cincinnati Bengals.

news.body: Devaughn Vele caught both of his targets for 14 yards in a 20-17 loss to the Panthers.
news.head: Devaughn Vele logs two receptions in Week 10
news.impact: Vele has seen his target share drop since the debut of Jordyn Tyson. Fantasy managers can leave Vele out of their lineup for now.

news.body: Devaughn Vele caught two of four targets for 17 yards in the Saints' 23-22 win over the Browns on Sunday.
news.head: Devaughn Vele snags two passes in win
news.impact: Vele was one of eight Saints players to catch a pass on Sunday, and he was tied for fourth in receptions. It's gonna be tough for Vele to find relevance with Jordyn Tyson now in the mix, so he can be dropped in most leagues.

news.body: Devaughn Vele caught all five of his targets for 54 yards and a touchdown in the Saints' 16-10 loss to the Steelers on Sunday.
news.head: Devaughn Vele snags touchdown in loss
news.impact: Vele caught the Saints' only touchdown in this game, very much helping out his final fantasy line. He was one of four Saints to finish between 57 and 54 receiving yards, joining Barion Brown, Alvin Kamara, and Chris Olave. Vele has been a great waiver pickup for the first half of the season, but with the Saints going on bye and Jordyn Tyson expected back soon after it, it could be tough for Vele to have much relevance moving forward.

news.body: DeVonta Smith hauled in 11 of his team-leading 14 targets for 200 yards and two touchdowns in the Eagles' 39-38 Week 12 win over the cowboys.
news.head: DeVonta Smith explodes in Week 12 win over Cowboys
news.impact: Smith has been dynamic in the Philadelphia offense while battling injuries to this point, recording at least 75 receiving yards and one touchdown in three of his last five games. The wideout offers head coach Nick Sirianni an explosive pass-catching option as part of an inconsistent Philadelphia offense to this point, with a Week 13 matchup against the Arizona Cardinals up next.

news.body: DeVonta Smith is off the injury report for Thursday’s game against the Cowboys.
news.head: DeVonta Smith (hamstring) off injury report for Thursday
news.impact: Smith was a full participant in practice on Wednesday. He remains a WR2 play for fantasy managers.

news.body: DeVonta Smith was listed as a full participant on Monday's estimated practice report.
news.head: DeVonta Smith (hamstring) practices fully in estimated practice Monday
news.impact: Smith hauled in five passes in his return to action on Sunday against the Steelers. He should remain a steady WR2 in a favorable matchup against Dallas.

news.body: DeVonta Smith had five catches for 41 yards in Sunday’s victory over the Steelers.
news.head: DeVonta Smith has five catches for 41 yards in Eagles' win
news.impact: Smith’s return to the lineup led to his lowest yardage output this season, but he finished with a clutch catch late in the fourth quarter that helped seal the Eagles' victory. Smith faces the Cowboys on Thursday, where he will likely fall in the high-end WR2 range.

news.body: DJ Moore caught 8-of-10 targets for 91 yards and a touchdown in the Bills 26-9 win over the Dolphins.
news.head: DJ Moore catches touchdown Sunday
news.impact: Moore led Buffalo in targets and receptions on the day, while also catching the only touchdown thrown by Josh Allen. He'll look to keep it going on a short week against the Chiefs.

news.body: DJ Moore (knee) is questionable to return for the Buffalo Bills Sunday according to Mike Garafolo.
news.head: DJ Moore (knee) questionable to return Sunday
news.impact: Moore was hurt late in the second quarter, hauling in all six of his targets for 58 yards and one touchdown prior to exiting.

news.body: DJ Moore caught 4-of-6 targets for 90 yards and a touchdown in a 31-12 win over the Jets. He rushed for four yards on one attempt.
news.head: DJ Moore finds the end zone in Week 10 win
news.impact: Moore hauled in a 45-yard touchdown reception late in the third quarter to push the Bills' lead to 12. This was a solid bounce back after only accounting for 25 receiving yards against the Vikings. Moore and the Bills will take on the Dolphins in Week 11.

news.body: DJ Moore caught 3-of-5 targets for 25 yards, adding 11 yards on one carry in Monday's 23-6 win over the Vikings.
news.head: DJ Moore totals 36 yards in Monday's win
news.impact: Moore had a big game in his return to action against the Ravens in Week 8. He couldn't replicate the effort in Week 9, but he is healthy and stronger fantasy performances should be on the way. Moore is best viewed as a low-end WR2 or high-end WR3.

news.body: The NFL is not expected to suspend WR DK Metcalf for his actions after he was ejected from Sunday's game against the Eagles.
news.head: DK Metcalf will not be suspended by NFL
news.impact: Metcalf’s actions will still be reviewed as part of the league’s standard discipline process. He could be fined, but he is not expected to be suspended.

news.body: DK Metcalf had one reception for two yards before being ejected from Sunday’s game against the Eagles.
news.head: DK Metcalf has one catch before Week 11 ejection
news.impact: Metcalf was ejected due to two unsportsmanlike conduct penalties and only had one catch prior to his removal. Metcalf has been an unreliable fantasy asset this year, and he is potentially facing additional discipline for his actions on Sunday. If he isn’t suspended for Week 12's game against the Texans, he will be a risky WR3.

news.body: Steelers WR DK Metcalf has been ejected from Sunday’s game due to unsportsmanlike conduct.
news.head: DK Metcalf ejected Sunday
news.impact: Metcalf was involved in a few different issues on the field Sunday, but was ejected after his second personal foul. He finished the game with one reception for two yards on four targets. Metcalf could face a suspension from the league after they review what caused the second personal foul penalty.

news.body: DK Metcalf caught 2-of-6 targets for 54 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 38-18 loss to the Cincinnati Bengals.
news.head: DK Metcalf leads team in receiving Sunday
news.impact: Metcalf ended the game with just two catches, but he was productive with them and was able to finish with 54 yards and a touchdown on the night. His fantasy total was decent in this matchup, but fantasy managers shouldn't expect him to be consistent on a game-to-game basis over the back half of the season.

news.body: Dohnte Meyers caught one of his two targets for two yards in a 22-20 loss to the Commanders in Week 11.
news.head: Dohnte Meyers held to one catch in Week 11
news.impact: Meyers was quiet in the close loss in a game where Joe Burrow spread the ball around to nine different pass-catchers. The rookie wideout will continue to be boom/bust as the No. 3 receiver in Cincinnati. Sitting on 21 catches for 244 yards and one touchdown in 10 games this year, he gets the Saints in Week 12.

news.body: Dohnte Meyers caught two passes for 20 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 38-18 win over the Pittsburgh Steelers.
news.head: Dohnte Meyers scores once in win Sunday
news.impact: Meyers didn't see a lot of work on Sunday, but he was still able to leave his mark on the game by catching a touchdown on one of his two receptions. Fantasy managers shouldn't have high expectations for him moving forward, however.

news.body: Dohnte Meyers caught 2-of-3 targets for 47 yards in a 34-17 win over the Falcons. He rushed for 16 yards on one carry.
news.head: Dohnte Meyers hauls in two passes in Week 9 win
news.impact: Meyers continues to operate as the third wide receiver in the offense, but has not seen more than three targets since Week 4. Fantasy managers can leave the rookie out of starting lineups heading into Week 10.

news.body: Dohnte Meyers caught all three of his targets for 34 yards in a 43-36 overtime win over the Titans in Week 8.
news.head: Dohnte Meyers goes for 34 yards in Week 8
news.impact: Meyers had a solid afternoon as the Bengals' No. 3 receiver. While he won't see much work stuck behind Ja'Marr Chase and Tee Higgins, Meyers has shown that he has enough talent to earn a role in the NFL. He will now prepare to face the Falcons in Week 9.

news.body: The Eagles placed WR Dontayvion Wicks on injured reserve.
news.head: Dontayvion Wicks (ankle/foot) placed on IR
news.impact: Wicks will miss at least the next four games for Philadelphia.

news.body: Dontayvion Wicks (ankle/foot) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Pittsburgh Steelers.
news.head: Dontayvion Wicks (ankle/foot) ruled out for Sunday
news.impact: Wicks has been ruled out for another game on Sunday. He's still recovering from a pair of injuries, and although he seems to be improving, he's not yet where he needs to be to make his return to the lineup. His next chance to play will come on Thanksgiving Day against the Dallas Cowboys.

news.body: Dontayvion Wicks practiced again on Thursday.
news.head: Dontayvion Wicks (ankle) practices Thursday
news.impact: Wicks has practiced on back-to-back days now. He will need to be monitored in practice on Friday.

news.body: Dontayvion Wicks (ankle) is participating at Philadelphia's practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Dontayvion Wicks (ankle) participating at practice Wednesday
news.impact: Wicks is taking part in Philadelphia's practice on Wednesday, which is a big step in the right direction for his Week 11 availability. We won't get an official injury designation for him until later on in the week, however.

news.body: Drake London hauled in six of his team-leading 12 targets for 109 yards in the Falcons' 35-13 Week 10 loss to the Chiefs.
news.head: Drake London surpasses 100 yards in Week 10 loss to Chiefs
news.impact: London has made the most of inconsistent quarterback play, registering five or more receptions in five of his last seven contests. The wideout remains one of the few impactful options on offense for head coach Kevin Stefanski as the team enters its bye week.

news.body: Drake London caught all five of his targets for 68 yards in a 34-17 loss to the Bengals.
news.head: Drake London hauls in five passes in Week 9 loss
news.impact: London lead the Falcons in receiving yards in the loss Sunday. London has been held in check over the last two weeks, posting just 76 receiving yards on six receptions. London and the Falcons will look to bounce back against the Chiefs in Week 10.

news.body: Drake London caught 1-of-6 targets for eight yards in the Falcons 16-0 loss against the Buccaneers.
news.head: Drake London catches one pass Sunday
news.impact: It was a week to forget for the entire Falcons offense as Michael Penix Jr. completed just eight passes all day and threw four interceptions. London remains a WR1 play next week against the Bengals.

news.body: Drake London caught 7-of-10 targets for 66 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 29-20 win over the 49ers.
news.head: Drake London hauls in a touchdown during Week 7 win
news.impact: London finally hit paydirt this season. He's having a great season, but the end zone had simply eluded the fifth-year star over the first six weeks of the campaign. That changed in the fourth quarter of Sunday's upset of the 49ers. London is now averaging 5.4 receptions and 88 yards per game. He is a certain WR1 for fantasy purposes.

news.body: Elic Ayomanor caught 3-of-3 targets for 27 yards in the Titans 51-30 loss against the Cowboys.
news.head: Elic Ayomanor quiet Sunday
news.impact: After Ayomanor had a big performance last week, it was Chimere Dike this time around for the Titans with Carnell Tate back and healthy. He remains a volatile WR4 for fantasy managers.

news.body: Elic Ayomanor caught 5 of 10 targets for 79 yards in the Titans' 40-23 loss to the Jaguars on Sunday.
news.head: Elic Ayomanor goes for 79 yards in loss to Jags
news.impact: Ayomanor has seen 7, 5, and 10 targets in the last three weeks, with 44, 34, and now 79 yards to show for it. It's a bit inefficient; he's caught only 50% of his targets in that span, but nothing terrible in terms of yardage. He's a flex play at best, but only in deep formats.

news.body: Elic Ayomanor caught three of his five targets for 34 yards in a 43-36 overtime loss to the Bengals in Week 8.
news.head: Elic Ayomanor goes for 34 yards in Week 8
news.impact: Ayomanor failed to capitalize on Carnell Tate's absence while Chimere Dike and Gunnar Helm led the way in receiving. The second-year wideout has now caught 13 passes for 211 yards and one touchdown in eight games. He will be on his bye in Week 9.

news.body: Elic Ayomanor caught three of his seven targets for 44 yards in a 27-24 loss to the Browns in Week 7.
news.head: Elic Ayomanor goes for 44 yards in Week 7 loss
news.impact: Ayomanor tied with Carnell Tate for the team lead with seven targets. The three catches go down as Ayomanor's best effort of the season as he's been held to just one catch in five of seven games. He will not be a strong fantasy play heading into Week 8 vs. the Bengals.

news.body: Emeka Egbuka hauled in just two of his five targets for 18 yards in the Buccaneers' 31-21 loss to the Lions in Week 11.
news.head: Emeka Egbuka disappoints in Week 11 loss
news.impact: Egbuka has struggled to make a consistent impact in the Tampa Bay passing attack, finishing under 50 receiving yards in each of his last five games. The wideout remains one of many risky pass-catching options for head coach Todd Bowles ahead of a Week 12 matchup against the Carolina Panthers.

news.body: Emeka Egbuka caught three of his five targets for 38 yards in a 27-24 loss to the Bears in Week 9. He also gained one yard on his lone rush in the loss.
news.head: Emeka Egbuka hauls in three passes in Week 9
news.impact: Egbuka was dealing with a foot injury throughout the week and was listed as questionable for the game before ultimately suiting up. The second-year wideout has 31 catches for 278 yards and two touchdowns in seven games this season. He will be on bye in Week 10 before taking on the Lions in Week 11.

news.body: Emeka Egbuka (foot) will play in Sunday’s matchup between night’s matchup between the Tampa Bay Buccaneers and Chicago Bears according to Ian Rapoport.
news.head: Emeka Egbuka (foot) will play Sunday
news.impact: Egbuka progressed enough throughout the week after being limited to entering it, as the wideout looks to provide quarterback Baker Mayfield with an impactful pass-catching option against the Chicago Bears Sunday night.

news.body: Emeka Egbuka (foot) is officially questionable for Sunday's game against the Chicago Bears.
news.head: Emeka Egbuka (foot) officially questionable for Sunday
news.impact: Egbuka will head into the weekend with a questionable tag. It seems like there's a lot of optimism surrounding his status, but he is officially considered questionable to play at this point. It may be hard for fantasy managers to trust starting him this week, however, especially with him playing on Sunday night after the main slate of games.

news.body: Garrett Wilson caught three of his five targets for 39 yards in a 27-24 win over the Chargers in Week 11.
news.head: Garrett Wilson leads Jets in receiving in Week 11
news.impact: Wilson's modest yardage total was good enough to lead the team in a game where the Jets only attempted 21 passes and threw for 176 yards. Wilson has been a bit boom/bust this season, but he remains a solid fantasy WR2, posting 53 catches for 672 yards and three touchdowns in 10 games. He will be a solid option in Week 12 vs. the Dolphins.

news.body: Garrett Wilson caught 7-of-14 targets for 106 yards in a 31-12 loss to the Bills.
news.head: Garrett Wilson eclipses 100 receiving yards in Week 10
news.impact: Wilson led the team in all receiving categories and logged a season high 14 targets in his return from a one game absence. The Jets did lose QB Geno Smtih to an ankle injury, so Wilson could be catching passes from rookie Cade Klubnik again in Week 11 against the Chargers.

news.body: Jets WR Garrett Wilson (concussion) is officially active for a Week 10 matchup for the Bills.
news.head: Garrett Wilson (concussion) officially active for Week 10
news.impact: Wilson was listed as questionable to play but has cleared concussion protocol in time to suit up against Buffalo. Wilson will likely lead the Jets' passing attack, with Omar Cooper Jr. and Adonai Mitchell also seeing time alongside the Jets' WR1.

news.body: Garrett Wilson is expected to play on Sunday against the Bills.
news.head: Garrett Wilson (concussion) expected to play Sunday
news.impact: Wilson has been trending in the right direction all week. He should be good to go after being sidelined last week.

news.body: George Pickens hauled in five of his nine targets for 67 yards in the Cowboys' 39-38 Week 12 loss to the Eagles.
news.head: George Pickens hauls in five passes in Week 12 loss to Eagles
news.impact: Pickens has been impactful in the Dallas passing attack of late, recording five or more receptions and over 60 receiving yards in each of his last three contests. The wideout remains one of the more explosive options in a high-octane Dallas passing attack entering a difficult Week 13 contest against the Seattle Seahawks.

news.body: George Pickens caught 7-of-10 targets for 102 yards and a touchdown in the Cowboys 51-30 win over the Titans.
news.head: George Pickens catches touchdown Sunday
news.impact: Pickens and CeeDee Lamb each saw double-digit targsts, exceeded 100 yards receiving and hauled in touchdowns on the day. Pickens remains a borderline WR1/WR2 for fantasy managers.

news.body: George Pickens hauled in 11 of his team-leading 18 targets for 145 yards and three touchdowns in the Cowboys' 46-40 Week 10 loss to the 49ers.
news.head: George Pickens hauls in three touchdowns in Week 10 loss to 49ers
news.impact: Pickens has found his way to the end zone of late, scoring one or more touchdowns in three of his last five games. The wideout offers fantasy managers one of the more impactful pass-catching options ahead of a favorable Week 11 contest against the Tennessee Titans.

news.body: George Pickens (hamstring) is officially active for Week 10 for the Dallas Cowboys against the San Francisco 49ers according to Joe Hoyt.
news.head: George Pickens (hamstring) active for Week 10
news.impact: Pickens is good to go after passing through pregame tests without any issues, boosting a Dallas passing attack that will be without TE1 Jake Ferguson (knee/ankle) against the 49ers Sunday.

news.body: Germie Bernard caught six passes for 40 yards in Sunday’s loss to the Eagles.
news.head: Germie Bernard leads team in targets on Sunday
news.impact: Bernard led the Steelers in both receptions and targets on Sunday, where he appeared to be Aaron Rodgers’ go-to target throughout the game. Bernard has not demonstrated consistency since his Week 6 breakout versus the Bucs, so he won’t be a reliable fantasy asset unless DK Metcalf faces suspension from the NFL.

news.body: Germie Bernard didn't haul in any of his three targets in Sunday's 38-18 loss to the Cincinnati Bengals.
news.head: Germie Bernard held without catch in loss Sunday
news.impact: The rookie was locked down on Sunday night. He saw three targets over the course of the game but couldn't haul in any of them, leaving him with a goose egg in most categories on the stat sheet. He should not be started in any league formats for the foreseeable future.

news.body: Germie Bernard caught 5-of-5 targets for 30 yards in the Steelers 27-6 win over the Browns.
news.head: Germie Bernard catches five passes Sunday
news.impact: Bernard hauled in all five targets that went his way. He remains in the WR3/WR4 range for fantasy managers while Michael Pittman and Roman Wilson both remain sidelined.

news.body: Germie Bernard caught three of five targets for 27 yards in the Steelers' 16-10 win over the Saints on Sunday.
news.head: Germie Bernard snags three passes in win over Saints
news.impact: After two great weeks in a row, Bernard was largely held in check by the Saints defense in this one, limited to three short yardage catches. There will be better days ahead, but one thing to keep note of is that the Steelers will have to start getting him some space downfield rather than the short dink-and-dunk targets he's had recently.

news.body: The Cardinals signed WR Harrison Wallace III to their active roster.
news.head: Harrison Wallace III signs with Cardinals' active roster
news.impact: Wallace gets the opportunity with Kendrick Bourne placed on injured reserve. He signed with Arizona as a UDFA.

news.body: The Cardinals signed Ole Miss WR Harrison Wallace III as an undrafted free agent.
news.head: Harrison Wallace III signs with Cardinals as UDFA
news.impact: Wallace finished out his collegiate career at Ole Miss after four years at Penn State. He totaled 934 yards and four touchdowns. He'll compete for a depth role at the next level.

news.body: Isaac TeSlaa failed to catch his lone target in the Lions' 39-35 loss to the Bears in Week 12.
news.head: Isaac TeSlaa sees one target in Week 12
news.impact: TeSlaa has struggled to make an impact in the Detroit offense of late, registering less than 20 receiving yards in each of his last seven contests. The wideout can remain off rosters in all formats ahead of a Week 13 contest against the Atlanta Falcons.

news.body: Isaac TeSlaa failed to catch any of his three targets in the Lions' 31-21 win over the Buccaneers in Week 11.
news.head: Isaac TeSlaa sees three targets in Week 11
news.impact: TeSlaa has struggled to make an impact in the Detroit passing attack of late, recording less than 20 receiving yards in each of his last six games. The wideout remains difficult to trust despite flashing explosive potential at times, with a Week 12 contest against the Chicago Bears up next.

news.body: Isaac TeSlaa caught two of his five targets for 19 yards and a touchdown in a 35-10 win over the Patriots in Munich in Week 10.
news.head: Isaac TeSlaa catches TD in Week 10
news.impact: TeSlaa hauled in a 12-yard touchdown in the second quarter, his first TD of the season. The veteran wideout has been sparingly used as Detroit's No. 3 receiver this season, catching 13 passes for 225 yards in nine games. He will now prepare to face the Buccaneers in Week 11.

news.body: Isaac TeSlaa caught one of his two targets for nine yards in the Lions' 19-9 win over the Dolphins in Week 9.
news.head: Isaac TeSlaa quiet in Week 9 win
news.impact: TeSlaa has made minimal impact on offense of late, finishing with 10 receiving yards or less in each of his last four contests. The wideout remains one of the more streaky pass-catching options with plenty of explosive potential heading into a Week 10 contest against the New England Patriots.

news.body: Jack Bech caught eight of nine targets for 88 yards and one touchdown in the Raiders' 38-24 loss to the Broncos in Week 11.
news.head: Jack Bech records 88 yards and a touchdown in Week 11
news.impact: With Brock Bowers inactive, Bech led Las Vegas with eight receptions and accounted for a third of Fernando Mendoza's passing yards. He also caught a seven-yard touchdown in the fourth quarter. Tre Tucker saw one more target than Bech but caught six fewer passes. It'll be interesting to see if Bech can sustain this level of involvement once Bowers returns. The second-year receiver is worth adding off waivers.

news.body: Jack Bech caught 2-of-7 targets for 10 yards in the Raiders 21-13 loss against the Seahawks.
news.head: Jack Bech sees seven targets Sunday
news.impact: It did not result in much production, but Bech led the Raiders in targets in the first start for Fernando Mendoza. If Brock Bowers misses time, Bech could be worth a look on waivers in deeper leagues.

news.body: The Raiders are expected to activate Jack Bech from injured reserve on Sunday.
news.head: Jack Bech (forearm) expected to be activated Sunday
news.impact: Bech been recovering from a fractured forearm. He remains listed as questionable.

news.body: Jack Bech is listed as questionable for Sunday’s game against the Jets.
news.head: Jack Bech (forearm) listed questionable Sunday
news.impact: Bech practiced in full all week. It is unclear if he will be activated for Sunday.

news.body: Ja'Kobi Lane did not record a target in a 35-33 loss to Carolina.
news.head: Ja'Kobi Lane not targeted in Week 11 loss
news.impact: Lane was targeted 11 times in Monday's loss to the Chargers, but did not have a ball thrown his way in the loss Sunday. Fantasy managers may need to consider sitting Lane until his target share becomes clear and more consistent.

news.body: Ja'Kobi Lane caught 3-of-11 targets for 61 yards in Monday night's 23-20 loss to the Los Angeles Chargers.
news.head: Ja'Kobi Lane solid in loss Monday
news.impact: The rookie saw the most targets out of anybody on the team on Monday night. He was only able to bring in three of them, however, but he was still able to finish with a solid 61 yards over the course of the game. He will have fantasy value if he continues to be targeted at this rate moving forward, but that's far from a guarantee.

news.body: Ja'Kobi Lane was held without a catch in the Ravens' 33-10 loss to the Jaguars on Thursday.
news.head: Ja'Kobi Lane held without a catch in loss
news.impact: Lane has only one catch in the last two games, but it's hard to take away much from Thursday's game, where the Ravens only had 10 completions, and their leading receiver had only 19 yards. So don't lose hope on Lane just yet.

news.body: Ja'Kobi Lane caught his lone target for 13 yards in a 36-10 loss to the Bills.
news.head: Ja'Kobi Lane held to one reception in Week 8
news.impact: Lane's one target sets a new season low for the rookie. The passing attack was clearly not the same after losing both Lamar Jackson and Tyler Huntley to injury. Fantasy managers should expect Lane and the passing game to struggle if Huntley is unable to play in Week 9.

news.body: Jakobi Meyers is off the injury report for Sunday's game against the Titans.
news.head: Jakobi Meyers (ankle) off injury report for Week 12
news.impact: Meyers will figure to step into a bigger role with Parker Washington ruled out for the Jaguars.

news.body: Jakobi Meyers remained limited in practice on Thursday.
news.head: Jakobi Meyers (ankle) limited in practice Thursday
news.impact: Meyers is trending towards being good to go for Sunday's game against the Titans.

news.body: Jakobi Meyers was limited in practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Jakobi Meyers (ankle) limited in practice Wednesday
news.impact: Meyers has continued to play through an ankle injury.

news.body: Jakobi Meyers caught four of ten targets for 85 yards in the Jaguars' 23-18 loss to the Giants on Sunday.
news.head: Jakobi Meyers goes for 85 yards in loss
news.impact: Meyers played second fiddle to Parker Washington in this contest, coming in second in targets, receptions, and yards on the team. It would have been nice to see Lawrence connect with Meyers once or twice more, but it is what it is. He should continue to operate as the WR2 of the team, but expect closer to 6-7 targets rather than the 10 he got on Sunday. He will face off against the Titans next week.

news.body: Jalen Coker caught 4-of-7 targets for 47 yards in a 35-33 win over the Ravens.
news.head: Jalen Coker hauls in four passes in Week 11 win
news.impact: Coker needed a bounce back performance after failing to record a catch last week. He did leave the game late and is now in the concussion protocol. He will need to clear the protocol before being able to suit up against the Buccaneers in Week 12.

news.body: Jalen Coker did not record a reception on four targets in a 20-17 win over the Saints. He tallied three rushing yards on one carry.
news.head: Jalen Coker fails to record a reception in Week 10
news.impact: Coker was held without a reception for the first time this season. Coker is dealing with a healthy wide receiver and tight end group, which could impact his targets moving forward. Coker and the Panthers will take on the Ravens in Week 11.

news.body: Jalen Coker caught four of five targets for 29 yards while losing three yards on his lone rushing attempt in the Panthers' 26-21 loss to the Broncos in Week 9.
news.head: Jalen Coker records 29 receiving yards in Week 9
news.impact: Coker caught four passes, but averaged just 7.3 yards per reception. Meanwhile, Darren Waller and Tetairoa McMillan combined for 146 receiving yards and two touchdowns. Coker continues to receive opportunities, but his production isn't enough to warrant a fantasy start in shallow leagues.

news.body: Jalen Coker caught just 2-of-5 targets for 36 yards, but scored a touchdown in Thursday's 27-19 loss to the Packers.
news.head: Jalen Coker hits paydirt in Thursday's loss
news.impact: Unfortunately for fantasy managers, Coker was hit with a lost fumble on an errant lateral attempt during the Panthers' last-ditch play of regulation. Still, Coker salvaged what could've been a second straight frustrating performance with a 26-yard TD play in the fourth quarter. The third-year wideout has been inconsistent on a weekly basis to this point, but he's got significant upside each time he takes the field. He's a WR3 in most standard formats.

news.body: Jalen Nailor caught one of five targets for 16 yards in the Raiders' 38-24 loss to the Broncos in Week 11.
news.head: Jalen Nailor held to one reception in Week 11
news.impact: Nailor had two would-be touchdowns negated by penalties Sunday. The former came via offensive pass interference, while Fernando Mendoza crossed the line of scrimmage before throwing the latter. So, the box score doesn't tell the entire story here. That said, Nailor remains difficult to start with Jack Bech and Tre Tucker combining for 19 targets.

news.body: Jalen Nailor caught 2-of-4 targets for nine yards in the Raiders 38-17 loss against the 49ers.
news.head: Jalen Nailor quiet Sunday
news.impact: Nailor remains off the fantasy radar in his current role.

news.body: Jalen Nailor caught 4-of-4 targets for 38 yards and a touchdown in a 38-33 win over the Jets.
news.head: Jalen Nailor hits pay dirt in Week 8 win
news.impact: Nailor found the end zone on a two-yard reception early in the fourth quarter to give the Raiders the lead. This marked his best game of the season, setting a new season-high in receptions and logging his first touchdown of the season. Nailor and the Raiders will take on the 49ers in Week 9.

news.body: Jalen Nailor caught two of his five targets for 14 yards in the Raiders' 35-21 Week 7 loss to the Los Angeles Rams.
news.head: Jalen Nailor dismal in Week 7
news.impact: Nailor remains minimally involved in the Las Vegas passing attack, recording less than 30 receiving yards in each of seven contests. The wideout remains difficult to trust in all formats ahead of a Week 8 contest against the New York Jets.

news.body: Ja'Marr Chase caught five of his nine targets for 31 yards in a 22-20 loss to the Commanders in Week 11.
news.head: Ja'Marr Chase held to 31 yards in Week 11
news.impact: Chase led the team in targets but was unable to get much going on a rainy night, averaging just 6.2 yards per catch. The star wideout now has 69 catches for 909 yards and seven touchdowns through 10 games this year. He will be a top-three fantasy WR in Week 12 vs. the Saints.

news.body: Ja'Marr Chase hauled in 11-of-14 targets for a whopping 231 yards in Sunday night's 38-18 win over the Pittsburgh Steelers.
news.head: Ja'Marr Chase racks up whopping 231 yards Sunday
news.impact: Chase was unstoppable on Sunday night. He racked up a whopping 231 receiving yards on 11 catches, which left him with a dominant fantasy total despite the fact that he didn't get into the end zone at all. He is heating up right now after a slightly slow start to the season and is primed to be one of the best players in fantasy over the back half of the year.

news.body: Ja'Marr Chase caught 10-of-12 targets for 155 yards and a touchdown in the Bengals' 34-17 win over the Falcons.
news.head: Ja'Marr Chase hauls in 10 passes in Week 9 win
news.impact: Chase led the team in receptions, targets, and receiving yards in the win. Chase and Joe Burrow connected on a 47-yard touchdown to open the scoring. The 26-year-old has found the end zone in four straight games, and will look to continue that streak against the Steelers in Week 10.

news.body: Ja'Marr Chase caught 11 of his 16 targets for 141 yards and a touchdown in a 43-36 overtime win over the Titans in Week 8.
news.head: Ja'Marr Chase goes for 141 yards, TD in Week 8 win
news.impact: Chase turned in a huge game in the high-scoring win, although he still finished behind Tee Higgins in receiving yardage on an afternoon where Joe Burrow threw for 462 yards. Chase has scored a touchdown in three straight games, giving him six overall this year. He will be a no-brainer WR1 in fantasy heading into Week 9 vs. the Falcons.

news.body: Jameson Williams hauled in six of nine targets for 68 yards while also rushing once for 12 yards in the Lions' 39-35 Week 12 loss to the Bears.
news.head: Jameson Williams hauls in six passes in Week 12 loss to Bears
news.impact: Williams has been impactful in the Detroit passing attack of late, recording 50 or more receiving yards in six of his last eight games. The wideout continues to flash explosive potential as one of the more dynamic pass-catching options for head coach Dan Campbell ahead of a Week 13 matchup against the Atlanta Falcons.
