news.body: Jameson Williams hauled in each of his four targets for a team-leading 93 receiving yards and one touchdown in the Lions' 31-21 Week 11 win over the Buccaneers.
news.head: Jameson Williams finds end zone in Week 11 win over Buccaneers
news.impact: Williams has had a nose for the end zone of late, recording one or more receiving touchdowns in four of his last six games. The wideout will look to showcase his explosive potential in a tough divisional matchup against the Chicago Bears in Week 12.

news.body: Jameson Williams caught four of his seven targets for 50 yards in a 35-10 win over the Patriots in Munich in Week 10.
news.head: Jameson Williams goes for 50 yards in Week 10 win
news.impact: Williams finished second on the team in targets in the lopsided win while hitting at least 50 receiving yards for the fourth time over his past six contests. He will be a boom/bust WR3 for fantasy heading into Week 11 vs. the Buccaneers.

news.body: Jameson Williams hauled in one of his two targets for 31 yards while also rushing once for nine yards in the Lions' 19-9 Week 9 win over the Dolphins.
news.head: Jameson Williams sees two touches in Week 9 win
news.impact: Williams was bottled up by an underrated Miami defense, finishing with less than 50 receiving yards for the first time in his last six games. The wideout will look to return to his explosive form against the New England Patriots in Week 10.

news.body: Jauan Jennings caught 3-of-6 targets for 20 yards in Sunday night's 35-10 loss to the 49ers.
news.head: Jauan Jennings finishes with three receptions Sunday night
news.impact: After missing the past two weeks, Jennings returned to the field against his former team Sunday night. The veteran receiver still didn't accomplish much for the Vikings despite playing over 75% of the offensive snaps. Jennings has largely been a non-factor this season.

news.body: Jauan Jennings (calf) logged a full practice session on Wednesday.
news.head: Jauan Jennings (calf) logs full practice Wednesday
news.impact: Jennings was able to log a full practice session on Wednesday, putting him squarely on track to make his return this week after being sidelined by a calf issue last week. He still isn't expected to be fantasy relevant for the foreseeable future, however.

news.body: Jauan Jennings (calf) took part in Minnesota's practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Jauan Jennings (calf) practices Wednesday
news.impact: A calf injury left Jennings sidelined last week, but he was able to take part in Minnesota's practice on Wednesday, although it's still unclear in what capacity. His Week 11 status will likely be determined later in the week as the team evaluates his health after a few days of practice.

news.body: Jauan Jennings has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Packers.
news.head: Jauan Jennings (calf) ruled out Sunday
news.impact: Jennings remains off the fantasy radar when he is healthy.

news.body: Jaxon Smith-Njigba (ankle) is off of the injury report for Week 12 for the Seattle Seahawks against the San Francisco 49ers according to Gregg Bell.
news.head: Jaxon Smith-Njigba (ankle) off injury report for Week 12
news.impact: Smith-Njigba is good to go after progressing throughout the practice week, with the dynamic wideout facing a stiff test in Week 12.

news.body: Jaxon Smith-Njigba was limited in practice on Thursday.
news.head: Jaxon Smith-Njigba (ankle) limited in practice Thursday
news.impact: Smith-Njigba has logged back-to-back limited practices. He should be on track to be good to go for Sunday's game against the 49ers.

news.body: Jaxon Smith-Njigba was limited in practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Jaxon Smith-Njigba (ankle) limited in practice Wednesday
news.impact: Smith-Njigba is managing an ankle issue. He'll need to be monitored in practice the rest of the week.

news.body: Jaxon Smith-Njigba caught 8-of-10 targsts for 171 yards and a touchdown in the Seahawks 21-13 win over the Raiders.
news.head: Jaxon Smith-Njigba explodes in third quarter Sunday
news.impact: Smith-Njigba entered halftime with just 11 yards before exploding for a huge third quarter that included a 71-yard touchdown reception plus other gains of 30 and 23 yards. He remains a locked and loaded WR1.

news.body: Jaylen Waddle caught three of six targets for 61 yards in the Broncos' 38-24 win over the Raiders in Week 11.
news.head: Jaylen Waddle records 61 receiving yards in Week 11
news.impact: Waddle returned from the concussion he suffered in Week 9 and averaged 20.3 yards per reception Sunday. He led Denver's wide receivers in targets, receptions and receiving yards. That said, three of Denver's four offensive touchdowns came on the ground. Waddle remains the Broncos only wide receiver to start in fantasy heading into Week 12 against Pittsburgh.

news.body: Jaylen Waddle was a full participant in practice on Thursday.
news.head: Jaylen Waddle (concussion) logs full practice Thursday
news.impact: Waddle has logged back-to-back full practices despite remaining in the concussion protocol.

news.body: Jaylen Waddle caught his only target for 22 yards before exiting the Broncos' 26-21 win over the Panthers in Week 9 with a concussion.
news.head: Jaylen Waddle suffers concussion in Week 9
news.impact: Waddle suffered the injury on a hit from Panthers safety Zakee Wheatley while attempting to make a reception downfield. He was subsequently ruled out for the remainder of the game. Meanwhile, Courtland Sutton saw nine targets, while Pat Bryant caught four passes for 56 yards and a touchdown. Denver enters its Week 10 bye, giving Waddle additional time to clear the concussion protocol before facing the Raiders in Week 11. His availability remains uncertain.

news.body: Jaylen Waddle (concussion) has been ruled out for the remainder of Denver’s game against the Panthers on Sunday.
news.head: Jaylen Waddle (concussion) ruled out for remainder of Sunday
news.impact: Waddle was hit hard while trying to make a leaping grab, and eventually found his way to the medical tent and locker room to be examined for a concussion. Tough break for the talented receiver.

news.body: Jerry Jeudy caught 2-of-4 targets for 74 yards in Sunday's 27-24 win over the Texans.
news.head: Jerry Jeudy goes over 70 yards receiving in Sunday's win
news.impact: Most of Jeudy's production Sunday came on a season-long 65-yard gain late in the second quarter. The veteran receiver has now caught multiple passes in six of the last seven games, but he's topped out at four. Overall, Jeudy has 20 receptions at just over 14 yards per with no touchdowns through 10 games.

news.body: Jerry Jeudy caught two of four targets for 37 yards in the Browns' 23-22 loss to the Saints on Sunday.
news.head: Jerry Jeudy snags two passes in loss
news.impact: Jeudy was able to reignite some of the 2025 chemistry he had with Shedeur Sanders, but he was still fourth on the team in yards and receptions. He's not startable in any format.

news.body: Jerry Jeudy did not catch his lone target in the Browns 27-6 loss against the Steelers.
news.head: Jerry Jeudy held without catch Sunday
news.impact: Jeudy remains off the fantasy radar.

news.body: Jerry Jeudy caught all four of his targets for 21 yards in a 27-24 win over the Titans in Week 7.
news.head: Jerry Jeudy catches four balls in Week 7 win
news.impact: Jeudy was quiet in the close win as he was held under 30 receiving yards for the fifth time in seven games this season. The veteran wideout will not be a recommended fantasy option heading into Week 8 vs. the Steelers.

news.body: Jordan Addison (thumb) has been ruled out for Sunday’s contest between the Minnesota Vikings and Atlanta Falcons according to Ben Goessling.
news.head: Jordan Addison (thumb) ruled out for Week 12
news.impact: Addison continues to work back from a thumb injury for head coach Kevin O’Connell, with Tai Felton, Jauan Jennings, and Myles Price to see increased snaps behind WR1 Justin Jefferson against the Falcons.

news.body: Jordan Addison did not practice on Thursday.
news.head: Jordan Addison (thumb) misses practice Thursday
news.impact: Addison is trending towards missing another game on Sunday against the Falcons.

news.body: Jordan Addison was estimated as a "DNP" in practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Jordan Addison (thumb) estimated as DNP in practice Wednesday
news.impact: It is only a walkthrough on Wednesday for the Vikings. Addison will need to continue to be monitored in practice the rest of the week.

news.body: Jordan Addison has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the 49ers.
news.head: Jordan Addison (thumb) ruled out Sunday
news.impact: Addison remains week-to-week.

news.body: Jordan Tyson hauled in one of his two targets for six yards while also rushing once for four yards in the Saints' 21-13 Week 11 loss to the Bears.
news.head: Jordyn Tyson bottled up in Week 11 loss
news.impact: Tyson has battled inconsistent output in the New Orleans offense since returning from injury, finishing with 30 or less receiving yards in two of his three contests. The rookie pass-catcher remains difficult to trust entering a Week 12 matchup against the Cincinnati Bengals.

news.body: Jordyn Tyson caught 11-of-13 targets for 80 yards in a 20-17 loss to the Panthers.
news.head: Jordyn Tyson hauls in 11 passes in Week 10 loss
news.impact: Tyson made his season debut last week and immediately saw more playing time in his second career game. There were reports prior to the game that he was working with the first team offense in pregame warmups, and will likely continue to see plenty of targets moving forward. Tyson and the Saints will take on the Bears in Week 11.

news.body: Saints coach Kellen Moore said Jordyn Tyson should get “a healthy dose more” snaps in Week 10 against the Panthers.
news.head: Jordyn Tyson to get 'a healthy dose more' snaps in Week 10
news.impact: Tyson is not on the injury report to begin the week. He will be an upside WR3/flex play for fantasy managers.

news.body: Jordyn Tyson caught four of five targets for 30 yards in the Saints' 23-22 win over the Browns on Sunday.
news.head: Jordyn Tyson snags four passes in NFL debut
news.impact: Tyson was second on the team in targets and receptions behind Chris Olave, great for an NFL debut and for coming off of an injury. He should only get better as he gets up to game speed and gets acclimated to the offense.

news.body: Josh Cameron caught three of four targets for 44 yards in the Jaguars' 23-18 loss to the Giants on Sunday.
news.head: Josh Cameron snags three passes in loss
news.impact: Cameron was third on the team in targets and yards, and tied for third in receptions. He's carved out a role for himself in the Jaguars offense, albeit a small one. He's not flex-worthy as of now, but could be in the future.

news.body: Josh Cameron caught all three of his targets for 67 yards and a touchdown in the Jaguars' 40-23 win over the Titans on Sunday.
news.head: Josh Cameron breaks out for touchdown in win over Titans
news.impact: Cameron had not had more than a single catch in three straight games, but exploded for a long touchdown reception in this contest. He's someone to keep an eye on for the future and in dynasty, but isn't relevant for redraft purposes.

news.body: Josh Cameron secured 3-of-6 targets for 43 yards in Sunday's 19-17 win over the Eagles.
news.head: Josh Cameron hauls in three passes Sunday
news.impact: Cameron has quickly carved himself out a role among Jaguars pass catchers. The sixth-round rookie out of Baylor has now come up with 5-of-8 targets for 85 yards over the last two weeks, including gains of 29 and 32 yards. Cameron set new career highs in receptions and targets in Week 5, outpacing both Jakobi Meyers and Brian Thomas Jr.

news.body: Josh Cameron caught both of his targets for 20 yards and a touchdown in the Jaguars' 34-10 win over the Browns on Sunday.
news.head: Josh Cameron snags touchdown in NFL debut
news.impact: The rookie receiver had the wonderful experience of catching a touchdown in his first-ever regular-season game. However, it's hard to take much from it for fantasy, as the Jaguars' passing attack is incredibly spread out and Cameron is buried on the depth chart. His usage might trend up as the season goes along, and he's at least a name to monitor for dynasty formats. But don't expect anything big in the short term.

news.body: Josh Downs caught 4-of-5 targets for 59 yards in a 34-7 win over the Cardinals.
news.head: Josh Downs hauls in four passes in Week 11
news.impact: Downs has posted similar lines in his first two outings with the Chiefs, logging five targets in each game. As he continues to become for comfortable in the offense, fantasy managers should expect Downs to earn more targets from Patrick Mahomes.

news.body: Josh Downs hauled in four of his five targets for 53 yards and one touchdown in the Chiefs' 35-13 Week 10 win over the Falcons.
news.head: Josh Downs finds end zone in Week 10 win
news.impact: Downs took advantage of his first game action since being acquired at the trade deadline, finishing third in targets, receptions, and yards in the win. The wideout offers quarterback Patrick Mahomes another speedy pass-catching option in the Kansas City offense entering a Week 11 contest against the Arizona Cardinals.

news.body: The Colts are trading wide receiver Josh Downs to the Chiefs.
news.head: Josh Downs traded to Chiefs
news.impact: Downs had requested a trade and now officially gets his request as he joins Patrick Mahomes and Kansas City. The Chiefs were looking to address their wide receiver room and they do so here bringing in Downs. He should be the No. 2 target for Mahomes behind Rashee Rice.

news.body: Josh Downs caught three of his six targets for 24 yards in a 27-23 loss to the Cowboys in Week 9.
news.head: Josh Downs goes for 24 yards in Week 9
news.impact: Downs was quiet in what could be his final game with the Colts as trade rumors have popped up surrounding the slot receiver. If Downs ultimately ends up staying in Indy, he will go up against the Dolphins in Week 10.

news.body: Justin Jefferson hauled in 7-of-9 passes for 86 yards in Sunday's 35-10 loss to the 49ers.
news.head: Justin Jefferson grabs seven passes in Week 11 loss
news.impact: A week after recording a season-high nine receptions, Jefferson followed up with another strong showing. With Kirk Cousins back at the helm of the Vikings' offense in those two games, Jefferson's production has stepped up as expected. The star receiver has secured 16-of-22 passes for 160 yards in that span. He's a WR2 at minimum headed into the stretch run.

news.body: Justin Jefferson hauled in nine of his team-leading 13 targets for 74 yards in the Vikings' 30-10 Week 10 win over the Packers.
news.head: Justin Jefferson leads pass-catchers in Week 10 win over Packers
news.impact: Jefferson took advantage of the return of quarterback Kirk Cousins behind center, recording over 70 receiving yards for the second time in his last five games. The superstar wideout will look to return to his dynamic WR1 form with more competent quarterback play behind center ahead of a Week 11 matchup against the San Francisco 49ers.

news.body: Justin Jefferson hauled in only 3-of-11 targets for 58 yards in Monday's 23-6 loss to the Bills.
news.head: Justin Jefferson catches three passes in Week 9 loss
news.impact: Jefferson is one of the league's top talents at wide receiver. Still, the Vikings' inept quarterback play so far this season has turned the All-Pro into an inconsistent, boom-or-bust asset for fantasy managers. Jefferson is in the low-end WR2 discussion at present, but if the Vikings can figure things out at QB, he would fly back up the rankings.

news.body: Justin Jefferson hauled in five of his nine targets for 33 yards and one touchdown in the Vikings' 19-15 Week 8 loss to the Lions.
news.head: Justin Jefferson finds end zone in Week 8 loss to Lions
news.impact: Jefferson made the most of an otherwise forgettable performance, scoring a touchdown for the second time in four contests despite recording less than 45 receiving yards in three of his last four contests. The wideout has fallen victim to underwhelming quarterback play to this point ahead of a Week 9 matchup against the Buffalo Bills.

news.body: Kalif Raymond caught three of his five targets for 20 yards in the Bears' 39-35 win over the Lions in Week 12.
news.head: Kalif Raymond catches three passes in Week 12
news.impact: Raymond has underwhelmed in the Chicago passing attack, finishing with under 35 receiving yards in each of his last eight games. The speedy wideout cannot be trusted as a reliable pass-catching option at this point ahead of a Week 13 contest against the Jacksonville Jaguars.

news.body: Kalif Raymond caught one of his four targets for 14 yards in the Bears' 21-13 win over the Saints in Week 11.
news.head: Kalif Raymond quiet in Week 11
news.impact: Raymond has underwhelmed in the Chicago offense of late, recording less than 35 receiving yards in each of his last seven contests. The speedy wideout remains difficult to trust entering a Week 12 contest against the Detroit Lions.

news.body: Kalif Raymond caught four of his seven targets for 32 yards in a 27-24 win over the Buccaneers in Week 9.
news.head: Kalif Raymond catches four passes in Week 9
news.impact: Raymond posted his best receiving game since Week 3 when he had six catches for 90 yards against the Eagles. The veteran wideout has 32 catches for 290 yards and one touchdown in nine games for the Bears this season. Settling in as a low-end flex in fantasy after a hot start to the year, Raymond will be on bye in Week 10 before a Week 11 matchup against the Saints.

news.body: Kalif Raymond caught 2-of-3 targets for 14 yards in Monday's 34-17 win over the Seattle Seahawks.
news.head: Kalif Raymond underwhelming in win Monday
news.impact: The veteran wasn't able to contribute much on Monday, catching just two passes in a win over the Seahawks. He remains off of the fantasy radar moving forward, even if he is capable of having a boom game every so often.

news.body: KC Concepcion Jr. hauled in 3-of-8 targets for 21 yards and scored on a six-yard run in Sunday's 27-24 win over the Texans.
news.head: KC Concepcion Jr. finds the end zone on the ground Sunday
news.impact: Concepcion had a five-game low in receiving yards on Sunday, but he made up for it with his one rushing attempt. The first-round rookie has now caught at least three passes in 8-of-10 games this season. Concepcion has also scored in each of the last two weeks.

news.body: KC Concepcion Jr. caught four of six targets for 85 yards and a touchdown in the Browns' 23-22 overtime loss to the Saints on Sunday.
news.head: KC Concepcion Jr. explodes for long touchdown in loss
news.impact: Concepcion had a 64-yard score where he took a deep pass from Shedeur Sanders to the house. He did have a non-contact injury and hobbled off the field, but he came back in and caught his touchdown afterwards. Managers will need to monitor his status in practice this week to see if it pops up.

news.body: KC Concepcion Jr. caught 3-of-4 targets for 37 yards in the Browns 27-6 loss against the Steelers.
news.head: KC Concepcion Jr. totals 37 yards Sunday
news.impact: Concepcion was quiet compared to last week when he exploded for 129 yards. He'll remain a volatile WR3/WR4 for fantasy managers.

news.body: KC Concepcion Jr. caught eight of his 10 targets for 129 yards in a 27-24 win over the Titans in Week 7.
news.head: KC Concepcion Jr. explodes for eight catches, 129 yards in Week 7
news.impact: The rookie easily turned in his best game as a pro as he dominated the Titans in the close win. Concepcion came into the game with just 186 receiving yards on the year and came close to doubling that total while leading the Browns in all receiving categories against Tennessee. He will be a WR3 heading into Week 8 vs. the Steelers.

news.body: Keenan Allen caught 3-of-4 targets for 38 yards in Sunday's 35-10 win over the Vikings.
news.head: Keenan Allen finishes with three receptions Sunday night
news.impact: Playing in his second game since being traded to the 49ers, Allen was plenty involved in the passing attack. However, his targets dropped from seven to four with Mike Evans returning from injury. Allen is in the WR4/Flex range in standard formats.

news.body: Keenan Allen caught five of his seven targets for 61 yards in the 49ers' 46-40 Week 10 win over the Cowboys.
news.head: Keenan Allen catches five passes in Week 10 win
news.impact: Allen was impactful in his first game action since being acquired from the Colts, logging over 60 receiving yards for the third time in his last five contests. The veteran wideout offers head coach Kyle Shanahan another stable pass-catching option as part of an injury-riddled wideout room entering a Week 11 matchup against the Minnesota Vikings.

news.body: The Colts are trading WR Keenan Allen to the 49ers for a 2027 sixth-round pick
news.head: Keenan Allen traded to 49ers
news.impact: With Mike Evans still sidelined and Deebo Samuel working his way back to practice this week, San Francisco adds depth to its wide receiver room with a veteran in Allen. He is likely to remain off the fantasy radar unless both Evans and Samuel continue to miss time.

news.body: Keenan Allen caught four of his eight targets for 26 yards in a 27-23 loss to the Cowboys in Week 9.
news.head: Keenan Allen hauls in four passes in Week 9
news.impact: Allen led the team with his eight targets but wasn't able to do much with the opportunities. The veteran wideout has emerged as one of Daniel Jones' favorite targets this season, catching 40 passes for 351 yards and one touchdown in eight games. Allen will be a flex option in Week 10 vs. the Dolphins.

news.body: Keon Coleman caught 2-of-4 targets for 17 yards in the Bills 26-9 win over the Dolphins.
news.head: Keon Coleman quiet Sunday
news.impact: It was DJ Moore and Khalil Shakir who far and away led the way for the Bills wide receiver room. He remains off the fantasy radar.

news.body: Keon Coleman caught 1-of-3 targets for 11 yards in a 31-12 win over the Jets.
news.head: Keon Coleman limited to one reception in Week 10
news.impact: Coleman did leave the game temporarily to be evaluated for a head injury. Coleman has seen at least three targets but has failed to do much with them. The 23-year-old will look to bounce back against Miami in Week 11.

news.body: Keon Coleman caught 3-of-6 targets for 17 yards in Monday's 23-6 win over the Vikings.
news.head: Keon Coleman finishes with three receptions Monday night
news.impact: Coleman has had a few strong games this season. He even had a stretch of three straight weeks with a touchdown. Since then, Coleman has managed only four receptions for 21 yards over the last two games. The third-year receiver is just unreliable from a fantasy standpoint.

news.body: Keon Coleman caught 1-of-3 targets for four yards in a 36-10 win over the Ravens.
news.head: Keon Coleman held to one reception in Week 8
news.impact: Coleman saw a major drop off from his six targets last week. With his inconsistent usage this season, fantasy managers should look elsewhere against the Vikings in Week 9.

news.body: Khalil Shakir caught 5-of-9 targets for 101 yards in the Bills 26-9 win over the Dolphins.
news.head: Khalil Shakir totals 101 yards Sunday
news.impact: Shakir hauled in two big gains for 38 yards and 32 yards on the day. He remains a steady WR3/flex play for fantasy managers.

news.body: Khalil Shakir caught 2-of-3 targets for 26 yards in a 31-12 win over the Jets. He added 29 rushing yards on three carries.
news.head: Khalil Shakir hauls in two passes in Week 10 win
news.impact: Shakir was one of five Bills' pass catchers to record at least three targets in the win over the Jets. His 26 receiving yards are his lowest since Week 3 against the Chargers. Shakir and the Bills will take on Miami in Week 11.

news.body: Khalil Shakir brought down all four of his targets for 58 yards in Monday's 23-6 win over the Vikings.
news.head: Khalil Shakir leads Bills in receiving Monday night
news.impact: Shakir tied for the team lead in catches and topped the Bills in receiving yards Monday night. Shakir has now caught four or more passes in four of the last five games, averaging 4.6 receptions and 63.6 yards per game in that span.

news.body: Khalil Shakir caught 5-of-6 targets for 64 yards in a 36-10 win over the Ravens.
news.head: Khalil Shakir hauls in five passes in Week 8 win
news.impact: Shakir has seen back-to-back games with at least six targets and has logged at least four receptions in each of those games. Shakir and the Bills will take on a tough Vikings' defense in Week 9.

news.body: Konata Mumpfield hauled in four of his team-leading five targets for 69 yards in the Rams' 26-13 Week 12 win over the Packers.
news.head: Konata Mumpfield leads pass-catchers in Week 12 win over Packers
news.impact: Mumpfield has taken advantage of a larger pass-catching role of late, logging over 60 receiving yards in each of his last two games. The wideout could be pushed back to a WR2 role with the potential return of Davante Adams entering a Week 13 matchup against the Kansas City Chiefs.

news.body: Konata Mumpfield caught 3-of-4 targets for 81 yards in the Rams 34-6 win over the Cardinals.
news.head: Konata Mumpfield totals 81 yards Sunday
news.impact: With the Rams wide receiver room depleted, it was Mumpfield who led the way for them. He had two big gains of 45 and 27 yards. He'll hold WR3/flex upside out of the Rams bye week if Davante Adams remains sidelined.

news.body: Konata Mumpfield had two catches for 20 yards in Sunday's win over the Commanders.
news.head: Konata Mumpfield snags two catches in win
news.impact: Mumpfield had minimal involvement in Sunday’s victory, but if Puka Nacua misses time with a knee injury, Mumpfield will be a popular waiver wire add and the next man up in the Rams' wide receiver room. He holds flex value in Week 10 against the Cardinals if Nacua is unable to play.

news.body: Konata Mumpfield caught one of his two targets for 15 yards in the Rams' 35-21 win over the Las Vegas Raiders in Week 7.
news.head: Konata Mumpfield quiet in Week 7
news.impact: Mumpfield has struggled to make an impact in the Los Angeles passing attack, finishing with under 20 receiving yards in seven of eight contests. The wideout cannot be trusted as a reliable pass-catching option in any format ahead of a Week 8 contest against the Los Angeles Chargers.

news.body: Ladd McConkey caught five of his eight targets for 37 yards and two touchdowns in a 27-24 loss to the Jets in Week 11.
news.head: Ladd McConkey hauls in two TDs in Week 11
news.impact: McConkey returned from a one-game absence to bring in two TD passes from Justin Herbert in the close loss. The veteran wideout has now caught 22 passes for 323 yards and three touchdowns this season. He will take on the Patriots in Week 12, although Herbert is unlikely to play after suffering a concussion late vs. the Jets.

news.body: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey (back) is officially active for a Week 11 matchup with the Jets.
news.head: Ladd McConkey (back) officially active for Week 11
news.impact: McConkey was expected to test out his injured back in pregame warmups and was cleared to play. McConkey will provide Justin Herbert with his top pass catching option as they look for their second win of the season.

news.body: Ladd McConkey (back) is expected to play for the Los Angeles Chargers Sunday according to Ian Rapoport.
news.head: Ladd McConkey (back) expected to play Sunday
news.impact: McConkey will test out the back during pregame warmups after being limited in practice throughout the week, offering head coach Jim Harbaugh one his more impactful pass-catchers against the New York Jets Sunday.

news.body: Ladd McConkey is listed as questionable for Sunday’s game against the Jets.
news.head: Ladd McConkey (back) listed questionable Sunday
news.impact: McConkey was limited in practice all week. He will need to be monitored closer to kickoff on Sunday.

news.body: Laquon Treadwell failed to catch his only target in Thursday's 26-3 loss to the Texans.
news.head: Laquon Treadwell puts up goose egg in Week 11
news.impact: After hauling in his first touchdown of the season in Sunday's win, Treadwell got shut out by the Texans' defense on Thursday. The Colts' passing game is simply not one to trust right now, as QB Daniel Jones has struggled to get much of anything going lately.

news.body: Laquon Treadwell caught all three of his targets for 24 yards and a score in the Colts' 24-22 win over the Dolphins on Sunday.
news.head: Laquon Treadwell snags touchdown in win
news.impact: Treadwell was limited to short area gains in this contest, but made it count with a touchdown. While there could be some potential value in Treadwell, it's hard to make any sort of move for him or any other Colts pass catcher when QB Daniel Jones is playing so poorly.

news.body: Laquon Treadwell caught just 1-of-2 targets for 18 yards in Sunday's 42-7 loss to the Jaguars.
news.head: Laquon Treadwell catches just one pass Sunday
news.impact: For the second consecutive week, Treadwell saw just two passes thrown his way. Over those two games, the veteran receiver has only three receptions for 37 yards. At the moment, Treadwell doesn't really register on the fantasy radar. That could change if the Colts, as expected, trade away some offensive pieces.

news.body: Laquon Treadwell caught two of five targets for 21 yards in the Colts' 26-20 loss to the Titans on Sunday.
news.head: Laquon Treadwell brings in two passes in loss
news.impact: Treadwell continued his trend of catching fewer than 50% of his targets. He's not a great option for fantasy in any format, failing to produce anything even in a depleted pass-catching room.

news.body: Luther Burden III hauled in three of his seven targets for 44 yards while also rushing once for one yard in the Bears' 39-35 win over the Lions in Week 12.
news.head: Luther Burden III sees four touches in Week 12 win
news.impact: Burden III has offered mixed results in the Chicago offense of late, recording less than 90 receiving yards in three of his last six contests. The wideout continues to flash explosive potential in the Chicago offense ahead of a Week 13 matchup against the Jacksonville Jaguars.

news.body: Luther Burden III hauled in two of his three targets for 10 yards while also rushing once for three yards in the Bears' 21-3 Week 11 win over the Saints.
news.head: Luther Burden III bottled up in Week 11 win
news.impact: Burden III was held in check by the Saints secondary, finishing with under 60 receiving yards for the first time in his last five games. The pass-catcher will look to offer a more impactful performance in a Week 12 matchup against the Detroit Lions.

news.body: Luther Burden III is off the injury report for Sunday's game against the Saints.
news.head: Luther Burden III (concussion) off injury report Sunday
news.impact: Burden was able to clear concussion protocol earlier in the week. He remains a borderline WR1 for fantasy managers.

news.body: Bears head coach Ben Johnson said Luther Burden is out of concussion protocol.
news.head: Luther Burden III clears concussion protocol
news.impact: Burden suffered the injury two weeks ago before the Bears bye week. He'll be good to go for Sunday's game against the Saints.

news.body: Mack Hollins caught five of his six targets for 48 yards in a 35-10 loss to the Lions in Munich in Week 10.
news.head: Mack Hollins leads Patriots in receiving in Week 10
news.impact: Hollins led the Patriots in receiving in the lopsided loss to Detroit. He has eight catches for 84 yards and a touchdown in his two games since returning from a multi-week injury. That being said, the entire Patriots pass-catching corps will take a hit as Drake Maye (ankle) is looking at a multi-week absence after getting knocked out of the game in Week 10.

news.body: Mack Hollins caught 3-of-6 targets for 36 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 45-27 loss to the Green Bay Packers.
news.head: Mack Hollins scores once in return game Sunday
news.impact: Sunday was Hollins' first game back after missing an extended period of time with a calf issue. He played pretty well, racking up 36 yards and a touchdown in this loss to the Packers. He isn't likely to be a great fantasy option moving forward, however, especially if A.J. Brown (knee) makes his return to the lineup soon.

news.body: Mack Hollins (calf) is active for Week 9 for the New England Patriots according to Evan Lazar.
news.head: Mack Hollins (calf) active for Week 9
news.impact: Hollins will take the field after being activated from injured reserve earlier in the week, boosting a New England wideout group that will be missing No. 1 option A.J. Brown against the Packers.

news.body: Patriots head coach Mike Vrabel said they'll see how Mack Hollins feels Saturday and make a decision on his status.
news.head: Mack Hollins (calf) to have decision made on status Saturday
news.impact: Hollins will need to be activated from injured reserve by Saturday if he is good to go.

news.body: Makai Lemon hauled in five of his six targets for 51 yards and one touchdown in the Eagles' 39-38 Week 12 win over the Cowboys.
news.head: Makai Lemon finds end zone in Week 12 win over Cowboys
news.impact: Lemon continues a steady stretch in the Philadelphia passing attack, registering five or more receptions in four of his last five games. The rookie wideout remains one of the few impactful pass-catching options in an inconsistent Philadelphia offense entering a Week 13 contest against the Arizona Cardinals.

news.body: Makai Lemon had one catch for three yards in Sunday’s win over the Steelers.
news.head: Makai Lemon disappears with only one catch against the Steelers
news.impact: Lemon’s involvement drastically decreased with the return of DeVonta Smith, as he recorded his lowest yardage output since Week 2. Lemon faces a good matchup against the Cowboys on Thursday; however, he will be a risky play due to QB Joe Milton’s low passing output over the last two games.

news.body: Makai Lemon hauled in 6-of-9 targets for 61 yards in Sunday's 19-11 loss to the New York Giants.
news.head: Makai Lemon leads team in receiving Sunday
news.impact: The rookie had a solid showing on Sunday. He led the team with 61 receiving yards over the course of the day, though his fantasy total remained limited since he didn't get into the end zone at all. He will continue to be a decent option in PPR leagues for the foreseeable future, even if his week-to-week upside isn't great.

news.body: Makai Lemon caught six of his nine targets for 57 yards in a 27-10 loss to the Commanders in Week 8.
news.head: Makai Lemon draws nine targets in Week 8
news.impact: Lemon led the Eagles in all receiving categories with DeVonta Smith and Dontayvion Wicks both out. The rookie has been productive over his past two contests, going for 124 yards and a touchdown over that span. He will be a flex option in Week 9 vs. the Giants.

news.body: Malachi Fields caught two of five targets for 25 yards in the Giants' 23-18 win over the Jaguars on Sunday.
news.head: Malachi Fields snags two passes in win
news.impact: Fields had a couple of nice grabs in this contest, but didn't do much for fantasy purposes. He's not worth rostering for fantasy right now, with Malik Nabers and Isaiah Likely taking so much of the work.

news.body: Malachi Fields caught three of his four targets for 62 yards in a 24-21 loss to the Commanders in Week 10's Thursday night game.
news.head: Malachi Fields goes for 62 yards in Week 10
news.impact: Fields finished second on the Giants in receiving in the close loss. The rookie wideout has emerged as a solid big-play threat for the Giants this year, averaging 15.9 yards per catch. Overall, he has 22 catches for 350 yards and one touchdown in nine games. He will be a boom/bust flex option in Week 11 vs. the Jaguars.

news.body: Malachi Fields caught 3-of-5 targets for 40 yards in Sunday's 19-11 win over the Philadelphia Eagles.
news.head: Malachi Fields racks up 40 yards Sunday
news.impact: The rookie was a solid contributor for New York on Sunday, finishing with 40 yards in a win over the Eagles. Fantasy managers shouldn't expect him to evolve into a trustworthy fantasy asset anytime soon, however.

news.body: Malachi Fields caught 4-of-5 targets for 83 yards in the Giants 27-21 win over the Texans.
news.head: Malachi Fields totals 83 yards Sunday
news.impact: Fields recorded a career-best in yardage in the first start with the Giants for J.J. McCarthy. He remains off the fantasy radar for now heading into the Giants bye week.

news.body: Malik Nabers caught 7 of 12 targets for 55 yards and a touchdown in the Giants' 23-18 win over the Jaguars on Sunday.
news.head: Malik Nabers snags touchdown in win over Jags
news.impact: Nabers led the Giants in targets, receptions, and yards by a wide margin; no other receiver had more than three catches or 35 yards. Of course, we'd want more on 12 targets, but it's hard to complain too much. He gets a decent matchup against the Colts next week.

news.body: Malik Nabers caught five of his seven targets for 44 yards on Thursday night in a 24-21 loss to the Commanders in Week 10.
news.head: Malik Nabers catches five balls in Week 10 loss
news.impact: Nabers finished second on the team in targets and catches, but it was a second straight pedestrian outing for the star wideout. He now has 58 catches for 692 yards and two touchdowns in nine games this season. He will be a low-end WR1 in fantasy in Week 11 vs. the Jaguars.

news.body: Malik Nabers caught 5-of-8 targets for 43 yards in Sunday's 19-11 win over the Philadelphia Eagles.
news.head: Malik Nabers underwhelming in win Sunday
news.impact: Nabers didn't have a great game to his standards on Sunday. He finished with under 50 yards in this win over the Eagles, and he wasn't able to bring in a nice touchdown that would've been the highlight play of the day. He should bounce back and return to form in the very near future, however.

news.body: Malik Nabers was seen catching passes during a walkthrough session for the New York Giants Friday.
news.head: Malik Nabers catching passes Friday
news.impact: Nabers has dealt with unknown issues throughout the practice week for head coach John Harbaugh, but the talented wideout seems poised to take the field barring any serious setbacks ahead of Sunday’s divisional matchup against the Philadelphia Eagles.

news.body: Malik Washington caught 3-of-6 targets for 30 yards in the Dolphins 26-9 loss against the Bills.
news.head: Malik Washington catches three passes Sunday
news.impact: Washington led Miami pass catchers in receptions on the day. He remains a borderline WR3/flex play in deeper leagues moving forward.

news.body: Malik Washington caught all three of his targets for 50 yards and also threw a 34-yard touchdown in the Dolphins' 24-22 loss to the Colts.
news.head: Malik Washington throws bomb touchdown in loss
news.impact: Washington surprised in this game, throwing a beautiful deep touchdown pass to Jalen Tolbert on a trick play. He finished second on the team in receptions and second in receiving yards on the day, and could be a PPR-flex option next week against the Bills.

news.body: Malik Washington caught two of his three targets for 21 yards while also rushing once for no gain in the Dolphins' 19-9 loss to the Lions in Week 9.
news.head: Malik Washington quiet in Week 9 loss
news.impact: Washington has cooled off in the Miami offense of late, finishing with less than 50 receiving yards in each of his last four contests. The wideout remains another inconsistent option as part of an underperforming Miami offense to this point, with a Week 10 matchup against the Indianapolis Colts up next.

news.body: Malik Washington caught five of six targets for 40 yards and a touchdown in the Dolphins' 24-19 loss to the Patriots on Sunday.
news.head: Malik Washington snags touchdown in loss to Patriots
news.impact: Washington had a score in the second quarter to put the Dolphins up by 10, led the team in receptions, and tied for the lead in targets. He's developed into a usable PPR asset this season and should have some utility next week against the Lions' secondary.

news.body: Marvin Harrison Jr. is off the injury report for Sunday's game against the Ravens.
news.head: Marvin Harrison Jr. (hamstring) off injury report for Week 12
news.impact: Harrison will make his return as had been expected. He'll be a risky flex/WR4 for fantasy managers.

news.body: Marvin Harrison Jr. (hamstring) is expected to return for Sunday's game against the Ravens.
news.head: Marvin Harrison Jr. (hamstring) expected to play in Week 12
news.impact: Harrison has missed the last two games due a hamstring injury, but he has been back at practice this week and is expected to go Sunday. With Kayshon Boutte out due to a hip injury, Harrison should have a clear route to plenty of snaps and potential targets.

news.body: Marvin Harrison Jr. returned to practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Marvin Harrison Jr. (hamstring) back at practice Wednesday
news.impact: Harrison was ruled out last Thursday for the Texans. He is trending towards returning this week.

news.body: Marvin Harrison Jr. (hamstring) has been ruled out for Thursday night's game against the Indianapolis Colts.
news.head: Marvin Harrison Jr. (hamstring) ruled out for Thursday
news.impact: Harrison is going to be sidelined for another game on Thursday night. He's still recovering from a hamstring issue of some kind, and it's unclear whether or not it will cause him to miss more time beyond this game. Tank Dell and Xavier Hutchinson will both see more opportunities while he's out.

news.body: Matthew Golden hauled in just one of his team-leading five targets for 39 yards in the Packers' 26-13 Week 12 loss to the Rams.
news.head: Matthew Golden quiet in Week 12 loss to Rams
news.impact: Golden was held in check by a physical Los Angeles secondary, finishing under 70 receiving yards for the first time in his last four contests. The wideout remains one of the more impactful pass-catching options in an inconsistent Green Bay offense entering a Week 13 matchup against the New Orleans Saints.

news.body: Matthew Golden hauled in five of his team-leading nine targets for 70 yards in the Packers' 30-10 Week 10 loss to the Vikings.
news.head: Matthew Golden leads pass-catchers in Week 10 loss to Vikings
news.impact: Golden has been dynamic of late, recording over 70 receiving yards in five of his last six games. The wideout remains one of the few impactful options in an inconsistent Packers offense entering the team's Week 11 bye.

news.body: Matthew Golden hauled in all of his team-leading 10 targets for 164 yards and one touchdown in the Packers' 45-27 Week 9 win over the Patriots.
news.head: Matthew Golden reaches end zone in Week 9 win over Patriots
news.impact: Golden has been impactful in the Green Bay offense of late, recording over 75 receiving yards in four of his last five contests. The wideout remains one of the more impactful offensive options to this point in the Green Bay offense entering a Week 10 matchup against the Minnesota Vikings.

news.body: Matthew Golden caught 7-of-13 targets for 79 yards and a touchdown in Thursday's 27-19 win over the Panthers.
news.head: Matthew Golden finds the end zone in Week 8
news.impact: Golden was questionable with shoulder and foot injuries leading into Thursday's game. He didn't seem very bothered by either, however. The first-round selection from 2025 continued his breakout season, setting a new career high with seven receptions against the Panthers' beat-up secondary. Golden also went over 75 yards for the fifth time in eight games this season.

news.body: The Steelers activated Michael Pittman (foot) from injured reserve.
news.head: Michael Pittman Jr. (foot) activated from IR
news.impact: Pittman will return for Week 12 against the Broncos. He will be on the WR4 radar for fantasy managers.

news.body: Michael Pittman Jr. was a full participant in practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Michael Pittman Jr. (foot) logs full practice Wednesday
news.impact: Pittman has logged back-to-back full practices. He remains on track to be good to go to return from injured reserve.

news.body: Michael Pittman Jr. was a full participant at practice on Tuesday.
news.head: Michael Pittman Jr. (foot) logs full practice Tuesday
news.impact: Pittman is trending towards being activated from injured reserve ahead of Friday's game against the Broncos. He will be a very risky WR3/flex play with Mason Rudolph behind center.

news.body: The Steelers did not activate WR Michael Pittman Jr. for Sunday's game against the Eagles.
news.head: Michael Pittman Jr. (foot) not activated from IR
news.impact: Pittman had been listed as questionable. He will miss at least one more game.

news.body: Mike Evans is listed as questionable for Sunday’s game against the Seahawks.
news.head: Mike Evans (Achilles) listed questionable for Week 12
news.impact: Evans returned to a limited practice on Thursday. He'll be a WR2 play for fantasy managers if he is cleared.

news.body: Mike Evans was limited in practice on Thursday.
news.head: Mike Evans (Achilles) limited in practice Thursday
news.impact: Evans was back on the field he missed practice on Wednesday. He is trending towards being good to go for Sunday's game against the Seahawks if he can practice again on Friday.

news.body: Mike Evans did not practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Mike Evans (Achilles) misses practice Wednesday
news.impact: It is not a huge surprise to see Evans miss practice to begin the week as he continues to manage Achilles tendinitis.

news.body: Mike Evans hauled in 6-of-7 targets for 109 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 35-10 blowout of the Vikings.
news.head: Mike Evans returns with a big performance Sunday night
news.impact: After not playing for more than a month, Evans did not miss a beat in his return to action Sunday night. The veteran receiver went over the 100-yard mark for the second time this season and picked up his fourth TD catch, despite playing only 43% of the offensive snaps. Evans is right back in must-start mode for fantasy managers.

news.body: Nico Collins caught 3-of-5 targets for 58 yards and a touchdown in Thursday's 26-3 win over the Colts.
news.head: Nico Colins scores again in Week 11
news.impact: Collins has now scored in three straight games and is up to six touchdown grabs over eight games this season. C.J. Stroud spread out his passes in this one, so Collins ended up with just a third of Week 10's season-high total in receptions. Still, fantasy managers won't be complaining due to the touchdown. Collins remains a steady WR1.

news.body: Nico Collins hauled in 9-of-16 targets for 94 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 27-24 loss to the Browns.
news.head: Nico Collins grabs nine passes, scores once in Week 10
news.impact: Collins saw more targets on Sunday than in his previous three games combined. The Texans' go-to guy set a new season high in receptions and put up his second-highest yardage total. Collins has now scored in back-to-back games and remains a solid WR1 in standard formats.

news.body: Nico Collins caught four passes for 55 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 44-22 win over the Los Angeles Chargers.
news.head: Nico Collins finds end zone Sunday
news.impact: The star wideout had a solid game on Sunday. He caught four passes for 55 yards and was able to get into the end zone on one of them, which left him with a good fantasy total in this matchup. Fantasy managers should feel solid about his value moving forward, though he may continue to be a bit volatile on a week-to-week basis.

news.body: Nico Collins caught 2-of-5 targets for six yards in the Texans 27-21 loss against the Giants.
news.head: Nico Collins shut down Sunday
news.impact: Collins was completely held in check. He'll look to bounce back off the bye week.

news.body: Omar Cooper Jr. (ankle) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Dolphins.
news.head: Omar Cooper Jr. (ankle) will not play in Week 12
news.impact: The Jets will have a bye in Week 13, giving Cooper extra time to fully recover from an ankle injury. Garrett Wilson and Adonai Mitchell will be the top two receivers for the Jets once again. Veterans Sterling Shepard and Tim Patrick should see significant snaps as well.

news.body: Omar Cooper Jr. did not practice on Thursday.
news.head: Omar Cooper Jr. (ankle) misses practice Thursday
news.impact: Cooper missed his second straight practice. He is trending in the wrong direction for Sunday's game against the Dolphins.

news.body: Jets head coach Aaron Glenn said Omar Cooper Jr. will not practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Omar Cooper Jr. (ankle/hip) not practicing Wednesday
news.impact: Cooper was sidelined last week for the Jets. He'll need to continue to be managed the rest of week in practice.

news.body: Omar Cooper Jr. (ankle/hip) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Chargers.
news.head: Omar Cooper Jr. (ankle/hip) will not play in Week 11
news.impact: Cooper played just one snap in Week 10 after being questionable all week. The Jets will not take the same approach in Week 11, ruling the rookie out a couple of days before the game. Garrett Wilson and Adonai Mitchell will lead the way for the Jets' route runners, as Isaiah Williams (ribs) has also been ruled out.

news.body: Parker Washington (shoulder) has been ruled out for the Jaguars game against the Titans on Sunday with and is week-to-week with an AC joint injury per HC Liam Coen.
news.head: Parker Washington (shoulder) out for Sunday, week-to-week with AC injury
news.impact: With Washington out, Jakobi Meyers and Brian Thomas Jr. should see some additional volume. Travis Hunter will likely get some increase in snaps as well, but he’s a desperation flex play given that the Jaguars also have Josh Cameron waiting in the wings at WR as well. Meyers is the preferred play, with Hunter, Cameron, and Thomas being big play threats.

news.body: Parker Washington was added to the injury report on Thursday with a shoulder issue.
news.head: Parker Washington (shoulder) added to injury report Thursday
news.impact: Washington still got in a limited practice. He will need to be monitored in practice on Friday.

news.body: Parker Washington caught 8 of 17 targets for 103 yards in the Jaguars' 23-18 loss to the Giants on Sunday.
news.head: Parker Washington snags eight passes in loss
news.impact: Washington had a ridiculous 17 targets on Sunday, by far the most he's seen in a game this year. He had a controversial play late in the game where he bobbled a potential touchdown, appeared to secure it and get his feet in bounds, but was ruled incomplete because Washington had not yet completed possession. It's a tough break for the breakout receiver, but he's now had back-to-back 100-yard games and gets the Titans next week.

news.body: Parker Washington caught seven of nine targets for 152 yards and a touchdown in the Jaguars' 40-23 win over the Titans on Sunday.
news.head: Parker Washington explodes against Titans
news.impact: This was Washington's second 100-yard game of the season and his highest yardage total overall. He was limited to just two catches against Baltimore last time out, failing to corral some targets that should have been caught. However, he made his opportunities count this time around, going nuclear against the Titans' woeful defense. He's right on the edge of WR1/WR2 territory from here on out.

news.body: Pat Bryant was a full participant in practice on Tuesday.
news.head: Pat Bryant (ankle) logs full practice Tuesday
news.impact: Bryant will be a full-go for Friday's game against the Steelers.

news.body: Pat Bryant caught three of four targets for 32 yards in the Broncos' 38-24 win over the Raiders in Week 11.Bryant followed his 56-yard, one-touchdown performance in Week 9 with 32 receiving yards Sunday. He saw four targets compared to six for Jaylen Waddle and two for Courtland Sutton. Bryant is carving out a role in Denver's passing attack, but four targets aren't enough to warrant a fantasy start in most leagues.
news.head: Pat Bryant catches three passes in Week 11
news.impact: Bryant followed his 56-yard, one-touchdown performance in Week 9 with 32 receiving yards Sunday. He saw four targets compared to six for Jaylen Waddle and two for Courtland Sutton. Bryant is carving out a role in Denver's passing attack, but four targets aren't enough to warrant a fantasy start in most leagues.

news.body: Pat Bryant caught four of five targets for 56 yards and one touchdown in the Broncos' 26-21 win over the Panthers in Week 9.
news.head: Pat Bryant scores touchdown in Week 9
news.impact: Bryant caught a 26-yard touchdown from Bo Nix in the fourth quarter, extending Denver's lead to 26-14. He also led the Broncos in receiving yards. Bryant's five targets matched Evan Engram for second on the team behind Courtland Sutton. With Jaylen Waddle seeing just one target, Bryant's involvement is worth monitoring heading into Denver's Week 10 bye.

news.body: Pat Bryant (ankle) has been activated from injured reserve ahead of Denver’s game against the Panthers on Sunday.
news.head: Pat Bryant (ankle) activated off of IR
news.impact: Bryant is still officially questionable, but his activation indicates that he will play on Sunday. He’ll be a tough start in his first game back, but could have some flex appeal in later weeks.

news.body: Puka Nacua will undergo MCL surgery and could potentially miss the remainder of the season for the Los Angeles Rams according to Adam Schefter.
news.head: Puka Nacua (MCL) could miss remainder of season

news.body: Puka Nacua has been handed a three-game suspension for a violation of the NFL's Personal Conduct Policy, which will be served while he's on injured reserve.
news.head: Puka Nacua receives three-game suspension from NFL
news.impact: Nacua has received a three-game suspension after an NFL review determined that he violated their Personal Conduct Policy. However, he is currently on injured reserve and is several weeks away from being eligible to return, so that suspension will be served while he's on IR, meaning that this suspension won't cause him to miss any more time than he was already set to miss due to injury. Fantasy managers should continue to keep close tabs on updates about his health over the next few weeks, as he could be a very valuable asset if he's cleared to play in time for the fantasy playoffs.

news.body: The Rams placed WR Puka Nacua on injured reserve.
news.head: Puka Nacua (knee/toe) placed on IR
news.impact: Nacua will be eligible to return for the Rams’ Week 15 game against the Cowboys. It had been reported that he wasn't expected to be placed on IR, but he wound up landing on it. Nacua suffered PCL and MCL sprains, along with a turf toe injury in Week 10 against the Commanders. His future status remains up in the air.

news.body: Puka Nacua (knee/toe) will not land on injured reserve due to roster logistics, but he is still expected to be sidelined for around 4-6 weeks
news.head: Puka Nacua (knee/toe) won't land on IR, still out for extended time
news.impact: The Rams are not going to place Nacua on injured reserve, not because he will be back sooner than expected, but rather just as a roster management tactic. This is significant for fantasy managers, as he may not be eligible for an IR slot in many league formats as a result of this. That will make him significantly harder to roster for the 4-6 weeks that he's expected to be out.

news.body: Quentin Johnston caught one of two targets for nine yards in a 27-24 loss to the Jets in Week 11.
news.head: Quentin Johnston catches one pass in Week 11
news.impact: Johnston was quiet in the close loss, which has been far too common this season. He has caught exactly one pass in five of his past six games, as the Chargers have not prioritized getting Johnston the ball this season. He will not be a recommended fantasy option in Week 12 vs. the Patriots.

news.body: Quentin Johnston caught one pass for just six yards in Monday night's 23-20 win over the Baltimore Ravens.
news.head: Quentin Johnston quiet in win Monday
news.impact: The Chargers were able to pick up their first win of the season on Monday night, but Johnston wasn't able to get going in that game, finishing with just six yards on one catch. He isn't going to be a reliable week-to-week fantasy option moving forward, especially when Ladd McConkey (back) makes his return to the lineup.

news.body: Quentin Johnston caught 1-of-4 targets for 58 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 44-22 loss to the Houston Texans.
news.head: Quentin Johnston hauls in touchdown Sunday
news.impact: Johnston was able to break Los Angeles' no-touchdown streak by taking a short catch 58 yards to the house on Sunday. He finished as the team's leading receiver as a result, but since he had no catches outside of that, his fantasy total remained mediocre. He is not expected to be a worthwhile asset moving forward, though he could see more work if Ladd McConkey (back) has to miss time.

news.body: Quentin Johnston caught four passes for 37 yards in Sunday's 24-9 loss to the Los Angeles Rams.
news.head: Quentin Johnston racks up 37 yards Sunday
news.impact: Johnston didn't have a great game on Sunday. He was a solid contributor with four catches for 37 yards, but he wasn't able to get into the end zone at all, which left him with a disappointing fantasy total. He should not be started for the foreseeable future, especially with how bad this Los Angeles offense still looks.

news.body: Rashee Rice caught 6-of-6 targets for 53 yards in a 34-7 win over Arizona.
news.head: Rashee Rice hauls in six passes in Week 11
news.impact: Rice tied Travis Kelce for the team lead in receptions in the win Sunday. Rice continues to see a consistent target share, logging at least six in each of his last four games. Rice and the Chiefs will take on the Bills in Week 12.

news.body: Rashee Rice hauled in five of his six targets for a team-leading 82 yards in the Chiefs' 35-13 Week 10 win over the Falcons.
news.head: Rashee Rice leads pass-catchers in Week 10 win over Falcons
news.impact: Rice continues to make the most of sizeable involvement in the Kansas City passing attack, recording five or more receptions in four of his last five games. The wideout remains locked in as a reliable pass-catching option entering a Week 11 matchup against the Arizona Cardinals.

news.body: Rashee Rice (knee) is good to go for Sunday's game against the Atlanta Falcons.
news.head: Rashee Rice (knee) good to go for Sunday
news.impact: Rice came into the week with a nagging knee issue of some kind, but it's not a serious issue and he has been fully cleared to play in Week 10. He may see more work in the receiving game if Kansas City's rushing attack is crippled by the potential absence of Kenneth Walker III (groin) this week.

news.body: Rashee Rice is practicing in full for Sunday's game against the Falcons.
news.head: Rashee Rice (knee) practicing in full for Week 10
news.impact: Rice had previously been managing a hamstring injury which appears to be behind him. He'll remain a WR2 for fantasy managers.

news.body: Rashid Shaheed caught 1-of-2 targets for eight yards in the Seahawks 21-13 win over the Raiders.
news.head: Rashid Shaheed catches one pass Sunday
news.impact: Shaheed was making his way back from injured reserve. He remains off the fantasy radar.

news.body: Rashid Shaheed was a full participant in practice on Thursday.
news.head: Rashid Shaheed (knee) logs full practice Thursday
news.impact: Shaheed remains on track to be a full-go for Sunday against the Raiders.

news.body: Rashid Shaheed was a full participant in practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Rashid Shaheed (knee) logs full practice Wednesday
news.impact: Shaheed appears likely to return for the Seahawks. He'll remain a WR4/WR5 for fantasy managers.

news.body: Rashid Shaheed (knee) won't play in Sunday's game against the Arizona Cardinals.
news.head: Rashid Shaheed (knee) won't play Sunday
news.impact: The veteran is going to be sidelined again on Sunday as he continues to battle a knee issue of some kind. Tory Horton may see more work as a result of his absence, but that isn't likely to matter much with Drew Lock set to start at quarterback in the absence of Sam Darnold (quad/ribs) this week.

news.body: Rashod Bateman is off the injury report for Sunday's game against the Texans.
news.head: Rashod Bateman (groin) off injury report for Week 12
news.impact: Bateman hauled in a touchdown last week. He will remain an upside WR4 for fantasy managers.

news.body: Rashod Bateman was a full participant in practice on Thursday.
news.head: Rashod Bateman (groin) logs full practice Thursday
news.impact: Bateman had been limited in practice on Wednesday. He remains in the upside WR4 range for fantasy managers.

news.body: Rashod Bateman caught 2-of-6 targets for 67 yards and a touchdown in a 35-33 loss to the Panthers.
news.head: Rashod Bateman finds the end zone in Week 11 loss
news.impact: Bateman found the end zone on a 52-yard touchdown pass from Jacoby Brissett early in the first quarter. It ended a long touchdown drought for Bateman, marking his first touchdown reception since Week 2. Bateman and the Ravens will take on the Texans in Week 12.

news.body: Rashod Bateman caught 3-of-5 targets for 42 yards in Monday night's 23-20 loss to the Los Angeles Chargers.
news.head: Rashod Bateman catches three passes in loss Monday
news.impact: Bateman was able to contribute three catches for 42 yards on Monday night, but that wasn't enough to propel the Ravens to a win over Los Angeles. QB Jacoby Brissett's passing attempts will fall over the next few weeks as well, so fantasy managers shouldn't expect Bateman to be valuable at any point in the foreseeable future.

news.body: Roman Wilson brought in three passes for 43 yards in Sunday’s loss to the Eagles.
news.head: Roman Wilson has three catches in return from IR
news.impact: Wilson returned from an IR stint and had the second-most receiving yards on the team. However, he is still at least WR3 on the depth chart, so he won’t be fantasy-viable unless things drastically change.

news.body: The Steelers activated Roman Wilson from injured reserve.
news.head: Roman Wilson (finger) activated from IR
news.impact: Wilson will officially return for Sunday's game against the Eagles.

news.body: Roman Wilson is expected to return for Sunday's game against the Eagles.
news.head: Roman Wilson (finger) expected to play Sunday
news.impact: Wilson remains listed as questionable and on injured reserve. He'll return to being a WR3/WR4 for fantasy managers.

news.body: Roman Wilson is listed as questionable for Sunday’s game against the Eagles.
news.head: Roman Wilson (finger) listed questionable Sunday
news.impact: Wilson returned to practice this week. He'll have a chance to be activated from injured reserve heading into Sunday.

news.body: Rome Odunze hauled in six of his team-leading nine targets for 87 yards and two touchdowns in the Bears' 39-35 Week 12 win over Lions.
news.head: Rome Odunze hauls in two touchdowns in Week 12 win over Lions
news.impact: Odunze has been impactful in the Chicago passing attack of late, registering 60 or more receiving yards in four of his last five games. The wideout remains one of the more reliable pass-catching options for head coach Ben Johnson entering a Week 13 matchup against the Jacksonville Jaguars.

news.body: Rome Odunze hauled in each of his four targets for 45 yards in the Bears' 21-13 Week 11 win over the Saints.
news.head: Rome Odunze hauls in four passes in Week 11 win
news.impact: Odunze has made modest impact in the Chicago passing attack of late, finishing with 45 receiving yards or more in each of his last four games. The wideout remains one of the more reliable pass-catching options in the Bears offense entering a Week 12 matchup against the Detroit Lions.

news.body: Rome Odunze caught four of his seven targets for 60 yards and a touchdown in a 27-24 win over the Buccaneers in Week 9.
news.head: Rome Odunze finds the end zone in Week 9 win
news.impact: Odunze found the end zone for the first time all year on a nine-yard pass from Caleb Williams in the first quarter. The veteran wideout has now caught 32 passes for 528 yards in nine games. He will be on bye in Week 10 before taking on the Saints in Week 11.

news.body: Rome Odunze caught 4-of-6 targets for 87 yards in Monday night's 34-17 win over the Seattle Seahawks.
news.head: Rome Odunze leads team in receiving Monday
news.impact: Odunze looked good on Monday night. He led the team with 87 yards on four catches, although he wasn't able to get into the end zone at all, which left him with a limited fantasy total. He will likely have some boom games here and there moving forward, but it remains difficult to trust starting him on an every-week basis at this point.

news.body: Romeo Doubs is not expected to return for Sunday's game against the Chargers.
news.head: Romeo Doubs (shoulder) unlikely to play in Week 12
news.impact: Doubs was able to return to a limited practice this week. He'll have a chance to return next week.

news.body: Romeo Doubs was limited in practice on Thursday.
news.head: Romeo Doubs (shoulder) limited in practice Thursday
news.impact: Doubs has a chance to return on Sunday against the Chargers if he can get in another practice on Friday.

news.body: Romeo Doubs (shoulder) is facing an uncertain timetable to return, per HC Mike Vrabel. When asked about Doubs and when he might come back into the lineup, Vrabel was uncertain and non-commital on a timeline, stating “I’m not sure how long that (his IR stint) will be.”
news.head: Romeo Doubs (shoulder) facing uncertain timetable to retun
news.impact: It’s a rough situation for Doubs, who was putting up a big game before going out with a shoulder injury. He’s not droppable jet yet, at least not in leagues with an IR slot. However, he seems to be right on the edge of drop territory, so fantasy managers will need to keep an eye out for any updates regarding his potential return. However, it’s not looking very promising as of writing.

news.body: The Patriots placed Romeo Doubs on injured reserve.
news.head: Romeo Doubs (shoulder) placed on IR
news.impact: Doubs left Sunday's game early in the third quarter. He will now miss at least the next four games.

news.body: Ryan Flournoy caught his lone target for 11 yards in the Cowboys 51-30 win over the Titans.
news.head: Ryan Flournoy quiet Sunday
news.impact: It was an unusually quiet day for Flournoy in a game where the Cowboys scored over 50 points and Dak Prescott tossed four touchdowns. He is an upside WR4 for fantasy managers.

news.body: Ryan Flournoy caught six of his seven targets for 71 yards and one touchdown in the Cowboys' 46-40 loss to the 49ers in Week 10.
news.head: Ryan Flournoy reaches end zone in Week 10 loss
news.impact: Flournoy has had a nose for the end zone of late, recording a touchdown in three of his last five contests. The wideout has been one of the more inconsistent pass-catching options in the Dallas offense ahead of a Week 11 contest against the Tennessee Titans.

news.body: Ryan Flournoy caught two of his three targets for 53 yards in a 27-23 win over the Colts in Week 9.
news.head: Ryan Flournoy goes for 53 yards in Week 9
news.impact: Flournoy was quiet despite the Cowboys playing without George Pickens (hamstring) in the contest. The veteran wideout has been a solid WR3 for Dallas this season, catching 32 passes for 395 yards and two touchdowns in nine games. He will be on the flex radar against the 49ers in Week 10 if Pickens is unable to suit up.

news.body: Ryan Flournoy caught three of his four targets for 38 yards and one touchdown while also rushing once for three yards in the Cowboys' 33-30 Week 8 loss to the Cardinals.
news.head: Ryan Flournoy finds end zone in Week 8 loss
news.impact: Flournoy has had a nose for the end zone of late, scoring a touchdown in two of his last three contests. The wideout remains a touchdown dependent option in all formats ahead of a favorable Week 9 contest against the Indianapolis Colts.

news.body: Savion Williams hauled in one of his three targets for three yards while also rushing twice for a team-high 18 yards in the Packers' 26-13 loss to the Rams in Week 12.
news.head: Savion Williams sees three touches in Week 12
news.impact: Williams has underwhelmed in the Green Bay offense of late, recording under 50 offensive yards in all seven of his games. The wideout remains another inconsistent option that is best left off rosters in all formats entering a Week 13 contest against the New Orleans Saints.

news.body: Savion Williams caught both of his targets for 27 yards in the Packers' 30-10 loss to the Vikings in Week 10.
news.head: Savion Williams catches two passes in Week 10
news.impact: Williams has struggled to make a sizeable impact on offense, finishing with under 40 receiving yards in four of his five games. The wideout remains best left off rosters in all formats ahead of the team's Week 11 bye.

news.body: Savion Williams caught three of his four targets for 25 yards and one touchdown while also rushing three times for 13 yards in the Packers' 45-27 win over the Patriots in Week 9.
news.head: Savion Williams scores touchdown in Week 9 win
news.impact: Williams has struggled to make an impact in the Green Bay offense, logging less than 60 offensive yards in each of his four contests. the wideout remains best left off rosters in all formats ahead of a Week 10 contest against the Minnesota Vikings.

news.body: Savion Williams caught 1-of-2 targets for just five yards, adding an 18-yard run in Thursday's 27-19 win over the Panthers.
news.head: Savion Williams does little with two touches in Week 8
news.impact: Williams hauled in four and three passes, respectively, over the previous two games heading into Thursday night. He is a factor for the Packers' offense, but he's well behind fellow wide receivers Matthew Golden and Christian Watson, as well as TE Tucker Kraft, in the pecking order for targets from QB Jordan Love. Workhorse RB Josh Jacobs is back in the fold as well. Williams has playmaking potential, but the volume just isn't there right now for fantasy purposes.

news.body: Simi Fehoko caught 1-of-5 targets for two yards and a touchdown in a 34-7 loss to the Chiefs. He also added seven rushing yards on three attempts.
news.head: Simi Fehoko finds the end zone in Week 11 loss
news.impact: Fehoko accounted for the lone touchdown on a two-yard reception in the second quarter. The five targets are a new season high for Fehoko, but he has not recorded more than one reception in a game this season. Fehoko and the Cardinals will take on the Commanders in Week 12.

news.body: Simi Fehoko caught 1-of-2 targets for 21 yards in the Cardinals 34-6 loss against the Rams.
news.head: Simi Fehoko hauls in one pass Sunday
news.impact: Fehoko hauled in one big play from Carson Beck. He remains off the fantasy radar.

news.body: Simi Fehoko caught his only target for 17 yards in the Cardinals' 33-30 win over the Cowboys in Week 8.
news.head: Simi Fehoko catches pass in Week 8
news.impact: Fehoko has been an afterthought in the Arizona offense to this point, registering his first reception in seven contests Sunday. The wideout remains best left off rosters in all formats ahead of a Week 9 contest with the Seattle Seahawks.

news.body: The Cardinals re-signed WR Simi Fehoko to a one-year contract.
news.head: Simi Fehoko re-signs with Cardinals
news.impact: Fehoko figures to remain in a blocking and special teams role for Arizona heading into this upcoming season.

news.body: Stefon Diggs is not at practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Stefon Diggs (personal) not at practice Wednesday
news.impact: Diggs is away due to personal reasons. He will need to be monitored in practice on Thursday.

news.body: Stefon Diggs caught four of his six targets for 45 yards in a 22-20 win over the Bengals in Week 11's Monday night game.
news.head: Stefon Diggs goes for 45 yards in MNF win
news.impact: Diggs was third on the Commanders in receiving in the close win over Cincinnati. The veteran wideout now has 40 catches for 431 yards and six touchdowns in nine games for the Commanders this season. He will be a WR3 option in Week 12 vs. the Cardinals.

news.body: Stefon Diggs will get a rest day from practice on Thursday.
news.head: Stefon Diggs (rest) will not practice Thursday
news.impact: It is a scheduled day off for Diggs. He should be back at practice on Friday.

news.body: Stefon Diggs caught six of his 10 targets for 86 yards and a touchdown in a 24-21 win over the Giants in Week 10.
news.head: Stefon Diggs goes for 83 yards, TD in Week 10
news.impact: Diggs had his best game of the season in the close win over the Giants on Thursday night. The veteran wideout caught the game-winning touchdown on a 32-yard pass from Jayden Daniels with 57 seconds left in regulation. Diggs has shown a nose for the end zone in his first season in Washington, catching six touchdowns in eight games. He will be a fantasy WR3 in Week 11 vs. the Bengals.

news.body: Tai Felton brought in 6-of-12 targets for 42 yards in Sunday night's 35-10 loss to the 49ers.
news.head: Tai Felton catches six passes in Week 11 loss
news.impact: Felton saw a team-high 12 targets Sunday night, as the second-year pro has been more involved in the offense with Jordan Addison out (thumb) out the past couple of weeks. Felton was limited in his yardage and only came up with half of the tosses that came his way, but he does merit PPR consideration while Addison remains out.

news.body: Tai Felton caught three of his five targets for 33 yards in the Vikings' 30-10 win over the Packers in Week 10.
news.head: Tai Felton sees five targets in Week 10 win
news.impact: Felton has struggled to make an impact in the Minnesota offense to this point, recording under 35 receiving yards in each of his nine contests. The wideout can be left off rosters in all formats ahead of a Week 11 contest against the San Francisco 49ers.

news.body: Tai Felton caught two of his three targets for 27 yards in the Vikings' 23-13 win over the New Orleans Saints in Week 5.
news.head: Tai Felton quiet in Week 5
news.impact: Felton has been minimally involved in the Minnesota offense to begin the season, finishing under 30 receiving yards in each of the first five games. The wideout can remain off rosters in all formats as the team enters a Week 6 bye.

news.body: Tai Felton caught his only target for six yards in the Vikings' 16-13 win over the Giants in Week 16.
news.head: Tai Felton catches pass in Week 16
news.impact: Felton remains a non-factor in the Minnesota offense, seeing one target or less in all 15 games. The wideout can remain off rosters in all formats ahead of a Week 17 Christmas Day contest against the Detroit Lions.

news.body: Tank Dell secured 3-of-4 targets for 27 yards in Thursday's 26-3 win over the Colts.
news.head: Tank Dell hauls in three passes Thursday night
news.impact: Dell has now caught at least three passes in each of the last three weeks, but his signature big plays have not been there for the most part over the last two games. Still, he has been on the field for just about half of the Texans' offensive snaps over the last three games, and he always has the potential to take one to the house at any point. Dell moves forward as a volatile, big-play receiver for fantasy purposes.

news.body: Tank Dell brought in 3-of-4 targets for 21 yards in Sunday's 27-24 loss to the Browns.
news.head: Tank Dell catches three passes in Week 10 loss
news.impact: Dell actually kept the big plays coming Sunday, gaining 29 yards on his first catch of the game. He would bring in two more passes on the day, but both ended up going for negative yardage. Dell is averaging more than 21 yards on his eight grabs over the last three weeks. He's a volatile boom-or-bust fantasy option.

news.body: Tank Dell (hand/shoulder) is good to go for Sunday's game against the Cleveland Browns.
news.head: Tank Dell (hand/shoulder) good to go for Sunday
news.impact: Dell will be good to go on Sunday. Neither of his two injuries are serious at this point, and his snaps are expected to continue to increase for a little while as he continues to look great in his return from injury. He may be inconsistent for a while but will have solid week-to-week upside for the foreseeable future.

news.body: Tank Dell (hand/shoulder) logged a full practice session on Thursday.
news.head: Tank Dell (hand/shoulder) logs full practice Thursday
news.impact: Dell was able to log a full practice session on Thursday after being limited on Wednesday due to a pair of injuries. He should be a full go for Week 10 and will look to continue building on the success that he has been having lately.

news.body: Ted Hurst III hauled in five of his team-high seven targets for 56 yards and two touchdowns in the Buccaneers' 31-21 Week 11 loss to the Lions.
news.head: Ted Hurst III catches two touchdowns in Week 11 loss to Lions
news.impact: Hurst III took advantage of a larger role in the Tampa Bay passing attack, finishing with 40 or more receiving yards for the second time in his last five contests. The speedy wideout remains difficult to trust as one of many inconsistent options on offense to this point, with a Week 12 matchup against the Carolina Panthers up next.

news.body: Ted Hurst III failed to catch his lone target in a 27-24 loss to the Bears in Week 9.
news.head: Ted Hurst III held without a catch in Week 9
news.impact: Hurst only drew one target in a game where the Tampa Bay passing attack struggled yet again. The rookie wideout has caught 11 passes for 168 yards and one touchdown in nine games this season. He will be on bye in Week 10 before a Week 11 matchup against the Lions.

news.body: Ted Hurst III did not catch his lone target in the Buccaneers 16-0 win over the Falcons.
news.head: Ted Hurst III does not catch pass Sunday
news.impact: Baker Mayfield did not complete a single pass on Sunday. Hurst will remain off the fantasy radar when Emeka Egbuka is healthy.

news.body: Ted Hurst III failed to catch his only target in the Bucs' 43-13 win over the Panthers on Sunday.
news.head: Ted Hurst III shut out in win
news.impact: Hurst was put into the WR3 role after Emeka Egbuka was ruled out due to injury, but it amounted to nothing. He's a boom-bust play at best, and in almost every format, too risky to start.

news.body: Tee Higgins (hamstring) did not practice on Friday and is questionable for Sunday against the Saints.
news.head: Tee Higgins (hamstring) DNP Friday, questionable for Sunday
news.impact: Higgins was a surprise DNP on Friday, and his status for Sunday is now in doubt. He still has a chance to play, but fantasy managers will need to watch this closely. If Higgins is out, Andrei Iosivas and Dohnte Meyers could find some extra appeal, but Mike Gesicki would be a great start.

news.body: Tee Higgins caught two of his three targets for 43 yards and a touchdown in a 22-20 loss to the Commanders in Week 11's Monday night game.
news.head: Tee Higgins finds the end zone in Week 11
news.impact: Higgins was mostly quiet in the game despite Joe Burrow throwing for 300 yards. That being said, he made an excellent catch in the end zone on his 31-yard touchdown reception from Burrow in the second quarter.
