Higgins now has 55 catches for 867 yards and seven touchdowns through 10 games this year. He will be a solid fantasy WR1 in Week 12 vs. the Saints.

news.body: Tee Higgins caught 5-of-6 targets for 66 yards in Sunday's 38-18 win over the Pittsburgh Steelers.
news.head: Tee Higgins solid in win Sunday
news.impact: Cincinnati's offense was unstoppable in Sunday night's big win over the Steelers. Higgins wasn't able to fully take advantage of that, however, finishing with five catches for 66 yards over the course of the game. He will have some more less than impressive games moving forward, but his boom weeks have been frequent enough to make him a stellar starting option over the first half of the season.

news.body: Tee Higgins caught 5-of-6 targets for 32 yards and two touchdowns in a 34-17 win over the Falcons.
news.head: Tee Higgins hits pay dirt twice in Week 9 win
news.impact: Higgins did not see a ton of targets Sunday, but made the most of his opportunities by hauling in two touchdowns. Higgins has found the end zone in three straight games, including back-to-back multi-touchdown performances. Higgins and the Bengals will look to continue that momentum against the Steelers in Week 10.

news.body: Tetairoa McMillan returned to a limited practice on Friday.
news.head: Tetairoa McMillan (foot) limited in practice Friday
news.impact: McMillan was back after he sat out of practice on Thursday. He is trending towards being good to go for Monday's game against the Buccaneers.

news.body: Tetairoa McMillan did not practice on Thursday.
news.head: Tetairoa McMillan (foot) misses practice Thursday
news.impact: McMillan did not participate in Thursday's walkthrough. He will need to be monitored in practice on Friday and Saturday.

news.body: Tetairoa McMillan caught 6-of-9 targets for 71 yards and one touchdown in a 35-33 win over the Ravens.
news.head: Tetairoa McMillan finds the end zone in Week 11 win
news.impact: McMillan found the end zone on a seven yard reception in the second quarter, marking his fourth touchdown of the season. McMilan and the Panthers will take on Tampa Bay in a divisional matchup in Week 12.

news.body: Tetairoa McMillan caught 3-of-7 targets for 35 yards in a 20-17 win over the Saints.
news.head: Tetairoa McMillan hauls in three passes in Week 10
news.impact: McMillan led the team in targets with seven, but was only able to convert that into three receptions, his lowest total since Week 2. The 23-year-old will look to bounce back against Baltimore in Week 11.

news.body: Tez Johnson caught two of his three targets for 17 yards in the Buccaneers' 31-21 loss to the Lions in Week 11.
news.head: Tez Johnson catches two passes in Week 11
news.impact: Johnson has struggled to make an impact in the Tampa Bay offense of late, finishing with less than 35 receiving yards in four of his last five contests. The wideout can be left off rosters in all formats ahead of a Week 12 contest against the Carolina Panthers.

news.body: Tez Johnson caught two of his five targets for 76 yards in a 27-24 loss to the Bears in Week 9.
news.head: Tez Johnson leads Bucs in receiving in Week 9
news.impact: Johnson led the Buccaneers in receiving yards in the close loss on Sunday night. The veteran wideout did most of his damage on a 58-yard reception. Johnson will be on bye in Week 10 before he takes on the Lions in Week 11.

news.body: Tez Johnson did not see a target in the Buccaneers 16-0 win over the Falcons.
news.head: Tez Johnson does not see target Sunday
news.impact: Baker Mayfield attempted just three passes and did not complete any of them on Sunday. Johnson remains off the fantasy radar.

news.body: Tez Johnson caught both of his targets for 33 yards and a score in the Buccaneers' 43-13 win over the Panthers on Sunday.
news.head: Tez Johnson snags touchdown in win
news.impact: Johnson led the team in receiving yards and caught QB Baker Mayfield's only touchdown of the day in a game dominated by the running game. If Emeka Egbuka misses next week's game as well, Johnson is back in flex consideration. If Egbuka plays, it's fine to let Johnson go back to waivers.

news.body: Travis Hunter caught both of his targets for 16 yards in the Jaguars' 40-23 win over the Titans. On defense, he racked up five total tackles, including three solo tackles, a pass defended, and an interception.
news.head: Travis Hunter catches two passes in Week 10 win
news.impact: While he was once again limited on offense, on defense, he was great in the secondary. He managed to pick off Titans QB Cam Ward, as well as rack up a handful of tackles. He's not a great asset in regular skill-position leagues, but in IDP style, his dual-threat combo is amazing.

news.body: Travis Hunter did not catch his one target and gained five yards on one carry in Sunday's 42-7 win over the Colts.
news.head: Travis Hunter does little on offense in Week 8
news.impact: Hunter was involved on the offensive side of the ball early in Sunday's game, but the Jaguars' attack just ultimately did not need him in this blowout. Hunter instead made his significant contributions on defense. The two-way star has shown his play-making ability on offense, but his unpredictable usage makes him a very difficult fantasy play.

news.body: Travis Hunter caught 4-of-4 targets for 59 yards and a touchdown in Jacksonville's 34-31 loss to Houston.
news.head: Travis Hunter hits pay dirt in Week 6 loss
news.impact: Hunter had an amazing day on both sides of the ball, also tallying three tackles and an interception on defense. He set new season highs in receptions, yards, and scored his first touchdown of the season. He should how versatile he can be on offense, so it would not be a surprise to see the Jaguars attempt to get him more involved in the offense after the bye week.

news.body: Travis Hunter had one catch for eight yards and one carry for three yards in the Jaguars' 34-10 win over the Browns on Sunday. On defense, he had one solo tackle.
news.head: Travis Hunter quiet in win over Browns
news.impact: No matter if you play in offense only or in IDP leagues, Hunter is not a player you're happy with right now. His production and usage isn't that of a first-round NFL pick, especially at second overall. The Jaguars are content to use him as a gadget player, and until that changes, he needs to be off of fantasy radars unless you are in dynasty formats.

news.body: Tre' Harris caught both of his targets for 28 yards in a 27-24 loss to the Jets in Week 11.
news.head: Tre' Harris goes for 28 yards in Week 11
news.impact: Harris had a big game in Week 10 with Ladd McConkey sidelined but he took a backseat in Week 11 with McConkey back in uniform. The veteran wideout has caught 28 passes for 376 yards in nine games this season. He will now prepare to face the Patriots in Week 12.

news.body: Tre' Harris caught five passes for 86 yards in Sunday's 23-20 win over the Baltimore Ravens.
news.head: Tre' Harris leads team in receiving Monday
news.impact: Harris was by far Los Angeles' leading receiver on Monday night. He finished with 86 yards over the course of the night, which was 70 more than the second-leading receiver on the team. He will see less opportunities whenever Ladd McConkey (back) makes his return to the lineup, however.

news.body: Tre' Harris is off the injury report for Monday's game against the Ravens.
news.head: Tre' Harris (shoulder) off injury report
news.impact: Harris was able to get in a full practice on Friday. He remains off the fantasy radar in his current role.

news.body: Tre' Harris was a full participant in practice on Friday.
news.head: Tre' Harris (shoulder) logs full practice Friday
news.impact: Harris is on track to be good to go for Monday's game against the Ravens. He remains off the fantasy radar.

news.body: Tre Tucker caught two of 10 targets for 50 yards in the Raiders' 38-24 loss to the Broncos in Week 11.
news.head: Tre Tucker sees 10 targets in Week 11
news.impact: Tucker led Las Vegas with 10 targets but caught just 20% of them. And 39 of his 50 receiving yards came on one reception. Meanwhile, Jack Bech caught eight of nine targets for 88 yards and a touchdown. The opportunities were there for Tucker in Fernando Mendoza's second career start, but the lack of efficiency makes him a volatile starting piece in fantasy lineups.

news.body: Tre Tucker caught 1-of-2 targets for nine yards in the Raiders 21-13 loss against the Seahawks.
news.head: Tre Tucker catches one pass Sunday
news.impact: Tucker struggled in a tough matchup and with Fernando Mendoza making his first career start. It is unclear what his role will be moving forward with Mendoza now starting the rest of the season.

news.body: Tre Tucker caught 4-of-8 targets for 55 yards in the Raiders 38-17 loss against the 49ers.
news.head: Tre Tucker totals 55 yards Sunday
news.impact: The eight targets Tucker saw tied the team-high. He will remain a volatile WR3 heading into next week against the Seahawks.

news.body: Tre Tucker did not record a reception on his lone target in a 38-33 win over the Jets.
news.head: Tre Tucker held without a catch in Week 8 win
news.impact: Tucker's one target marks a new season low for the 25-year-old. Jalen Nailor was the only wide receiver on the roster that logged a catch in the high-scoring affair with the Jets. Tucker and the Raiders will take on the 49ers in Week 9.

news.body: Treylon Burks is off the injury report for Sunday's game against the Cardinals.
news.head: Treylon Burks (foot) off injury report for Week 12
news.impact: Burks has struggled the past couple of weeks. He will be an upside WR4 play for fantasy managers.

news.body: Treylon Burks caught two of his three targets for 30 yards in a 22-20 win over the Bengals in Week 11.
news.head: Treylon Burks goes for 30 yards in Week 11
news.impact: Burks was quiet, although he drew a pass interference flag on an end zone target in the second quarter, setting up Jacory Croskey-Merritt's one-yard touchdown run. Burks has caught 16 passes for 290 yards and two touchdowns in eight games this year. He will not be a recommended fantasy option in Week 12 vs. the Cardinals.

news.body: Treylon Burks is off the injury report for Monday's game against the Bengals.
news.head: Treylon Burks (foot) off injury report Monday
news.impact: Burks returned to practice on Saturday after he was absent on Friday. He'll be a borderline WR3/WR4 for fantasy managers.

news.body: Commanders WR Treylon Burks was back at practice on Saturday.
news.head: Treylon Burks (foot) returns to practice Saturday
news.impact: Burks missed practice on Friday. He is trending towards being good to go for Monday's game against the Bengals.

news.body: Tutu Atwell caught 1-of-2 targets for 31 yards in the Rams 34-6 win over the Cardinals.
news.head: Tutu Atwell hauls in one pass Sunday
news.impact: Atwell had one big gain of 31 yards from Matthew Stafford on the day. He remains a big play dependent WR4 for fantasy managers despite the Rams wide receiver room being banged up.

news.body: Tutu Atwell had two catches for 16 yards in Sunday’s win against the Commanders.
news.head: Tutu Atwell has two catches in win
news.impact: Atwell hasn’t been very involved in the Rams offense since they lost wide receiver Davante Adams. However, if Puka Nacua (knee) misses time, Atwell could hold desperation flex value in Week 10's matchup against the Cardinals.

news.body: Tutu Atwell caught 2-of-4 targets for 54 yards in Sunday's 24-9 win over the Los Angeles Rams.
news.head: Tutu Atwell racks up 54 yards Sunday
news.impact: The veteran wideout was able to leave his mark on Sunday's game. He racked up 54 yards on just two catches, although he wasn't able to get into the end zone on either of them. Fantasy managers shouldn't have high hopes for him moving forward.

news.body: Tutu Atwell caught 1-of-2 targets for 19 yards in Monday night's 28-6 win over the New York Giants.
news.head: Tutu Atwell held to one catch Monday
news.impact: The veteran wideout wasn't able to capitalize on the absence of Puka Nacua (hip) on Monday night, hauling in just one pass over the course of the night. He remains off of the fantasy radar for the foreseeable future.

news.body: Xavier Hutchinson caught 2-of-3 targets for only 13 yards in Thursday's 26-3 win over the Colts.
news.head: Xavier Hutchinson finishes with 13 yards in Week 11 win
news.impact: After scoring in three straight games, Hutchinson was disappointing for fantasy managers who hoped his hot streak would continue Thursday night. Hutchinson is consistently involved in the Texans' passing attack, but his ceiling is significantly limited in his current role. The fourth-year receiver has caught between 2 and 4 passes in all 10 games so far this season.

news.body: Xavier Hutchinson hauled in 4-of-9 targets for 58 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 27-24 loss to the Browns.
news.head: Xavier Hutchinson hits paydirt once again in Week 10
news.impact: Hutchinson has scored in each of the Texans' last three games, hauling in 10-of-20 targets for an average of around 35 yards in that span. Hutchinson has a limited ceiling, but he's a regular contributor to the Texans' offense and a trusted option for QB C.J. Stroud. Hutchinson has to be considered at least a Flex play in most league right now.

news.body: Xavier Hutchinson caught 3-of-5 targets for 29 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 44-22 win over the Los Angeles Chargers.
news.head: Xavier Hutchinson scores once in win Sunday
news.impact: Hutchinson was able to contribute for the Texans on Sunday, scoring a touchdown on one of his three catches in a win over the Chargers. Fantasy managers should not have high hopes for him moving forward, however.

news.body: Xavier Hutchinson caught 3-of-6 targets for 17 yards and a touchdown in the Texans 27-21 loss against the Giants.
news.head: Xavier Hutchinson hauls in touchdown Sunday
news.impact: Hutchinson hauled in one of the two touchdowns thrown by C.J. Stroud on the day. He remains off the fantasy radar.

news.body: Xavier Worthy caught 2-of-4 targets for 38 yards and a touchdown in a 34-7 win over Arizona.
news.head: Xavier Worthy hits pay dirt in Week 11
news.impact: Worthy hauled in a 18-yard touchdown pass in the fourth quarter to put the finishing touches on the win Sunday. This marked Worthy's first touchdown reception since Week 2. Worthy will look to continue to build on this momentum in a Week 12 matchup with Buffalo.

news.body: Xavier Worthy failed to catch any of his three targets in the Chiefs' 35-13 win over the Falcons in Week 10.
news.head: Xavier Worthy sees three targets in Week 10
news.impact: Worthy was an afterthought in the Kansas City passing attack, seeing less than six targets for the first time in six contests. The wideout will look to get back on track against the Arizona Cardinals in Week 11.

news.body: Xavier Worthy (hamstring) is without an injury designation for Sunday's game against the Atlanta Falcons.
news.head: Xavier Worthy (hamstring) without injury designation for Sunday
news.impact: Worthy is over his hamstring injury at this point and carries no injury designation heading into the weekend. He isn't a reliable week-to-week fantasy option at this point, but he could still put up a good performance if he's able to connect with QB Patrick Mahomes II on a big play at some point.

news.body: Chiefs head coach Andy Reid said he expects Xavier Worthy to practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Xavier Worthy (hamstring) expected to practice Wednesday
news.impact: Reid added that Worthy was “feeling pretty good" as he battles a hamstring injury.

news.body: Zay Flowers is off the injury report for Sunday's game against the Texans.
news.head: Zay Flowers (ankle) off injury report for Week 12
news.impact: Flowers will be a full-go for the Ravens. He will remain a borderline WR1/WR2 with Jacoby Brissett behind center.

news.body: Zay Flowers was a full participant in practice on Thursday.
news.head: Zay Flowers (ankle) logs full practice Thursday
news.impact: Flowers was upgraded after he was limited on Wednesday. He will be a full-go on Sunday against the Texans.

news.body: Zay Flowers caught 8-of-11 targets for 84 yards in a 35-33 loss to the Panthers.
news.head: Zay Flowers hauls in eight passes in Week 11 loss
news.impact: Flowers has quickly built a strong rapport with Jacoby Brissett in his first two starts with the Ravens. Flowers has 14 receptions for 171 yards on 18 targets with Brissett at the helm. Flowers and the Ravens will take on the Texans in Week 12.

news.body: Zay Flowers hauled in 6-of-7 targets for 74 yards in Monday night's 23-20 loss to the Los Angeles Chargers.
news.head: Zay Flowers racks up 74 yards in loss Monday
news.impact: Flowers was able to put up a respectable performance on Monday night. He finished with six catches for 74 yards, which left him with a decent fantasy total in PPR formats. His game-to-game outlook may be rocky moving forward, however, as fantasy managers can't expect QB Jacoby Brissett to continue to attempt 49 passes per game over the back half of the season.
